author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} commented on the verse of Allah {SWT},
the Exalted, "And prepare for them whatever force you can muster"
(Surah Al-Anfal; 8:60).
Imam {a.s} said: "Among it is dyeing with black”.
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} narrated;
“A man entered upon the Messenger of Allah {saws} with his beard dyed yellow (light
color), and the Messenger of Allah {saws} said to him, "How good this is."
Then he entered again after that with his beard dyed with henna (reddish color), and
the Messenger of Allah {saws} smiled and said: "This is better than the previous."
Then he entered again after having dyed it black, and the Prophet smiled and said:
"This is better than both of the previous”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى «® وَأَعِدُوا لَهُمْ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةِ » قَالَ «مِنْهُ اَلْخِضَابُ
بِالسِّوَادِ وَ إِنَّ رَجُلاً دَخَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ قَدْ صَفَّرَ لِحْيَتَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «مَا أَحْسَنَ هَذَا» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ هَذَا وَ قَدْ أَقْنَى بِالْحِنَّاءِ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
وَقَالَ «هَذَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْ ذَاكَ» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ قَدْ خَضَبَ بِالسَّوَادِ فَضَحِكَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «هَذَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْ ذَاكَ
وَ ذَاكَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 123 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 643
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} commented on the verse of Allah {SWT},
the Exalted, "And prepare for them whatever force you can muster"
(Surah Al-Anfal; 8:60).
Imam {a.s} said: "Among it is dyeing with black”.
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} narrated;
“A man entered upon the Messenger of Allah {saws} with his beard dyed yellow (light
color), and the Messenger of Allah {saws} said to him, "How good this is."
Then he entered again after that with his beard dyed with henna (reddish color), and
the Messenger of Allah {saws} smiled and said: "This is better than the previous."
Then he entered again after having dyed it black, and the Prophet smiled and said:
"This is better than both of the previous”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "A woman should not neglect herself, even if it means
wearing a necklace around her neck, Nor should She leave her hands without dyeing,
even if it is by lightly applying henna, even if She is elderly."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «لا يَنْبَغِي لِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تُعَطَّلَ نَفْسَهَا وَ لَوْ أَنْ تُعَلَّقَ فِي عُنْقِهَا قِلاَدَةً وَ لا يَنْبَغِي
لَهَا أَنْ تَدَعَ يَدَهَا مِنَ الْخِضَابِ وَ لَوْ أَنْ تَمْسَحَهَا بِالْحِنَّاءِ مَسْحاً وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِنَّةً.

chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"When nails are affected by Nuura (depilatory paste), they can change their
appearance, such that they may resemble the nails of the deceased. Therefore, there
is no harm in changing (their appearance)."

Scholar's Note:
The Imams have used wasmah (a natural dye), and dyeing with yellow (or light colors)
is considered the dye of faith. Dyeing dark is the dye of Islam, and dyeing with black is
both Islam, faith, and light.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ الْأَظَافِيرَ إِذَا أَصَابَثْهَا النُورَةُ غَيَّرَتْهَا حَتَّى أَنَّهَا تُشْبِهُ أَظَافِيرَ ٱلْمَوْتَى
فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِتَغْيِيرِهَا.
وقد خضب الأئمة عليهم السلام بالوسمة، والخضاب بالصفرة خضاب الايمان، والاقناء خضاب الاسلام وبالسواد إسلام
وإيمان ونور.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}:
"O’ Ali, spending a dirham on dyeing is better than spending a thousand dirhams in
other paths for the sake of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious. It has fourteen benefits:
it repels odors from the ears, improves eyesight, softens the nostrils, freshens breath,
strengthens the gums, removes ailments, reduces the whispering of Satan, brings joy
CLEANLINESS AND BEAUTIFICATION
to the angels, gladdens the believer, enrages the disbeliever, it is a form of adornment,
a fragrance, it makes Munkar and Nakir (the angels who question the dead in their
graves) feel shy, and it is a source of innocence (purity) in one's grave”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِعَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يَا عَلِيُّ دِرْهَمْ فِي الْخِضَابِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ
دِرْهَمِ فِي غَيْرِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ فِيهِ أَرْبَعَ عَشَرَةَ خَصْلَةً يَطْرُدُ الرِّيحَ مِنَ ٱلْأَذُنَيْنِ وَ يَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ وَ يُلَيِّنُ
اَلْخَيَاشِيمَ وَ يُطَيِّبُ النَّكْهَةَ وَ يَشُدُ اللَّثَةَ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالضَّنَى وَ يُقِلُ وَسْوَسَةَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ تَفْرَحُ بِهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ يَسْتَبْشِرُ
بِهِ الْمُؤْمِنُ وَ يَغِيظُ بِهِ الْكَافِرَ وَ هُوَ زِينَةٌ وَ طِيبٌ وَ يَسْتَجِي مِنْهُ مُنكَرْ وَ نَكِيرٌ وَ هُوَ بَرَاءَةٌ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Shaving the head outside of Hajj or 'Umrah is a form of humiliation for your enemies
and a source of beauty for you."
The meaning of these words the Prophet became apparent, when He described the
Khawarij, saying:
"They will exit from the religion as an arrow exits from the bow, and their sign is shaving
(the head) completely.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «حَلْقُ ٱلرَّاْسِ فِي غَيْرِ حَجِّ وَ لاَ عُمْرَةٍ مُثْلَةٌ لِأَعْدَائِكُمْ وَ جَمَالْ لَكُمْ.
وَ مَعْنَى هَذَا فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: جِينَ وَصَفَ الْخَوَارِجَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُمْ يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ آلدِّينِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ
السَّهَمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ وَ عَلاَمَتُهُمُ التَّسْبِيدُ.

"Washing the head with Al-khatmi (a type of herbal shampoo or a plant known as

"Washing the head with sidr (lote tree leaves) brings sustenance abundantly."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «غَسْلُ ٱلرَّأْسِ بِالسِّدْرِ يَجْلِبُ الرِّزْقَ جَلْباً».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Wash your heads with sidr (lote)
leaves, for every Muqarrab Angel and every Mursil Prophet has sanctified it. Whoever
washes their head with sidr leaves, Allah {SWT} will remove the whisperings of Shaytan
(Satan) from them for seventy days. Whoever is free from the whisperings of Shaytan
for seventy days will not disobey Allah {SWT}, and whoever does not disobey Allah {SWT}
will enter Paradise."
CLEANLINESS AND BEAUTIFICATION

Scholar's Note:
If one washes their feet after exiting the bath, it is permissible, and if they do not, it is
also permissible.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «اغْسِلَوا رُءُوسَكُمْ بِوَرَقِ السِّدْرِ فَإِنَّهُ قَدَّسَهُ كُلُّ مَلَكٍ مُقَرَّبِ وَ كُلّ نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٍ
وَ مَنْ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِوَرَقِ السِّدْرِ صَرَفَ اللهُ عَنْهُ وَسْوَسَةَ الشَّيْطَانِ سَبْعِينَ يَوْماً وَ مَنْ صَرَفَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ وَسَوَسَةَ
الشَّيْطَانٍ سَبْعِينَ يَوْماً لَمْ يَعْصِ اللهَ وَ مَنْ لَمْ يَعْصِ اللّهَ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
ومن غسل رجليه بعد خروجه من الحمام فلا بأس، وإن لم يغسلهما فلا بأس.
commentary:
If one washes their feet after exiting the bath, it is permissible, and if they do not, it is
also permissible.

text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Wash your heads with sidr (lote)
leaves, for every Muqarrab Angel and every Mursil Prophet has sanctified it. Whoever
washes their head with sidr leaves, Allah {SWT} will remove the whisperings of Shaytan
(Satan) from them for seventy days. Whoever is free from the whisperings of Shaytan
for seventy days will not disobey Allah {SWT}, and whoever does not disobey Allah {SWT}
will enter Paradise."

also permissible.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Hasan ibn Ali {a.s} came out of the bathhouse, and a man met him and
said:
"May your (backside) bathing be good."
Imam {a.s} said: "O’ fool, what business do you have mentioning the ‘backside’ here ?"
(The man) replied: "May your bath be pleasant"
Imam {a.s} said: "And if my bath is pleasant, what benefit is that to me?"
(The man) replied: "May your warm water be pleasant."
Imam {a.s} said: "Woe to you! Do you not know that 'Hamim' (hot water) is sweat?"
(The man) asked Him: “So what should I say?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Say: 'May what is purified from you be pleasant, and may what is
pleasant from you be purified.'".
text_ar:
وَ خَرَجَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مِنَ الْحَمَّامِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلْ طَابَ اِسْتِحْمَامُكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ
«يَا لُكَعُ وَ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِالإِستِ هَاهْنَا» فَقَالَ طَابَ حَمَامُكَ قَالَ «إِذَا طَابَ الْحَمَامُ فَمَا رَاحَةُ البَدَنِ مِنْهُ» فَقَالَ طَابَ
حَمِيمُكَ فَقَالَ «وَيُحَكَ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْحَمِيمَ الْعَرَقُ» قَالَ لَهُ كَيْفَ أَقُولُ قَالَ «قُلْ طَابَ مَا طَهُرَ مِنْكَ وَ طَهُرَ مَا
طَابَ مِنْكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 125 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 54 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 78

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "If your brother says to you after

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Disease is of three types, and the cure is of
three types : As for the ailments, they are blood, bile, and phlegm.
The cure for blood is with cupping, The cure for phlegm is the bathhouse,
And the cure for bile is walking."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «الدَّاءُ ثَلاثَةٌ وَ الدَّوَاءُ ثَلاَثَةٌ فَأَمَا الدَّاءُ فَالدَّمُ وَ ٱلْمِرَّةُ وَ الْبَلْغَمُ فَدَوَاءُ
اَلدَّمِ الْحِجَامَةُ وَ دَوَاءُ الْبَلْغَمِ الْحَمَّامُ وَ دَوَاءُ الْمِرَّةِ اَلْمَشِيُّ.

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There are three things that can weaken and potentially destroy the body:
Eating dried meat excessively,
Entering the bathhouse on a full stomach,
And marrying an elderly woman."
It is also reported: "Intimacy on a full stomach."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «ثَلاَثَةٌ يَهْدِمْنَ الْبَدَنَ وَ رُبَّمَا قَتَلْنَ أَكْلُ الْقَدِيدِ الْغَابِّ وَ دُخُولُ الْحَمَّامِ عَلَى
الْبِطْنَةً وَ نِكَاحُ الْعَجُوزِ.
وَ رُوِيَ: «الْعِشَيَانُ عَلَى الاِمْتِلاَءِ.

Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that
He said: "Trimming the nails on Jumu’ah provides protection from leprosy, insanity,
vitiligo, and blindness. If you do not need to trim them, then scrape or clean them."

تقليم الأظفار وأخذ الشارب والمشط
وَ رَوَى هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «تَقْلِيمُ ٱلْأَظْفَارِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ يُوْمِنُ مِنَ
اَلْجُذَامِ وَ الْجُنُونِ وَ الْبَرَصِ وَ الْعَمَى فَإِنْ لَمْ تَحْتَجْ فَحُكَهَا حَكَّاً.

text_en:
Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s}, that He said:
"Whoever trims their nails and mustache every Jumu’ah and says while doing so:
‘In the name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, and upon the Sunnah of Muhammad and
the family of Muhammad, may the blessings of Allah {SWT} be upon them,'
That no nail or hair clipping will fall except that Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious, will
record it as freeing a soul, and such a person will not become ill except for the illness
that causes their death."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الرّجِيمِ الْقَصِيرُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ أَظْفَارِهِ وَ شَارِبِهِ كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ
وَقَالَ جِينَ يَأْخُذُهُ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ بِاللَّهِ وَ عَلَى سُنَّةٍ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ لَمْ تَسْقُطْ مِنْهُ قُلاَمَةٌ وَ لا
جُزَازَةً إِلاَ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ بِهَا عِثْقَ نَسَمَةٍ وَ لَمْ يَمْرَضْ إِلاَّ مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي يَمُوتُ فِيهِ.

Al-Hussain ibn Abi al-'Ala asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
'What is the reward for someone who trims their moustache and cuts their nails every
Jumu’ah?'
Imam {a.s} replied: 'They will remain purified until the next Jumu’ah.'

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"May I be your ransom. It is said that no act brings down sustenance like ta'qeeb
(supplications and prayers) between the dawn and sunrise."
Imam {a.s} replied: "Indeed, but I will tell you something even better than that: trimming
the mustache and cutting the nails on Jumu’ah."

Scholar's Note:
It is also mentioned that trimming the nails on Thursday prevents eye ailments.

وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورِ لِلصَّادِقِ عَ: جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ يُقَالُ مَا اسْتُنْزِلَ الرَّزْقُ بِشَيْءٍ مِثلِ التَّعْقِيبِ فِيمَا
بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ «أَجَلْ وَ لَكِنْ أُخْبِرُكَ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَخْذِ الشَّارِبِ وَ تَقْلِيمِ ٱلْأَطْفَارِ يَوْمَ
اَلْجُمُعَةِ.
وتقليم الأظافر يوم الخميس يدفع الرمد.

Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"May I be your ransom. It is said that no act brings down sustenance like ta'qeeb

Imam {a.s} replied: "Indeed, but I will tell you something even better than that: trimming
the mustache and cutting the nails on Jumu’ah." Scholar's Note:

"Whoever trims their nails every Thursday, their child will not suffer from eye

text_en:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} was asked about the saying of
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious:
'Take your adornment at every place of worship.' (Surah Al-A’raf 7:31).
Imam {a.s} said: "Part of that includes combing one's hair before every prayer”.

ذَلِكَ التَّمَشُّطُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Combing the hair removes ailments, and combing the beard strengthens the teeth."

text_en:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said: "When you comb your
beard and head, pass the comb over your chest as well, for it removes worry and
lethargy”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا سَرَّحْتَ لِحْيَتَكَ وَ رَأْسَكَ فَأَمِرَ ٱلْمُشَطَ عَلَى صَدْرِكَ
فَإِنَّهُ يَذْهَبُ بِالْهَمِّ وَ الْوَنَا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever combs their beard
seventy times and counts it one by one will not be approached by Shaytan (Satan) for
forty days."

Scholar's Note:
Additionally, there is no harm in using combs made of ivory, kohl applicators, and
ointment containers.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ سَرَّحَ لِحْيَتَهُ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً وَ عَدَّهَا مَرَّةً مَرَّةً لَمْ يَقْرَبْهُ اَلشَّيْطَانُ أَرْبَعِينَ
يَوْماً،
اولا بأس بأمشاط العاج، والمكاحل والمداهن.
commentary:
Additionally, there is no harm in using combs made of ivory, kohl applicators, and
ointment containers.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Combing the hair removes
ailments," referring specifically to fever. In a narration by Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-
Barqi, it is stated: 'It removes fatigue,' meaning weakness.
Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, said:
'And do not slacken in My remembrance,' (Surah Taha 20:42) meaning do not become
weak.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «ٱلْمَشطْ يَذْهَبُ بِالْوَبَاءِ. وهو الحمى. وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
اَلْبَرْقِيَّ: «يَذْهَبُ بِالْوَنَا. وَ هُوَ الضَّعْفُ قَالَ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: «وَ لا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكْرِي» أُي لا تَضْعُفَا.

text_en:
Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"There are three things which, if a person understands them, they will not abandon:
trimming the hair, shortening the garment, and marrying bondwomen."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَ: «ثَلاَثُ مَنْ عَرَفَهُنَّ لَمْ يَدَعْهُنَّ جَزُّ الشَّعْرِ وَ تَشَمِيرُ التَّوْبِ وَ نِكَاحُ
اَلْإِمَاءِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said to some of his companions:
"Cut your hair short to reduce its dirt, pests, and grime; it will strengthen your neck,
improve your eyesight, and provide relief for your body."

وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ لِبَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ: «اِسْتَأْصِلْ شَعْرَكَ يَقِلُ دَرَنُهُ وَ دَوَابُهُ وَ وَسَخَهُ وَ تَغْلُظْ رَقَبَثُكَ
وَ يَجْلَو بَصَرَكَ وَ يَسْتَرِيحُ بَدَنُكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Whoever grows their hair should take good
care of it or cut it short."

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever grows their hair and does not part it, Allah {SWT} will part it with a saw of fire."

كان شعر رسول الله صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله وفرة لم يبلغ الفرق.

The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Trim your mustaches and let your beards
grow, and do not resemble the Jews."

text_en:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} once saw (looked) a man with a long beard, and
said: "It would have been better if he had trimmed his beard.
When the man heard this, he trimmed his beard to a moderate length. Then entered to
see the Prophet. When the Prophet saw him, He {saws} said: "This is how you should do
it. "

وَ نَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِلَى رَجُلٍ طَوِيلِ اللَّحْيَةِ فَقَالَ «مَا كَانَ هَذَا لَوْ هَيَّاً مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ » فَبَلَغَ
الرَّجُلَ ذَلِكَ فَهَيَّأً مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ بَيْنَ اللَّحْيَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَلَما رَآهُ قَالَ «هَكَذَا فَافْعَلُوا.

text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Gray hair at the front of the head is a sign of blessing, at the temples is a sign of
generosity, at the hair ends is a sign of courage, and at the nape of the neck is a sign of
ill-omen."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «الشَّيْبُ فِي مُقَدَّمِ الرّأْسِ يُمْنٌ وَ فِي الْعَارِضَيْنِ سَخَاءُ وَ فِي
الذَّوَائِبِ شَجَاعَةٌ وَ فِي الْقَفَا شُوْمٌ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The first person to have gray hair
was Ibrahim {a.s}, the Friend (Khaleel) of Allah {SWT}. When he saw a white strand in his
beard, He {a.s} said: 'O’ Archangel Jibril {a.s}, what is this?'
Archangel Jibril {a.s} said: "'This is dignity (Waqar).'
So Ibrahim {a.s} replied: 'O’ Allah {SWT}, increase me in dignity.'
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «أَوَّلُ مَنْ شَابَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْخَلِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ إِنَّهُ ثَنَى لِحْيَتَهُ فَرَأَى طَاقَةً
بَيْضَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا جَبْرَئِيلُ مَا هَذَا فَقَالَ هَذَا وَقَارٌ فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ اللَهُمَّ زِدْنِي وَقَارا.

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} says: "There is no harm in cutting gray
hair or plucking it, but cutting it is more beloved to me than plucking it."

Scholar's Note:
Their (Imams ) hadiths do not differ in one case to another because it comes from Allah
{SWT}, the Exalted; rather, it differs according to the variation of circumstances
text_ar:
الصَادِقَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «لا بَأْسَ بِجَزَّ الشَمَطِ وَ نَثْفِهِ وَ جَزْهُ أَحَبُ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَثْفِهِ.
فأخبارهم عليهم السلام لا تختلف في حالة واحدة لان مخرجها من عند اللّٰه تعالى ذكره، وإنما تختلف بحسب اختلاف
الأحوال،
commentary:
Their (Imams ) hadiths do not differ in one case to another because it comes from Allah
{SWT}, the Exalted; rather, it differs according to the variation of circumstances

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There are four traits of the Prophets: using fragrance, grooming with a razor, shaving
the body with Nuura (depilatory paste), and frequenting the mosque."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: «أَرْبَعْ مِنْ أَخْلاَقِ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ التَطَيُبُ وَ التَّنظِيفُ بِالْمُوسَى وَ حَلْقُ
الْجَسَدِ بِالنُّورَةِ وَ كَثْرَةُ الطَّرُوقَةِ.)

حَاجَتَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ وَ تَطَيِّبُوا بِأَطْيَبِ طِيبِكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The Messenger of Allah {saws}
entered upon a man from the Banu Hashim who was in the throes of death and said to
him: 'Say :
'There is no Allah {SWT} but Allah {SWT}, the Forbearing, the Generous; there is no God but
Allah {SWT}, the Most High, the Most Great; Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the seven
heavens and the Lord {AZJ} of the seven earths and what is in them and what is between
them and what is beneath them, and the Lord {AZJ} of the Mighty Throne. Peace be upon
the messengers, and all praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all the worlds.'
The man said thusly, and the Messenger of Allah {saws} said: 'Praise be to Allah {SWT} who
has saved him from the Fire.'".

Scholar's Note:
These words are known as the Words of Relief.
text_ar:
باب - غسل الميتة
قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ دَخَلَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ وَ هُوَ فِي
اَلنَّزْعِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «قُلْ: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّهُ الْحَلِيمُ اَلْكَرِيمُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللّهُ الْعَلِيّ الْعَظِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ
رَبِّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ «وَ سَلاَمٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ الْحَمْدُ
لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» » فَقَالَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ « الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي أَنْقَذَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ » »
وهذه الكمات هي كلمات الفرج.
commentary: These words are known as the Words of Relief.

them and what is beneath them, and the Lord {AZJ} of the Mighty Throne. Peace be upon
the messengers, and all praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all the worlds.'
The man said thusly, and the Messenger of Allah {saws} said: 'Praise be to Allah {SWT} who
has saved him from the Fire.'". Scholar's Note:
These words are known as the Words of Relief.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "You instruct your deceased to say
'There is no god but Allah {SWT}' at the time of death, while we instruct our deceased to
say 'Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws}.'".
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «إِنَّكُمْ ثُلَقَّنُونَ مَوْتَاكُمْ: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ ٱللَّهُ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَ نَحْنُ نُلَقِّنُ مَوْتَانَا مُحَمَّدٌ
رَسُولُ اللّهِ.

chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The believer is most rational
(aware) at the time of their death."

cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 132 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 238 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 456

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "During the time of the Messenger of Allah {saws}, a man
from the people of Medina was unable to speak due to throes of death.
The Messenger of Allah {saws} entered upon him and said:
'Say: There is no god but Allah {SWT}.'
But the man was unable to say it.
The Messenger of Allah {saws} repeated it to him, but he still could not say it.
At the head of this man was a woman, and He asked her: 'Is this man’s mother
present?'"
She said: 'Yes, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, I am his mother.'
He asked her: 'Are you pleased with him or displeased?'
She said: 'I am displeased with him.'
Messenger of Allah {saws} said to her: "I would like that you become pleased with him,"
She said: 'I am pleased with him for your sake, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}.'
He {saws} then said to him: "Say: There is no god but Allah {SWT}.'"
(the man) replied: "There is no god but Allah {SWT}."
Then He {saws} said: 'Say: O’ One who accepts the small and forgives the great, accept
from me the small and forgive the great, for You are Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.'
(the man) said it, and then Prophet {saws} asked him, 'What do you see?'
(the man) replied: 'I see two dark figures approaching me.'
He {saws} said: 'Repeat the supplication.'
So he repeated it, and Prophet {saws} said: 'What do you see now?'
(the man) replied: 'They have moved away from me, and two white figures have come
in, and the dark figures have left. I no longer see them, and the white figures are now
drawing close to me to take my soul.' The man then passed away thereafter.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ: «أُعْتُقِلَ لِسَانُ رَجْلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّا اللَّهُ » فَلَمْ يَقْدِرْ
عَلَيْهِ فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَلَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَيْهِ وَ عِنْدَ رَأْسِ الرَّجُلِ اِمْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا «هَلْ لِهَذَا
الرَّجُلِ أُمِّ» فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ أَنَا أُمُهُ فَقَالَ لَهَا «أَ فَرَاضِيَةٌ أَنْتِ عَنْهُ أَمْ لا» فَقَالَتْ لاَ بَلْ سَاخِطَةٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا
رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «فَإِنَّي أُحِبُ أَنْ تَرْضَي عَنْهُ» فَقَالَتْ قَدْ رَضِيتُ عَنْهُ لِرِضَاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ
لَهُ «قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّا اللَّهُ» فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ «قُلْ يَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ ٱلْيَسِيرَ وَ يَعْفُو عَنِ الْكَثِيرِ اِقْبَلْ مِنَّي الْيَسِيرَ وَ
أُعْفُ عَنَّي الْكَثِيرَ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُ الْغَفُورُ » فَقَالَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ «مَا ذَا تَرَى» فَقَالَ أَرَى أَسْوَدَيْنِ قَدْ دَخَلا عَلَيَ قَالَ
«أَعِدْهَا» فَأَعَادَهَا فَقَالَ «مَا ذَا تَرَى» فَقَالَ قَدْ تَبَاعَدَا عَنَّي وَ دَخَلَ أَبْيَضَانِ وَ خَرَجَ ٱلْأَسْوَدَانِ فَمَا أَرَاهُمَا وَ دَنَا
الْأَبْيَضَانِ مِنَّي الْآنَّ يَأْخُذَانٍ بِنَفْسِي فَمَاتَ مِنْ سَاعَتِهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the positioning of the deceased.
Imam {a.s} said: "Direct the soles of their feet toward the Qibla”.
text_ar: - وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ تَوْجِيهِ الْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ «اِسْتَقْبِلْ بِبَاطِنٍ قَدَمَيْهِ الْقِبْلَةَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 132 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 453 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 239 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 120

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} entered upon a man from the descendants of Abdul
Muttalib, while he was in the throes of death and was facing away from the Qibla.
The Prophet said: 'Direct him toward the Qibla, for when you do so, the angels will
approach him, and Allah {SWT}, the Mighty, will turn toward him with His face (attention).'
And he remained in that state until he passed away.”
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ وُلْدِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
وَ هُوَ فِي السُّوقِ وَ قَدْ وُجِّهَ لِغَيْرِ ٱلْقِبْلَةِ فَقَالَ «وَجَّهُوهُ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ فَإِنَّكُمْ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمْ ذَلِكَ أَقْبَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ
أَقْبَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ عَلَيْهِ بِوَجْهِهِ» فَلَمْ يَزَلْ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُقْبَضَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 133 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 195 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 297 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 36 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 228 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 453 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 230

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no one who is faced with death except that Iblis (Satan) sends some of his
devils to entice him toward disbelief and to cause him to doubt his faith until his soul
departs.
Therefore, when you are present with your dying ones, instruct them to bear witness
that there is no god but Allah {SWT} and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws}
until they pass away."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَحْضُرُهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ إِلاَّ وَكَلَ بِهِ إِبْليسُ مِنْ شَيَاطِينِهِ مَنْ يَأْمُرُهُ بِالْكُفْرِ
وَ يُشَكِّكُهُ فِي دِينِهِ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ نَفْسُهُ فَإِذَا حَضَرْثُمْ مَوْتَاكُمْ فَلَقُنُوهُمْ شَهَادَةَ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللّهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمّداً رَسُولُ
اَللّهِ حَتَّى يَمُوثُوا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said in his last sermon:
"Whoever repents a year before his death, Allah {SWT} will accept his repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A year is a long time; whoever repents a month before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A month is a long time; whoever repents a week before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A week is a long time; whoever repents a day before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A day is a long time; whoever repents an hour before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: “An hour is a long time; whoever repents before their soul reaches
here" - and he pointed to his throat - "Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي آخِرِ خُطْبَةِ خَطَبَهَا: «مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِسَنَةِ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ»
ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ السَّنَةَ لَكَثِيرَةٌ مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِشَهْرِ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّهْرَ لَكَثِيرٌ وَ مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ
بِجُمْعَةِ تَابَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْجُمْعَةَ لَكَثِيرَةٌ وَ مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِيَوْمِ تَابَ اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ »وَ إِنَّ يَوْماً
لَكَثِيرٌ وَ مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِسَاعَةٍ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ »وَ إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَكَثِيرَةُ وَ مَنْ تَابَ وَ قَدْ بَلَغَتْ نَفْسُهُ
هَذِهِ» وَ أَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ إِلَى حَلْقِهِ «تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 5, p. 1098 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 1, p. 431 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 461 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 16, p. 88 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol. 2, p. 44 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 15 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 1, p. 457 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 3, p. 355

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the words of Allah
{SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious:
"But repentance is not [accepted] of those who [continue to] do evil deeds up until,
when death comes to one of them, he says, 'Indeed, I repent now’."
(Surah An Nisa 4:18).
Imam {a.s} said: "That is when they witness the realities of the Hereafter."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ « وَ لَيْسَتِ التَّوْبَةُ لِلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّثَاتِ حَتَّى
إذا حَضَرَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قْالَ إِنَّي ثُبْتُ الْآنَ » قَالَ «ذَاكَ إِذَا عَايَنَ أَمْرَ الْآخِرَةِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
A man from the Bedouins, who had servants and camels, came to the
Messenger of Allah {saws} and said:
"O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, inform me about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Glorious: 'Those who believe and are conscious of Allah {SWT} - they will have good
news in this world and in the Hereafter'
(Surah Yunus 10:63-64)
The Prophet replied: "As for His {SWT} words, 'They will have good news in this world,' it
refers to the good dreams that a believer sees and is given glad tidings by them in this
world.
And as for 'and in the Hereafter,' it refers to the glad tidings a believer receives at the
time of death, that Allah {SWT} has forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave."
text_ar:
وَ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ رَجُلْ مِنْ أُهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ لَهُ حَشَمْ وَ جِمَالْ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي
عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: « الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَ كَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ "لَهُمُ الْبُشَرىٰ فِي الْحَيْاةِ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ )
فَقَالَ «أَمَّا قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى «) لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشرىٰ فِي الْحَيْاةِ الدُنْيَا » فَهِيَ الرُوْيَا الْحَسَنَةُ يَرَاهَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ فَيُبَشَّرُ بِهَا فِي
دُنْيَاهُ وَ أَمَّا قَوْلُ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: « وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ » فَإِنَّهَا بِشَارَةُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ يُبَشَّرُ بِهَا عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَنْ
اللهَ قَدْ غَفَرَ لَكَ وَ لِمَنْ يَحْمِلُكَ إِلَى قَبْرِكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 259 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, vol. 3, p. 39 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 58, p. 176 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 2, p. 309 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol. 6, p.
text_chunk:
A man from the Bedouins, who had servants and camels, came to the
Messenger of Allah {saws} and said:
"O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, inform me about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Glorious: 'Those who believe and are conscious of Allah {SWT} - they will have good
news in this world and in the Hereafter'
(Surah Yunus 10:63-64)
The Prophet replied: "As for His {SWT} words, 'They will have good news in this world,' it
refers to the good dreams that a believer sees and is given glad tidings by them in this
world.
And as for 'and in the Hereafter,' it refers to the glad tidings a believer receives at the
time of death, that Allah {SWT} has forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"It was said to the Angel of Death {a.s}, 'How do you seize souls while some are in the
west and others in the east at the same moment?'
He said: 'I summon them, and they respond to me.'
Imam {a.s} said: “Then, The Angel of Death, said:
'The world is like a bowl in front of me from which I take as I please, and the world is
like a coin in the palm of one of you, which you turn as you wish.'
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: «قِيلَ لِمَلَكِ ٱلْمَوْتِ عليه السلام، كَيْفَ تَقْبِضُ ٱلْأَرْوَاحَ وَبَعْضُهَا فِي الْمَغْرِبِ وَ
بَعْضُهَا فِي الْمَشرِقِ فِي سَاعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ فَقَالَ أَدْعُوهَا فَتُجِيبُني» قَالَ «فَقَالَ مَلَكْ ٱلْمَوْتِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ إِنَّ الدُنْيَا بَيْنَ
يَدَيَّ كَالْقَصْعَةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ أَحَدِكُمْ يَتَنَاوَلُ مِنْهَا مَا شَاءَ وَ الدُّنْيَا عِنْدِي كَالدِّرْهَمِ فِي كَفَّ أَحَدِكُمْ يُقَلَّبُهُ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 266 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 301 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, vol. 4, p. 390 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 144

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"No believer leaves this world except with contentment, for Allah {SWT}, Blessed and
Exalted, lifts the veil for them until they see their place in Paradise and what Allah {SWT}
has prepared for them there.
Then the world is shown to them as the best it could have been, and they are given the
choice, so they choose what is with Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Glorious, and they say,
'What do I need with the world and its trials?'
Therefore, instruct your dying with the Words of Relief (Kalimat E Faraj)."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَا يَخْرُجُ مُؤْمِنْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا إِلاّ بِرِضاً مِنْهُ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى يَكْشِفُ
لَهُ اَلْغِطَاءَ حَتَّى يَنْظُرَ إلَى مَكَانِهِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ مَا أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ فِيهَا وَ تُنصَبُ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا كَأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانَتْ لَهُ ثُمَّ يُخَيَّرُ
فَيَخْتَارُ مَا عِنْدَ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ يَقُولُ مَا أَصْنَعُ بِالدُّنْيَا وَ بَلاَئِهَا فَلَقُّنُوا مَوْتَاكُمْ كَلِمَاتِ الْفَرَجِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 245 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 460 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 3, p. 298

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"If I had reached Ikrimah at the time of his death, I would have benefited him."
When Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked (about this narration), Imam
{a.s} explained:
"He (Imam Al Baqir {a.s} would have instructed him (ikrimah) in what you are upon
(referring to the beliefs of faithful)”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لَوْ أَدْرَكْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ لَنَفَعْتُهُ» فَقِيلَ لِلصَادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ بِمَا
ذَا كَانَ يَنْفَعُهُ قَالَ «كَانَ يُلَقُّنُهُ مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Sudden death is an ease and relief for the
believer but a regretful taking for the disbeliever”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِنَّ مَوْتَ ٱلْفَجْأَةِ تَخْفِيفُ عَلَى ٱلْمُوْمِنِ وَ رَاحَةٌ وَ أَخْذَةُ أَسَفٍ عَلَى
اَلْكَافِرٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 112 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 205

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Death is the expiation for the sins of every believer."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: «ٱلْمَوْتُ كَفَارَةُ ذَنْبِ كُلَّ مُؤْمِنٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Amali Volume 1, p. 283 • Amali (by Al-Tusi) Vol. 1, p. 110 • Taʾwīl al-Āyāt, Part 1, p. 148 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 274 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 151 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 178 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 3, p. 541
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Death is the expiation for the sins of every believer."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"Indeed, between this world and the Hereafter, there are a thousand obstacles, the
easiest and least difficult of which is death."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِنَّ بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ أَلْفَ عَقَبَةٍ أَهْوَنُهَا وَ أَيْسَرُهَا ٱلْمَوْتُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 275

"Indeed, between this world and the Hereafter, there are a thousand obstacles, the
easiest and least difficult of which is death."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Indeed, Shaytan comes to one
of our followers at the time of their death, approaching from their right and from their
left to lead them astray from what they are upon. But Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Glorious, refuses this, and this is the meaning of Allah’s {SWT} words:
'Allah {SWT} will keep firm those who believe, with the firm word, in this worldly life and
in the Hereafter'" (Surah Ibrahim 14:27).
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَيَأْتِي الرَّجُلَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِنَا عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ
لِيُضِلْهُ عَمّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ فَيَأْبَى اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ذَلِكَ وَ ذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللّهِ تَعَالَى:
يُثَبِّتُ اللهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ »
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 258 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 3, p. 86 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 2, p. 541 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 7, p. 60

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "When a believer is at the
moment of death, tears may come to their eyes because, at that moment, they witness
the presence of the Messenger of Allah {saws} and they see what pleases them."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Do you not see that when a person sees what delights and
pleases them, tears come to their eyes and they smile?"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «فِي الْمَيَّتِ تَدْمَعُ عَيْنَاهُ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ مُعَايَنَةٍ رَسُولِ آللَّهِ صَلَّى
اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَيَرَى مَا يَسُرُّهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَمَا تَرَى الرَّجُلَ يَرَى مَا يَسُرُّهُ وَ مَا يُحِبُّ فَتَدْمَعُ عَيْنَاهُ وَ يَضْحَكُ.
cross_references: Asceticism, Part 1, p. 83 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 133 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 306 • Ma’ani al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 236 • Al-Muḥtaḍar, Part 1, p. 39 • Al-Fusul al- Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 303 • Madīnat Maʿājiz al-Aʾimma ʿAlayhim al-Salām, Part 3, p. 114 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 182 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 161

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "If you see a believer whose eyes
are fixed, the left eye tears up, the forehead perspires, the lips contract, and the
nostrils widen, then that is sufficient for you (as a sign of their passing)."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ: «إِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَ قَدْ شَخَصَ بِبَصَرِهِ وَ سَالَتْ عَيْنُهُ ٱلْيُسْرَى وَ رَشَحَ جَبِينُهُ وَ
تَقَلَّصَتْ شَفَتَاهُ وَ اِنْتَشَرَ مَنْخِرَاهُ فَأَيَّ ذَلِكَ رَأَيْتَ فَحَسْبُكَ بِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 161

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The sign of a believer when death approaches is that their face becomes whiter than
its usual color, their forehead perspires, and tears flow from their eyes like drops. This
is the sign of the departure of their soul. As for the disbeliever, their soul exits from
their mouth forcefully, like the froth of a camel or the expiration of a donkey."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ آيَةَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ أَنْ يَنْيَضَ وَجْهُهُ أَشَدَّ مِنْ بَيَاضِ لَوْنِهِ وَ
يَرْشَحَ جَبِينُهُ وَ يَسِيلَ مِنْ عَيْنَيْهِ كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّمُوعِ فَيَكُونُ ذَلِكَ آيَةَ خُرُوجِ رُوحِهِ وَ إِنَّ الْكَافِرَ تَخْرُجُ رُوحُهُ سَلاً مِنْ
شِدْقِهِ كَزَبَدِ الْبَعِيرِ كَمَا تَخْرُجُ نَفْسُ الْحِمَارِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 225 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 290 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 161

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
It is reported:
"The last taste that a person experiences at the time of death is the taste of grapes."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ آخِرَ طَعَمِ يَجِدُهُ الْإِنْسَانُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ طَعَمُ الْعِنَبِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 275

It is reported:
"The last taste that a person experiences at the time of death is the taste of grapes."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} was asked how the Angel of Death takes the soul
of a believer.
He {saws} replied: "Indeed, the Angel of Death stands before the believer at the time of
their death in the position of a humble servant before their master. He and his
companions do not approach until the believer is greeted with peace and given glad
tidings of Paradise."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلْى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَيْفَ يَتَوَفِّى مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الْمُؤْمِنَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ مَلَكَ ٱلْمَوْتِ لَيَقِفُ مِنَ
الْمُؤْمِنِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ مَوْقِفَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ مِنَ الْمَوْلَى فَيَقُومُ وَ أَصْحَابُهُ لَا يَدْنُونَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَبْدَأَهُ بِالتَّسْلِيمِ وَ يُبَشَّرَهُ
بِالجَنَّةٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 266 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 167 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 225 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 290
text_chunk:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} was asked how the Angel of Death takes the soul
of a believer.
He {saws} replied: "Indeed, the Angel of Death stands before the believer at the time of
their death in the position of a humble servant before their master. He and his
companions do not approach until the believer is greeted with peace and given glad
tidings of Paradise."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"When a believer is at the point of death, the Angel of Death reassures (secures) them;
without this, they would not be able to remain settled."

Scholar's Note:
when death approaches, The Prophet {saws} and the divinely appointed proofs (Imams,
peace be upon them all) are made present to the dying person so that they may see
them. If the person is a believer, they will see them in a pleasing state; if they are not a
believer, they will see them in a way they dislike. Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, has said:
"Then why, when the soul reaches the throat, and you are at that moment looking on,
and We are nearer to him than you, but you do not see" (Sural Al Waqi’ah 56:83-85)
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ الْمُومِنَ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ وَثَقَهُ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ فَلَوْ لا ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَسْتَقِرَّ.
وما من أحد يحضره الموت إلا مثل له النبي صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله والحجج صلوات اللّٰه عليهم أجمعين حتى يراهم، فإن كان
مؤمنا يراهم بحيث يحب، وإن كان غير مؤمن يراهم بحيث يكره، وقال اللّٰه تبارك وتعالى: '''
فلولا إذا بلغت الحلقوم
وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون ونحن أقرب إليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "When the soul reaches the throat, the person
(believer), is shown their place in Paradise. They say, 'Return me to the world so that I
may inform my family about what I see.' But it is said to them, 'There is no way for that.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّهُ إِذَا بَلَعَتِ ٱلنَّفْسُ الْحُلْقُومَ أَرِيَ مَكَانَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَيَقُولُ رُدُّونِي إِلَى الدُّنْيَا
حَثَّى أُخْبِرَ أَهْلِي بِمَا أَرَى فَيُقَالُ لَهُ لَيْسَ إِلَى ذَلِكَ سَبِيلٌ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the different Qur'anic
verses that mention Allah {SWT} taking souls at the time of death, about the words of
Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Allah {SWT} takes the souls at the time of their death,"
(Surah Az-Zumar 39:42)
And about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted:
"Say, 'The Angel of Death, who is put in charge of you, will take you,'" (Surah As-Sajdah
32:11)
And about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted:
"Those whom the angels take while they are in a state of purity," (Surah An-Nahl 16:32)
And "Those whom the angels take while they are wronging themselves," (Surah An-
Nahl 16:28)
And about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Our messengers angels take them,"
(Surah Al-An’am 6:61)
And about His words:
"And if you could see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved." (Surah
Al-Anfal 8:50)
The questioner further inquired about how this process works, given that countless
souls may die simultaneously across the world
Imam Al-Sadiq replied: "Indeed, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, has appointed for the
Angel of Death assistants among the angels who seize souls. They function similarly
to a chief of police who has deputies among the people whom he sends out to fulfil
tasks on his behalf. Thus, the angels take the souls, and the Angel of Death receives
them from the angels along with what he himself seizes. Ultimately Allah {SWT}, Blessed
and Exalted, takes them from Angel of Death”.
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ « اَللهُ يَتَوَفِّى ٱلْأَنْفُسَ جِينَ مَوْتِهَا » وَ عَنْ
قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ « قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ مَلَكْ ٱلْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ » وَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: « الَّذِينَ
تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ » وَ « الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ ٱلْمَلائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهمْ •» وَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ:
«® تَوَفِّثَهُ رُسُلُنَا » وَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: « وَ لَوْ تَرِىٰ إِذْ يَتَوَفِّى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الْمَلائِكَةُ » وَ قَدْ يَمُوتُ
فِي السَّاعَةِ الْوَاجِدَةِ فِي جَمِيعِ الْآفَاقِ مَا لا يُحْصِيهِ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَكَيْفَ هَذَا فَقَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى
جَعَلَ لِمَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ أَعْوَاناً مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ يَقْبِضُونَ الْأَرْوَاحَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ صَاجِبِ الشُّرْطَةِ لَهُ أَعْوَانٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَبْعَثُهُمْ فِي
حَوَائِجِهِ فَتَتَوَفَّاهُمُ ٱَلْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ يَتَوَفَّاهُمْ، مَلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ مِنَ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ مَعَ مَا يَقْبِضُ هُوَ وَ يَتَوَفَّاهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ مِنْ
مَلَكِ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 266 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 302 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol. 2, p. 427 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 144 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 51 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 223 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 7, p. 204 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 287

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the follower of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} will see him in three places that bring
joy: at the time of death, at the Sirat (the bridge over Hell), and at the Hawdh (the
Pool)."

Scholar's Note:
And the Angel of Death repels Shaytan from those who consistently perform their
prayers and instructs them to declare the testimony that there is no god but Allah {SWT}
and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws} during that great moment.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «إِنّ وَلِيَ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَرَاهُ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ مَوَاطِنَ حَيْتُ يَسُرُّهُ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَ
عِنْدَ الصَّرَاطِ وَ عِنْدَ اَلْحَوْضِ.
وملك الموت يدفع الشيطان عن المحافظ على الصلاة ويلقنه شهادة أن لا إله إلا اللّٰه وأن محمد رسول اللّٰه في تلك الحالة
العظيمة.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali {a.s} said: "When a servant is in their
last day of this world and their first day of Hereafter; their wealth, children, and deeds
are presented before them.
They turn to their wealth and say, 'By Allah {SWT}, I was extremely attached and miserly
with you; what do you have for me now?'
It (wealth) replies, 'Take your shroud from me.'
Then they turn to their children and say, 'By Allah {SWT}, I loved you and I was protective
over you; what do you have for me now?'
They (children) respond, 'We will carry you to your grave and bury you in it.'
Then they turn to their deeds and say, 'By Allah {SWT}, you were burdensome upon me,
and I was reluctant toward you; what do you have for me now?'
It (deeds) replies, 'I am your companion in your grave and on the Day of Resurrection
until you and I are presented before your Lord {AZJ}.'".
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «إِنَّ ٱلْعَبْدَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي آخِرٍ يَوْمِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَ أَوَّلِ يَوْمِ مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ مُثَلَ
لَهُ مَالُهُ وَ وُلْدُهُ وَ عَمَلْهُ فَيَلْتَفِتُ إِلَى مَالِهِ وَ يَقُولُ وَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ عَلَيْكَ لَحَرِيصا شَجِيحاً فَمَا ذَا عِنْدَكَ فَيَقُولُ خَذْ
مِنِّي كَفَنَكَ فَيَلْتَفِتُ إِلَى وُلْدِهِ فَيَقُولُ وَ اللّهِ إِنَّي كُنْتُ لَكُمْ مُحِبّا وَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَمُحَامِياً فَمَا ذَا عِنْدَكُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ
نُؤَدِّيكَ إِلَى حُفْرَتِكَ وَ نُوَارِيكَ فِيهَا فَيَلْتَفِتُ إِلَى عَمَلِهِ فَيَقُولُ وَ اللّهِ إِنَّكَ كُنْتَ عَلَيَّ لَثَقِيلاً وَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ فِيكَ لَزَاهِداً
فَمَا ذَا عِنْدَكَ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا قَرِيئَكَ فِي قَبْرِكَ وَ يَوْمِ حَشَرِكَ حَتَّى أُعْرَضَ أَنَا وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever dies on a Jumu’ah or on the night of Jumu’ah, Allah {SWT} will relieve him from
the punishment of the grave."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: («مَنْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ لَيْلَةَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ رَفَعَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَذَابَ ٱلْقَبْرِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 269
text_chunk:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:

the punishment of the grave."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever dies between the
decline of the sun on Thursday until the decline of the sun on will be safe from the
squeezing (pressure) of the grave."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ مَاتَ مَا بَيْنَ زَوَالِ الشَمْسِ مِنْ يَوْمِ ٱلْخَمِيسِ إِلَى زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ يَوْمٍ
الْجُمُعَةً أَمِنَ مِنْ ضَعْطَةِ الْقَبْرِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 269

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "Jumu’ah night is a radiant night,
and its day is a radiant day. There is no day on the face of the earth on which the sun
sets with more people freed from the Fire than on Jumu’ah.
Whoever dies on Jumu’ah, Allah {SWT} will write for them freedom from the punishment
of the grave, and whoever dies on Jumu’ah will be freed from the Fire."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: « لَيْلَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ لَيْلَةٌ غَرَّاءُ وَ يَوْمُهَا يَوْمٌ أَزْهَرُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ يَوْمٌ
تَغْرُبُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ أَكْثَرَ مُعْتَقاً مِنَ النَّارِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ مَنْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بَرَاءَةً مِنْ عَذَابٍ
الْقَبْرِ وَ مَنْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ أُعْتِقَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 269

Whoever dies on Jumu’ah, Allah {SWT} will write for them freedom from the punishment

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "There is no dying person for
whom Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious, does not return their sight, hearing, and
intellect at the moment of death, whether they are giving a final will or not. This is the
'relief of death' that is referred to as the comfort of passing away."

Scholar's Note:
And if a person in the throes of death moves their hands, feet, or head, they should not
be restrained, as is done by ignorant people. If their soul's departure becomes severe,
they should be moved to the place where they used to pray or on it. They should not be
touched during this time. When they have passed, it is appropriate to say : "Indeed, we
belong to Allah {SWT}, and to Him we return."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَا مِنْ مَيّتٍ يَحْضُرُهُ ٱلْوَفَاةُ إِلَّ رَدْ اللَهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَصَرِهِ وَ سَمْعِهِ وَ
عَقْلِهِ آخِذاً لِلْوَصِيَّةِ أَوْ تَارِكاً وَ هِيَ الرَّاحَةُ اَلْتِي يُقَالُ لَهَا رَاحَةُ الْمَوْتِ.
وإذا حرك الانسان في حالة النزع يديه أو رجليه أو رأسه فلا يمنع من ذلك كما يفعل جهال الناس، فإذا اشتد عليه نزع
روحه حول إلى مصلاه الذي كان يصلي فيه أو عليه. ولا يمس في تلك الحالة فإذا قضى نحبه فيجب أن يقال: " إنا لله
وإنا إليه راجعون.
commentary:
And if a person in the throes of death moves their hands, feet, or head, they should not
be restrained, as is done by ignorant people. If their soul's departure becomes severe,
they should be moved to the place where they used to pray or on it. They should not be
touched during this time. When they have passed, it is appropriate to say : "Indeed, we
belong to Allah {SWT}, and to Him we return."
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "There is no dying person for
whom Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious, does not return their sight, hearing, and
intellect at the moment of death, whether they are giving a final will or not. This is the
'relief of death' that is referred to as the comfort of passing away." Scholar's Note:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked: "For what reason is the
deceased washed (given ghusl)?"
Imam {a.s} said: "The drop that he was created from, exits from their eyes or their mouth,
and no one leaves this world until they see their place in either Paradise or the Fire."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: لِأَيَّ عِلَّةِ يُغْسَلُ الْمَيِّتُ قَالَ «تَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ النَّظْفَةُ الْتِي خُلِقَ مِنْهَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ
عَيْنَيْهِ أَوْ مِنْ فِيهِ وَ مَا يَخْرُجُ أُحَدٌ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَتَّى يَرَى مَكَانَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ أَوْ مِنَ النَّارِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever dies in the state of Ihram (consecration for Hajj or Umrah), Allah {SWT} will
resurrect them reciting the Talbiyah."

text_en:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever dies in one of the two sanctuaries (Makkah or Madinah) will be safe from the
Great Terror on the Day of Resurrection."

text_en:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"If a woman dies during childbirth (in her postpartum state), no record of her deeds
will be unfurled on the Day of Resurrection."

"The death of a stranger (someone who dies away from their home) is martyrdom."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Imam {a.s} said regarding the words of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious:
"No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in which land it will die"
(Surah Luqman 31:34).
Imam {a.s} said; "From one step to another."

وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: فِي قَوْلِ آللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: «® وَ مَا تَدْرِي نَفْسُ مَا ذَا تَكْسِبُ غَداً وَ مَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيَّ
أرضِ تَمُوثُ
فَقَالَ «مِنْ قَدَمِ إِلَى قَدَمِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"When a believer dies, the places on earth where they used to worship Allah {SWT}, the
door through which their deeds would ascend, and their place of prostration weep for
them."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا مَاتَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِ بِقَاعُ ٱلْأَرْضِ الَّتِي كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِيهَا وَ اَلْبَابُ
الَّذِي كَانَ يَصْعَدُ مِنْهُ عَمَلْهُ وَ مَوْضِعُ سُجُودِهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever considers tomorrow
as part of their lifespan has not kept good company with death."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ عَدَّ غَداً مِنْ أَجَلِهِ فَقَدْ أَسَاءَ صُحْبَةَ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 139 • Tahaf al-Uqool, Part 1, p. 49 • Al-Majāzāt al- Nabawiyyah, Part 1, p. 198 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 191 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 437 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 74, p. 153

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} entered upon Khadijah {s.a} while she was
experiencing what she {s.a} was enduring (her final illness).
He {saws} said to her: "In spite of what we see happening to you, Khadijah {s.a}, when you
meet your co-wives in the Hereafter, give them my greetings of peace."
She {s.a} asked: "Who are they, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}?"
He {saws} replied: "Mary {s.a}, the daughter of Imran {a.s}, and Kulthum {s.a}, the sister of Musa
{a.s}, and Asiya {s.a}, the wife of Pharaoh."
She {s.a} responded: "With pleasure, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}."
text_ar:
وَ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ وَ هِيَ لِمَا بِهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ «بِالرَّغْمِ مِنَّا مَا نَرَى بِكِ يَا
خَدِيجَةُ فَإِذَا قَدِمْتٍ عَلَى ضَرَائِرِكِ فَأَقْرِئِيهِنَّ السَّلامَ» فَقَالَتْ مَنْ هُنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ قَالَ » مَرْيَمُ إِبْنَةُ عِمْرَانَ وَ كُلْثُمُ
أُخْتُ مُوسَى وَ آسِيَةُ اِمْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ » قَالَتْ بِالرِّفَاءِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ.

chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «ضَمِنْتُ لِسِنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ بِصَدَقَةٍ فَمَاتَ فَلَهُ ٱلْجَنَّةُ وَ رَجْلٌ خَرَجَ
يَعُودُ مَرِيضاً فَمَاتَ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَ رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ مُجَاهِداً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمَاتَ فَلَهُ اَلْجَنَّةُ وَ رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ حَاجًا فَمَاتَ
فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَ رَجلٌ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَمَاتَ فَلَهُ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ' وَ رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ فِي جِنَازَةٍ رَجْلٍ مُسْلِمِ فَمَاتَ فَلَهُ اَلْجَنَّةُ

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The honor of the deceased is their hastening (to be buried)."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «كَرَامَةُ ٱلْمَيَّتِ تَعْجِيلُهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 140 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 282 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 474

The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "I do not want to find among you a man whose
deceased loved one died at night and he waits until morning, or a man whose
deceased loved one died during the day and he waits until night. Do not wait for the
rising or setting of the sun with your dead. Hurry them to their resting places; may Allah
{SWT} have mercy on you."
The people replied: "And may Allah {SWT} have mercy on you, O’ Messenger of Allah
{saws}."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لا أَلْفِيَنَّ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلاً مَاتَ لَهُ مَيّتٌ لَيْلاً فَانْتَظَرَ بِهِ الصُّبْحَ وَ لا رَجُلاً
مَاتَ لَهُ مَيِّتُ نَهَاراً فَانْتَظَرَ بِهِ اللَّيْلَ لا تَنْتَظِرُوا بِمَوْتَاكُمْ طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَ لَاَ غُرُوبَهَا عَجِّلُوا بِهِمْ إِلَى مَضَاجِعِهِمْ
يَرْحَمُكُمُ اللَّهُ» فَقَالَ النَّاسُ وَ أَنتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ يَرْحَمُكَ اللّهُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 137 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 140 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 427 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 281 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 471

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "In what Musa ibn Imran {a.s}
privately spoke to his Lord {AZJ}, the Mighty and Glorious,
Musa {a.s} said: 'O’ Lord {AZJ}, what is the reward for visiting the sick?'
Allah {SWT} replied: 'I will appoint an angel to visit them in their grave until the Day of
Resurrection.'
Musa {a.s} asked: 'O’ Lord {AZJ}, what about the one who washes the deceased?'
Allah {SWT} replied: 'I will cleanse them of their sins as on the day their mother gave birth
to them.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «كَانَ فِيمَا نَاجَى بِهِ، مُوسَى بْنُ عِمْرَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَبَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ أَنْ قَالَ يَا
رَبِّ مَا بَلَغَ مِنْ عِيَادَةِ الْمَرِيضِ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ قَالَ أُوَكِّلُ بِهِ مَلَكاً يَعُودُهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ إِلَى مَحْشَرِهِ قَالَ يَا رَبَّ فَمَا لِمَنْ غَسَلَ
الْمَوْتَى قَالَ أَغْسِلُهُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ كَيَوْمَ وَلَدَثْهُ أَمُّهُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever washes a deceased believer and fulfils the trust in that act, Allah {SWT} will
forgive them." It was asked: "How does one fulfil the trust in this matter?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "By not disclosing what they see and maintaining their duty until the
deceased is buried."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «مَنْ غَسَلَ مَيّتاً مُؤْمِناً فَأَدَّى فِيهِ الْأَمَانَةَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ» قِيلَ وَ كَيْفَ يُؤْدِي فِيهِ الْأَمَانَةَ
قَالَ «لاَ يُخْبِرُ بِمَا يَرَاهُ وَ حَدُّهُ إِلَى أَنْ يُدْفَنَ الْمَيِّثُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Any believer who washes the
body of another believer and says while turning it:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, this is the body of Your believing servant; You have taken their soul from
it and separated them from each other, so forgive, forgive, forgive,'
Allah {SWT} will forgive the washer's sins for a year, except for major sins."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «أَيُمَا مُؤْمِنٍ غَسَّلَ مُؤْمِناً فَقَالَ إِذَا قَلْبَهُ: اللّهُمَّ هَذَا بَدَنْ عَبْدِكَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ وَ قَدْ
أَخْرَجْتَ رُوحَهُ مِنْهُ وَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَهُمَا فَعَفْوَكَ عَفْوَكَ عَفْوَكَ إِلَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ ذُنُوبَ سَنَةٍ إِلاَّ الْكَبَائِرَ.

body of another believer and says while turning it:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, this is the body of Your believing servant; You have taken their soul from
it and separated them from each other, so forgive, forgive, forgive,'
Allah {SWT} will forgive the washer's sins for a year, except for major sins."

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no believing servant who washes a deceased believer and says while washing
them:
'O’ Lord {AZJ}, Your forgiveness, Your forgiveness,' except that Allah {SWT} forgives them."

وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدِ مُؤْمِنٍ يَغْسِلُ مَيّتاً مُؤْمِناً وَ يَقُولُ وَ هُوَ يَغْسِلُهُ رَبٌّ عَفْوَكَ عَفُوَكَ
إلاَّ عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever washes a deceased person and conceals and keeps secret what they see,
they will emerge from their sins like the day their mother gave birth to them."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ غَسَّلَ مَيّتاً فَسَتَرَ وَ كَتَمَ خَرَجَ مِنَ ٱلذُنُوبِ كَيَوْمَ وَلَدَثْهُ أُمْهُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar wrote to Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s}
asking:
"What is the prescribed amount of water for washing the deceased, as it has been
narrated that the junub (one in a state of major ritual impurity) bathes with six ratls of
water and the menstruating woman with nine ratls of water ? Is there a prescribed
amount of water for washing the deceased?"
And Imam {a.s} replied in his own handwriting, saying: "The prescribed washing of the
deceased is to continue until they are purified, if Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, wills."

Scholar's Note:
This response was among a series of his responses that I possess in his handwriting
on a document.
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَارُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: كَمْ حَدُّ ٱلْمَاءِ الَّذِي يُغْسَلُ
بِهِ الْمَيِّثُ كَمَا رَوَوْا أَنّ الْجُنُبَ يَعْتَسِلُ بِسِتَّةِ أَرْطَالٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ وَ الْحَائِضَ بِتِسْعَةِ أَرْطَالِ فَهَلْ لِلْمَيَّتِ حَدُّ مِنَ ٱلْمَاءِ
اَلَّذِي يُغْسَلْ بِهِ فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «حَدُّ غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ يُغْسَلُ حَتَّى يَطْهُرَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى.
وهذا التوقيع في جملة توقيعاته عندي بخطه عليه السلام في صحيفة.
commentary:
This response was among a series of his responses that I possess in his handwriting
on a document.

Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Water should not be heated for washing the deceased."

text_en:
It is also narrated in another hadith: "Except if it is a cold winter, in which case,
you should protect the deceased as you would protect yourself."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Do not leave your deceased alone, for Shaytan may disturb them within their body."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «لاَ تَدَعَنَّ مَيِّتَكَ وَحْدَهُ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَعْبَثُ بِهِ فِي جَوْفِهِ.

chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about
washing the deceased in an open space.
Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no issue with it, but if they are covered with a curtain (for
privacy), that is more beloved to me."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الْمَيَّتِ يُغْسَلُ فِي الْفَضَاءِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ وَ
إِنْ سُتِرَ بِسِثْرٍ فَهُوَ أُحَبُّ إِلَيَّ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
whether it is permissible for a man to look at his wife when She dies or to wash her if
there is no one else to wash her, and likewise, if a woman can do the same for her
husband when he dies. Imam {a.s} replied:
"There is no issue with that. It is usually the woman's family who may dislike her
husband seeing something he would dislike about her."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ أيَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَنُظُرَ إِلَى اِمْرَأَتِهِ جِينَ تَمُوتُ
أَوْ يَغْسِلُهَا إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهَا مَنْ يَغْسِلُهَا وَ الْمَرْأَةِ هَلْ تَنُظُرُ إلَى مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ مِنْ زَوْجِهَا جِينَ يَمُوتُ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ
بِذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَهْلُ الْمَرْأَةِ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ زَوْجُهَا إِلَى شَيْءٍ يَكْرَهُونَهُ مِنْهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 157 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 439 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 198 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 295 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 528

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about about who
performed the washing (Ghusl) of (the body of) Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}?"
Imam {a.s} said: "The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} performed
her washing because She was a ‘Al-Siddiqah’ (the most truthful and righteous one) ;
and her ghusl is not permitted except by a ‘Al-Siddiq’ (truthful and righteous person)."

Scholar's Note:
And whoever touches a piece of the body of a dead human devoured by animals; if he
has touched a bone, he must perform ghusl (ritual purification), but if there is no bone
present, there is no obligation for ghusl.
And whoever touches a dead creature must wash his hands, but he is not required to
perform the wash of touching; this obligation applies only to humans.
If someone touches a dead person before they have cooled (while their body is still
warm), they are not required to perform ghusl. However, if they touch them after the
body has cooled, they must perform ghusl. If the person is touched after the deceased
has been washed (ritually purified), there is no ghusl required.
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا ٱلسَلامُ مَنْ غَسَلَهَا فَقَالَ «غَسَلَهَا أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
الأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ صِدِّيقَةً لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيَغْسِلَهَا إِلَّ صِدِّيقٌ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Touching a deceased person at the time of their death and after their washing, and
kissing them, is not an issue”.

Scholar's Note:
If one's clothing comes into contact with the body of the deceased, then they must
wash whatever part of the clothing was touched.
When preparing the deceased, the person washing starts by preparing the shroud.
They begin with a sheet (namat), spreading it out, then placing a "habrah" (a specific
cloth) and sprinkling some powdered perfume (dharirah) on it.
Next, they spread out the izar (waist cloth) on top of the habrah, sprinkling more of the
powdered perfume, then place the shirt (Qamis) on top of the izar, again sprinkling the
powdered perfume.
They take two fresh, green palm branches (Jaridatayn), each the length of
approximately a forearm, and if they are the length of an arm or a span, there is no
issue.
He writes on the Izar (wrap), Qamis (shirt), the habrah, and the two branches:
"So-and-so bears witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}."
They then wrap all of it together.
text_ar:
باب - باب المس الميتة
ومن مس قطعة من جسد أكيل السبع فعليه الغسل إن كان فيما مس عظم وما لم يكن فيه عظم فلا غسل عليه في مسه،
ومن مس ميتة فعليه أن يغسل يديه وليس عليه الغسل إنما يجب ذلك في الانسان وحده، ومن مس ميتا قبل الغسل
بحرارته فلا غسل عليه، وإن مسه بعدما يبرد فعليه الغسل، ومن مسه بعدما يغسل فليس عليه غسل.
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَسُ ٱلْمَيّتِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ وَ بَعْدَ غُسْلِهِ وَ ٱلْقُبْلَةُ لَيْسَ بِهَا بَأْسٌ.
ومن أصاب ثوبه جسد الميت فعليه أن يغسل ما أصاب الثوب منه. وغاسل الميت يبدأ بكفنه فيقطعه، يبدأ بالنمط فيبسطه
ويبسط عليه الحبرة وينثر عليه شيئا من الذريرة، ويبسط الإزار على الحبرة وينثر عليه شيئا من الذريرة، ويبسط القميص
على الإزار وينثر عليه شيئا من الذريرة، ويأخذ جريدتين من النخل خضراوين رطبتين، طول كل واحدة قدر عظم الذراع،
وإن كانت قدر ذراع فلا بأس أو شبر فلا بأس، ويكتب على إزاره وقميصه وحبره والجريدتين: " فلان يشهد أن لا إله إلا
الله " ويلفها جميعا.

They then wrap all of it together.

text_ar:
وضع الجريدتين
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ عِلّةِ الْجَرِيدَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ يَتَجَافَى عَنْهُ اَلْعَذَابُ مَا دَامَتْ رَطْبَةً.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} passed by a grave where its occupant was being
punished. He requested a palm branch, split it into two halves, and placed one at the
head and the other at the feet of the grave.
It is narrated that the person in the grave was Qays ibn Fahd al-Ansari (in another
narration: Qays ibn Qumayr)
When asked why he placed the branches,
He {saws} replied: "Indeed, the punishment is lessened as long as they remain green."
text_ar:
وَ مَرّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى قَبْرٍ يُعَذَّبُ صَاحِبُهُ فَدَعَا بِجَرِيدَةٍ فَشَقَّهَا نِصْفَيْنِ فَجَعَلَ وَاحِدَةً
عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ وَ الْأُخْرَى عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ.وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ صَاحِبَ الْقَبْرِ كَانَ قَيْسَ بْنَ فَهْدِ ٱلْأَنْصَارِيّ. وَ رُوِيّ: « قَيْسَ بْنَ قُمَيْرٍ
» وَأَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهُ لِمَ وَضَعْتَهُمَا فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُ اَلْعَذَابُ مَا كَانَتَا خَصْرَاوَيْنِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 144 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 387

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about placing the palm
branch (jareedah) in the grave,
Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no issue (with it)”.

Scholar's Note:
It means that if Jaridatayn were found after the deceased has been buried in their grave
or if someone is present from whom taqiyya is necessary, and thus it is not possible
that the Jaridatayn be placed inside the shroud as reported; instead, they should be
placed with the deceased however possible.
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْجَرِيدَةِ تُوضَعُ فِي الْقَبْرِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ.
يعني إن لم توجد إلا بعد حمل الميت إلى قبره أو يحضره من يتقيه فلا يمكنه وضعهما على ما روي، فيجعلهما معه حيث
أمكن
commentary:
It means that if Jaridatayn were found after the deceased has been buried in their grave
or if someone is present from whom taqiyya is necessary, and thus it is not possible
that the Jaridatayn be placed inside the shroud as reported; instead, they should be
placed with the deceased however possible.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Ali ibn Bilal wrote to Abu Al-Hasan al-Third, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi
{a.s}:
"A man dies in a land where there are no palm trees. Is it permissible to use something
from other trees instead of the palm branch?
It has been narrated from your forefathers {a.s} that 'the punishment is averted as long
as the two palm branches remain fresh, and that it benefits both the believer and the
disbeliever.'"
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is permissible to use fresh branches from another tree."

Scholar's Note:
And if people of opposing beliefs are present during the washing of the deceased,
efforts should be made to ensure that the deceased is washed according to the rites
of a believer, and the placement of the branches should be concealed from them.
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ عَلِيْ بْنُ بِلاَلِ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: الرَّجُلُ يَمُوتُ فِي بِلاَدِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا نَخْلٌ فَهَلْ
يَجُوزُ مَكَانَ اَلْجَرِيدَةِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ غَيْرِ النَّخْلِ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ آبَائِكُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «أَنَّهُ يَتَجَافَى عَنْهُ
الْعَذَابُ مَا دَامَتِ الْجَرِيدَتَانِ رَطْبَتَيْنِ وَ أَنَّهَا تَتْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنَ وَ الْكَافِرَ » فَأَجَابَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ «يَجُوزُ مِنْ شَجَرٍ آخَرَ
رَظبٍ.
ومتى حضر غسل الميت قوم مخالفون وجب أن يقع الاجتهاد في أن يغسل غسل المؤمن وتخفى الجريدة عنهم.
commentary:
And if people of opposing beliefs are present during the washing of the deceased,
efforts should be made to ensure that the deceased is washed according to the rites
of a believer, and the placement of the branches should be concealed from them.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
It was narrated from Yahya ibn 'Abbad al-Makki that He said:
"I heard Sufyan al-Thawri asking Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about 'al-
takhdir' (placing green branches).
Imam {a.s} replied: 'A man from the Ansar died, and the Messenger of Allah {saws} was
informed of his death. He said to those from the man's relatives who were responsible
for him, "Place greenery (al-takhdir) on your companion. How few are those who will
be adorned with greenery on the Day of Resurrection."'
Sufyan asked: 'What is al-takhdir?'
Imam {a.s} said: "A green palm branch that is placed from the base of the hands to the
base of the collarbone."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادِ الْمَكِّيَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيَّ. يَسْأَلُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ التَّخْضِيرِ
فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ ٱلْأَنْصَارِ هَلَكَ فَأْوذِنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِمَوْتِهِ فَقَالَ لِمَنْ يَلِيهِ مِنْ قَرَابَتِهِ «خَضِّرُوا
صَاحِبَكُمْ مَا أَقَلَ الْمُخَضَّرِينَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ » قَالَ وَ مَا التَّخْضِيرُ فَقَالَ «جَرِيدَةُ حَضْرَاءُ تُوضَعُ مِنْ أَصْلِ ٱلْيَدَيْنِ
إلَى أَصْلِ التَّرْقُوَةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
palm branch that is placed with the deceased.
Imam {a.s} replied: "It benefits both the believer and the disbeliever”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْجَرِيدَةِ الَّتِي تَكُونُ مَعَ الْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ «تَنْفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَ
وَ الْكَافِرَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Zurarah said: I asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}: "Why is a palm
branch placed with the deceased?"
Imam {a.s} said:
"The punishment and accounting (in the grave) are averted from them as long as the
branch remains fresh.
The entire accounting and punishment occur in a single day and a single moment -
during the time it takes for the deceased to be placed in the grave and for the people
to return.
The two palm branches were placed for this reason, so no punishment or accounting
will afflict the deceased after they have dried up, if Allah {SWT} wills."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ زُرَارَةْ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَرَأَيْتَ ٱلْمَيّتَ إِذَا مَاتَ لِمَ تُجْعَلُ مَعَهُ الْجَرِيدَةُ فَقَالَ «يَتَجَافَى
عَنْهُ الْعَذَابُ وَ الْحِسَابُ مَا دَامَ الْعُودُ رَطْباً إِنَّمَا الْحِسَابُ وَ الْعَذَابُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَوْمِ وَاحِدٍ فِي سَاعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ قَدْرَ مَا
يُدْخَلُ الْقَبْرَ وَ يَرْجِعُ الْقَوْمُ وَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَتِ السَّعَفَتَانِ لِذَلِكَ فَلاَ يُصِيبُهُ عَذَابٌ وَ لاَ حِسَابٌ بَعْدَ جُفُوفِهِمَا إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ
تَعَالَى.
