author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Be meticulous in choosing the shrouds, for they will be resurrected in them."
text_ar:
التكفين وآدابه
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «تَنَوَّقُوا فِي الْأَكْفَانِ فَإِنَّهُمْ يُبْعَثُونَ بِهَا.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 149 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 146 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 449 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 69 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 374 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 2, p. 140 • Wasail Al- Shia, Part 3, p. 39 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 39 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 340 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 7, p. 43

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Make the shrouds of your deceased good, for they are their adornment."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «أَجِيدُوا أَكْفَانَ مَوْتَاكُمْ فَإِنَّهَا زِينَثُهُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 148 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al- A’mal, Part 1, p. 197 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 301 • Sulwat al-Hazin, Part 1, p. 254 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 69 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 373 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 39 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 40 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 312

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "If you shroud the deceased, and
you are able to include in their shroud a garment that they used to pray in and it is
clean, then do so. It is recommended that they be shrouded in what they used to pray
in”.

Scholar's Note:
Additionally, it is not permissible to shroud the deceased in linen or silk, but only in
cotton.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِذَا كَفَّنْتَ ٱلْمَيَّتَ فَإِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي كَفَنِهِ ثَوْبٌ كَانَ يُصَلِّي
فِيهِ نَظِيفاً فَافْعَلْ فَإِنَّهُ يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يُكَفَّنَ فِيمَا كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ.
ولا يجوز أن يكفن الميت في كتان ولا إبريسم، ولكن في القطن.
commentary:
Additionally, it is not permissible to shroud the deceased in linen or silk, but only in
cotton.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Linen was used by the Children
of Israel for shrouding, while cotton is for the Ummah (community) of Muhammad."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «اَلْكَتَانُ كَانَ لِبَنِي إسْرَائِيلَ يُكَفَّنُونَ بِهِ وَ الْقُطْنُ لِأُمَّةٍ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who had
purchased part of the covering of the Kaaba (Kiswah) and used some of it to fulfil a
need, while some of it remained with him. He was asked whether it was permissible
to sell the remaining part.
Imam {a.s} said: "He may sell what he wants, give away what he does not need, use it,
and seek its blessings."
He was then asked if it was permissible to shroud a deceased person in it
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ اَلثَالِثُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ ثِيَابٍ تُعْمَلُ بِالْبَصْرَةِ عَلَى عَمَلِ الْعَصْبِ الْيَمَانِيَّ مِنْ قَزّ وَ قُطْنٍ
هَلْ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يُكَفِّنَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَى فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ الْقُطْنُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الْقَزِّ فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
وَ سُئِلَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ اِشتَرَى مِنْ كِسْوَةِ الْكَعْبَةِ شَيْئاً فَقَضَى بِبَعْضِهِ حَاجَتَهُ وَ
بَقِيَ بَعَضُهُ فِي يَدِهِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ بَيْعُهُ فَقَالَ «يَبِيعُ مَا أَرَادَ وَ يَهَبُ مَا لَمْ يُرِدْهُ وَ يَسْتَنْفِعُ بِهِ وَ يَطلُبُ بَرَكَتَهُ» قِيلَ أ

text_chunk:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who had
purchased part of the covering of the Kaaba (Kiswah) and used some of it to fulfil a
need, while some of it remained with him. He was asked whether it was permissible
to sell the remaining part.
Imam {a.s} said: "He may sell what he wants, give away what he does not need, use it,
and seek its blessings."
He was then asked if it was permissible to shroud a deceased person in it
Imam {a.s} said: "No."

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The shirt (Qamis) for the deceased should be without cuffs and without buttons."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about whether a man
should be shrouded in his shirt (Qamis).
Imam {a.s} said: "Remove its buttons."
I asked: "And the sleeves?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No, that is only necessary if it is made new for him, in which case it
should have no sleeves. However, if it is an already-worn garment, only the buttons
need to be removed."

Scholar's Note:
After the shrouding is prepared, the deceased is placed on the washing platform facing
the Qiblah, and the shirt is removed from above down to the waist, leaving it in place
until the washing is complete to cover the 'awrah’ (private parts). If there is no shirt, a
covering is placed over the private parts.
He gently and softly extends his fingers; if it becomes difficult (due to rigor mortis), he
leaves it.
The hands are passed gently over the abdomen, then washing begins.
He begins with the hands: The hands are washed three times with water containing
sidr (lotus leaves).
He wraps a cloth around his own left hand and places some of the ‘Hirad ‘ (type of soap
alkali plant/cleansing agent) on it, and he reaches his hand under the garment
(covering the privates) and another person pours water from above to his navel,
washing his front and back (of privates) without cutting off the water.
Then he washes his head and beard with the lather (froth) of sidr, followed by three
washings with water. The deceased is not seated during the process.
The body is turned to the left side to expose the right side, and the right arm is extended
along the body. The body is washed three times with water from head to toe.
The process is then repeated on the left side ; he turns him to his right side so that his
left side becomes visible, and he extends his left hand to his left side where he has
reached, then he washes him with three pots from his head to his foot.
After the washing, the abdomen is gently massaged, and a second washing is
performed with water mixed with a small amount of camphor, similar to the first wash.
Then he rinses the vessels containing the camphor water and a third washing with pure
water is performed without massaging the abdomen again.
During the washing, say the supplication:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, Your pardon," and if this is done, Allah {SWT} forgives the
deceased.
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ الْقَمِيصُ أَيُكَفَّنُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ «اِقْطَعْ أَزْرَارَه» قُلْتُ وَ كُمَّهُ
قَالَ «لَا إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ إِذَا قُطِعَ لَهُ وَ هُوَ جَدِيدٌ لَمْ يُجْعَلْ لَهُ أَكْمَامُ فَأَمَا إِذَا كَانَ ثَوْباً لَبِيساً فَلاَ يُقْطَعُ مِنْهُ إِلَّ ٱلْأَزْرَارُ.
فإذا فرغ غاسل الميت من أمر الكفن وضع الميت على المغتسل مستقبل القبلة ونزع القميص من فوقه إلى سرته ويتركه
إلى أن يفرغ من غسله ليستر به عورته فإن لم يكن عليه قميص ألقى على عورته ما يسترها به ويلين أصابعه برفق، فإن
تصعبت عليه تركها، ويسمع يده على بطنه مسحا رفيقا، ثم يبدأ بيديه فيغسلهما بثلاث حميديات بماء السدر، ثم يلف على
يده اليسرى خرقه يجعل عليها شيئا من الحرض - وهو الأشنان - ويدخل يده تحت الثوب ويصب عليه غيره الماء من
فوق إلى سرته، ويغسل قبله ودبره ولا يقطع الماء عنه، ثم يغسل رأسه ولحيته برغوة السدر، وبعده بثلاث حميديات، ولا
يقعده، ثم يقلبه إلى جانبه الأيسر ليبدو له الأيمن، ويمد يده اليمنى على جنبه الأيمن إلى حيث بلغت، ثم يغسله بثلاث
حميديات من قرنه إلى قدمه ، ولا يقطع الماء عنه، ثم يقلبه إلى جانبه الأيمن ليبدو له الأيسر، ويمد يده اليسرى على جنبه
الأيسر إلى حيث بلغت، ثم يغسله بثلاث حميديات من قرنه إلى قدمه، ولا يقطع الماء عنه، ثم يقلبه عن ظهره، ويمسح
بطنه مسحا رفيقا ويغسله مرة أخرى بماء وشئ من جلال الكافر مثل الغسلة الأولى، ثم يخضخض الأواني التي فيها الماء
ويغسله الثالثة بماء قراح ولا يمسح بطنه ثالثة، ويقول عند غسله: " اللهم عفوك عفوك " فإنه من فعل ذلك عفى اللّٰه عنه.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Archangel Jibril {a.s}, brought to the Prophet Muhammad {saws} an ounce of
camphor from Paradise. An ounce in this context is equivalent to forty dirhams. The
Prophet {saws} divided it into three parts: one part for himself, one part for Imam Ali {a.s},
and one part for Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}.

Scholar's Note:
For someone who cannot afford the weight of thirteen dirhams and one-third of
camphor, the deceased should be embalmed with four mithqals (about 14 grams), If
that is not possible, at least one mithqal (about 3.5 grams) should be used, as it is
necessary.
The Hunut (anointing with camphor) of a deceased man and a deceased woman is the
same, and it is disliked that he use incense or follow the body with a censer, but the
shroud is to be incensed (there is no harm in that).
The camphor is to be daubed/applied to his eyes, nostrils, ears, lips, hands, knees,
and all his joints, as well as on the places of prostration. If there is any remaining, it is
placed on the chest.
After completing the third washing of the deceased, the washer should wash their
hands from the elbows to the fingers and cover the deceased with a cloth to dry the
water.
The water from the washing of the deceased must not be disposed of in a latrine or
well ; it should instead be directed to drains or a pit.
The deceased's nails should not be clipped, nor their mustache trimmed, nor any hair
cut. If anything falls from the body, it should be included with the shroud.
The washer then performs ablution, followed by a full-body wash, before placing the
deceased in the shroud.
Two palm stalks are placed with the deceased : one by the collarbone touching the
skin and extending over the right side, and the other at the hip on the left side, between
the shirt and the lower garment.
The deceased is then wrapped in a shroud, with the left side folded over the right and
vice versa. If desired, the upper shroud can be placed after the deceased is put in the
grave, and they are then wrapped in a cloth, with the turban not tied like an Arab’s
customary style, but rather having its ends placed on the chest.
Before putting on the shirt, cotton mixed with ground fragrant herbs is placed around
the lower body. Cotton is also placed over the front, with the legs pressed together and
the thighs bound tightly with the lower garment to prevent anything from leaving the
body.
When the shrouding is complete, the embalming (Hunut) described earlier is
performed. The body is then placed on a bier and carried to the grave.
No one should say "Be gentle with him" or "Have mercy on him," nor strike their thighs
in mourning, lest their reward is lost.
If anything leaves the body after washing, the washing is not repeated; instead, the
affected area of the shroud is cleaned until placed in the grave. If any discharge occurs
in the grave, the affected part of the shroud is to be trimmed, and one of the other
garments should be laid over the other.
text_ar:
أَنَّ جَبْرَئِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِأُوقِيَّةِ كَافُورٍ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ الْأُوقِيَّةُ أَرْبَعُونَ دِرْهَماً
فَجَعَلَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَثلاَثِ ثُلْثاً لَهُ وَ ثُلْثاً لِعَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ ثُلْثاً لِفَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ.
ومن لم يقدر على وزن ثلاثة عشر درهما وثلث كافورا حنط الميت بوزن أربعة مثاقيل، فإن لم يقدر فمثقال، لا أقل منه
لمن وجده. وحنوط الرجل والمرأة سواء غير أنه يكله أن يجمر أو يتبع بمجمرة و لكن يجمر الكفن، ويجمل الكافور على
بصره وأنفه وفي مسامعه وفيه ويديه وركبتيه ومفاصله كلها وعلى أثر السجود منه ، فأن بقي منه شئ جعل على صدره.
فإذا فرغ الغاسل من الغسلة الثالثة فليغسل يديه من المرفقين إلى الأصابع و ألقى على الميت ثوبا ينشف به الماء عنه. ولا
يجوز أن يدخل الماء الذي ينصب عن الميت من غسله في بئر كنيف، وليكن ذلك في بلاليع أو حفيرة. ولا يجوز أن يقلم
أظافيره، ولا يجز شاربه، ولا شيئا من شعره، فإن سقط منه شئ جعل معه في أكفانه، ثم يغتسل الغاسل يبده بالوضوء ثم
يغتسل، ثم يضع الميت في أكفانه ويجعل الجريدتين معه، إحداها من عند الترقوة يلصقها بجلده ويمد عليه قميصه من

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever shrouds a believer, it is as if they have guaranteed their clothing until the
Day of Resurrection. And whoever digs a grave for a believer, it is as if they have
prepared for them a suitable dwelling until the Day of Resurrection."

Scholar's Note:
Regarding a person who dies in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah), one washing
suffices for both removing the state of impurity and the washing of the deceased, as
these two obligations converge into a single sanctity.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ كَفَّنَ مُؤمِناً فَكَأَنَّمَا ضَمِنَ كِسْوَتَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَ مَنْ حَفَرَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ قَبْراً
فَكَأَنَّمَا بَوَّأَهُ بَيْتاً مُوَافِقاً إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
والجنب إذا مات غسل غسلا وحدا يجزي عنه لجنابته ولغسل الميت لأنهما حرمتان اجتمعتا في حرمة واحدة.
commentary:
Regarding a person who dies in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah), one washing
suffices for both removing the state of impurity and the washing of the deceased, as
these two obligations converge into a single sanctity.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Abu al-Jaroud asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who
passed away: Should his nails be trimmed, his armpit hair plucked, or his pubic hair
shaved if he had been bedridden for a long period? Imam {a.s} said: "No."

Scholar's Note:
Regarding a woman who has a miscarriage, if the fetus is fully formed, it should be
washed, embalmed, shrouded, and buried. If it is not fully formed, it does not require
washing and is to be buried with its blood. The criterion for a fetus being fully formed
is when it reaches four months (from conception).
The obligatory shroud (Kafan) consists of three pieces: a shirt (Qamis), a loincloth
(izar), and an outer covering (lifafah). The turban and cloth used for binding are not
considered part of the required shroud, but for those who wish to add more, it is
permissible to use up to five cloths.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ أَبُو الْجَارُودِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُتَوَفَّى أَتُقَلّمُ أَظَافِيرُهُ وَ يُنْتَفُ إِبْطَاهُ وَ تُحْلَقُ عَانَتْهُ
إِنْ طَالَتْ بِهِ مِنَ الْمَرَضِ فَقَالَ «لا.
وإذا أسقطت المرأة وكان السقط تاما غسل حنط وكفن ودفن، وإن لم يكن تاما فلا غسل عليه ويدفن بدمه، وحد تمامه
إذا أتى عليه أربعة أشهر.
والكفن المفروض ثلاثة: قميص وإزار ولفافة سوى العمامة والخرقة فلا يعدان من الكفن فمن أحب أن يزيد زاد لفافتين
حتى يبلغ العدد خمسة أثواب فلا بأس.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
"The Prophet, was shrouded in three garments: two pieces of Yemeni cloth
known as "Zafariyyah" and a garment made of cotton ‘Kursaf’ cloth."
text_ar:
وَ كُفِّنَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثُوَابٍ فِي بُرْدَتَيْنِ ظَفِرِيَّتَيْنِ مِنْ ثِيَابِ الْيَمَنِ وَ ثَوْبٍ كُرْسُفٍ
وَ هُوَ ثَوْبُ قُطْنِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 152 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 362 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 12

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
It is reported that the Prophet Muhammad {saws} was embalmed with a mithqal
(a specific weight) of musk in addition to camphor.
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ حُنَّطَ بِمِثْقَالِ مِسْكِ سِوَى ٱلْكَافُورِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 152 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 316

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "My father {a.s} wrote in his will
that I should shroud him in three garments: one of them being a Yemeni cloth (hibarah)
that he used to wear for Jumu’ah prayers, along with another cloth and a shirt
(Qamis)."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «كَتَبَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ أَنْ أُكَفَّنَهُ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثوَابِ أَحَدُهَا بُرْدٌ لَهُ
جِبَرَةٌ كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ وَ ثَوْبٌ آخَرُ وَ قَمِيصْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "My father {a.s} wrote in his will
that I should shroud him in three garments: one of them being a Yemeni cloth (hibarah)
that he used to wear for Jumu’ah prayers, along with another cloth and a shirt
(Qamis)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who dies and
whether he can be shrouded in three garments without a shirt (Qamis).
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with that, but having a shirt is more preferred to
me."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ أَيُكَفَّنُ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِغَيْرِ قَمِيص قَالَ «لا
بَأُسَ بِذَلِكَ وَ الْقَمِيصُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيّ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
about a woman who dies in a state of postpartum bleeding (nifas).
Imam {a.s} said: "She is washed just like a pure woman is washed, as is the case for a
menstruating woman or someone in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah). They are
washed with one washing."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا مَاتَتْ فِي نِفَاسِهَا كَيْفَ تُفَسَّلْ
قَالَ «تُغَسَّلُ مِثْلَ مَا تُغَسَّلُ الطَّاهِرَةُ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْحَائِضُ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْجُنْبُ إِنَّمَا يُغَسَّلُ غُسْلاً وَاجِداً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Abu Al-Hasan al-Thalith, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s} was asked
whether musk and incense (bukhoor) should be brought near the deceased.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
text_ar: - وَسُبِلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: هَلْ يُقَرَّبُ إِلَى الْمَيَّتِ الْمِسْكُ وَ الْبَخُورُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If a woman dies in a state of postpartum bleeding (nifas) and her bleeding is heavy,
She is washed up to the navel using a leather garment or something similar.
Then She is cleaned thoroughly, and cotton is placed in the front and back (private
areas), and She is shrouded afterward."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا مَاتَتْ نُفَسَاءَ وَ كَثُرَ دَمُهَا أُدْخِلَتْ إِلَى السُّرَّةِ فِي الْأَدَمِ أَوْ مِثْلِ الْأَدَمِ
وَ تُنَظَّفُ ثُمَّ يُحْشَى الْقُبُلُ وَ الدُّبُرُ ثُمَّ تُكَفَّنُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 153 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 334

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a woman who
passes away among a group of men with no male relative (mahram) present. Should
they wash her while She remains clothed?
Imam {a.s} replied: "If they do that, it will be burdensome for them. Rather, they should
wash only her hands."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ مَعَ رِجَالٍ لَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ ذُو مَحْرَمِ هَلْ يُفَسِّلُونَهَا وَ عَلَيْهَا تِيَابُهَا
فَقَالَ «إِذاً يُدْخَلَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَكِنْ يَغْسِلُونَ كَفِّيْهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Abi Ya’fur asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a
man who dies while traveling in the company of women, with no other men present.
What should they do?
Imam {a.s} replied: "They should wrap him in his clothes and bury him without washing
him."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَغْفُورِ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ فِي السِّفَرِ مَعَ النَّسَاءِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعْنَ
بِهِ قَالَ «يَلْفُفْنَهُ لَفّا فِي ثِيَابِهِ وَ يَدْفِنَّهُ وَ لا يُفَسَّلْنَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Imam {a.s} replied: "They should wrap him in his clothes and bury him without washing

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a woman who
dies while traveling, with no male relative (mahram) or other women present.
Imam {a.s} replied: "She should be buried as She is, in her clothes”.
He (Halabi) asked; Regarding a man who dies with only women present and no other
men.
Imam said: "They should bury him as he is, in his clothes."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ الْحَلَبِيُّ: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمِ وَ لا نِسَاءُ قَالَ «تُدْفَنُ كَمَا هِيَ بِثِيَابِهَا
» وَ الرَّجُلُ يَمُوتُ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ النِّسَاءُ لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ رِجَالٌ قَالَ «يَدْفِنَّهُ كَمَا هُوَ بِثِيَابِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 154 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 520

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Abu al-Numeir, the freed slave of al-Harith ibn al-Mughira, asked Imam Al-
Sadiq {a.s}: "Tell me about the age up to which a child can be washed by women."
Imam {a.s} replied: "Up to three years old."

Scholar's Note:
Our Shaykh Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan mentioned in his book, ‘Al Jamiah’, a girl who
dies among men during travel. If She is older than five or six years, She should be
buried without washing. If She is younger than five years, She can be washed.
He mentioned a related narration from Al-Halabi attributed to Imam Al-Sadiq.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ أَبُو النُمَيْرِ مَوْلَى الْحَارِثِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ فَقَالَ: حَدَّثْنِي عَنِ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى كَمْ تُفَسِّلْهُ ٱلنَّسَاءُ فَقَالَ «إِلَى
ثَلاَثِ سِنِينَ.
وذكر شيخنا محمد بن الحسن - في جامعه في الجارية تموت مع الرجال في السفر قال: إذا كانت ابنة أكثر من خمس
سنين أو ست دفنت ولم تغسل، وإذا كانت ابنة أقل من خمس سنين غسلت، وذكر عن الحلبي حديثا في معناه عن الصادق.

dies among men during travel. If She is older than five or six years, She should be
buried without washing. If She is younger than five years, She can be washed.
He mentioned a related narration from Al-Halabi attributed to Imam Al-Sadiq.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Mansour ibn Hazim asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a
man traveling with his wife, and She dies. Should he wash her?
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes, as well as his mother, sister, and similar relatives. He should
cover her private parts with a cloth and then perform the washing."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ مَنْصُورُ بْنُ حَازِمِ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ مَعَ اِمْرَأَتِهِ فَتَمُوتُ أَيُفَسَّلْهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ أُمْهُ وَ أُخْتَهُ وَ نَحْوَهُمَا
يُلْقِي عَلَى عَوْرَتِهَا خِرْقَةً وَ يُفَسِّلُهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a
man who dies and is only accompanied by women.
Imam {a.s} replied: "A woman who is his mahram (close relative) should wash him, and
the other women should pour water over him without removing his clothes. If it is a
woman who dies among men, with no women or mahram present, She should be
buried as she is in her clothing. If a mahram is present, he may wash her from over her
clothes."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلا نِسَاءُ فَقَالَ «تُغَسِّلُهُ اِمْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَحْرَمِ مِنْهُ وَ تَصُبُ
النَّسَاءُ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ وَ لَا تَخْلَعُ ثَوْبَهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَتِ اِمْرَأَةٌ مَاتَتْ مَعَ رِجَالٍ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُمُ اِمْرَأَةٌ وَ لا مَحْرَمٌ لَهَا فَلْتُدْفَنْ
كَمَا هِيَ فِي ثِيَابِهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمِ لَهَا غَسَّلَهَا مِنْ قَوْقٍ ثِيَابِهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 155 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 444 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 204 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 306 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 519

author: Shaykh al-Saduq

text_en:
Ammar al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a young
girl for whom no woman is available to wash her.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The one most closely related to her among men should wash her."
text_ar: - وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارْ السَّابَاطِيُ: عَنِ الصَّبِيَّةِ لا تُصَابُ اِمْرَأَةً تُفَسِّلُهَا قَالَ «يُفَسِّلُهَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهَا مِنَ الرِّجَالِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 155 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 519

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Imam was asked about a Muslim man who dies while traveling, with no
other Muslim men present but with a group of Christian men and two Muslim women
(his paternal aunt and maternal aunt). How should his washing be performed?
Imam {a.s} replied: "His paternal aunt and maternal aunt should wash him while he is in
his shirt, and the Christian men should not approach him”.
Similarly, he was asked about a Muslim woman who dies while traveling, with no
Muslim women present but accompanied by Christian women, along with her Muslim
paternal uncle and maternal uncle.
The Imam said: "Her uncles should wash her, but the Christian women should not
approach her. She should wear a protective garment, and water should be poured over
the garment."
text_ar:
وَ سَأْلَهُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ يَمُوتُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ رَجُلْ مُسْلِمٌ وَ مَعَهُ رِجَالٌ نَصَارَى وَ عَمَّتُهُ وَ خَالَتُهُ
مُسْلِمَتَانٍ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ فِي غُسْلِهِ قَالَ «تُغَسِّلُهُ عَمْتُهُ وَ خَالَتُهُ فِي قَمِيصِهِ وَ لا تَقْرَبُهُ ٱلنَّصَارَى » وَ عَنِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ
فِي السَّفَرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا اِمْرَأَةً مُسْلِمَةً وَ مَعَهَا نِسَاءُ نَصَارَى وَ مَعَهَا عَمْهَا وَ خَالُهَا مُسْلِمَانِ فَقَالَ «يُغَسِّلاَنِهَا وَ لا
تَقْرَبُهَا النَّصْرَانِيَّةُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهَا دِزْعٌ فَيُصَبُّ الْمَاءُ مِنْ قَوْقِ الدِّزْعِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 155 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 517

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam was asked about a Christian who dies while traveling among Muslims.
Imam {a.s} said: "A Muslim should not wash him, nor bury him, nor give him any honor,
and should not stand by his grave, even if he was his father."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ: عَنِ النَّصْرَانِيَّ يَكُونُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ هُوَ مَعَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ فَيَمُوتُ قَالَ «لا يُفَسِّلْهُ مُسْلِمٌ وَ لا يَدْفِنْهُ وَ لا
كَرَامَةَ وَ لاَ يَقُومُ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أُبَاهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 155 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 335 • Sulwat al- Hazin, Part 1, p. 256 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 514 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 204

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar asked Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}: "May I be your ransom, what
is your ruling about a woman who dies while traveling with men, none of whom are her
mahram (close relatives), and no women are present? What should be done with her?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Only those parts that Allah {SWT} has required for tayammum (dry
ablution) should be washed, and She should not be touched or any of her private
features, which Allah {SWT} has commanded to be covered, uncovered."
He then asked: "How should it be done?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Her inner palms should be washed first, then her face, followed by
washing the backs of her hands”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ الْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ عُمَرَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَكُونُ فِي السَّفَرِ مَعَ الرِّجَالِ لَيْسَ فِيهِمْ
لَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ وَ لا مَعَهُمُ اِمْرَأَةً فَتَمُوتُ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ مَا يُصْنَعُ بِهَا قَالَ «يُعْسَلُ مِنْهَا مَا أَوْجَبَ اللّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلتَّيَمُمَ وَ لا تُمَسْ
وَ لاَ يُكْشَفُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ مَحَاسِنِهَا الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِسَثْرِهَا» فَقَالَ لَهُ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهَا قَالَ «يُغْسَلُ بَاطِنُ
كَفَّيْهَا ثُمَّ يُغْسَلُ وَجْهُهَا ثُمَّ يُغْسَلُ ظَهْرُ كَفَّيْهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 156 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 342 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Part 1, p. 442 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 200 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 202 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 522
text_chunk:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar asked Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}: "May I be your ransom, what
is your ruling about a woman who dies while traveling with men, none of whom are her
mahram (close relatives), and no women are present? What should be done with her?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Only those parts that Allah {SWT} has required for tayammum (dry
ablution) should be washed, and She should not be touched or any of her private
features, which Allah {SWT} has commanded to be covered, uncovered."
He then asked: "How should it be done?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Her inner palms should be washed first, then her face, followed by
washing the backs of her hands”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
about a man who dies and is accompanied by no Muslim men or female Muslim
relatives. Instead, there are Christian men and Muslim women unrelated to him.
The Imam said: "The Christian man should first perform ghusl (ritual washing for
himself), then wash the deceased, as it is a case of necessity”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيُّ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ وَ لا اِمْرَأَةٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ مِنْ ذَوِي
قَرَابَتِهِ وَ مَعَهُ رِجَالُ نَصَارَى وَ نِسَاءُ مُسْلِمَاتُ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ بَيْنَهُ قَرَابَةٌ قَالَ «يَعْتَسِلُ ٱلنَّصْرَانِي ثُمَّ يُغَسِّلُهُ فَقَدِ
أضطُرّ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Imam was asked about a Muslim woman who dies and is accompanied by
no Muslim women or male Muslim relatives, but there is Christian woman and Muslim
men present.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The Christian woman should first perform ghusl (ritual washing for
herself), and then She should wash the deceased."

Scholar's Note:
And five categories of deceased individuals can be kept for three days before burial
unless their bodies begin to decompose : hose who have drowned, those struck by
lightning, those who died of stomach-related ailments, buried under rubble, and those
who died from smoke inhalation.
For someone who has died of smallpox (or similar contagious diseases), water should
be poured over the body without touching it if there is a fear that touching would cause
the skin to detach. The same applies to individuals with broken limbs, burns, or severe
sores.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمُسْلِمَةِ تَمُوتُ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا اِمْرَأَةٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ وَ لا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمُ مِنْ ذَوِي قَرَابَتِهَا وَ مَعَهَا
نَصْرَانِيَّةٌ وَ رِجَالٌ مُسْلِمُونَ فَقَالَ «تَغْتَسِلُ ٱلنَّصْرَانِيَّةُ ثُمَّ تُغَسِّلْهَا.
وخمسة ينتظر بهم ثلاثة أيام إلا أن يتغيروا: الغريق، والمصعوق، والمبطون، والمهدوم، والمدخن. والمجدور إذا مات يصيب
عليه الماء صبا إذا خيف أن يسقط من جلده شئ عند المس وكذلك الكسير والمحترق والذي به القروح.
commentary:
And five categories of deceased individuals can be kept for three days before burial
unless their bodies begin to decompose : hose who have drowned, those struck by
lightning, those who died of stomach-related ailments, buried under rubble, and those
who died from smoke inhalation.
For someone who has died of smallpox (or similar contagious diseases), water should
be poured over the body without touching it if there is a fear that touching would cause
the skin to detach. The same applies to individuals with broken limbs, burns, or severe
sores.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: "When a person
dies at sea, they are washed, anointed (with Hunut), and shrouded. Then a stone
should be tied to their leg, and they should be cast into the water."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا مَاتَ الْمَيّتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ غُسِّلَ وَ حُنَّطَ وَ كُفَّنَ ثُمَّ يُوثَقُ فِي رِجْلِهِ
حَجَرٌ وَ يُرْمَى بِهِ فِي الْمَاءِ.
cross_references: Qurb al-Isnād, Part 1, p. 138 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 157 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 339 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 538 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 206 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 2

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
It has been narrated that a deceased person should be placed in a large jar
(khabiyah), which is then sealed, and the jar is thrown into the water.

Scholar's Note:
This applies when it is not possible to reach the shore.
text_ar:
وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ يُجْعَلُ فِي خَابِيَةِ وَ يُوكَى رَأْسُهَا وَ يُرْمَى بِهَا فِي ٱلْمَاءِ.
هذا كله إذا لم يقدر على الشط
commentary: This applies when it is not possible to reach the shore.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said : "The man and
woman sentenced to stoning should be washed, embalmed, and dressed in shrouds
before being stoned, then they are to be stoned and prayers are to be offered for them
(Salat Al Janazah). The person subject to retaliation (Qisas) is treated similarly: they
should be washed, embalmed, and dressed in shrouds before the execution, and
funeral prayers should be offered for them (Salat Al Janazah).

Scholar's Note:
If the deceased was crucified, they should be taken down after three days, washed,
shrouded, and buried. It is not permissible for crucifixion to last more than three days.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «الْمَرْجُومُ وَ ٱلْمَرْجُومَةُ يُغَسَّلآَنِ وَ يُحَنَّطَانٍ وَ يُلْبَسَانِ الْكَفَنَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ
ثُمَّ يُرْجَمَانٍ وَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمَا وَ ٱلْمُقْتَصُ مِنْهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ ذَلِكَ يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُحَنَّطُ وَ يُلْبَسُ الْكَفَنَ ثُمَّ يُقَادُ وَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
فإذا كان الميت مصلوبا أنزل عن الخشبة بعد ثلاثة أيام وغسل وكفن ودفن ولا يجوز صلبه أكثر من ثلاثة أيام.
commentary:
If the deceased was crucified, they should be taken down after three days, washed,
shrouded, and buried. It is not permissible for crucifixion to last more than three days.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a man
who has been devoured by a wild animal or birds, leaving only his bones without flesh.
He asked what should be done in such a case.
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should be washed, shrouded, funeral prayers should be offered
for him, and he should be buried”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِي بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْكُلُهُ السَّبْعُ أَوِ الطَّيْرُ فَتَبْقَى عِظَامُهُ
بِغَيْرٍ لَحْمِ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ «يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُكَفِّنُ وَ يُصَلِّى عَلَيْهِ وَ يُدْفَنُ.
cross_references: Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, P 1, p. 349 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 158 • Wasail Al-Shia, P 3, p. 134

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
In another report, "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, did not wash Ammar ibn Yasir and
Hashim ibn Utbah (known as al-Mirqal). He buried them in their clothing with their
blood and did not offer funeral prayers for them”.

Scholar's Note:
This is how it was narrated, it is understood that no member of the community should
be left without a funeral prayer upon their death.
text_ar:
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: «إِنَّ عَلِيْاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ لَمْ يُغَسِّلْ، عَمَّارَ بْنَ يَاسِرٍ وَ لاَ هَاشِمَ بْنَ عُثْبَةَ وَ هُوَ ٱلْمِرْقَالُ وَ دَفْنَهُمَا
فِي ثِيَابِهِمَا بِدِمَائِهِمَا وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمَا.
هكذا روى، لكن الأصل أن لا يترك أحد من الأمة إذا مات بغير صلاة..
commentary:
This is how it was narrated, it is understood that no member of the community should
be left without a funeral prayer upon their death.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Abu Mariam Al-Ansari narrated that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
said:
"If a martyr has a remaining breath (sign of life), then he should be washed, shrouded,
embalmed, and funeral prayers should be offered for him. But if there is no remaining
breath, he should be shrouded in his own clothes."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو مَرْيَمَ الْأَنْصَارِي عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «الشَّهِيدُ إِذَا كَانَ بِهِ رَمَقٌ غُسِّلَ وَ كُفَّنَ وَ
حُنَّطَ وَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِهِ رَمَقٌ كُفَّنَ فِي أَثْوَابِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 211 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 331 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 214 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 348 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 506

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Aban ibn Taghlib asked Him about a man who is killed in the path of Allah {SWT}:
Should he be washed, shrouded, and embalmed (with Hunut)?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should be buried as he is, in his clothing with his blood, unless
there is a sign of life remaining. If he has a sign of life and then dies, he should be
washed, shrouded, embalmed, and the funeral prayer should be offered for him. This
is because the Messenger of Allah {saws} prayed over Hamza, shrouded him, and
embalmed him because he had been stripped (of his clothing)”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُقْتَلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّهِ أَيُفَسِّلُ وَ يُكَفَّنُ وَ يُحَنَّطُ فَقَالَ «يُدْفَنُ كَمَا هَوَ فِي
ثِيَابِهِ بِدَمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ بِهِ رَمَقٌ فَإِنْ كَانَ بِهِ رَمَقٌ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَإِنَّهُ يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُكَفَّنُ وَ يُحَنَّطُ وَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ لِأَنَ رَسُولَ
اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى عَلَى حَمْزَةً وَ كَفِّنَهُ وَ حَنَّطَهُ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَّ جُرِّدَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Hanzalah ibn Abu 'Amir, known as " Rahib," was martyred at the Battle of Uhud.
The Prophet Muhammad {saws} did not command that he be washed, saying: "I saw the
angels washing Hanzalah with water from the clouds, using silver vessels."
Because of this, he was given the title "Ghasil al-Malaika" (The One Washed by the
Angels).
text_ar:
وَ أسْتَشَهِدَ حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي عَامِرِ الرَّاهِبُ بِأُحُدٍ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرِ النَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِغَسْلِهِ وَقَالَ «رَأَيْتُ
الْمَلاَئِكَةَ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَ الْأَرْضِ تُغَسِّلُ، حَنْظَلَةَ بِمَاءِ الْمُزْنِ فِي صِحَافٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَ كَانَ يُسَمَّى غَسِيلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 159 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 349 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 506 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 20, p. 47

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"From a martyr, the fur, shoes, cap, turban, belt, and trousers should be removed,
unless they have been stained with blood ; if they are stained with blood, they are to
be left on. No tied item should remain on the body; it must be untied."

Scholar's Note:
Regarding a person in a state of ihram (ritual consecration during Hajj or Umrah) who
dies, they should be washed, shrouded, and buried with all the rites performed for
someone not in ihram, except that camphor should not be used.
A person killed in battle not in obedience to Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, should be washed
like any deceased person, and if their head has been severed, it should be joined to
the body and washed together.
In the case of a woman who dies while pregnant, if the fetus is moving in her womb,
the left side of her abdomen should be opened, and the child removed. If the child dies
inside her and does not come out while She is alive, a person should reach in through
the birth canal, cut the child into pieces, and extract it.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يُنْزَعُ عَنِ الشَّهِيدِ الْفَرْوُ وَ الْخُفُ وَ الْقَلَنْسُوَةُ وَ الْعِمَامَةُ وَ الْمِنْطَقَةُ وَ
السَّرَاوِيلُ إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَصَابَهُ دَمْ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ دَمْ تُرِكَ وَ لا يُثَرَكُ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مَعْقُودٌ إِلَّ حُلَّ.
والمحرم إذا مات غسل وكفن ودفن وعمل به ما يعمل بالمحل إلا أنه لا يقربه الكافور. وقتيل المعركة في غير طاعة اللّٰه
عز وجل يغسل كما يغسل الميت، ويضم (رأسه إلى عنقه، ويغسل مع البدن. وإذا ماتت المرأة وهي حامل وولدها يتحرك
في بطنها شق بطنها من الجانب الأيسر وأخرج الولد، وإن مات الولد في جوفها ولم يخرج وهي حية أدخل إنسان يده
في فرجها وقطع الولد بيده وأخرجه.
commentary:
Regarding a person in a state of ihram (ritual consecration during Hajj or Umrah) who
dies, they should be washed, shrouded, and buried with all the rites performed for
someone not in ihram, except that camphor should not be used.
A person killed in battle not in obedience to Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, should be washed
like any deceased person, and if their head has been severed, it should be joined to
the body and washed together.
In the case of a woman who dies while pregnant, if the fetus is moving in her womb,
the left side of her abdomen should be opened, and the child removed. If the child dies
inside her and does not come out while She is alive, a person should reach in through
the birth canal, cut the child into pieces, and extract it.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
It has been narrated that when Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} passed
away, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} continued to have a lamp lit in the room
where Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} lived, until Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} also passed
away.
Then Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} also instructed to do the same
in the room of Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} to remain lit until He was taken
to Iraq, after which it is unknown what happened”.

Scholar's Note:
Regarding a person in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) who wishes to wash a
deceased person, they should perform ablution (wudu) as for prayer before washing
the body.
If someone wishes to engage in marital relations after washing the deceased, they
should perform ablution before doing so.
If a deceased person is washed and a significant amount of blood continues to flow
from the body without stopping, then clean clay should be applied, as it will stop the
bleeding.
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ لَمَّا قُبِضَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ لَمْ يَزَلْ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَأْمُرُ بِالسِّرَاجِ فِي
الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي كَانَ يَسْكُنُهُ حَتَّى قُبِضَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ
يِمِثلِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ حَتَّى أُخْرِجَ بِهِ إِلَى ٱلْعِرَاقِ ثُمَّ لا يُدْرَى مَا كَانَ.
ومن كان جنبا وأراد أن يغسل الميت فليتوضا وضوء الصلاة ثم يغسله.
ومن أراد الجماع بعد غسله للميت فليتوضا ثم يجامع.
وإن غسل ميت فخرج منه دم كثير لا ينقطع فإنه يجعل عليه الطين الحر فإنه ينقطع.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Sulayman ibn Khalid asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"Does one who washes the deceased need to perform ghusl (ritual purification)?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
He then asked: "What about someone who places the deceased in the grave?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "No, because he only touches the clothing."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ خَالِدِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: أَيَفْتَسِلُ مَنْ غَسَّلَ الْمَيِّتَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ فَمَنْ أَدْخَلَهُ
اَلْقَبْرَ قَالَ «لَا إِنَّمَا مَسَّ الثِّيَابَ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When (my son) Ismail died, I ordered that his body, while covered, be uncovered so
that I could kiss his forehead, chin, and neck.
Then, I had him covered again and later ordered that he be uncovered a second time,
and I kissed his forehead, chin, and neck once more. Then, I had him covered again.
After that, I instructed that he be washed. When the washing was completed, I entered
while he was being shrouded and said: 'Uncover his face,' and I kissed his forehead,
chin, and neck and then recited protective supplications over him.
I then said: 'Wrap him.'
Someone asked: 'With what did you offer the protective supplication?'
Imam {a.s} replied: 'With the Qur'an.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لَمَّا مَاتَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ أَمَرْتُ بِهِ وَ هُوَ مُسَجَّى أَنْ يُكْشَفَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ فَقَبَّلْتُ جَبْهَتَهُ
وَ ذَقَنَهُ وَ نَحْرَهُ ثُمّ أَمَرْتُ بِهِ فَغَطَّيَ ثُمّ قُلْتُ اِكْشِفُوا عَنْهُ فَقَبَّلْتُ أَيْضاً جَبْهَتَهُ وَ ذَقَنَهُ وَ نَحْرَهُ ثُمّ أَمَرْتُهُمْ فَغَطَّوْهُ
ثُمَّ أَمَرْتُ بِهِ فَغُسِّلَ ثُمَّ دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ كُفِّنَ فَقُلْتُ اِكْشِفُوا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ فَقَبَّلْتُ جَبْهَتَهُ وَ ذَقَنَهُ وَ نَحْرَهُ وَ عَوْذَتُهُ
ثُمَّ قُلْتُ أَدْرِجُوهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ بِأيَّ شَيْءٍ عَوَّذْتَهُ فَقَالَ بِالْقُرْآنِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} kissed ‘Uthman ibn Maz'un after his death."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَبَّلَ، عُثْمَانَ بْنَ مَظْعُونِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 161 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 161 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 430 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 100 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 38 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 564 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 298 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 264 • Mustadrak Al- Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 493

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Whoever follows a funeral procession, Allah {SWT} will record four qirats for them : one
qirat for following the procession, one qirat for offering the funeral prayer, one qirat for
waiting until the burial is completed, and one qirat for offering condolences."
text_ar:
باب - الصلاة على الميت
قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ تَبِعَ جَنَازَةً كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَرْبَعَةَ قَرَارِيطَ قِيرَاطِ لاتَّبَاعِهِ إِيَّاهَا وَ قِيرَاطِ
لِلصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا وَ قِيرَاطِ لِلاِنْتِظَارِ حَنَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْ دَفْنِهَا وَ قِيرَاطِ لِلتَّعْزِيَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 161 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 401

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Whoever walks with a funeral procession until the funeral prayer is offered and then
returns will receive one qirat (measure of reward). If they continue walking with it until
the deceased is buried, they will receive two qirats, and one qirat is like the size of
Mount Uhud."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ مَشَى مَعَ جَنَازَةٍ حَتَّى يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ كَانَ لَهُ قِيرَاطٌ وَ إِذَا مَشَى
مَعَهَا حَتَّى ثُدْفَنَ كَانَ لَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ وَ ٱلْقِيرَاطُ مِثْلُ جَبَلٍ أُحُدٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 173 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 455 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 400 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 145

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever follows the funeral procession of a Muslim will be
granted four intercessions on the Day of Judgment. Whatever supplication or
statement they make, the angel will say to them, 'And for you is the same.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ تَبِعَ جَنَازَةَ اِمْرِيِ مُسْلِمِ أُعْطِيَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ أَرْبَعَ شَفَاعَاتٍ وَ لَمْ يَقُلْ شَيْئا إِلاَّ قَالَ
لَهُ اَلْمَلَكُ وَ لَكَ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever takes hold of the four
sides of the bier (funeral bier) will have forty major sins forgiven by Allah {SWT}."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ بِجَوَانِبِ السَّرِيرِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ غَفَرَ آللَّهُ لَهُ أَرْبَعِينَ كَبِيرَةً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, V3, p.174 • Al-Wafi, V 24, p. 396 • Wasail Al-Shia, P3, p. 154

sides of the bier (funeral bier) will have forty major sins forgiven by Allah {SWT}."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever accompanies the funeral of a believer until they are
buried in their grave, Allah {SWT} will assign seventy angels to accompany and seek
forgiveness for that person when they rise from their grave to stand at the gathering
(on the Day of Judgment)."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «مَنْ شَبَّعَ جَنَازَةَ مُؤْمِنٍ حَتَّى يُدْفَنَ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَكَلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ سَبْعِينَ مَلَكاً مِنَ ٱلْمُشَيِّعِينَ
يُشَيِّعُونَهُ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ قَبْرِهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْقِفِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said:
"The first gift given to a believer in their grave is the forgiveness granted to those who
followed their funeral procession."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: «أَوَّلُ مَا يُثَحَفُ بِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ فِي قَبْرِهِ أَنْ يُغْفَرَ لِمَنْ تَبِعَ جَنَازَتَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Muʾmin, Part 1, p. 65 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 173 • Al- Khasal, Part 1, p. 24 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 455 • Sulwat al-Hazin, Part 1, p. 262 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 399 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 143 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 258

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"When a believer enters their grave, it is proclaimed: 'Behold, your first gift is Paradise!
And the first gift for those who followed your funeral procession is forgiveness.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «إِذَا دَخَلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ قَبْرَهُ نُودِيَ أَلاَ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جِبَائِكَ الْجَنَّةُ، أَلاّ وَ أَوَّلُ حِبَاءٍ مَنْ
تَبِعَكَ الْمَغْفِرَةُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 172 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 162 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 399 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 142
text_chunk:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"When a believer enters their grave, it is proclaimed: 'Behold, your first gift is Paradise!
And the first gift for those who followed your funeral procession is forgiveness.'"

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, said: “Whoever carries their deceased
brother on all four sides of the bier, Allah {SWT} will erase forty major sins from them."

Scholar's Note:
The Sunnah (recommended practice) is to carry the bier from its four sides, and any
additional carrying (from other angles) after that is considered voluntary.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ حَمَلَ أَخَاهُ الْمَيَّتَ بِجَوَانِبِ السَّرِيرِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ مَحَا اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَرْبَعِينَ كَبِيرَةً
مِنَ اَلْكَبَائِرِ.
والسنة أن يحمل السرير من جوانبه الأربعة وما كان بعد ذلك فهو تطوع.
commentary:
The Sunnah (recommended practice) is to carry the bier from its four sides, and any
additional carrying (from other angles) after that is considered voluntary.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever takes hold of the
handles of the bier, Allah {SWT} will forgive twenty-five major sins for them. And if they
carry it on all four sides, they will be cleansed of their sins."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ بِقَوَائِمِ السَّرِيرِ غَفَرَ اللَهُ لَهُ خَمْساً وَ عِشرِينَ كَبِيرَةً وَ إِذَا رَبَّعَ خَرَجَ
مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said to Ishaq ibn Ammar:
"When you carry the sides of the bier of the deceased, you will be cleansed of your sins
as if you were just born from your mother."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ لإِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ إِذَا حَمَلْتَ جَوَانِبَ السَّرِيرِ سَرِيرِ الْمَيِّتِ خَرَجْتَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا
وَلَدَثْكَ أُمّكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, said:
"Walking behind the funeral procession is better than walking in front of it, but there is
no harm if you walk in front."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَغْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «إِنَّ ٱلْمَشِيَ خَلْفَ الْجَنَازَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ ٱلْمَشِيِ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهَا وَ لا بَأْسَ إنْ
مَشَيْتَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Hussein ibn Saeed wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s},
asking about the bier of the deceased: Is there a specific side that should be carried
first from among its four sides, or can one carry it from any side that is easiest?
Imam {a.s} replied: "From whichever side he wishes."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَسْأَلُهُ: عَنْ سَرِيرِ الْمَيِّتِ يُحْمَلُ أَلَهُ جَانِبْ
يُبْدَأُ بِهِ فِي الْحَمْلِ مِنْ جَوَانِبِهِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ أَوْ مَا خَفَّ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ يَحْمِلُ مِنْ أَيِّ الْجَوَانِبِ شَاءَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
«مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ.

chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a funeral procession
in which fire (torches or lamps) is carried.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The daughter of the Messenger of Allah {saws} was taken out at night,
and lamps accompanied her."

وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الْجَنَازَةِ يُخْرَجُ مَعَهَا بِالنَّارِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ اِبْنَةَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ أَخْرِجَ بِهَا لَيْلاً وَ مَعَهَا مَصَابِيحُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
When the Messenger of Allah {saws} offered the funeral prayer over a deceased
person, he would recite the first takbir and then recite the testimony of faith (shahada).
He would then recite the second takbir, send blessings upon the Prophet and his
family, and make supplications.
Upon the third takbir, he would pray for the believing men and women.
After the fourth takbir, he would supplicate for the deceased,
And then conclude with a fifth takbir before leaving.
When Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, forbade him from praying over the hypocrites,
he recited the first takbir, recited the shahada,
then recited the second takbir, sent blessings upon the Prophet and his family,
recited the third takbir, and prayed for the believing men and women.
Upon the fourth takbir, he did not offer any supplication for the deceased and then
concluded.

Scholar's Note:
When someone offers the funeral prayer over a deceased person, they should stand
at the head of the body so that if the wind lifts their garment, it will touch the funeral
bier. After each takbir, they should make the following supplications:
They should say the first Takbir and declare (Testimony of Faith):
"I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone with no partner, and I bear
witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, sent with truth as a bearer of
glad tidings and a warner before the Hour."
Then they should say the second takbir and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, have
mercy upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the
family of Muhammad, just as You blessed, had mercy upon, and honored Ibrahim and
the family of Ibrahim. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious."
Then they should say the third takbir and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive the believing men and women, the Muslim men and women, the
living and the dead."
Then they should say the fourth takbir and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, this is Your servant, the child of Your servant and the child of Your
maidservant. They have returned to You, and You are the best to return to. O’ Allah {SWT},
we know nothing of them except good, but You know them better than we do. If they
were a doer of good, increase their goodness; if they committed wrong, forgive and
overlook their misdeeds. O’ Allah {SWT}, place them among the highest ranks of the
elevated ones and grant mercy upon them with Your mercy, O’ Most Merciful of the
merciful."
Then they should say the takbir for the fifth time, and conclude. The one offering the
prayer should not leave their position until they see the body being carried away by the
men.
The reason for reciting five takbirs in the funeral prayer is because Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, has imposed five obligations upon the people: prayer (Salat), almsgiving
(Zakat), fasting (Saum), pilgrimage (Hajj), and leadership (Wilayah).
Thus, Allah {SWT} has designated one takbir for each obligation for the deceased.
text_ar:
وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا صَلِّى عَلَى مَيَّتٍ كَبَّرَ فَتَشَهْدَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ فَصَلَّى عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَ آلِهِ وَ
دَعَا ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ وَ دَعَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ الرَّابِعَةَ وَ دَعَا لِلْمَيِّتِ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فَلَمَّا نَهَاهُ اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
عَنِ الصَّلاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ فَكَبَّرَ وَ تَشَهَّدَ ثُمَ كَبَّرَ فَصَلَّى عَلَى النِّبِيِّ وَ آلِهِ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ وَ دَعَا لِلْمُوْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُوْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ
كَبَّرَ الرَّابِعَةً وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فَلَمْ يَدْعُ لِلْمَيِّتِ.
ومن صلى على ميت فليقف عند رأسه بحيث إن هبت ريح فرفعت ثوبه أصاب الجنازة ويكبر ويقول: " أشهد أن لا إله إلا
الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله، أرسله بالحق بشيرا ونذيرا بين يدي الساعة " ويكبر الثانية ويقول:
" اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد، وارحم محمدا وآل محمد، وبارك على محمد وآل محمد كأفضل ما صليت وباركت
وترحمت على إبراهيم وآل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد. ويكبر الثالثة ويقول: " اللهم اغفر للمؤمنين والمؤمنات والمسلمين
والمسلمات الاحياء منهم والأموات "، ويكبر الرابعة ويقول: " اللهم عبدك [و] ابن عبدك ابن أمتك ونزل بك وأنت خير
منزول به، اللهم إنا لا نعلم منه إلا خيرا وأنت أعلم به منا، اللهم إن كان محسنا فزد في إحسانه وإن كان مسيئا فتجاوز عنه
واغفر له، اللهم اجعله عندك في أعلى عليين، واخلف على أهله في الغابرين، وارحمه برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين " ثم يكبر
الخامسة .ولا يبرح من مكانه حتى يرى الجنازة على أيدي الرجال .والعلة التي من أجلها يكبر على الميت خمس تكبيرات
أن اللّٰه تبارك وتعالى فرض على الناس خمس فرائض: الصلاة والزكاة، والصوم، والحج، والولاية، فجعل للميت عن كل
فريضة تكبيرة .

recited the third takbir, and prayed for the believing men and women.
Upon the fourth takbir, he did not offer any supplication for the deceased and then
concluded.

Scholar's Note:
When someone offers the funeral prayer over a deceased person, they should stand
at the head of the body so that if the wind lifts their garment, it will touch the funeral
bier. After each takbir, they should make the following supplications:
They should say the first Takbir and declare (Testimony of Faith):
"I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone with no partner, and I bear
witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, sent with truth as a bearer of
glad tidings and a warner before the Hour."
Then they should say the second takbir and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, have
mercy upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the
family of Muhammad, just as You blessed, had mercy upon, and honored Ibrahim and
the family of Ibrahim. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious."
Then they should say the third takbir and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive the believing men and women, the Muslim men and women, the
living and the dead."
Then they should say the fourth takbir and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, this is Your servant, the child of Your servant and the child of Your
maidservant. They have returned to You, and You are the best to return to. O’ Allah {SWT},
we know nothing of them except good, but You know them better than we do. If they
were a doer of good, increase their goodness; if they committed wrong, forgive and
overlook their misdeeds. O’ Allah {SWT}, place them among the highest ranks of the
elevated ones and grant mercy upon them with Your mercy, O’ Most Merciful of the
merciful."
Then they should say the takbir for the fifth time, and conclude. The one offering the
prayer should not leave their position until they see the body being carried away by the
men.
The reason for reciting five takbirs in the funeral prayer is because Allah {SWT}, the

(Zakat), fasting (Saum), pilgrimage (Hajj), and leadership (Wilayah).
Thus, Allah {SWT} has designated one takbir for each obligation for the deceased.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
It has been narrated that the reason behind this practice is that Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, has prescribed five obligatory prayers for people, and thus, one takbir is
designated for the deceased from each of these obligatory prayers.

Scholar's Note:
When offering the funeral prayer for a woman, one should stand near her chest. There
is no Tasleem (final salutatory phrase) in the funeral prayer except in cases of taqiyya
(precautionary dissimulation to protect oneself).
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ الْعِلَّةَ فِي ذَلِكَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فَرَضَ عَلَى النَّاسِ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ فَجَعَلَ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ
لِلْمَيِّتِ تَكْبِيرَةٌ.
ومن صلى على المرأة وقف عند صدرها، وليس في الصلاة على الميت تسليم إلا في حال التقية.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "The Commander of the Faithful
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} used to recite takbirs five at a time over the deceased. When
people would arrive late and say, 'O’ Commander of the Faithful, we did not catch the
prayer over Sahl ibn Hunayf,' he would place the bier down and recite five takbirs over
him again, repeating this process until he reached the grave, doing so five times”.

Scholar's Note:
If someone recites one or two takbirs over a funeral and then another bier is brought
to join the first, they may, if they wish, continue with five takbirs over both, or they can
finish the first funeral prayer and then start anew for the second.
If a person offers the funeral prayer over a deceased individual who is positioned
incorrectly, they should correct the position and repeat the prayer.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ يُكَبَّرُ خَمْساً خَمْساً كَانَ إِذَا أَدْرَكَهُ النَّاسُ
قَالُوا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَمْ نُدْرِكِ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ فَيَضَعُهُ فَيُكَبِّرُ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً حَتَّى اِنْتَهَى إِلَى قَبْرِهِ
خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ.
ومن كبر على جنازة تكبيرة أو تكبيرتين فوضعت جنازة أخرى معها فان شاء كبر الآن عليهما خمس تكبيرات، وإن شاء
فرغ من الأولى واستأنف الصلاة على الثانية
ومن صلى على جنازة وكانت مقلوبة فليسوها وليعد الصلاة عليها.

incorrectly, they should correct the position and repeat the prayer.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"If a person catches one or two takbirs of the funeral prayer over the deceased, they
should complete the remaining takbirs consecutively."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَلَبِيْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «إِذَا أَدْرَكَ الرَّجُلُ التَّكْبِيرَةَ وَ التَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ
عَلَى اَلْمَيَّتِ فَلْيَقْضٍ مَا بَقِيَ مُتَتَابِعاً.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Omar ibn Yazid narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, that He
said: "If a believer passes away and forty men from among the believers attend their
funeral and say:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, we do not know of anything but good from this person, and You know him
better than we do,'
Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, responds, 'I have accepted your testimony and
forgiven him for what I know that you do not.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا مَاتَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ فَحَضَرَ جَنَازَتَهُ أَرْبَعُونَ رَجْلاً
مِنَ ٱلْمُومِنِينَ وَ قَالُوا: اللَّهُمْ إِنَّا لا تَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِلَّ خَيْراً وَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنَّا قَالَ اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَدْ أَجَزْتُ شَهَادَاتِكُمْ
وَ غَفَرْتُ لَهُ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِمَّا لاَ تَعْلَمُونَ.

Al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik asked Imam {a.s}: "Is it permissible to perform the

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Abu Basir asked Imam {a.s} about who has the most right to perform the funeral
prayer for a woman who has passed away.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Her husband."
Abu Basir then asked: "Does the husband have more right than her father, son, or
brother?"
The Imam said: "Yes, and he may also wash her."

Scholar's Note:
My father wrote in his message to me:
"Know, my son, that the person with the most right to lead the funeral prayer for the
deceased is whoever is designated by the deceased's guardian (Wali).
If there is a man from the Banu Hashim among the people, he has priority for leading
the prayer if designated by the guardian of the deceased.
If someone leads without being appointed by the deceased’s guardian, then they are
usurping that right."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ مَنْ أَحَقُ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ «زَوْجُها» فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلزَّوْجُ أَحَقُ مِنَ ٱلْأَبِ وَ
الْوَلَدٍ وَ الْأَخِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ يُفَسَّلُهَا.
وقال أبي رحمه اللّٰه في رسالته إلي: إعلم يا بني أن أولى الناس بالصلاة على الميت من يقدمه ولي الميت، وإن كان في
القوم رجل من بني هاشم فهو أحق بالصلاة عليه إذا قدمه ولي الميت، فان تقدم من غير أن يقدمه ولي الميت فهو غاصب.

the prayer if designated by the guardian of the deceased.
If someone leads without being appointed by the deceased’s guardian, then they are
usurping that right."

If there is a man from the Banu Hashim among the people, he has priority for leading
the prayer if designated by the guardian of the deceased.
If someone leads without being appointed by the deceased’s guardian, then they are
usurping that right."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If you miss the funeral prayer for the deceased until they are buried, there is no
problem in performing the prayer for them after they have been buried”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا فَانَثِكَ الصَّلاةُ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ حَتَّى يُذْفَنَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ
دُفِنَ.

"The Messenger of Allah {saws}, if he missed the funeral prayer for a deceased

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Al-Yasa' ibn Abdullah al-Qummi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s} about a man praying over a funeral alone.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes, he may do so."
I then asked: "What if there are two people praying?"
The Imam said: "Yes, but one should stand behind the other, not next to him."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ الْيَسَعُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْقُمِّيِّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْجِنَارَةِ وَحْدَهُ قَالَ
«نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَاثْنَانِ يُصَلِّيَانٍ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ يَقُومُ ٱلْآخَرُ خَلْفَ ٱلْآخَرِ وَ لاَ يَقُومُ بِجَنْبِهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Jabir said : Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"If no men are present for the deceased, a woman should step forward and stand in
the middle, with the other women positioned on her right and left, and She should lead
by reciting the takbirs until the prayer is completed."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ جَابِرٌ قَالَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: «إِذَا لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الرِّجَالُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ تَقَدَّمَتِ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ وَسَطَهُنَّ وَ قَامَ ٱلنَّسْوَةُ
عَنْ يَمِينِهَا وَ شِمَالِهَا وَ هِيَ وَسَطُهُنَّ تَكَبَّرُ حَتَّى تَفْرُغَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 179 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 166 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 326 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 425 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 118 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 337

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad al-Sayqal reported that Imam Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked
about how women should perform the funeral prayer if no men are present.
Imam {a.s} replied: "They should all stand together in a single row, and no woman should
step forward as a leader."
He was then asked if, during the obligatory (written) prayers, one woman may lead
another.
The Imam said: "Yes."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ زِيَادِ الصَّيْقَلُ: سُبْلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَيْفَ تُصَلِّي النَّسَاءُ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ
مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ «يَقُمْنَ جَمِيعاً فِي صَفَّ وَاجِدٍ وَ لا تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ اِمْرَأَةٌ» قِيلَ فَفِي صَلاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ أَيَوُمُ بَعْضُهُنَّ بَعْضاً
قَالَ «نَعَمْ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Offer the funeral prayer for the stoned (person) from my Ummah and for the one who
takes their own life from my Ummah, and do not leave anyone from my Ummah
without the funeral prayer."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «صَلُوا عَلَى الْمَرْجُومِ مِنْ أَمَّتِي وَ عَلَى الْقَاتِلِ نَفْسَهُ مِنْ أَمَّتِي وَ لاَ
تَدَعُوا أَحَداً مِنْ أَمْتِي بِلاَ صَلاَةٍ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Hisham ibn Salim asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
whether the funeral prayer should be offered for one who drinks alcohol, commits
adultery (zina), or steals if they pass away.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنْ شَارِبِ الْخَمْرِ وَ الزَّانِي وَ السَّارِقِ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ إِذَا
مَاثُوا فَقَالَ »نَعَمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 166 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 328 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 468 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 481 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 132

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati said:
"I asked Imam Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a group of people who were traveling along the
seashore and came across a dead man who was naked and had been cast ashore by
the sea. They themselves were also without sufficient clothing, having only a single
garment. How should they perform the funeral prayer for him since he was naked and
they did not have an extra cloth to shroud him?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "A grave should be dug, and he should be placed in his burial niche,
with bricks placed over his private parts to cover them. Then, the funeral prayer should
be offered over him, and he should be buried."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَابَاطِيُّ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي قَوْمٍ كَانُوا فِي سَفَرٍ لَهُمْ
يَمْشُونَ عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ فَإِذَا هُمْ بِرَجُلٍ مَيِّتٍ عُرْيَانٍ قَدْ لَفَظَهُ الْبَحْرُ وَ هُمْ عُرَاةْ لَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ إِلاَّ إِزَارْ فَكَيْفَ
يُصَلُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ عُرْيَانْ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ فَضْلُ ثَوْبِ يُكَفَّنُونَهُ بِهِ قَالَ «يُحْفَرُ لَهُ وَ يُوضَعُ فِي لَحْدِهِ وَ يُوضَعُ اللِّبِنُ
عَلَى عَوْرَتِهِ» لِتُسْتَرَ عَوْرَتُهُ بِاللَّبِنِ وَ بِالْحَجَرِ وَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُدْفَنُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 214 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 166 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 179 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 327 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 487 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 131

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, and
him from his father, Imam al-Baqir: that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, once found
scattered parts of a deceased person. He gathered them together, performed the
funeral prayer over them, and then they were buried.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَلامُ: «أَنَّ عَلِياً صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَجَدَ قِطَعاً مِنْ
مَيِّتِ فَجْمِعَثْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ دُفِنَتْ
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 167 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 337 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Part 3, p. 329 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 492 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 135

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Al-Fadl ibn 'Uthman al-A'war narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} and him from his father, Imam al-Baqir, regarding a man who is killed and his
head is found in one tribe, his torso and hands in another tribe, and the rest of his body
in a different tribe.
The Imam said: "The responsibility for his blood money (diyah) is upon the tribe where
his torso and hands are found, and the funeral prayer should be performed over those
parts”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْأَعْوَرُ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُقْتَلُ فَيُوجَدُ
رَأْسُهُ فِي قَبِيلَةِ وَ وَسَطْهُ وَ صَدْرُهُ وَ يَدَاهُ فِي قَبِيلَةٍ وَالْبَاقِي مِنْهُ فِي قَبِيلَةِ قَالَ «دِيَثُهُ عَلَى مَنْ وُجِدَ فِي قَبِيلَتِهِ
صَدْرُهُ وَ يَدَاهُ وَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 167 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 4, p. 166 • Al- Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 491 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 135

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“If a man is found killed and one of his limbs is found intact, a funeral prayer should
be offered over it, and it should be buried. If no complete limb is found, no funeral
prayer is offered, but it should still be buried”.

Scholar's Note:
And if a man is cut in half, he should pray funeral prayer over the half that contains the
heart; if only the head remains, he should not pray funeral prayer over it.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا وُجِدَ الرَّجُلُ قَتِيلاً فَإِنْ وُجِدَ لَهُ عُضْوْ مِنْ أَعْضَائِهِ تَامَاً صُلِّيَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ
دُفِنَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهُ عُضْوٌ تَامٌّ لَمْ يُصَلَّ عَلَيْهِ وَ دُفِنَ.
وإذا وسط الرجل بنصفين صلى على النصف الذي فيه القلب، وإن لم يوجد منه إلا الرأس لم يصل عليه. .
commentary:
And if a man is cut in half, he should pray funeral prayer over the half that contains the
heart; if only the head remains, he should not pray funeral prayer over it.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Zurarah and Ubaidullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He was asked about when the funeral prayer should be
offered for a child.
Imam {a.s} replied: "When the child understands the concept of prayer."
I asked: "At what age does prayer become obligatory for the child?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "When the child reaches six years old, and fasting becomes
obligatory when they are capable of it."

Scholar's Note:
And if someone attends the funeral prayer for a child, they should say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, make this child a precursor (one who goes ahead) for their parents and
for us”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ وَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيّ الْحَلَبِيْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ عَلَى الصِّبِيِّ
مَتَى يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا عَقَلَ الصَّلاةَ» فَقُلْتُ مَتَى تَجِبُ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ اِبْنَ سِنَّ سِنِينَ وَ الصِّيَامُ
إِذَا أَطَاقَهُ.
ومن حضر مع قوم يصلون على طفل فليقل: " اللهم اجعله لأبويه ولنا فرطا.
commentary:
And if someone attends the funeral prayer for a child, they should say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, make this child a precursor (one who goes ahead) for their parents and
for us”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} offered the funeral prayer for a young son
of his who was three years old.
Imam {a.s} then said: "If it were not for the fact that people might say that the Banu
Hashim do not offer funeral prayers for their young children, I would not have prayed
over him”.
text_ar:
وَ صَلَّى أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَلَى اِبْنِ لَهُ صَبِيَّ صَغِيرٍ لَهُ ثَلاثُ سِنِينَ ثُمّ قَالَ - « لَوْ لا أَنّ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ
إنَّ بَنِي هَاشِمِ لا يُصَلُونَ عَلَى الصِّغَارِ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِهِمْ مَا صَلّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 498 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 101
text_chunk:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} offered the funeral prayer for a young son
of his who was three years old.
Imam {a.s} then said: "If it were not for the fact that people might say that the Banu
Hashim do not offer funeral prayers for their young children, I would not have prayed
over him”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
He was asked : "When does the funeral prayer become obligatory for a child?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "When the child understands the concept of prayer and is six years
old."

chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"Prayers over the oppressed (Al-Mustadh'afin) and those who are unversed of their
beliefs will be: first send salawat for the Prophet his family, and then make
supplications for the believing men and women, and then do supplication saying:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect
them from the punishment of Hellfire.'"

Scholar's Note:
It is said in the Salat Al Mayyat prayer for someone whose sect is unknown:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, this soul You have given life to and You have caused to die, O’ Allah {SWT},
grant it what it has turned to, And gather it with those it loved."
text_ar:
489 رَوَى زُرَارَةُ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ أَنْهُ قَالَ: «الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى ٱلْمُسْتَضْعَفِ وَ الَّذِي لا
يُعْرَفُ مَذْهَبُهُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ يَدْعُو لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَ يُقَالُ: «اللّهُمْ اِغْفِرْ لِلْذِينَ
ثابُوا وَ اِتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَ قِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَجِيمِ».
ويقال في الصلاة على من لم يعرف مذهبه: " اللهم إن هذه النفس أنت أحييتها وأنت أمتها، اللهم ولها ما تولت. واحشرها
مع من أحبت
