author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
It was narrated by Safwan ibn Mehran al-Jammal from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"A man from the hypocrites passed away, and Imam al-Hussain ibn Ali {a.s} went out
walking. Imam {a.s} encountered a servant of his, and asked: 'Where are you going?'
The servant said: 'I am avoiding the funeral of this hypocrite so that I do not have to
pray over him.'
Imam al-Hussain {a.s} replied: 'Come stand by my side, and whatever you hear me say,
you should say as well.' Imam {a.s} then raised his hands and said:
"'O’ Allah {SWT}, disgrace Your servant among Your servants and in Your lands. O’ Allah
{SWT}, make him taste the intensity of Your fire. O’ Allah {SWT}, make him feel the heat of
Your punishment, for he was loyal to Your enemies, hostile to Your allies, and had
hatred for the family of Your Prophet.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ اَلْجَمَالُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَاتَ رَجُلْ مِنَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ فَخَرَجَ
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَمْشِي فَلَقِيَ مَوْلَى لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ «إِلَى أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ» فَقَالَ أَفِرُ مِنْ جِنَازَةِ هَذَا ٱلْمُنَافِقِ
أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ «قُمْ إلَى جَئْبِي فَمَا سَمِعْتَنِي أَقُولُ فَقُلْ مِثلَهُ» قَالَ فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ
« اللَّهُمَّ أَخِزٍ عَبْدَكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ وَ بِلادِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِهِ أَشَدَّ نَارِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَذِقْهُ حَرَّ عَذَابِكَ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُوَالِي أَعْدَاءَكَ وَ
يُعَادِي أَوْلِيَاءَكَ وَ يُنْغِضُ أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيّكَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, V.3, p. 189 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 168 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 70

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
It was narrated by Ubaidullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"If you perform the funeral prayer for an enemy of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, say:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, we know of him only that he was an enemy to You and Your Messenger.
O’ Allah {SWT}, fill his grave with fire, fill his innermost with fire, and hasten him toward
the fire, for he was loyal to Your enemies, hostile to Your allies, and had hatred for the
family of Your Prophet. O’ Allah {SWT}, make his grave tight upon him.'"
And when his coffin bier is raised, say: "O’ Allah {SWT}, do not raise him up or purify him."
And if he However, if he is considered weak (Mustadh’af), say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive those who repent, follow Your way, and protect them from the
torment of Hell."
If you are unaware of his condition, then say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, if he loved good and its people, forgive him, have mercy upon him, and
overlook him."
And If the Mustadh’af has a connection to you, seek forgiveness for him as an
intercession but not as an expression of loyalty."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِي عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ فَقُلِ اللّهُمْ إِنَّا لا نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ عَدُوُّ لَكَ وَ لِرَسُولِكَ اللَّهُمّ فَاحْشُ قَبْرَهُ نَاراً وَ أُحْشُ جَوْفَهُ نَاراً وَ عَجِّلْهُ إِلَى
النَّارِ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُوَالِي أَعْدَاءَكَ وَ يُعَادِي أَوْلِيَاءَكَ وَ يُنْغِضُ أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ اللّهُمَّ ضَيّقْ عَلَيْهِ قَبْرَهُ فَإِذَا رُفِعَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ
لاَ تَرْفَعْهُ وَ لا تُزَكِّهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُسْتَضْعَفاً فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ «لِلَّذِينَ تابُوا وَ اِتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَ قِهِمْ عَذْابَ الْجَحِيمِ» فَإِذَا
كُنْتَ لاَ تَذْرِي مَا حَالُهُ فَقُلِ اللّهُمْ إِنْ كَانَ يُحِبُّ الْخَيْرَ وَ أُهْلَهُ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَ اِرْحَمْهُ وَ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ » وَ إِنْ كَانَ
اَلْمُسْتَضْعَفُ مِنْكَ بِسَبِيلٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ الشَّفَاعَةِ مِنْكَ لاَ عَلَى وَجْهِ الْوَلاَيَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
When Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} performed the funeral prayer for a man and a
woman together, he would place the woman in front and the man behind.
When praying for a slave and a free person, he would place the slave in front and the
free person behind. When praying for an elder and a child, he would place the child in
front and the elder behind.
text_ar:
وَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الرَّجْلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ قَدَّمَ ٱلْمَرْأَةَ وَ أَخِّرَ الرَّجُلَ وَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى اَلْعَبْدِ وَ
الْحُرِّ قَدَّمَ الْعَبْدَ وَ أَخَرَ الْحُرِّ وَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الْكَبِيرِ وَ الصَّغِيرِ قَدَّمَ الصَّغِيرَ وَ أَخَرَ الْكَبِيرَ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 175 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 169 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 322 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 471 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 430 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 126

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that
He said: "There is no harm in placing the man in front and the woman behind or in
placing the woman in front and the man behind"

Scholar's Note:
This is referring to the arrangement of the funeral prayer for the deceased.
The preferred position in the funeral prayer is the last row, and the reason for this is
that women used to mix with men during the funeral prayer.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُقَدَّمَ الرَّجُلُ وَ تُؤْخِرَ الْمَرْأَةُ
أَوْ تُقَدَّمَ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ وَ يُؤَخِّرَ الرَّجُلُ. - يعني في الصلاة على الميت.
وأفضل المواضع في الصلاة على الميت الصف الأخير، والعلة في ذلك أن النساء كن يختلطن بالرجال في الصلاة على
الجنازة.
commentary:
This is referring to the arrangement of the funeral prayer for the deceased.
The preferred position in the funeral prayer is the last row, and the reason for this is
that women used to mix with men during the funeral prayer.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
The Prophet, said: "The best place in the funeral prayer is the last row."

Scholar's Note:
Therefore, people should move back to the last row, as its merit remains as the
Prophet {a.s} described.
Furthermore, if a man is invited to both a feast (walimah) and a funeral, he should
attend the funeral, as it reminds him of the hereafter, and leave the feast, as it reminds
him of worldly matters.
text_ar:
فَقَالَ النَّبِيُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «أَفْضَلُ ٱلْمَوَاضِعِ فِي الصَّلَاَةِ عَلَى ٱلْمَيَّتِ الصَّفُ ٱلْأَخِيرُ.
فتأخرن إلى الصف الأخير فبقي فضله على ما ذكره عليه السلام. وإذا دعي الرجل إلى وليمة وإلى جنازة أجاب إلى الجنازة
الأنها تذكر أمر الآخرة، ويدع الوليمة لأنها تذكر الدنيا.
commentary:
Therefore, people should move back to the last row, as its merit remains as the
Prophet {a.s} described.
Furthermore, if a man is invited to both a feast (walimah) and a funeral, he should
attend the funeral, as it reminds him of the hereafter, and leave the feast, as it reminds
him of worldly matters.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Tahdhib, Volume 1, p. 343 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 176
text_chunk:
The Prophet, said: "The best place in the funeral prayer is the last row." Scholar's Note:
Therefore, people should move back to the last row, as its merit remains as the
Prophet {a.s} described.
Furthermore, if a man is invited to both a feast (walimah) and a funeral, he should

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
The Prophet, said:
"If you are invited to funerals, hasten to attend, but if you are invited to weddings, take
your time."

Scholar's Note:
My father wrote in his letter to me:
Do not offer the funeral prayer while wearing a sandal with an elevated heel, and do
not rush with two deceased people together on one bier. He also said: When two
people are praying over a deceased person, one should stand behind the Imam, not
next to him. If a man, a woman, a boy, and a slave are all part of the funeral, position
the woman closest to the Qibla, followed by the slave, then the boy, and then the man
nearest to the Imam. The Imam stands behind the man and prays over them all with a
single prayer.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَائِزِ فَأْسْرِعُوا وَ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَرَائِسِ فَأْبْطِنُوا.
وقال أبي - رضي اللّٰه عنه - في رسالته إلي: لا تصل على الجنازة بنعل حذو ولا تعجل ميتين على جنازة. وقال: إذا صلى
رجلان على جنازة قام أحدهما خلف الامام ولم يقم بجنبه. وقال: إذا اجتمع جنازة رجل وامرأة وغلام ومملوك فقدم المرأة
إلى القبلة، واجعل المملوك بعدها، واجعل الغلام بعد المملوك، واجعل الرجل بعد الغلام مما يلي الامام ويقف الامام خلف
الرجل فيصلي عليهم جميعا صلاة واحدة.
commentary:
My father wrote in his letter to me:
Do not offer the funeral prayer while wearing a sandal with an elevated heel, and do
not rush with two deceased people together on one bier. He also said: When two
people are praying over a deceased person, one should stand behind the Imam, not
next to him. If a man, a woman, a boy, and a slave are all part of the funeral, position
the woman closest to the Qibla, followed by the slave, then the boy, and then the man
nearest to the Imam. The Imam stands behind the man and prays over them all with a
single prayer.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
performing the funeral prayer without being in a state of ritual ablution (wudu).
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes, it is permissible, for it is comprised of takbir (saying 'Allahu
Akbar'), tasbih (glorification of Allah {SWT}), tahmid (praise of Allah {SWT}), and tahlil
(declaration of 'La ilaha illa Allah {SWT}'), just as you say them in your home."

Scholar's Note:
In another narration, it is mentioned: "One may perform tayammum (dry ablution) if
they wish."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ يُونُسُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْجِنَازَةِ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ
إنَّمَا هِيَ تَكْبِيرٌ وَ تَسْبِيحٌ وَ تَحْمِيدٌ وَ تَهْلِيلٌ كَمَا تَكَبَّرُ وَ تُسَبِّحُ فِي بَيْتِكَ.
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: «أنّهُ يَتَيَمَمُ إنْ أحَبّ
commentary:
In another narration, it is mentioned: "One may perform tayammum (dry ablution) if
they wish."
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
performing the funeral prayer without being in a state of ritual ablution (wudu).
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes, it is permissible, for it is comprised of takbir (saying 'Allahu
Akbar'), tasbih (glorification of Allah {SWT}), tahmid (praise of Allah {SWT}), and tahlil
(declaration of 'La ilaha illa Allah {SWT}'), just as you say them in your home." Scholar's Note:
In another narration, it is mentioned: "One may perform tayammum (dry ablution) if
they wish."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"A menstruating woman may participate in the funeral prayer but does not stand in the
rows with the rest of the congregation."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: «أَنَّ الْحَائِضَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى ٱلْجِنَازَةِ وَ لا تَصُفُ مَعَهُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 170 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 421

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
In a narration of Sama’a ibn Mehran from Imam Jafar Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"A menstruating woman who is present at a funeral should perform tayammum (dry
ablution) and pray for the deceased, standing apart and separate from the row."

Scholar's Note:
This means that She stands to the side and does not mix with the men.
Similarly, a person in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) should also perform
tayammum and then offer the funeral prayer.
When the deceased is carried to the grave, it should not be rushed or hurriedly placed
into the grave, as the grave is a place with immense awe and trials.
The one carrying the body should seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from the difficulties of the
grave.
The deceased should be placed near the edge of the grave for a moment to prepare
and then moved closer gradually.
The person authorized by the guardian of the deceased may place the body in the
grave, either with two people (in pairs) or one at a time. At the sight of the grave, one
should say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, make it a garden from the gardens of Paradise and not a pit from the pits
of Hellfire".
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: «فِي الطَّامِتِ إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الْجِئَازَةَ تَتَيَمَّمُ وَ
تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا وَ تَقُومُ وَحْدَهَا بَارِزَةً مِنَ الصَّفَّ.»
يعني أنها تقف ناحية ولا تختلط بالرجال. والجنب إذا قدم للصلاة على الجنازة تيمم وصلى عليها. وإذا حمل الميت إلى
قبره فلا يفاجأ به القبر لان للقبر أهوالا عظيمة، ويتعوذ حامله بالله من هول المطلع ، ويضعه قرب شفير القبر، ويصبر عليه
هنيئة، ثم يقدمه قليلا ويصبر عليه هنيئة ليأخذ أهبته ثم يقدمه إلى شفير القبر، ويدخله القبر من يأمره ولي الميت إن
شاء شفعا وإن شاء وترا، ويقال عند النظر إلى القبر: " اللهم اجعله روضة من رياض الجنة ولا تجعله حفرة من حفر النيران.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The depth of the grave is to the
collarbone (clavicle)."

Scholar's Note:
Some have said it is to the chest, while others have said it should be as deep as the
height of a man, so that the shroud can cover the head of the deceased in the grave.
As for the niche (luhd), it should be wide enough to allow for the deceased to sit up.
It is narrated from Imam al-Hadi {a.s} that it is permissible for the grave to be lined with
wooden boards and covered with them over the deceased.
Each thing has its place, and the entrance to the grave is at the feet of the deceased.
When burying a woman, She should be lowered into the grave from the side, with her
husband standing where he can support her hip, while a man is lowered from his feet
and slid in gently.
My father wrote in his letter to me:
When you enter the grave, recite the Surah Al-Fatiha, the two chapters of seeking
refuge (Surah Al-Falaq & Surah An-Nas), and the Ayatul Kursi (2:255).
When you receive the deceased, say: "In the name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, and
in the religion of the Messenger of Allah {saws} and his family."
Place the deceased on their right side, facing the Qibla, untie the shroud, place their
cheek on the earth, and say: "O’ Allah {SWT}, make the earth gentle on their sides, raise
their soul to You, and grant them Your pleasure."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «حَدُّ اَلْقَبْرِ إِلَى التَّرْقُوَةِ»
وقال بعضهم: إلى الثديين وقال بعضهم: قامة الرجل حتى يمد الثوب على رأس من في القبر، وأما اللحد فإنه يوسع بقدر
ما يمكن الجلوس فيه. وقد روى عن أبي الحسن الثالث عليه السلام إطلاق في أن يفرش القبر بالساج ويطبق على الميت
الساج. ولكل شى باب وباب القبر عند رجلي الميت. والمرأة تؤخذ بالعرض من قبل اللحد ويقف زوجها في موضع يتناول
وركها ويؤخذ الرجل من قبل رجليه يسل سلا. وقال أبي رحمه اللّٰه في رسالته إلي: إذا دخلت القبر فاقراً أم الكتاب
والمعوذتين وآية الكرسي، فإذا تناولت الميت فقل: " بسم اللّٰه وبالله وعلى ملة رسول اللّٰه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله " ثم ضعه
في لحده على يمينه مستقبل القبلة وحل عقد كفنه، وضع خده على التراب وقل: " اللهم جاف الأرض عن جنبيه، وصعد
إليك روحه ولقه منك رضوانا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Salim ibn Mukram narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that
He said: "A pillow of earth should be placed for the deceased, and a clump of soil
behind their back to prevent them from lying flat. The knots of their shroud should be
untied, their face uncovered, and supplications should be made:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, this is Your servant, the child of Your servant and maidservant. They have
returned to You, and You are the best to receive.
O’ Allah {SWT}, expand their grave for them, teach them their proof, and join them with
their Prophet. Protect them from the trial of Munkar and Nakir.'"
Then, place your right hand under their right shoulder and your left hand on their left
shoulder, and shake them firmly while saying:
"O’ [name of the deceased], child of [father’s name], Allah {SWT} is your Lord {AZJ},
Muhammad is your Prophet, Islam is your religion, Ali is your guardian and Imam" -
Name each of the Imams, ending with: 'Your Imams are the guides and the righteous.'
Then repeat the talqeen (prompting of faith) once more.
And when you put earth over him or when placing bricks over the grave, say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, have mercy on their loneliness, connect their solitude, comfort their
fear, and fill them with Your mercy so that they need no mercy from anyone other than
You. Unite them with those they loved."
When visiting their grave, recite this supplication facing the Qibla, with hands on the
grave.
Upon exiting the grave, while brushing the dirt off your hands, say:
"Indeed, we belong to Allah {SWT}, and indeed, to Him we shall return."
Throw dirt onto the grave with the backs of your hands three times, saying:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, we believe in You and affirm Your Book. This is what You and Your
Messenger have promised, and Allah {SWT} and His Messenger have spoken the truth."
Whoever performs this and says these words will earn a reward for every particle of
soil.
Once the grave is made/leveled, pour water over it, beginning at the head and circling
around all four sides, returning to the head without breaking the flow of water. If any
water remains, pour it in the middle of the grave.
Place your hand on the grave, supplicate for the deceased, and seek forgiveness for
them.
text_ar:
وَ قَدْ رَوَى سَالِمُ بْنُ مُكْرَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يُجْعَلُ لَهُ وِسَادَةٌ مِنْ تُرَابٍ وَ يُجْعَلُ
خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ مَدَرَةً لِئَلاً يَسْتَلْقِيَ وَ يُحَلُّ عُقَدُ كَفَنِهِ كُلَّهَا وَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ يُدْعَى لَهُ وَ يُقَالُ اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَ اِبْنُ
عَبْدِكَ وَ اِبْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَزَلَ بِكَ وَ أَنتَ خَيْرُ مَنْزُولِ بِهِ اللَّهُمَّ اِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ لَقُنْهُ حُجَّتَهُ وَ اَلْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَ قِهِ شَرَّ
مُنْكَرٍ وَ نَكِيرٍ ثُمَّ تُدْخِلُ يَدَكَ الْيُمْنَى تَحْتَ مَنْكِبِهِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَ تَضَعُ يَدَكَ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ الْأَيْسَرِ وَ تُحَرِّكُهُ تَحْرِيكاً
شَدِيداً وَ تَقُولُ يَا فُلانَ بْنَ فُلاَنِ اللَّهُ رَبْكَ وَ مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُكَ وَ الْإِسْلامُ دِينُكَ وَ عَلِيٌّ وَلِيْكَ وَ إِمَامُكَ وَ تُسَمِّي الْأَئِمَةَ
عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلامُ وَاحِداً وَاحِداً إِلَى آخِرِهِمْ أَيِمَثُكَ أَئِمَةُ هُدى أَبْرَارٌ ثُمَّ تُعِيدُ عَلَيْهِ التَّلْقِينَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى وَ إِذَا وَضَعْتَ
عَلَيْهِ اللِّبِنَ فَقُلٍ: اللَّهُمَّ اِرْحَمْ غُرْبَتَهُ وَ صِلْ وَحْدَتَهُ وَ آنِسْ وَحْشَتَهُ وَ آمِنْ رَوْعَتَهُ وَ أَسْكِنْ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ رَحْمَةً
بَسْتَغْنِي بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةٍ مَنْ سِوَاكَ وَ أُحْشُرْهُ مَعَ مَنْ كَانَ يَتَوَلاهُ وَ مَتَى زُرْتَ قَبْرَهُ فَادْعُ لَهُ بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ وَ أَنْتَ
مُسْتَقْبِلُ ٱلْقِبْلَةِ وَ يَدَاكَ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ فَإِذَا خَرَجْتَ مِنَ الْقَبْرِ فَقُلْ وَ أَنْتَ تَنْفُضُ يَدَيْكَ مِنَ التُّرَابِ: «إِنَّا لِلهِ وَ إِنَّا إِلَيْهِ
زاجِعُونَ» ثُمَّ أُحْثُ التُّرَابَ عَلَيْهِ بِظَهْرِ كَفَّيْكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِيمَاناً بِكَ وَ تَصْدِيقاً بِكِتَابِكَ هَذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا
اللَّهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ وَ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ وَقَالَ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَاتِ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ حَسَنَةً فَإِذَا سُوِّيّ
قَبْرُهُ فَصُبَ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ ٱلْمَاءَ وَ تَجْعَلُ ٱلْقَبْرَ أَمَامَكَ وَ أَنْتَ مُسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةِ وَ تَبْدَأَ بِصَبِّ الْمَاءِ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ وَ تَدُورُ بِهِ
عَلَى قَبْرِهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعِ جَوَانِبِهِ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ إِلَى الرَّأْسِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَقْطَعَ الْمَاءَ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ شَيْءٌ فَصُبَّهُ عَلَى
وَسَطِ اَلْقَبْرِ ثُمَّ ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ وَ أُدْعُ لِلْمَيَّتِ وَ اِسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 172 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 521 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 179

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE FUNERAL PRAYER (SALAT AL-JANAZAH)
text_en:
Yahya ibn Abdullah narrates from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"There is no harm for the family of the deceased among you to help the deceased
prepare for the encounter with Munkar and Nakir (the questioning angels).” I asked:
“How should we do that?”
Imam {a.s} said: “When the deceased is placed in the grave, the closest person to them
should remain by their side, place their mouth near the head of the deceased, and call
out in a loud voice:
"O’ [name of the deceased], child of [father’s name], are you still on the covenant upon
which we left you - the testimony that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone without
partner, and that Muhammad {saws} is His servant and Messenger, the Master of the
Prophets; that Ali is The Commander of the Faithful, the Master of the Successors; that
what Muhammad {saws} brought is the truth; that death is real, resurrection is real, and
that the Hour is coming without a doubt, and that Allah {SWT} will raise those who are in
the graves?"
If this is said: Munkar will turn to Nakir and say:
“Let us leave, for he has been properly instructed (given Talqeen)."

Scholar's Note:
The term "ma'tam” originally referred to a gathering of men and women for either
sorrowful or joyful occasions. Over time, it became specifically associated with
gatherings of women during times of mourning for the deceased.
It has also been said to apply particularly to young women in mourning (Al-Nihaya).
Additionally, the term "matam" can also refer to food that is prepared for the deceased
("Fi").
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «مَا عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَيَّتِ مِنْكُمْ
أَنْ يَدْرَءُوا عَنْ مَيَّتِهِمْ لِقَاءَ مُنكَرٍ وَ نَكِيرٍ » فَقُلْتُ وَ كَيْفَ نَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَفْرِدَ الْمَيَّثُ فَلْيَتَخَلِّف عِنْدَهُ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ
بِهِ فَيَضَعَ فَاهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ يُنَادِيَ بِأَعْلَى صَوْتِهِ: يَا فُلانَ بْنَ فُلانٍ أَوْ يَا فُلانَةَ بِئْتَ فُلانَةَ هَلْ أَنْتَ عَلَى ٱلْعَهْدِ ٱلَّذِي
فَارَقْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ
سَيِّدُ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ أَنْ عَلِيّاً أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ سَيِّدُ الْوَصِيِّينَ وَ أَنَّ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ حَقُّ وَ أَنَّ
الْمَوْتَ حَقٌّ وَ الْبَعْثَ حَقٌّ «وَ أَنَّ الشَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَ أَنّ اللهَ يَنْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ» فَإِذَا قَالَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ مُنْكَرْ
لِنَكِيرٍ اِنْصَرِفْ بِنَا عَنْ هَذَا فَقَدْ لُقَّنَ بِهَا حُجَتَهُ

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever consoles a grieving person will be clothed in a robe of honor on the Day of
Standing (the Day of Judgment), which will bring them joy (and honor)."
text_ar:
باب - باب التعزية والجزع عند المصيبة وزيارة القبور والنوح والمأتم
المأتم في الأصل: مجتمع الرجال والنساء في الغم والفرح، ثم خص باجتماع النساء للموت وقيل هو للشواب من النساء لا
غير (النهاية) ويطلق على الطعام للميت (في)
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ عَزَّى حَزِيناً كُسِيَ فِي ٱلْمَوْقِفِ حَلَّةً يُحَبَّرُ بِهَا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING
text_en:
It was narrated from Hisham ibn al-Hakam that He said:
"I saw Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} offering condolences both before and after
the burial."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ يُعَزِّي قَبْلَ الدَّفْنِ وَ بَعْدَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 463 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 217 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 215

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The obligatory act of offering condolences is after the burial."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «التَّعْزِيَةُ ٱلْوَاجِبَةُ بَعْدَ ٱلدَّفْنِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 204 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 174 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 552 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 216 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 112

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"It is sufficient as a form of condolence for the bereaved to see you."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «كَفَاكَ مِنَ التَّعْزِيَةِ بِأَنْ يَرَاكَ صَاحِبُ ٱلْمُصِيبَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 174 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 551

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} visited a group of people who had experienced a loss and
said:
"May Allah {SWT} strengthen you in your weakness, grant you beautiful patience, and
have mercy on your deceased." Then Imam {a.s} departed (from the funeral).
text_ar:
وَ أَثَى أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَوْما قَدْ أُصِيبُوا بِمُصِيبَةٍ فَقَالَ «جَبَرَ اللَّهُ وَهَنَكُمْ وَ أَحْسَنَ عَزَاكُمْ وَ رَجِمَ
مُتَوَفَّاكُمْ» ثُمَّ اِنْصَرَفَ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
The truthful one, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, offered condolences
to a man who had lost his son and said to him: "Allah {SWT} is better for your son than
you are, and the reward from Allah {SWT} is better for you than your son."
Later, when the Imam heard of the man's continued grief, he returned to him and said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} also passed away; do you not take him as an example?"
The man said that his son was on the verge of maturity (approaching adulthood).
The Imam then said (consoling him): "There are three things ahead of him: the
testimony that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, Allah’s {SWT} mercy, and the intercession
of the Messenger of Allah {saws}. He will not miss out on any of these, if Allah {SWT} the
Almighty wills."
text_ar:
وَ عَزَّى الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلاً بِابْنِ لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ «آللَّهُ خَيْرٌ لإِبْنِكَ مِنْكَ وَ ثَوَابُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ
لَكَ مِنْهُ» فَبَلَغَهُ جَزَّعُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَعَادَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «قَدْ مَاتَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَفَمَا لَكَ بِهِ أُسْوَةً»
فَقَالَ لَهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُرَاهِقاً فَقَالَ لَهُ «إِنَّ أَمَامَهُ ثَلاَثَ خِصَالٍ شَهَادَةَ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلا آللَّهُ وَ رَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ وَ شَفَاعَةَ رَسُولِ
اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَلَنْ تَفُوتَهُ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"It is proper for the person responsible for the funeral (i.e., the chief mourner) not to
wear an outer cloak (ridā') and to remain in a shirt (Qamis) so that they are recognized
(as grieving). It is also proper for the neighbors to provide food on their behalf for three
days.”
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِصَاحِبِ الْجِنَازَةِ أَنْ لاَ يَلْبَسَ رِدَاءً وَ أَنْ يَكُونَ
فِي قَمِيصٍ حَتَّى يُعْرَفَ وَ يَنْبَغِي لِجِيرَانِهِ أَنْ يُطْعِمُوا عَنْهُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "Cursed!, cursed is the one who puts down (removes) their
cloak (rida') in the misfortune of someone else."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «مَلْعُونٌ مَلْعُونٌ مَنْ وَضَعَ رِدَاءَهُ فِي مُصِيبَةِ غَيْرِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 174 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 307 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 554 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 441 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 71

text_en:
"When Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s} passed away, Imam Hasan ibn Ali
Al-Askari {a.s}, was seen coming out of the house with his shirt torn from the front and
the back."
text_ar:
وَ لَمَّا قُبِضَ عَلِيْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ الْعَسْكَرِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رُئِيَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنَ ٱَلدَّارِ
وَ قَدْ شُقًّ قَمِيصُهُ مِنْ خَلْفٍ وَ قُدَّامِ.

text_en:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} placed his cloak down during the funeral of Sa'd
ibn Mu'adh (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him). When asked about this, Prophet {saws}
said:
"I saw the angels had placed their cloaks down, so I placed mine as well."
text_ar:
وَ قَدْ وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ رِدَاءَهُ فِي جِنَازَةِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ قَسُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ
فَقَالَ «إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ قَدْ وَضَعَتْ أُرْدِيَتَهَا فَوَضَعْتُ رِدَائِي.

text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "If patience had not been created before trials, the
believer would have shattered like an egg striking a rock."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «لَوْ لا أَنَّ الصَّبْرَ خُلِقَ قَبْلَ ٱلْبَلاَءِ لَتَفَطَّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ كَمَا تَتَفَطَّرُ ٱلْبَيْضَةُ عَلَى الصَّفَا.

Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "If patience had not been created before trials, the
believer would have shattered like an egg striking a rock."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "There are four qualities; whoever possesses
them will be in the greatest light of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted and Glorious:"
One whose protection is in the testimony that there is no god but Allah {SWT} and that I
am the Messenger of Allah {saws},
And one who, when afflicted with a calamity, says:
"Indeed, we belong to Allah {SWT} and to Him we will return"
And one who, when blessed with goodness, says:
"All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds"
And one who, when committing a sin, says:
"I seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT} and repent to Him."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «أَرْبَعْ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ فِي نُورِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ٱلْأَعْظَمِ مَنْ كَانَ
عِضْمَةُ أَمْرِهِ شَهَادَةَ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللّهُ وَ أَنَّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَ مَنْ إِذَا أَصَابَثَهُ مُصِيبَةً قَالَ «إِنَا لِلُهِ وَ إِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ» وَ
مَنْ إِذَا أَصَابَ خَيْراً قَالَ «اَلْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» وَ مَنْ إِذَا أَصَابَ خَطِيئَةً قَالَ «أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Whenever a believer is afflicted with a calamity in this world and responds by reciting
the phrase of 'istirja' (saying 'Indeed, we belong to Allah {SWT} and to Him we will return')
at the moment of calamity and exhibits patience, Allah {SWT} forgives their past sins,
except for major sins for which Allah {SWT} has decreed Hellfire.
Additionally, each time the believer remembers that calamity in the future, recites
'istirja' again, and praises Allah {SWT}, Allah {SWT} forgives all sins committed between the
first instance of istirja' and the next, except for major sins."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنِ يُصَابُ بِمُصِيبَةٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَيَسْتَرْجِعُ عِنْدَ مُصِيبَتِهِ وَ يَصْبِرُ
جينَ تَفْجَأهُ الْمُصِيبَةُ إِلَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَا مَضَى مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ إِلَّ ٱلْكَبَائِرَ آلَّتِي أَوْجَبَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ عَلَيْهَا النَّارَ وَ كُلَّمَا
ذَكَرَ مُصِيبَتَهُ فِيمَا يَسْتَقْبِلُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ فَاسْتَرْجَعَ عِنْدَهَا وَ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عِنْدَهَا، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ كُلَّ ذَنْبِ اِكْتَسَبَهُ
فِيمَا بَيْنَ الاِسْتِرْجَاعِ الْأَوَّلِ إِلَى الإِسْتِرْجَاعِ الْأَخِيرِ إِلاَّا الْكَبَائِرَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ.

chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"There is an angel assigned to the cemeteries.
When the family of the deceased returns home after the funeral, this angel takes a
handful of soil and throws it after them, saying, 'Forget what you have seen.'
Were it not for this, no one would find any benefit (joy) in living."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ مَلَكاً مُوَكَّلاً بِالْمَقَابِرِ فَإِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ أَهْلُ الْمَيَّتِ
مِنْ جَنَازَتِهِمْ عَنْ مَيَّتِهِمْ أَخَذَ قَبْضَةً مِنْ ثُرَابٍ فَرَمَى بِهَا فِي آثَارِهِمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ اِنْسَوْا مَا رَأَيْتُمْ فَلَوْ لاَ ذَلِكَ مَا اِنْتَفَعَ
أحَدٌ بعيش.

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever is afflicted with a calamity, whether they express intense grief over it or not,
whether they exercise patience or not, their reward from Allah {SWT}, the Exalted and
Glorious, is Paradise."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «مَنْ أُصِيبَ بِمُصِيبَةِ جَزِعَ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ لَمْ يَجْزَعُ صَبَرَ عَلَيْهَا أَمْ لَمْ يَصْبِرْ كَانَ
ثَوَابُهُ مِنَ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الْجَنَّةَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 176 • Muskkin al-Fu’ād, Part 1, p. 21 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 567 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 116

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The reward for a believer whose child dies is Paradise, whether they exhibit patience
or not”.
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «ثَوَابُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ وَلَدِهِ إِذَا مَاتَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ صَبَرَ أَوْ لَمْ يَصْبِرْ
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 219 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 176 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 284 • Muskkin al-Fu’ād, Part 1, p. 20 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 547 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 244 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 332 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 116

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever loses a child (before their own passing), it is better for them than leaving
behind seventy children after them, all of whom rode horses and fought in the way of
Allah {SWT}, the Exalted and Glorious."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ قَدَّمَ وَلَداً كَانَ خَيْراً لَهُ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ يُخَلِّفُهُمْ بَعْدَهُ كُلُّهُمْ قَدْ رَكِبَ الْخَيْلَ وَ قَاتَلَ فِي
سَبِيلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 176 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 245

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"No one will enter Paradise unless they have a farat (one who goes ahead)."
A man who had no children and had not lost any asked:
"O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, does everyone among us have a farat?"
The Prophet replied: "Yes, among the farat of a believer is their brother in faith who
preceded them (in death) for the sake of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted and Glorious."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ لَهُ فَرَطْ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يُولَدْ
لَهُ وَ لَمْ يُقَدَّمْ وَلَداً يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أ وَ لِكُلِّنَا قَرَطْ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّ مِنْ قَرَطِ ٱلرَّجُلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ أَخَاهُ فِي اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.

text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said to Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A} when Ja'far
ibn Abi Talib was martyred:
"Do not supplicate with (expressions of) humiliation, loss, or desolation. Whatever you
have said about him is true."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِفَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ جِينَ قُتِلَ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبِ «لا تَدْعِي بِذُلَ وَ لاَ تَكَلٍ
وَلَاَ حَرَبٍ وَ مَا قُلْتِ فِيهِ فَقَدْ صَدَقْتِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 176 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 105

chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
it was narrated from Mehran ibn Muhammad that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad
Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When a person dies, Allah {SWT}, the Exalted and Glorious, sends an angel to the one
among their family who is most deeply affected by the loss. The angel touches their
heart and alleviates the intensity of grief. If it were not for this, the world would not be
able to continue”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مِهْرَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ ٱَلْمَيّتَ إِذَا مَاتَ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مَلَكاً
إلَى أَوْجَعِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ فَمَسَحَ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ فَأَنْسَاهُ لَوْعَةَ ٱلْحُرْنِ لَوْ لا ذَلِكَ لَمْ تُعْمَرِ الدُّنْيَا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "When the child of a believer passes away,
Allah {SWT} – knowing best what His servant has said – asks the angels: 'Have you taken
the child of My believing servant?' They reply: 'Yes, our Lord {AZJ}.'
Allah {SWT} then asks: 'What did My servant say?'
They say: "He praised You and said: "Indeed, we belong to Allah {SWT} and to Him we will
return"
Then Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, says: "'Build for My servant a house in Paradise and name
it the House of Praise (Bayt al-Hamd).'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِذَا قُبِضَ وَلَدُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ وَ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا قَالَ ٱلْعَبْدُ فَيَسْأَلُ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ
قَبَضْتُمْ وَلَدَ فُلاَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ فَيَقُولُونَ نَعَمْ رَبَّنَا فَيَقُولُ فَمَا ذَا قَالَ عَبْدِيَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ فَيَقُولُونَ حَمِدَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ اِسْتَرْجَعَ
فَيَقُولُ اللَهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ اِبْنُوا لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ ' وَ سَمُوهُ بَيْتَ الْحَمْدِ.

text_en:
When Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s}, saw a funeral procession, He would say:
'Praise be to Allah {SWT} who did not make me from among those whose lives were
abruptly taken'".
text_ar: - وَكَانَ عَلِيْ بْنُ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ إِذَا رَأَى جَنَازَةً قَالَ » ٱَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي لَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي مِنَ ٱلسَّوَادِ ٱلْمُخْتَرَمِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 167 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 177 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 452 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 391 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 157 • Awalim al-Ulum, Vol. 18, p. 155

author: Shaykh al-Saduq

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah {saws} passed away, the Prophet said:
'We are grieved by your departure, O’ Ibrahim, and we are patient. The heart is
sorrowful, and the eyes shed tears, but we do not say that which displeases the Lord
{AZJ}.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «لَمَّا مَاتَ إبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللَهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «حَزِنَّا عَلَيْكَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَ إِنَّا لَصَابِرُونَ يَحْزَنُ الْقَلْبُ وَ تَدْمَعُ الْعَيْنُ وَ لا نَقُولُ مَا يُسْخِطُ الرَّبَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 177 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 571 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 280 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 283 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 398
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah {saws} passed away, the Prophet said:
'We are grieved by your departure, O’ Ibrahim, and we are patient. The heart is
sorrowful, and the eyes shed tears, but we do not say that which displeases the Lord
{AZJ}.'"

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When The Prophet {saws} received news of the deaths of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib {a.s} and Zayd
ibn Harithah, he would weep intensely when he entered his house and would say,
'They used to converse with me and bring me comfort, and now they are both gone.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ جِينَ جَاءَثْهُ وَفَاةُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ
زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ كَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ كَثُرَ بُكَاؤُهُ عَلَيْهِمَا جِدَاً وَ يَقُولُ «كَانَا يُحَدَّثَانِي وَ يُؤَانِسَانِي فَذَهَبَا جَمِيعاً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 177 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 571 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 280 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 21, p. 55

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Indeed, trials and patience race toward the believer, so when trials reach him, he is
patient. But panic and trials race toward the disbeliever, so when trials reach him, he
panics."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «إِنَّ ٱلْبَلاَءَ وَ الصِّبْرَ يَسْتَبِقَانٍ إلَى الْمُوْمِنِ فَيَأْتِيهِ الْبَلاَءُ وَ هُوَ صَبُورٌ وَ إِنَّ ٱلْجَزَعَ وَ الْبَلاَءَ
يَسْتَبِقَانٍ إلَى الْكَافِرِ فَيَأْتِيهِ الْبَلاءُ وَ هُوَ جَزُوعُ.
cross_references: Al-Muʾmin, Part 1, p. 63 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 223 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 177 • Muskkin al-Fu’ād, Part 1, p. 51 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 566 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 256 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 68, p. 95 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 142 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 65

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
It was narrated from Al-Kahili that He said: "I said to Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa
ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}:
‘My wife and my sister, who is the wife of Muhammad ibn Marid, go out to mourning
gatherings. I prohibited them, but they said to me, 'If it is forbidden, we will refrain, but
if it is not forbidden, why do you prevent us when people refrain from fulfilling our rights
(if we do not attend)?’
Imam {a.s} replied: 'You ask me about rights? My father {a.s} used to send my mother and
Umm Farwah to fulfil the rights of the people of Medina.'
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ الْكَاهِلِيَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ إِنَّ اِمْرَأَتِي وَ أُخَتِي وَ هِيَ
اِمْرَأَةُ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ مَارِدٍ تَخْرُجَانٍ فِي الْمَاتِمِ فَأَنْهَاهُمَا فَقَالَتَا لِي إِنْ كَانَ حَرَاماً اِنْتَهَيْنَا عَنْهُ وَ إنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ حَرَاماً فَلِمَ
تَمْنَعْنَا فَيَمْتَنعَ النَّاسُ مِنْ قَضَاءِ حُقُوقِنَا فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ «عَنِ ٱلْحُقُوقِ تَسْأَلْنِي كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ يَبْعَثُ أُمِّي
وَأُمَّ فَرْوَةَ تَقْضِيَانِ حُقُوقَ أَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"No one will be questioned in the grave except one who has perfected their faith
completely or one who has perfected disbelief completely. As for the rest, they will be
left alone until the Day of Resurrection."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: «لَاَ يُسْأَلُ فِي الْقَبْرِ إِلا مَنْ مَحَضَ الْإِيمَانَ مَحْضاً أَوْ مَحَضَ الْكُفْرَ مَحْضاً وَ
اَلْبَاقُونَ مَلَهُوْ عَنْهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
visiting graves and building mosques around them.
Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no issue with visiting graves, but no mosques should be
built around them."
text_ar:
وَ سَأْلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ: عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ وَ بِنَاءِ الْمَسَاجِدِ فِيهَا فَقَالَ «أَمَّا زِيَارَةُ ٱَلْقُبُورِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهَا وَ لا
يُبْنَى عِنْدَهَا مَسَاجِدُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 228 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 178 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 578 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 20

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
The Prophet Muhammad {saws} said:
"Do not take my grave as a qibla (direction of prayer) or a mosque. Indeed, Allah {SWT},
the Exalted and Glorious, cursed the Jews when they took the graves of their prophets
as places of worship."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لا تَتَخِذُوا قَبْرِي قِبْلَةً وَ لاَ مَسْجِداً فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ لَعَنَ الْيَهُودَ جِينَ
اِتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أُنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 178 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 451 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 235 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 161 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 20

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Jarrah al-Mada'ini asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about how to
offer salutations to the inhabitants of the graves.
Imam {a.s} replied: "[You should stand and] say:
'Peace be upon the inhabitants of the dwellings (graves) from among the believers and
the Muslims. May Allah {SWT} have mercy on those of us who have gone ahead and those
who will come later, and indeed, if Allah {SWT} wills, we shall join you.'"
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ جَرَّاحُ الْمَدَائِنِي أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: كَيْفَ التَّسْلِيمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقُبُورِ فَقَالَ «تَقِفُ وَ تَقُولُ:
السَّلَاَمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَجِمَ اللّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَ الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ وَ إِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ
لاحِقُونَ.
cross_references: Kamil al-Ziyarat, Part 1, p. 322 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 179 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 99, p. 298 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 366

author: Shaykh al-Saduq

text_en:
When the Messenger of Allah {saws} would pass by graves, he would say:
'Peace be upon you, O’ dwellers of the homes of believers. Indeed, if Allah {SWT} wills,
we shall join you.'"
text_ar:
وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا مَرَّ عَلَى الْقُبُورِ قَالَ «السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِ قَوْمِ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَ إِنَّا
إِنْ شَاءَ اللَهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 179 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 581

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} entered the
graveyard, He said:
"O’ inhabitants of the earth and estranged ones! As for your homes, they have been
inhabited; As for your spouses, they have remarried; And as for your wealth, it has
been divided. This is the news from our side ; if only I knew what news you have."
Then he turned to his companions and said:
"If they were permitted to respond, they would say, 'Indeed, the best provision is taqwā
(God-consciousness).'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ لَمَّا دَخَلَ الْمَقَابِرَ «يَا أَهْلَ التُّرْبَةِ وَ يَا أَهْلَ الْغُرْبَةِ أَمَّا الدُّورُ فَقَدْ سُكِنَّتْ وَ
أَمَّا الْأَزْوَاجُ فَقَدْ نُكِحَتْ وَ أَمَّا الْأَمْوَالُ فَقَدْ قُسِمَتْ، فَهَذَا خَبَرُ مَا عِنْدَنَا وَ لَيْتَ شِعْرِي مَا عِنْدَكُمْ» ثُمَّ اِلْتَفَتَ إِلَى
أضحَابِهِ وَقَالَ «لَوْ أَذِنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْجَوَابِ لَقَالُوا إِنَّ «خَيْرَ ٱلزَّادِ النَّقْوى»»
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 180 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 581

text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} stood over the bodies of those killed at Badr,
having gathered them into a well/pit, and said:
“O’ inhabitants of the well, we have found what our Lord {AZJ} promised us to be true;
have you found what your Lord {AZJ} promised to be true?”
The hypocrites replied: "The Messenger of Allah {saws} is speaking to the dead?"
He then turned to them and said: "If they were permitted to speak, they would say,
'Indeed, the best provision is taqwā (God-consciousness).'"
text_ar:
وَ وَقَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى الْقَثْلَى بِيَدْرٍ وَ قَدْ جَمَعَهُمْ فِي قَلِيبِ فَقَالَ «يَا أَهْلَ الْقَلِيبِ
إنّا «قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًا فَهَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا»» فَقَالَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ يُكَلَّمُ الْمَوْتَى
فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ « لَوْ أَذِنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْكَلامِ لَقَالُوا نَعَمْ وَ إِنَّ «خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوىٰ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 180 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 581

text_en:
Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A} used to visit the graves of the martyrs every
Saturday morning, and She would come to the grave of Hamzah {a.s}, show mercy upon
him, and seek forgiveness for him.
text_ar: - وَ كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ عَ تَأْتِي قُبُورَ الشُّهَدَاءِ كُلَّ غَدَاةِ سَبْتِ فَتَأْتِي قَبْرَ حَمْرَةَ فَتَتَرَحِّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَ تَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 180 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 465 • Taʿziyat al- Ḥazānā, Part 1, p. 273 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 579 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 224 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 43, p. 90 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 99, p. 300 • Awalim al-Ulum, Part 11, p. 269

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "When you enter the graveyard,
say :
“Peace be upon the people of Paradise."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ ٱلْجَبَّانَةَ فَقُلِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 180 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 582 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 226

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"When you enter the graveyards, step over the graves. Whoever is a believer will find
comfort from that, and whoever is a hypocrite will feel its pain."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ فَطَأِ الْقُبُورَ فَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِناً اِسْتَرْوَحَ
إِلَى ذَلِكَ وَ مَنْ كَانَ مُنَافِقاً وَجَدَ أَلَمَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 180 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 582 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 231 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 43 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 19 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 99, p. 300

"When you enter the graveyards, step over the graves. Whoever is a believer will find

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
It was narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim that He said: "I asked Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}: Do the dead know when we visit them?"
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, by Allah {SWT}, they know of your visits and they rejoice and find
comfort in your presence”
I said: "What should we say when we visit them?"
Imam {a.s} said: Say;
"O’ Allah {SWT}, make the earth light upon their sides, raise their souls to You, grant them
Your pleasure, and send upon them from Your mercy that which connects their
loneliness and soothes their desolation. Truly, You are powerful over all things."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ ٱلْمَوْتَى نَزُورُهُمْ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ
فَيَعْلَمُونَ بِنَا إِذَا أَتَيْنَاهُمْ فَقَالَ «إِي وَ اللّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَعْلَمُونَ بِكُمْ وَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِكُمْ وَ يَسْتَأْنِسُونَ إلَيْكُمْ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَأَيَّ
شَيْءٍ نَقُولُ إِذَا أَتَيْنَاهُمْ قَالَ «قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ جَافِ ٱلْأَرْضَ عَنْ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَ صَاعِدْ إِلَيْكَ أَرْوَاحَهُمْ وَ لَقُهِمْ مِنْكَ رِضْوَاناً وَ
أَسْكِنْ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا تَصِلُ بِهِ وَحْدَتَهُمْ وَ ثُوْنِسُ بِهِ وَحْشَتَهُمْ «إِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ».

text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} said:
"Whenever a believing servant visits the grave of a believer and recites 'Indeed, We
revealed it [the Qur'an] on the Night of Qadr' Surah Al-Qadr (97:1-5) seven times, Allah
{SWT} will forgive him and the person buried in the grave”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدِ مُؤْمِنٍ زَارَ قَبْرَ مُؤْمِنٍ فَقَرَأَ عِنْدَهُ « إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ))
سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ إِلاّ غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ وَ لِصَاحِبِ الْقَبْرِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Ishaq ibn Ammar asked Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-
Kadhim {a.s} about whether a believer visits their family (after death).
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes." He (Ishaq) asked: ‘How often?’
The Imam said: "It depends on their level of virtue; some visit every day, some every
two days, and some every three days."
He then noted, "The least frequent among them visit once a week."
He (Ishaq) then asked Him: "At what time?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "At the time of the sun's decline (midday) or just before that. Allah
{SWT} sends with them an angel who shows them what pleases them and conceals from
them what they dislike, so they see joy and return to a state of contentment”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارِ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ ٱلْمُوْمِنِ يَزُورُ أَهْلَهُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ فِي كَمْ
فَقَالَ «عَلَى قَدْرِ فَضَائِلِهِمْ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَزُورُ فِي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَزُورُ فِي كُلَّ يَوْمَيْنِ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَزُورُ فِي كُلَّ
ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ» قَالَ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ فِي مَجْرَى كَلاَمِهِ أَنَّهُ يَقُولُ «أَدْنَاهُمْ جُمْعَةً » فَقَالَ لَهُ فِي أَيَ سَاعَةٍ قَالَ «عِنْدَ زَوَالِ
الشَّمْسِ أَوْ قُبَيْلَ ذَلِكَ فَيَبْعَثُ اللهُ مَعَهُ مَلَكاً يُرِيهِ مَا يَسُرُّ بِهِ وَ يَسْتُرُ عَنْهُ مَا يَكْرَهُهُ فَيَرَى سُرُوراً وَ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى قُرَّةِ
عَيْنٍ.

text_en:
Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"Indeed, the disbeliever visits their family and sees what displeases them, while what
they would like is concealed from them (by the accompanying angels)."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَفْصُ بْنُ الْبَخْتَرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ: «أَنَّ الْكَافِرَ يَزُورُ أَهْلَهُ فَيَرَى مَا يَكْرَهُهُ وَ يُسْتَرُ عَنْهُ مَا
يُحِبُّ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 181 • Al-Muḥtaḍar, Part 1, p. 40 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p.

text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya said to Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}:
"I have heard that when a believer is visited by someone (at their grave), they are
comforted by their presence, but when the visitor leaves, they feel lonely."
Imam {a.s} replied: "They do not feel lonely."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ ٱلْمُوْمِنَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الزَّائِرُ
آَنَسَ بِهِ فَإِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ عَنْهُ اِسْتَوْحَشَ فَقَالَ «لا يَسْتَوْحِشُ.

text_en:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: "A mourning gathering (ma'tam) is to be held for the
deceased for three days from the day of their death."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يُصْنَعُ لِلْمَيَّتِ مَأْتَمٌ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامِ مِنْ يَوْمَ مَاتَ.
cross_references: Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 419 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 217 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 182 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 86 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 541 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 236 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 236 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 236 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 72 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 82

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} made a will specifying 800 dirhams to be used for his
mourning gathering (ma'tam), as he saw this as part of the tradition (sunnah).
This was because the Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Prepare food for the family of
Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, for they are preoccupied [by their loss]."
text_ar:
وَ أَوْصَى أَبُو جَعْفَرِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ بِثَمَانِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ لِمَأْتَمِهِ وَ كَانَ يَرَى ذَلِكَ لِلسُنَّةِ لِأَنْ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ «اِتَّخِذُوا لآلِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ طَعَاماً فَقَدْ شُغْلُوا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Imam al-Baqir {a.s} willed that he be lamented (mourned) during special
gatherings for ten years.

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Eating [a meal] at the home of those afflicted with a loss is from the practices of the
people of the pre-Islamic era (Jahiliya), The sunnah (tradition) is to send food to them,
as The Prophet {saws} ordered when the news of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib’s {a.s} martyrdom
came”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «الْأَكْلُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ ٱلْمُصِيبَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِ أَهْلِ ٱلْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَ ٱلسُنَّةُ اَلْبَعْثُ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالطَّعَامِ
كَمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي آلِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ لَمَّا جَاءَ نَعْيُهُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "No one should observe
mourning (ḥidād) for more than three days, except for a woman mourning her
husband, as She must continue her mourning until the completion of her 'iddah
(waiting period).”
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَ: «لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُجِدَّ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامِ إِلاَ ٱلْمَرْأَةَ عَلَى زَوْجِهَا حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 183 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 23, p. 1219 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 543 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 72

text_en:
Imam {a.s} was asked about the reward (ajr) of the mourning woman (na’ihah),
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no issue with it, for mourning (niyahah) was done for
Messenger of Allah {saws}."
text_ar: - وَ سُئِلَ: عَنْ أَجْرِ النَّائِحَةِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ وَ قَدْ نِيحَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 183 • Al-Wafi, V. 17, p. 200 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 17, p. 128

text_en:
It was narrated that Imam {a.s} said: "There is no issue with the earnings of the
mourning woman (nā’iḥah) if She speaks truthfully."
In another narration, Imam {a.s} said:
"She justifies it (her earnings) by striking one of her hands on the other."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِكَسْبِ النَّائِحَةِ إِذَا قَالَتْ صِدْقاً. وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ قَالَ: «تَسْتَجِلُهُ بِضَرْبِ إِحْدَى
يَدَيْهَا عَلَى الْأُخْرَى.

chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
When the Messenger of Allah {saws} returned to Medina after the Battle of Uhud,
he heard mourning and weeping from every house in which someone had been killed.
However, he did not hear mourning from the house of Hamza, his uncle.
The Prophet {saws} then said: "But Hamza has no mourners."
The people of Medina swore that they would not mourn or weep over any deceased
until they began with mourning and weeping for Hamza.
To this day, they continue this tradition.
text_ar:
وَ لَمَا اِنْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنْ وَقْعَةِ أَحْدِ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ سَمِعَ مِنْ كُلَّ دَارٍ قُتِلَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا
قَتِيل نَوْحاً وَ بُكَاءً وَ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْ دَارِ حَمْزَةَ عَمِّهِ فَقَالَ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «لَكِنَّ حَمْرَةَ لا بَوَاكِيَ لَهُ» فَآلَى أَهْلُ
الْمَدِينَةِ أَنْ لا يَنُوحُوا عَلَى مَيِّتٍ وَلَا يَبْكُوهُ حَتَّى يَبْدَءُوا بِحَمْزَةَ فَيَنُوحُوا عَلَيْهِ وَ يَبْكُوهُ فَهُمْ إِلَى الْيَوْمِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 183 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 571 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 284

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Omar ibn Yazid said: I asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} whether
it is permissible to pray on behalf of a deceased person.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes, even to the extent that if the deceased is in difficulty, Allah {SWT}
will alleviate that difficulty through the prayer of his brother for him. Then it is said to
the deceased, 'Your difficulty has been eased by the prayer of such-and-such, your
brother, on your behalf.'"
I then asked: "Can I include two people in one set of two units of prayer?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
He {a.s} also said: "The deceased rejoices in mercy and forgiveness offered on his behalf
just as the living person rejoices in a gift given to him."

Scholar's Note:
It is permissible to perform pilgrimage (Hajj or Umrah), prayer, or circumambulation
(Tawaf) on behalf of a deceased person, and they benefit from it - even if the deceased
was under divine displeasure, they may be forgiven or have their hardship relieved
through such actions. The deceased is made aware of these acts. Even performing
MOURNING GATHERINGS
these acts for an adversary (nāṣib) could lessen their burden. Acts of piety,
connection, and Hajj can be performed for both the living and the dead, but prayer on
behalf of a living person is not permitted.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُصَلَّى عَنِ الْمَيَّتِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ حَتَّى إِنَّهُ لَيَكُونُ فِي
ضِيقٍ فَيُوَسِّعُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ الضِّيقَ ثُمَّ يُوْتَى فَيُقَالُ لَهُ خَفَّفَ عَنْكَ هَذَا الضِّيقُ بِصَلاَةِ فُلاَنِ أَخِيكَ عَنْكَ» قَالَ
فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَأَشرِكُ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنٍ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ لَيَفْرَحُ بِالتَّرَحْمِ عَلَيْهِ وَ
اَلْاِسْتِغْفَارٍ لَهُ كَمَا يَفْرَحُ اَلْحَيُّ بِالْهَدِيَّةِ تُهْدَى إِلَيْهِ.
ويجوز أن يجعل الرجل حجته أو عمرته أو بعض صلاته أو بعض طوافه لبعض أوله وهو ميت وينتفع به حتى أنه ليكون
مسخوطا عليه فيغفر له، ويكون مضيقا عليه فيوسع له ، ويعلم الميت بذلك، ولو أن رجلا فعل ذلك عن ناصب لخفف عنه
، والبر والصلة والحج يجعل للميت والحي، فأما الصلاة فلا تجوز عن الحي.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "Six things follow a believer after his death: a child who seeks
forgiveness for him, a Quran he leaves behind, a tree he plants, a charity of water he
provides, a well he digs, and a good tradition that is acted upon after him."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «سِنَّةُ يَلْحَقْنَ الْمُؤْمِنَ بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ وَلَدْ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ وَ مُصْحَفٌ يُخَلَّفُهُ وَ غَرْسٌ يَفْرِسُهُ وَ
صَدَقَةُ مَاءٍ يُجْرِيهِ وَ قَلِيبٌ يَحْفِرُهُ وَ سُنَّةٌ يُوْخَذُ بِهَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ.

text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever from among the Muslims performs a good deed on
behalf of a deceased person, their reward will be multiplied, and Allah {SWT} will benefit
the deceased through it."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ عَنْ مَيَّتٍ عَمَلاً صَالِحاً أُضْعِفَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ وَ نَفَعَ اللَّهُ بِهِ ٱلْمَيَّتَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 185 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 587 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 444 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 3, p. 297 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 12, p. 516

author: Shaykh al-Saduq

text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "Prayer, fasting, pilgrimage, charity, righteousness, and
supplication enter upon the deceased in their grave, and the reward is written for both
the one who performs these deeds and the deceased."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يَدْخُلُ عَلَى ٱلْمَيِّتِ فِي قَبْرِهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَ الصَّوْمُ وَ ٱلْحَجّ وَ الصَّدَقَةُ وَ الْبِرُ وَ الدُعَاءُ وَ
يُكْتَبُ أَجْرُهُ لِلّذِي يَفْعَلُهُ وَ لِلْمَيَّتِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 185 • Nuzhat al-Nāẓir, Part 1, p. 6 • Uddat al-Da’i, Part 1, p. 146 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 1, p. 340 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 2, p. 53 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 588 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 444 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 279 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 3, p. 297 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 311

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CHAPTER OF CONDOLENCES AND GRIEF DURING CALAMITIES, VISITING GRAVES, LAMENTATION AND
text_en:
When Dhar ibn Abi Dhar, passed away, Abu Dharr stood by his grave, touched
it with his hand, and said:
"May Allah {SWT} have mercy on you, O’ Dhar. By Allah {SWT}, you were righteous toward
me. You were taken from me while I am content with you.
By Allah {SWT}, I have not felt your loss as a disgrace, nor have I sought from anyone
besides Allah {SWT} any need.
Were it not for the terror of the grave and its trials, I would have been pleased to be in
your place. Sorrow for you has preoccupied me from sorrow over your loss.
By Allah {SWT}, I did not cry for you but for myself over you. I wonder what you said and
what was said to you.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I have forgiven him what was due to me of rights.
Grant him what is due from You, for You are more worthy of generosity and grace."
text_ar:
وَ لَمَّا مَاتَ ذَرّ بْنُ أَبِي ذَرِّ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَفَ أَبُو ذَرِّ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ فَمَسَحَ الْقَبْرَ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ يَا
ذَرْ وَ اللهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ بِي لَبَرّاً وَ لَقَدْ قُبِضْتَ وَ إِنِّي عَنْكَ لَرَاضٍ وَ اللّهِ مَا بِي فَقْدُكَ وَ مَا عَلَيَّ مِنْ غَضَاضَةٍ وَ مَا لِي إِلَى
أَحَدٍ سِوَى اللهِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ وَ لَوْ لا هَوْلُ الْمُطَّلَعِ لَسَرِّنِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَكَانَكَ وَ لَقَدْ شَغَلَنِي الْحُزْنُ لَكَ عَنِ الْحُزْنِ عَلَيْكَ
وَ اللَّهِ مَا بَكَيْتُ لَكَ وَ لَكِنْ بَكَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ فَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي مَا قُلْتَ وَ مَا قِيلَ لَكَ: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي قَدْ وَهَبْتُ لَهُ مَا اِفْتَرَضْتَ
عَلَيْهِ مِنْ حَقِّي فَهَبْ لَهُ مَا اِفْتَرَضْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ حَقَّكَ فَأَنْتَ أَحَقُ بِالْجُودِ مِنِّي وَ الْكَرَمِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no one whose death is more beloved to Iblis than the death of a scholar
(faqih)."
text_ar:
باب - باب النوادر
قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَمُوتُ أَحَبَ إِلَى إِبْلِيسَ مِنْ مَوْتِ فَقِيهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the meaning of the
words of Allah {SWT}:
"Do they not see that We are advancing upon the land, reducing it from its borders?
And Allah {SWT} judges; there is no adjuster of His ruling, and He is swift in account."
(Surah Ar-Ra’d 13:41).
Imam {a.s} replied: "The loss of the scholars."

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the meaning of the
verse from Allah’s {SWT} Book: "And there is no town but We shall destroy it before the
Day of Resurrection or punish it with severe punishment."
(Surah Al-Isra 17:58)
Imam {a.s} said: "It refers to perishing through death”.
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: « وَ إِنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةِ إِلا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ أَوْ
مُعَذّبُوها
» قَالَ «هُوَ ٱلْفَنَاءُ بِالْمَوْتِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"It is not for you to offer us condolences, but it is for us to offer you condolences.
Indeed, it is for you to congratulate us, because you share in our misfortune”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «لَيْسَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُعَزُونَا وَ لَنَا أَنْ نُعَزِّيَكُمْ إِنَّمَا لَكُمْ أَنْ تُهَنَّثُونَا لِأَنْكُمْ تُشَارِكُونَنَا
فِي الْمُصِيبَةٍ.

chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who
says to his son or daughter, "May my father and mother (or my parents) be ransomed
for you."
The Imam responded: "If his parents are alive, I consider this to be an act of
disobedience (toward them). If they have passed away, then there is no problem."
text_ar:
وَ سُبِلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرّجُلِ يَقُولُ لابْنِهِ أَوْ لاِبْنَتِهِ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَ أَمِّي أَوْ
بِأُبَوَيَّ أَنْتَ أتَرَى بِذَلِكَ بَأْساً فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ أُبَوَاهُ حَيَّيْنِ فَأْرَى ذَلِكَ عُقُوقاً وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ مَاتَا فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who
says to his son or daughter, "May my father and mother (or my parents) be ransomed
for you."
The Imam responded: "If his parents are alive, I consider this to be an act of
disobedience (toward them). If they have passed away, then there is no problem."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Patience is of two types: patience during a calamity, which is good and beautiful, and
greater than this is patience in refraining from what Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic,
has forbidden, as it acts as a barrier for you."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «الصَّبْرُ صَبْرَانِ فَالصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ ٱلْمُصِيبَةِ حَسَنْ جَمِيلٌ وَ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الصَّبْرُ
عِنْدَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَيْكَ فَيَكُونُ لَكَ حَاجِزاً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى تَطَوْلَ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ بِثَلاَثِ أَلْقَى عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ بَعْدَ الرُوحِ وَ لَوْ لا
ذَلِكَ مَا دَفَنَ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيما وَأَلْقَى عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلْوَةَ بَعْدَ ٱلْمُصِيبَةِ وَ لَوْ لَا ذَلِكَ لاَنْقَطَعَ النَّسْلُ وَ أَلْقَى عَلَى هَذِهِ الْحَبَّةِ
الدَّابَةَ وَ لَوْ لاَ ذَلِكَ لَكَنَزَهَا مُلُوكُهُمْ كَمَا يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَ الْفِضَّةَ.
cross_references: Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 316 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 227 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 187 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 299 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 559 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 277 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 247 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 100, p. 87

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
(Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Hussain narrates from) Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"We, the people of the household (AhlulBayt {a.s}), may become distressed before a
calamity occurs, but when the command of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, comes
to pass, we are content with His decree and submit to His command. We do not have
the right to dislike what Allah {SWT} has chosen for us."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِنَّا أَهْلُ بَيْتِ نَجْزَعُ قَبْلَ ٱلْمُصِيبَةِ فَإِذَا نَزَلَ أَمْرُ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ رَضِينَا بِقَضَائِهِ وَ سَلّمْنَا
الأَمْرِهِ وَ لَيْسَ لَنَا أَنْ نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لَنَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 187 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 276

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever fears being overwhelmed by grief due to a
calamity should let their tears flow, for it will bring them relief."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «مَنْ خَافَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ مِنْ وَجْدٍ بِمُصِيبَةِ فَلْيُفِضُ مِنْ دُمُوعِهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْكُنُ عَنْهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 187 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 564 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 280 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 105

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Ibn Abi Layla said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"What is the sweetest of what Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has created?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "A young child."
Ibn Abi Layla then asked: "What is the most bitter of what Allah {SWT} has created?"
The Imam answered: "Losing him."
Ibn Abi Layla then said: "I testify that you are the proofs of Allah {SWT} for His creation."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ اِبْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى لِلصَادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: أَيُ شَيْء أَحْلَى مِمَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَقَالَ «الْوَلَدُ الشَّابُ»
فَقَالَ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ أَمَرٌ مِمَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَالَ «فَقْدُهُ» فَقَالَ أَشهَدُ أَنَّكُمْ حُجَجُ اللَّهِ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 548 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 4, p. 148

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no servant who passes their hand over the head of an orphan out of
compassion for them except that Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, grants them a
light for every strand of hair (they touch) on the Day of Judgment."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدِ يَمْسَحُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ يَتِيمِ تَرَحُما لَهُ إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ
نُوراً يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 557 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 286 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 21, p. 374

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
It is reported: "Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, writes for the person, for
every strand of hair that their hand passes over (on the head of the orphan), a good
deed."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ يَكْتُبُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ شَعْرَةِ مَرَّثْ عَلَيْهَا يَدُهُ حَسَنَةٌ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 286

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever finds hardness in their heart should bring an orphan close, show kindness
to them, and pass their hand over their head; this will soften their heart, by the
permission of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic. Indeed, the orphan has a right."
It is also reported that He said: "He should seat the orphan at his table and pass his
hand over their head, and this will soften his heart."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ أَنكَرَ مِنْكُمْ قَسَاوَةَ قَلْبِهِ فَلْيَذْنُ يَتِيماً فَيْلاَطِفُهُ وَ لْيَمْسَحْ رَأْسَهُ
يَلِينُ قَلْبُهُ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَإِنَّ لِلْيَتِيمِ حَقّا. وَ رُوِيَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يُقْعِدُهُ عَلَى جِوَانِهِ وَ يَمْسَحُ رَأْسَهُ يَلِينُ قَلْبُهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 557 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 286 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 21, p. 375 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 287

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When an orphan cries, the Throne of Allah {SWT} shakes, and Allah {SWT}, Blessed and
Exalted, says,
'Who is it that has made My servant cry, the one from whom I took his parents in his
childhood? By My might, majesty, and elevated status, no believer will calm him
except that I will make Paradise obligatory for him.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَ: «إِذَا بَكَى ٱلْيَتِيمُ اِهْتَزَّ لَهُ الْعَرْشُ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى مَنْ هَذَا الَّذِي أُبْكَى عَبْدِيَ
اَلَّذِي سَلَبْتُهُ أَبَوَيْهِ فِي صِغَرِهِ فَوَ عِزَّتِي وَ جَلَالِي وَ اِرْتِفَاعِي فِي مَكَانِي لا يُسْكِثُهُ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ إِلَّ أَوْجَبْتُ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 558 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 287 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 21, p. 446 • Kulliyat Hadith Qudsi, Vol. 1, p. 674

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever offers children (to Allah {SWT}, i.e., loses them and bears the loss patiently,
seeking reward from Allah {SWT}), they will shield him from the Fire, by the permission of
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ قَدْمَ أَوْلاداً يَخْتَسِبْهُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ حَجَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱَلنَّارِ بِإِذْنِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 219 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 220 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 196 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 541 • Jami’ al- Akhbar, Part 1, p. 105 • Muskkin al-Fu’ād, Part 1, p. 20 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 547 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 548 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 244

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Indeed, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, dislikes six traits for me, and I also dislike
them for the successors (Imams) from my descendants and for their followers after
me: playing around during prayer, inappropriate speech during fasting, boasting after
giving charity, entering mosques while in a state of major ritual impurity, peeking into
people’s houses, and laughing among graves."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى كَرِهَ لِي سِتَّ خِصَالٍ وَ كَرِهْتُهُنَّ لِلْأَوْصِيَاءِ
مِنْ وُلْدِي وَ أَثْبَاعِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْدِي الْعَبَثَ فِي الصَّلاةِ وَ الرَّفَتَ فِي الصَّوْمِ وَ الْمَنَّ بَعْدَ ٱلصَّدَقَةِ وَ إِثْيَانَ ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ جُنُباً
وَ التَطَلُعَ فِي الدُورِ وَ الضَّحِكَ بَيْنَ ٱلْقُبُورِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 188 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 2, p. 71 • Al- Khisal, Part 1, p. 327 • The Virtues of the Three Months, Part 1, p. 76 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 62 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 232 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 233 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 9, p. 452 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 76, p. 277 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 61

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whatever is placed on the grave that is not from the soil of the grave itself is a burden
upon the deceased."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «كُلُمَا جُعِلَ عَلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تُرَابِ الْقَبْرِ فَهُوَ ثِقْلٌ عَلَى ٱلْمَيَّتِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 189 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 521 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 202 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 42

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
It is narrated that Al-Sindi ibn Shahak said to Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn
Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} ; "I would like you to allow me to provide your shroud."
Imam {a.s} replied: "We, the people of the household (AhlulBayt {a.s}), have our
pilgrimage, dowries of our women, and shrouds taken from the purity of our own
wealth."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: أَنْ السِّنْدِيَّ بْنَ شَاهَكَ قَالَ لأَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَدَعَنِي عَلَى أَنْ
أُكَفِّئَكَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّا أَهْلُ بَيْتِ حَجُ صَرُورَتِنَا وَ مُهُورُ نِسَائِنَا وَ أَكْفَاتُنَا مِنْ طَهُورِ أَمْوَالِنَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 189 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 355 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 55

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: ON MISCELLANEOUS TOPICS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Our enemies die of plague, while you (our Shi’ite) die of ailments of the stomach.
Verily, this is a sign among you, O’ group of Shi'a."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ أَعْدَاءَنَا يَمُوتُونَ بِالطَّاعُونِ وَ أَنْثُمْ تَمُوتُونَ بِعِلَّةِ الْبُطُونِ أَلاَ إِنَّهَا عَلامَةٌ
فِيكُمْ يَا مَعْشَرَ الشِّيعَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 189 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 201
