text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated from Imam al-Ridha
{a.s} that He said: "A man may give the adhan (call to prayer) while sitting or while riding."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ الْبَرَئْطِيّ عَنِ آَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يُؤَذِّنُ الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ جَالِسْ
وَ يُؤَذَّنْ وَ هُوَ رَاكِبٌ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"There is no issue if you give the adhan (call to prayer) while riding, walking, or without
wudu (ritual purity). However, do not perform the iqamah (second call to prayer) while
riding or sitting, unless there is an excuse, or if you are on slippery ground”.
text_ar:
868 رَوَى أُبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُؤْذِّنَ رَاكِباً أَوْ مَاشِياً أَوْ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ
وَلاَثُقِمْ وَ أَنْتَ رَاكِبٌ وَ لاَ جَالِسٌ إِلاَّ مِنْ عُذْرٍ أَوْ تَكُونَ فِي أَرْضِ مَلَصَّةٍ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) has a reward between the adhan and the iqamah
equal to that of a martyr who is drenched in his blood in the way of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic."
Imam Ali {a.s} said: "People will compete over the adhan."
The Prophet replied: "No, there will come a time when people will leave the adhan to
their weak ones. These (mu'adhdhins) are people whose flesh Allah {SWT} has forbidden
for the Fire”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لِلْمُؤَذِّنٍ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ الشَّهِيدِ الْمُتَشَحَّطِ
بِدَمِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ» فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنَّهُمْ يَجْتَلِدُونَ عَلَى الْأَذَانِ» فَقَالَ «كَلاَ إِنَّهُ يَأْتِي عَلَى
اَلنَّاسِ زَمَانٌ يَطْرَحُونَ الْأَذَانَ عَلَى ضُعَفَائِهِمْ فَتِلْكَ لُحُومُ حَرَّمَهَا اَللَّهُ عَلَى اَلنَّارِ.

for the Fire”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Ali {a.s} said:
"The last thing my beloved (the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his
family) said to me before parting was:
'O’ Ali, when you lead the prayer, lead it considering the weakest among those behind
you. And do not appoint a mu'adhdhin who takes payment for his adhan.'"
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «آخِرُ مَا فَارَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَبِيبَ قَلْبِي صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَا عَلِيْ إِذَا
صَلَّيْتَ فَصَلَ صَلاَةَ أَصْعَفٍ مَنْ خَلْفَكَ وَ لا تَتَّخِذَنَّ مُؤَذّناً يَأْخُذُ عَلَى أَذَانِهِ أَجْرا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 283 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 283 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 592 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 447

text_en:
Khalid ibn Najih narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He
said: "The takbir (saying 'Allahu Akbar') in the adhan must be pronounced firmly, with
clear articulation of the 'ha' and 'alif'“.

cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 283 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 58 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 576 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 408

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from one of the Imams {a.s} that He said:
"Bilal was a righteous servant who said:
'I will not call the adhan for anyone after the Messenger of Allah {saws}.'
Therefore, on that day, 'Hayya 'ala khayr al-'Amal' (Hasten to the best of deeds) was
left out."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ بِلاَلاً كَانَ عَبْداً صَالِحاً فَقَالَ لا أُوَذِّنُ لِأَحَدِ بَعْدَ
رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَتُرِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 283 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 583 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 417 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 142

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn al-Sari reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that
He said:
"It is part of the Sunnah (tradition) for a person giving the adhan (call to prayer) to place
his fingers in his ears."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ السَّرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مِنَ السُّنَّةِ إِذَا أَذَّنَ الرَّجُلُ أَنْ يَضَعَ
إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أَذْنَيْهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 284 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 411

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Khalid ibn Najih narrated from Imam {a.s} that He said:
"The adhan and the iqamah must be recited with firmness."
In another narration, it states, "They must be delivered with a pause."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى خَالِدُ بْنُ نَجِيحِ عَنْهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «الْأَذَانُ وَ ٱلْإِقَامَةُ مَجْزُومَانٍ» وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ «مَوْقُوفَانِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 284 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 577

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"The adhan is not sufficient for you unless you hear it yourself or understand it. Clearly
articulate the 'alif' and 'ha'."
Send blessings upon the Prophet and his family {a.s} whenever you mention him or hear
someone mention him, whether during the adhan or outside of it. The louder your
voice, without straining yourself, the more people will hear, and your reward will be
greater."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا يُجْزِيكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ إِلاَّ مَا أَسْمَعْتَ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ فَهِمْتَهُ
وَ أَفْصِحْ بِالْأَلِفِ وَ الْهَاءِ وَ صَلَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَ آلِهِ صَلَوَاتُ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّمَا ذَكَرْتَهُ أَوْ ذَكَرَهُ ذَاكِرْ عِنْدَكَ فِي أَذَانٍ أَوْ
غَيْرِهِ وَكُلَّمَا اِشتَدَّ صَوْتُكَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تُجَهِدَ نَفْسَكَ كَانَ مَنْ يَسْمَعُ أَكْثَرَ وَ كَانَ أَجْرُكَ فِي ذَلِكَ أَعْظَمَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 284 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 574

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Muawiya ibn Wahb asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
adhan (call to prayer).
The Imam said: "Raise your voice and speak loudly when giving the adhan. When
performing the iqamah (second call to prayer), use a slightly lower voice.
Do not delay your adhan and iqamah except until the time for prayer has arrived, and
recite the iqamah quickly (with fluidity)."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ وَهْبِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ ٱلْأَذَانِ فَقَالَ «إِجْهَزْ وَ إِرْفَع بِهِ صَوْتَكَ فَإِذَا أَقَمْتَ
فَدُونَ ذَلِكَ وَ لا تَنْتَظِرْ بِأَذَانِكَ وَ إِقَامَتِكَ إِلاَّ دُخُولَ وَقْتِ الصَّلاةِ وَ أُحْدُرْ إِقَامَتَكَ حَدْراً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Do not delay your adhan and iqamah except until the time for prayer has arrived, and
recite the iqamah quickly (with fluidity)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
It is narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} by 'Ammar al-Sabati
that He said: "When you stand for a mandatory prayer, give the adhan and the iqamah,
and separate between the adhan and the iqamah with sitting, speaking, or tasbih
(glorification of Allah {SWT})."
He (Ammar) asked: "What is the minimum that suffices between the adhan and the
iqamah in terms of speech?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Saying 'Alhamdulillah' (All praise belongs to Allah {SWT})."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ عَ عَمَّارٌ السَّابَاطِيُّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلاةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَأَذِّنْ وَ أَقِمْ وَ اِفْصِلْ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ وَ
الْإِقَامَةِ بِقُعُودٍ أَوْ بِكَلامٍ أَوْ تَسْبِيحٍ» وَقَالَ سَأَلْثُهُ كَمِ الَّذِي يُجْزِي بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ ٱلْإِقَامَةِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ قَالَ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 285 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 588

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a
man who gives the adhan (call to prayer) while walking, while not in a state of ritual
purity, or while riding an animal.
The Imam said: "Yes, it is permissible if the one giving the testimony of faith (in the
adhan) faces the Qiblah; there is no issue."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي وَ هُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ طُهْرٍ أَوْ هُوَ
عَلَى ظَهْرِ الدَّابَّةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَ ٱلْمُتَشَّهِدُ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 285 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 56 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 598 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 403

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Abu Ja'far {a.s} that He said:
"When the iqamah (second call to prayer) is pronounced, speaking becomes
prohibited for the Imam and the people of the mosque, except in the case of
appointing an Imam."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ زْرَارَةُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ حَرُمَ ٱلْكَلَاَمُ عَلَى ٱلْإِمَامِ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ
إلاً فِي تَقْدِيمِ إِمَامِ »
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 285 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Al- Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 596 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 393
text_chunk:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Abu Ja'far {a.s} that He said:
"When the iqamah (second call to prayer) is pronounced, speaking becomes

appointing an Imam."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Ali {a.s} said that the Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The one who leads you in prayer should be the one who has the most knowledge of
the Qur'an among you, and the one who calls the adhan (mu'adhdhin) should be the
best among you."
In another narration, it is said: "the most articulate among you."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «يَوُمُّكُمْ أَقْرَوُكُمْ وَ يُؤَذِّنُ لَكُمْ خِيَارُكُمْ وَ فِي
حَدِيثِ آَخَرَ أَفْصَحْكُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 285 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 591
text_chunk:
Imam Ali {a.s} said that the Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The one who leads you in prayer should be the one who has the most knowledge of
the Qur'an among you, and the one who calls the adhan (mu'adhdhin) should be the
best among you."
In another narration, it is said: "the most articulate among you."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
The Messenger, and his family, said:
"Whoever calls the adhan (call to prayer) in one of the cities of the Muslims for a year,
Paradise becomes obligatory for him."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ أَذِّنَ فِي مِصْرٍ مِنْ أَمْصَارِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ سَنَةً وَجَبَثْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 285 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 31 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 283 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 567 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 371 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 146
text_chunk:
The Messenger, and his family, said:
"Whoever calls the adhan (call to prayer) in one of the cities of the Muslims for a year,
Paradise becomes obligatory for him."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"For the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer), Allah {SWT} forgives him as far as his sight and
voice reach into the sky. Every moist and dry thing that hears him bears witness to his
truth. For every person who prays with him in his mosque, he receives a share, and for
every person who prays due to hearing his call, he earns a good deed."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «الْمُؤَذِّنُ يَغْفِرُ آللَّهُ لَهُ مَدَّ بَصَرِهِ وَ مَدَّ صَوْتِهِ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَ يُصَدَّقُهُ كُلّ رَطْبِ
وَ يَابِسِ يَسْمَعُهُ وَ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَنْ يُصَلِّي مَعَهُ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ سَهُمْ وَ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَنْ يُصَلِّي بِصَوْتِهِ حَسَنَةٌ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"For the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer), Allah {SWT} forgives him as far as his sight and
voice reach into the sky. Every moist and dry thing that hears him bears witness to his
truth. For every person who prays with him in his mosque, he receives a share, and for
every person who prays due to hearing his call, he earns a good deed."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever calls the adhan (call to prayer) for seven years with the intention of seeking
Allah’s {SWT} reward will come on the Day of Judgment without any sins."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ أَذَّنَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ مُحْتَسِباً جَاءَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ لاَ ذَنْبَ لَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 286 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 31 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 283 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 567 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 371 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 374 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 146 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 149
text_chunk:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever calls the adhan (call to prayer) for seven years with the intention of seeking
Allah’s {SWT} reward will come on the Day of Judgment without any sins."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
It is narrated: "When the angels hear the adhan (call to prayer) from the people
of the earth, they say,
'These are the voices of the nation of Muhammad {saws} declaring oneness of Allah {SWT}.'
They then seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT} for the nation of Muhammad until the prayer
is completed."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ: «أَنّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ إِذَا سَمِعَتِ الْأَذَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ قَالَثْ هَذِهِ أَصْوَاتْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ بِتَوْجِيدِ اللّهِ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللهَ لِأُمّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا مِنْ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 286 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 376
text_chunk:
It is narrated: "When the angels hear the adhan (call to prayer) from the people
of the earth, they say,
'These are the voices of the nation of Muhammad {saws} declaring oneness of Allah {SWT}.'
They then seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT} for the nation of Muhammad until the prayer
is completed."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"The minimum that suffices for the adhan is to begin the night with an adhan and
iqamah and to begin the day with an adhan and iqamah. For the other prayers during
the day, an iqamah without an adhan suffices."

Scholar's Note:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} combined the Dhuhr (noon) and 'Asr (afternoon) prayers
at 'Arafat with one adhan and two iqamah, and he combined the Maghrib (sunset) and
'Isha (night) prayers at Muzdalifah with one adhan and two iqamah.
text_ar:
885 رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ أَدْنَى مَا يُجْزِي مِنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ أَنْ يَفْتَتِحَ اللِّيْلَ بِأَذَانِ وَ
إقَامَةٍ وَ يَفْتَتِحَ النَّهَارَ بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَةٍ وَ يُجْزِيكَ فِي سَائِرِ الصَّلاةِ إِقَامَةٌ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ.
وجمع رسول اللّٰه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله بين الظهر والعصر بعرفة بأذان واحد وإقامتين، وجمع بين المغرب والعشاء بجمع
بأذان واحد وإقامتين
commentary:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} combined the Dhuhr (noon) and 'Asr (afternoon) prayers
at 'Arafat with one adhan and two iqamah, and he combined the Maghrib (sunset) and
'Isha (night) prayers at Muzdalifah with one adhan and two iqamah.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} combined the Dhuhr (noon) and 'Asr (afternoon) prayers
with one adhan and two iqamah, and he combined the Maghrib (sunset) and 'Isha
(night) prayers in the same setting without any particular reason, using one adhan and
two iqamah”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ ٱلظُهْرِ
وَ ٱَلْعَصْرِ بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنٍ وَ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْعِشَاءِ فِي الْحَضَرِ مِنْ غَيْرٍ عِلَّةٍ بِأَذَانِ وَاحِدٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 287 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 282 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 4, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
It is narrated: "Whoever prays with both the adhan (call to prayer) and iqamah
(second call to prayer), two rows of angels pray behind him. And whoever prays with
just the iqamah without the adhan, one row of angels prays behind him, and the extent
of the row is from the east to the west."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنّ مَنْ صَلَّى بِأَذَانِ وَ إِقَامَةٍ صَلَّى خَلْفَهُ صَفَّانٍ مِنَ ٱلْمَلائِكَةِ وَ مَنْ صَلَّى بِإِقَامَةٍ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانِ صَلَّى
خَلْفَهُ صَفِّ وَاحِدٌ وَ حَدُّ الصَّفِّ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَشرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 287 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 382

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
In the narration of Abbas ibn Hilal from Abu Al-Hasan Imam al-Ridha {a.s} said:
"Whoever gives the adhan (call to prayer) and the iqamah (second call to prayer) will
have two rows of angels praying behind him.
If he only recites the iqamah without the adhan, then one angel will pray on his right
and one on his left."
The Imam {a.s} then said: "Take advantage of the two rows (of angels)."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ هِلالٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَذَّنَ وَ أَقَامَ صَلَّى وَرَاءَهُ
صَفَّانٍ مِنَ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَ إِنْ أَقَامَ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ صَلَّى عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَاجِدٌ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَاجِدٌ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «اِغْتَنِمِ الصِّفَّيْنِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 287 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 559 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
In a narration from Ibn Abi Layla, Imam Ali {a.s} said:
"Whoever prays with both the adhan (call to prayer) and the iqamah (second call to
prayer) will have two rows of angels praying behind him, the ends of which cannot be
seen.
And whoever prays with only the iqamah will have an angel praying behind him."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ اِبْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى بِأَذَانِ وَ إِقَامَةِ صَلَّى خَلْفَهُ صَفَّانٍ مِنَ
الْمَلائِكَةٍ لاَ يُرَى طَرَفَاهُمَا وَ مَنْ صَلَّى بِإِقَامَةٍ صَلَّى خَلْفَهُ مَلَكٌ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 287 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 1, p. 352 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 559 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 382 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 147

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever, upon hearing the adhan for Fajr (morning prayer), says:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You by the coming of Your day and the departure of Your night, and
by the presence of Your prayers and the voices of Your callers, that You accept my
repentance. Indeed, You are the Most Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful,'
and then says a similar supplication upon hearing the adhan for Maghrib (evening
prayer), and dies during that day or night, dies in a state of repentance."
He also mentioned that Ibn al-Nabbah used to say during his adhan, "Hayya 'ala khayr
al-'Amal (Hasten to the best of deeds), hasten to the best of deeds," and whenever
Imam Ali {a.s} would see him, Imam {a.s} would say,
"Welcome, O’ caller of justice, and welcome to prayer."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ قَالَ جِينَ يَسْمَعُ أَذَانَ الصُّبْحِ - اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِإِقْبَالِ نَهَارِكَ وَ إِدْبَارٍ
لَيْلِكَ وَ حُضُورٍ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ أَصْوَاتِ دُعَاتِكَ أُنْ تَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ «إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوْابُ الرَّحِيمُ» وَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ
أَذَانَ الْمَغْرِبِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ أَوْ لَيْلَتِهِ مَاتَ تَائِباً وَ كَانَ اِبْنُ النَّبَّاحِ يَقُولُ فِي أَذَانِهِ - حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ حَيَّ
عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ فَإِذَا رَآهُ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ «مَرْحَباً بِالْقَائِلِينَ عَدْلاً وَ بِالصَّلاةِ مَرْحَباً وَ أَهْلاً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Harith ibn al-Mughira al-Nadri narrated from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"Whoever hears the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) say, 'I bear witness that there is no
god but Allah {SWT}, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws},'
and then, affirming and seeking reward, responds with
'And I also bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, and I bear witness that
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws}. I suffice myself with these testimonies
against anyone who denies or rejects, and I support with them anyone who affirms and
bears witness,' will receive a reward equivalent to the number of those who deny and
reject and the number of those who affirm and bear witness."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَارِثُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ النَّضْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «مَنْ سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِنَ يَقُولُ - أَشْهَدُ
أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ أَشهَدُ أَنّ مُحَمْداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ مُصَدَّقاً مُخْتَسِباً وَ أَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ
مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللّهِ أَكْتَفِي بِهِمَا عَنْ كُلِّ مَنْ أَبَى وَ جَحَدَ وَ أُعِينُ بِهِمَا مَنْ أَقَرّ وَ شَهِدَ كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْرِ عَدَدُ مَنْ أَنْكَرَ
وَ جَحَدَ وَ عَدَدُ مَنْ أَقَرَّ وَ شَهِدَ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 307 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 288 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 31 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 215 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 564 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 454 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 175

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said to Muhammad ibn Muslim:
"O’ Muhammad ibn Muslim, never neglect the remembrance of Allah {SWT} in any
situation. Even if you hear the caller calling the adhan while you are in a state of
relieving yourself, remember Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, and say what the
mu'adhdhin says."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ لِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ: «يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ مُسْلِمِ لا تَدَعَنَّ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَ لَوْ سَمِعْتَ ٱلْمُنَادِيَ
يُنَادِي بِالْأَذَانِ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى اَلْخَلاَءِ فَاذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ قُلْ كَمَا يَقُولُ ٱلْمُؤَذَّنُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 288 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 284 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 564 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 1, p. 314 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 454 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 175 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 176

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Zaid al-Shahham asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man
who forgot the adhan (call to prayer) and iqamah (second call to prayer) and began the
prayer.
The Imam said: "If he remembers before reciting (the Qur'an in prayer), he should send
blessings upon the Prophet and his family and then recite the iqamah. But if he has
already started reciting, then he should complete his prayer”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ زَيْدٌ الشَّحَّامُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ الْأَذَانَ وَ الْإِقَامَةَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ
«إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْرَأ فَلْيُصَلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَ آلِهِ وَ لَيُقِمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دَخَلَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
It was narrated from Ammar al-Sabati that He said: "Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who forgot a word during the adhan
(call to prayer) and remembered it after completing the adhan and iqamah (second
call to prayer).
The Imam said: "He should go back to the word he forgot, say it, and then continue
from that point to the end. He does not need to repeat the entire adhan or the iqamah."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ مِنَ الْأَذَانِ حَرْفاً فَذَكَرَهُ
جِينَ فَرَغَ مِنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ قَالَ «يَرْجِعُ إِلَى اَلْحَرْفِ الَّذِي نَسِيَهُ فَلْيَقُلْهُ وَ لَيَقُلْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْحَرْفِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ وَ لا
بُعِيدُ الْأَذَانَ كُلَّهُ وَ لا الْإِقَامَةَ.
cross_references: Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 623 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 442
text_chunk:
It was narrated from Ammar al-Sabati that He said: "Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who forgot a word during the adhan
(call to prayer) and remembered it after completing the adhan and iqamah (second
call to prayer).
The Imam said: "He should go back to the word he forgot, say it, and then continue
from that point to the end. He does not need to repeat the entire adhan or the iqamah."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Muawiya ibn Wahb asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
practice of "tathwib" (additional announcements or calls made between the adhan
and the iqamah).
Imam {a.s} replied: "We do not recognize it”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ التَّثوِيبِ آَلَّذِي يَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ فَقَالَ «مَا
نَعْرِفُهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Ali {a.s} used to say:
"There is no issue if a boy calls the adhan (call to prayer) before reaching the age of
puberty, and there is no issue if the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) is in a state of
janabah (major ritual impurity), but he should not perform the iqamah (second call to
prayer) until he has performed ghusl (ritual purification)."
text_ar:
وَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَقُولُ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ ٱلْغُلامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ وَ لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ ٱلْمُؤَذِّنُ وَ هُوَ
جُنُبٌ وَ لاَ يُقِيمُ حَتَّى يَغْتَسِلَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 289 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 53 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 595

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Abu Bakr al-Hadhrami and Kulaib al-Asadi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that he taught them the adhan, saying:
"Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar (Allah {SWT} is the Greatest,
repeated four times).
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT} (twice).
I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws} (twice).
Hasten to prayer (twice).
Hasten to success (twice).
Hasten to the best of deeds (twice).
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar. There is no god but Allah {SWT} (twice)."
The iqamah is the same.

Scholar's Note:
It is also permissible, in the Fajr prayer, after "Hasten to the best of deeds" to say
"Prayer is better than sleep" twice, for reasons of taqiyya (precautionary
dissimulation).
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented:
This is the correct adhan; nothing should be added to or removed from it. The
"Mufawwida" (a sect accused of exaggeration), may Allah {SWT} curse them, have
fabricated reports and added phrases to the adhan such as "Muhammad and the
family of Muhammad are the best of creation" repeated twice, or "I bear witness that
Ali is the wali (guardian) of Allah {SWT}" repeated twice, and in some reports "I bear
witness that Ali is truly The Commander of the Faithful" repeated twice. There is no
doubt that Ali is the wali of Allah {SWT} and the true Commander of the Faithful, and that
Muhammad and his family {a.s} are the best of creation. However, these additions are
not part of the original adhan, and I have mentioned them here so that these
fabrications and those accused of exaggeration who mix themselves among us may
be recognized.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيّ وَ كُلَيْبٌ ٱلْأَسَدِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ حَكَى لَهُمَا ٱلْأَذَانَ فَقَالَ »-
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشهَدُ
أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاَةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ
حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّا اللَّهُ » وَ الْإِقَامَةُ كَذَلِكَ.
ولا بأس أن يقال في صلاة الغداة على أثر حي على خير العمل " الصلاة خير من النوم " مرتين للتقية.
وقال مصنف هذا الكتاب رحمه الله: هذا هو الاذان الصحيح لا يزاد فيه ولا ينقص منه، والمفوضة لعنهم اللّٰه قد وضعوا
أخبارا وزادوا في الاذان " محمد وآل محمد خير البرية " مرتين، وفي بعض رواياتهم بعد أشهد أن محمدا رسول اللّٰه "
أشهد أن عليا ولي اللّٰه " مرتين، ومنهم من روى بدل ذلك " أشهد أن عليا أمير المؤمنين حقا " مرتين ولا شك في أن عليا
ولي اللّه وأنه أمير المؤمنين حقا وأن محمدا وآله صلوات اللّٰه عليهم خير البرية، ولكن ليس ذلك في أصل الاذان، وإنما
ذكرت ذلك ليعرف بهذه الزيادة المتهمون بالتفويض، المدلسون أنفسهم في جملتنا.
commentary:
It is also permissible, in the Fajr prayer, after "Hasten to the best of deeds" to say

dissimulation).
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented:
This is the correct adhan; nothing should be added to or removed from it. The
"Mufawwida" (a sect accused of exaggeration), may Allah {SWT} curse them, have
fabricated reports and added phrases to the adhan such as "Muhammad and the
family of Muhammad are the best of creation" repeated twice, or "I bear witness that
Ali is the wali (guardian) of Allah {SWT}" repeated twice, and in some reports "I bear
witness that Ali is truly The Commander of the Faithful" repeated twice. There is no
doubt that Ali is the wali of Allah {SWT} and the true Commander of the Faithful, and that
Muhammad and his family {a.s} are the best of creation. However, these additions are
not part of the original adhan, and I have mentioned them here so that these
fabrications and those accused of exaggeration who mix themselves among us may
be recognized.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding the mu'adhdhins
(callers to prayer):
"They are the trustworthy ones”.
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: فِي ٱلْمُؤَذَّنِينَ «إِنَّهُمُ ٱلْأُمَنَاءُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 291 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 617 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding the mu'adhdhins
(callers to prayer):
"They are the trustworthy ones”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Pray the Jumu'ah (Jumu’ah prayer) with the adhan of these people, for they are the
most diligent in observing the time."

Scholar's Note:
There should be a sitting between the adhan and iqamah, except for Maghrib, where it
suffices to have only a breath's interval between the adhan and iqamah.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «صَلِّ ٱلْجُمُعَةَ بِأَذَانِ هَؤُلاَءٍ فَإِنَّهُمْ أَشَدُّ شَيْءٍ مُوَاظَبَةً عَلَى ٱلْوَقْتِ.
وينبغي أن يكون بين الأذان والإقامة جلسة إلا المغرب فإنه يجزي [أن يكون] بين الأذان والإقامة نفس.
commentary:
There should be a sitting between the adhan and iqamah, except for Maghrib, where it
suffices to have only a breath's interval between the adhan and iqamah.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"In travel, the iqamah (second call to prayer) suffices without the adhan (call to
prayer)."
text_ar: وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الرِّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يُجْزِي فِي السَّفَرِ إِقَامَةٌ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 291 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 605 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.
text_chunk:
Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"In travel, the iqamah (second call to prayer) suffices without the adhan (call to
prayer)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"If you give the adhan (call to prayer) on the road or in your home, and then perform
the iqamah (second call to prayer) in the mosque, it suffices."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَذَّنْتَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ أَوْ فِي بَيْتِكَ ثُمَّ أَقَمْتَ فِي
الْمَسْجِدِ أَجْزَأَكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 291 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 598 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Imam Ali {a.s} would sometimes give the adhan (call to prayer) while someone
else would perform the iqamah (second call to prayer), and at other times, he would
perform the iqamah after someone else had given the adhan.
text_ar: - وَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ غَيْرُهُ وَ كَانَ يُقِيمُ وَ قَدْ أَذَّنَ غَيْرُهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 291 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 601 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
Hisham ibn Ibrahim complained to Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about his illness and the
fact that he had no children. The Imam advised him to raise his voice with the adhan
(call to prayer) in his home.
Hisham said: "I did as he advised, and Allah {SWT} removed my illness and granted me
many children."
Muhammad ibn Rashid said: "I was constantly ill, and so were many of my servants
and family members, to the extent that there were times when I had no one to serve
me. When I heard about what Hisham had done, I followed the same advice, and Allah
{SWT} removed illness from me and my family. Praise be to Allah {SWT}."
text_ar:
وَ شَكَا هِشَامُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ سُقْمَهُ وَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يُولَدُ لَهُ: فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ صَوْتَهُ
بِالْأَذَانِ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَأَذْهَبَ اللَّهُ عَنِّي سُقْمِي وَ كَثِرَ وُلْدِي قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ وَ كُنْتُ دَائِمَ ٱلْعِلَّةِ
مَا أَنْفَكْ مِنْهَا فِي نَفْسِي وَ جَمَاعَةٍ مِنْ خَدَمِي وَ عِيَالِي حَتَّى إِنَّي كُنْتُ أَبْقَى وَ مَا لِي أَحَدٌ يَخْدُمُنِي فَلَمَّا سَمِعْتُ
ذَلِكَ مِنْ هِشَامٍ عَمِلْتُ بِهِ فَأْذْهَبَ اللهُ عَنِّي وَ عَنْ عِيَالِي الْعِلَلَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 9 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 292

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE CALL TO PRAYER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PRAYER AND THE REWARD OF THE MUEZZINS
text_en:
It is narrated: "Whoever hears the adhan (call to prayer) and repeats what the
mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) says will have an increase in their sustenance."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيّ: «أَنَّ مَنْ سَمِعَ الْأَذَانَ فَقَالَ كَمَا يَقُولُ ٱلْمُؤَذِّنُ زِيدَ فِي رِزْقِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 292 • Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 298 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 564 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 455 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 174
