author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
regarding a person who wishes to attend to a need while in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should gesture with his head and signal with his hand. As for a
woman, when She wants to attend to a need, She should clap."
text_ar:
باب - المصلي يريد الحاجة
رَوَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ الْحَاجَةَ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ
فَقَالَ «يُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ وَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ وَ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَرَادَتِ الْحَاجَةَ تُصَفِّقُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 370 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 7, p. 254
text_chunk:
Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
regarding a person who wishes to attend to a need while in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should gesture with his head and signal with his hand. As for a
woman, when She wants to attend to a need, She should clap."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
Al-Halabi asked him about a man who wishes to attend to a need while
praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should gesture with his head, signal with his hand, and glorify
(SubhanAllah {SWT}). As for a woman, when She wants to attend to a need while praying,
She should clap her hands”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَلَبِيُّ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ الرَجُلِ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَاجَةَ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي فَقَالَ «يُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ وَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ وَ يُسَبِّحُ
وَ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَرَادَتِ الْحَاجَةَ وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي تُصَفَّقُ بِيَدَيْهَا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
Hanan ibn Sadeer asked him: "Can a man gesture while praying?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, the Prophet {saws} gestured in one of the mosques of the Ansar with
a Muḥjan that he had with him."
Hanan said: "And I do not know except that it was the mosque of the Banu Abd al-
Ashhal."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ حَنَانُ بْنُ سَدِيرِ: أَ يُومِئ الرَّجُلُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ قَدْ أَوْمَأَ النَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي
مَسْجِدٍ مِنْ مَسَاجِدِ الْأَنْصَارِ بِمِحْجَنٍ كَانَ مَعَهُ » قَالَ حَنَانٌ وَ لا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّ مَسْجِدَ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْأَشْهَلِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 370 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 896 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 7, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
Ammar ibn Musa asked him about a man who hears a sound at the door while
he is in prayer and clears his throat to make his servant or family member hear, so that
they come and look to see who is at the door. Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in that."
He also asked about a man and a woman who are in prayer and want something,
whether it is permissible for them to say "SubhanAllah {SWT}."
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, and they can gesture to what they want. And a woman, when She
wants something, can strike her thighs while in prayer."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْمَعُ صَوْتاً بِالْبَابِ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَيَتَنَحْتَحْ لِيُسْمِعَ جَارِيَتَهُ أَوْ
أَهْلَهُ لِتَأْتِيَهُ فَيُشِيرَ إِلَيْهَا بِيَدِهِ لِيُعْلِمَهَا مَنْ بِالْبَابِ لِتَنْظُرَ مَنْ هُوَ فَقَالَ
«لا بَأْسَ بِهِ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ يَكُونَانِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَ يُرِيدَانِ شَيْئاً أَيَجُوزُ لَهُمَا أَنْ يَقُولاَ سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ قَالَ »نَعَمْ
وَ يُومِيَانٍ إِلَى مَا يُرِيدَانٍ وَ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَرَادَثْ شَيْئاً ضَرَبَتْ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهَا وَ هِيَ فِي الصَلاَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 370 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 895 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 7, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Bajil, the brother of Ali ibn Bajil, narrated:
"I saw Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} praying, and a man passed by him while
he was between the two prostrations. Abu Abdullah {a.s} threw a small stone at him, and
the man came towards him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَجِيلٍ أَخُو عَلِيَّ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يُصَلِّي فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلْ وَ
هُوَ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَنَيْنِ فَرَمَاهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ بِحَصَاةٍ فَأَقْبَلَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَيْهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 371 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 327 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 897 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 7, p. 258

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
It was narrated by Abu Zakariya al-Awra :
"I saw Abu al-Hasan {a.s} praying while standing, and beside him was an elderly man
who wanted to stand up and had a stick with him. The man wanted to take the stick,
so Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, while still standing in his prayer, bent down and handed the man
the stick. Then he returned to his place and resumed his prayer."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي زَكَرِيًا الْأَعْوَرِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يُصَلِّي قَائِماً وَ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ رَجُلٌ كَبِيرٌ
يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقُومَ وَ مَعَهُ عَصّا لَهُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَانْحَطَّ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَنَاوَلَ
اَلرَّجُلَ الْعَصَا ثُمَّ عَادَ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ إِلَى صَلاَتِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 371 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 332 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 901 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 503 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 304

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ONE PRAYING WHO NEEDS TO RELIEVE HIMSELF
text_en:
Abu Habib Najiyah said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"I have a mill where I grind sesame seeds, and I stand to pray, knowing that the servant
is asleep. I strike the wall to wake him up."
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, you are in the obedience of your Lord {AZJ}, seeking your
sustenance. There is no harm in that."

Scholar's Note:
There is no call to prayer (adhan) or iqama for a woman, nor is there a Jumu’ah prayer
(Jumu'ah) or congregational prayer (Jama'ah) for her.
When a woman stands in prayer, She gathers her feet together and does not spread
them apart, placing her hands on her chest at the location of her breasts.
When She bows, She places her hands on her knees, on her thighs, so as not to bend
too much and cause her back to rise.
When She goes to prostrate, She sits first and then prostrates, pressing her face to the
ground and placing her arms on the ground.
When She rises to stand, She lifts her head from the prostration and sits on her
buttocks, not in the way a man would sit. Then, She rises to stand without raising her
back and hips, moving smoothly.
When She sits for the tashahhud (testification), She raises her legs and brings her
thighs together. A free woman (Hura) does not pray except with a veil (niqab), while a
slave woman (ama) prays without a veil.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو حَبِيبِ نَاجِيَةُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: إِنَّ لِي رَحَى أَطَحَنُ فِيهَا السِّمْسِمَ فَأَقُومُ وَ أُصَلِّي وَ
أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الْغَلامَ نَائِمُ فَأَضْرِبُ الْحَائِطَ لِأُوقِظَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ أَنْتَ فِي طَاعَةِ رَبَّكَ تَطْلُبُ رِزُقَكَ لاَ بَأْسَ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
who said:
"A woman prays in a dress (dir'aa) and a head covering (miqna'a) if it is thick, meaning
it is concealing."
text_ar:
باب - أدب المرأة في الصلاة
ليس على المرأة أذان ولا إقامة ولا جمعة ولا جماعة. وإذا قامت المرأة في صلاتها جمعت بين قدميها ولم تفرج بينهما،
ووضعت يديها على صدرها لمكان ثدييها، فإذا ركعت وضعت يديها فوق ركبتيها على فخذيها لئلا تطأطأ كثيرا فترتفع
عجيزتها، وإذا أرادت السجود جلست ثم سجدت لاطئة بالأرض وتضع ذراعيها في الأرض فإذا أرادت النهوض إلى القيام
رفعت رأسها من السجود وجلست على أليتيها ليس كما يقعى الرجل، ثم نهضت إلى القيام من غير أن ترفع عجيزتها تنسل
انسلالا ، وإذا قعدت للتشهد رفعت رجليها، وضمت فخذيها، والحرة لا تصلي إلا بقناع، والأمة تصلي بغير قناع .
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «الْمَرْأَةُ تُصَلِّي فِي الدَّرْعِ وَ ٱلْمِقْنَعَةِ إِذَا كَانَ
كَثِيفاً يَعْنِي سَتِيراً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 372 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 376 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man
who prays in one garment.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
He then asked: "What about a woman?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No, and it is not proper for a free woman (Hurr) to pray when she
menstruates except with a khimar (headscarf), unless She does not find it."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ يُونُسُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِ وَاجِدٍ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ
قُلْثُ فَالْمَرْأَةُ قَالَ «لا وَ لا يَصْلُحُ لِلْحُرَّةِ إِذَا حَاضَتْ إِلَّ الْخِمَارُ إِلاَّ أَنْ لاَ تَجِدَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 373 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 405

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a
woman who has only one cover (milhafa). How should She pray?
Imam {a.s} said: "She should wrap herself in it and cover her head, and then pray. If her
legs are exposed and She is unable to cover them in any other way, then there is no
harm."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ، أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ: عَنِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ لَيْسَ لَهَا إِلاَّ مِلْحَفَةٌ وَاحِدَةً كَيْفَ
تُصَلِّي قَالَ «تَلْتَفُ فِيهَا وَ تُغَطَّي رَأْسَهَا وَ تُصَلِّي فَإِنْ خَرَجَتْ رِجْلَيْهَا وَ لَيْسَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
cross_references: Questions of Ali bin Jaafar, Part 1, p. 172 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 373 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 177

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
In a narration from Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays, he asked Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a woman praying in a shirt (dir') and a cover (milhafa)
without a waistcloth (izar) or headcover (miqna'a).
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if She wraps herself in it, and if it is not wide enough
to cover her, She should make it long."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ الْمُعَلَّى بْنِ خَتَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي دِزْعِ وَ
مِلْحَفَةٍ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا إِزَارٌ وَ لا مِقْتَعَةٌ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إِذَا اِلْتَفَّتْ بِهَا وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَكْفِيهَا عَرْضاً جَعَلَثهَا طُولاً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 373 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"There is no obligation for a slave woman (amā) to wear a headcover (qina'ah) in
prayer, nor for a woman who is 'mukātabah' (a slave who has entered into a contract
to pay for her freedom) if her master has not required it as part of the terms of her
contract, until She has fulfilled all the terms of her contract. The same rules that apply
to a slave in all legal matters apply to her as well."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَمَةِ قِنَاعٌ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ لاَ عَلَى
الْمُدَبَّرَةِ قِنَاعْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ لاَ عَلَى الْمُكَانَبَةِ إِذَا اِشتَرَطَ عَلَيْهَا مَوْلاَهَا قِنَاعٌ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ هِيَ مَمْلُوكَةٌ حَتَّى تُؤَدِّيَ
جَمِيعَ مُكَاتَبَتِهَا وَ يَجْرِي عَلَيْهَا مَا يَجْرِي عَلَى الْمَمْلُوكِ فِي الْحُدُودِ كُلَهَا.

text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"There is no obligation for a slave woman (amā) to wear a headcover (qina'ah) in
prayer, nor for a woman who is 'mukātabah' (a slave who has entered into a contract
to pay for her freedom) if her master has not required it as part of the terms of her
contract, until She has fulfilled all the terms of her contract. The same rules that apply
to a slave in all legal matters apply to her as well."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
I asked him about a slave woman (amā) who gave birth, and whether the
headcover (khimar) would be required for her.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it were required for her, She would have to wear it when She
menstruates, but there is no requirement for her to wear a headcover in prayer."
text_ar:
قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ: عَنِ الْأَمَةِ إِذَا وَلَدَثْ عَلَيْهَا الْخِمَارُ قَالَ «لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهَا لَكَانَ عَلَيْهَا إِذَا هِيَ حَاضَتْ وَ لَيْسَ
عَلَيْهَا اَلتَّقَنُّعُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 373 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 377

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
Iyas ibn al-Qasim narrated from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who prays in
a woman's izar (waistcloth), in her garment, and uses her khimar (headcover) as a
turban.
Imam {a.s} said: "If She is trustworthy (māʾmūnah), there is no harm."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عِيصُ بْنُ ٱلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: فِي الرَجُلِ يُصَلِّي فِي إِزَارِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ وَ فِي ثَوْبِهَا وَ
يَعْتَمُ بِخِمَارِهَا قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَتْ مَأْمُونَةً فَلاَ بَأْسَ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
It is narrated:
"The best places for women to pray are their homes. A woman's prayer in her house is
better than her prayer in a public prayer area (ṣuffah), and her prayer in the public
prayer area is better than her prayer in the courtyard of her house. Her prayer in the
courtyard is better than her prayer on the roof of her house. And it is disliked for a
woman to pray on a roof that is not enclosed (muḥajjar)."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ خَيْرَ مَسَاجِدِ النِّسَاءِ الْبَيُوتُ وَ صَلاَةَ الْمَرْأَةِ فِي بَنْتِهَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهَا فِي صُفَّتِهَا وَ صَلاَتَهَا
فِي صُفَّتِهَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهَا فِي صَحْنِ دَارِهَا وَ صَلاَتَهَا فِي صَحْنٍ دَارِهَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهَا فِي سَطَحِ بَيْتِهَا وَ
ثُكْرَهُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الصَّلاَةُ فِي سَطْحِ غَيْرِ مُحَجَّرٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 374 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 514

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF WOMEN IN PRAYER
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Do not place women in upper rooms (ghuraf), nor teach them writing, nor teach them
Surah Yusuf. Teach them spinning (al-mighzal) and Surah al-Nur."

Scholar's Note:
And when a woman makes the tasbih (glorification of God), She should knot her
fingers, for they will be questioned on the Day of Judgment.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لا تُنْزِلُوا ٱلنَّسَاءَ ٱلْغُرَفَ وَ لا تُعَلَّمُوهُنَ الْكِتَابَةَ وَ لاَ تُعَلَّمُوهُنَ سُورَةَ
يُوسُفَ وَ عَلَّمُوهُنَّ ٱلْمِغْزَلَ وَ سُورَةَ النُّورِ. فإذا سبحت المرأة عقدت على الأنامل لأنهن مسؤولات يوم القيامة.
commentary:
And when a woman makes the tasbih (glorification of God), She should knot her
fingers, for they will be questioned on the Day of Judgment.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: THE ETIQUETTE OF DEPARTING FROM PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
who said: "When you finish your prayer, turn to your right as you leave."

Scholar's Note:
Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, says:
"And establish the prayer and give the zakah and bow with those who bow."
(Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:43).
Allah {SWT} has commanded the congregation as He commanded the prayer. Allah {SWT},
Blessed and Exalted, has made it obligatory upon the people to pray five times a day,
from Jumu’ah to Jumu’ah, totaling thirty-five prayers. Among them, one prayer is
obligatory in congregation, which is the Jumu’ah prayer.
As for the other prayers, it is not obligatory to pray in congregation, but it is a
recommended practice (Sunnah).
Whoever neglects it without a valid excuse has no prayer. Whoever neglects three
consecutive Jumu’ah prayers without a valid excuse is considered a hypocrite.
A man's prayer in congregation is worth twenty-five degrees more than his prayer alone
in Paradise. The prayer in congregation is worth twenty-four prayers more than the
individual prayer, making a total of twenty-five prayers.
text_ar:
باب - الأدب في الانصراف عن الصلاة
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ فَانْصَرِفْ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ.
commentary:

A man's prayer in congregation is worth twenty-five degrees more than his prayer alone

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated that Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
said:
"There is no prayer for the one who does not attend the congregational prayer from
among the neighbors of the mosque, except for someone who is ill or preoccupied."
text_ar:
باب - الجماعة وفضلها
قال اللّٰه تبارك وتعالى: " وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة واركعوا مع الراكعين "
فأمر الله بالجماعة كما أمر بالصلاة، وفرض اللّٰه تبارك وتعالى على الناس من الجمعة إلى الجمعة خمسا وثلاثين صلاة، فيها
صلاة واحدة فرضها اللّٰه في جماعة وهي الجمعة فأما سائر الصلوات فليس الاجتماع إليها بمفروض ولكنه سنة، من تركها
رغبة عنها وعن جماعة المسلمين من غير علة فلا صلاة له ومن ترك ثلاث جمعات متواليات من غير علة فهو منافق وصلاة
الرجل في جماعة تفضل على صلاة الرجل وحده بخمس وعشرين درجة في الجنة، والصلاة في الجماعة تفضل صلاة
الفرد بأربع وعشرين صلاة فيكون خمسا وعشرين صلاة.
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أُنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لاَ يَشْهَدُ الصَّلاةَ مِنْ جِيرَانٍ
الْمَسْجِدِ إِلاَّ مَرِيضٌ أَوْ مَشْغُولٌ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said to a group of people:
"You must attend the mosque, or I will burn down your houses."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِقَوْمٍ: « لَتَحْضُرُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ أَوْ لَأُحْرِقَنّ عَلَيْكُمْ مَنَازِلَكُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 376 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 291

chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
He {a.s} said: "Whoever prays the five daily prayers in congregation, assume
every good about him."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ صَلَّى الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسَ جَمَاعَةً فَظُنُوا بِهِ كُلَّ خَيْرٍ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Al-Hasan al-Sayqal asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
minimum number for a congregation.
Imam {a.s} said: "A man and a woman."

Scholar's Note:
And if no one else attends the mosque, a believer praying alone is still a congregation
because when he gives the call to prayer (adhan) and the iqamah, two rows of angels
pray behind him.
If he performs the iqamah but not the adhan, one row of angels prays behind him.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ الْحَسَنُ الصَّيْقَلُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: عَنْ أَقَلَ مَا تَكُونُ ٱلْجَمَاعَةُ قَالَ «رَجُلٌ وَ اِمْرَأَةً.
وإذا لم يحضر المسجد أحد فالمؤمن وحده جماعة لأنه متى أذن وأقام صلى خلفه صفان من الملائكة، ومتى أقام ولم
يؤذن صلى خلفه صف واحد .
commentary:
And if no one else attends the mosque, a believer praying alone is still a congregation
because when he gives the call to prayer (adhan) and the iqamah, two rows of angels
pray behind him.
If he performs the iqamah but not the adhan, one row of angels prays behind him.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Prophet {saws} said:
"A believer alone is a proof (Hujjah), and a believer alone is a congregation."
text_ar: - وَ قَدْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «الْمُؤْمِنُ وَحْدَهُ حُجَّةٌ وَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ وَحْدَهُ جَمَاعَةٌ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 376 • Al-Khasal, Part 2, p. 584 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1172 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 297 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 592 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 28, p. 3

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} prayed the Fajr (dawn) prayer one day, and after
finishing, he turned his face towards his companions and asked about certain people
by name, asking if they were present for the prayer.
They replied: "No, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}."
He {saws} then said: "Are they absent?"
They said: "No, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}."
He {saws} said: "Indeed, there is no prayer heavier on the hypocrites than this prayer
(Fajr) and the 'Isha' (night) prayer. If they knew the reward that is in them, they would
come to them, even if crawling."
text_ar:
وَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ الْفَجْرَ ذَاتَ يَوْمِ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فَسَأَلَ
عَنْ أَنَاسِ يُسَمِّيهِمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ هَلْ حَضَرُوا الصَّلاةَ قَالُوا لا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «غُيَّبٌ هُمْ » فَقَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
قَالَ «أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ صَلاةٍ أَثْقَلَ عَلَى ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةِ وَ صَلاَةِ ٱلْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ لَوْ عَلِمُوا ٱلْفَضْلَ ٱلْذِي
فِيهِمَا لَأَثَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوا.

come to them, even if crawling."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever prays the morning (Fajr) and the evening ('Isha') prayers in congregation is
under the protection of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic. Whoever wrongs him,
wrongs Allah {SWT}, and whoever belittles him, belittles Allah {SWT}, the Majestic."

Scholar's Note:
And when there is rain or severe cold, it is permissible for a man to pray in his dwelling
and not attend the mosque.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ صَلَى ٱلْغَدَاةَ وَ ٱلْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَهُوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ وَ
مَنْ ظَلَمَهُ فَإِنَّمَا يَظْلِمُ اللَّهَ وَ مَنْ حَقَّرَهُ فَإِنَّمَا يُحَقِّرُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.
وإذا كان مطر وبرد شديد فجائز للرجل أن يصلي في رحله ولا يحضر المسجد.
commentary:
And when there is rain or severe cold, it is permissible for a man to pray in his dwelling
and not attend the mosque.
cross_references: Al Mahasin, P1, p. 52 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V1, p.377 • Awaali al-La’aali, P1, p. 342 • Al-Wafi, V8, p.1169 • Wasail Al-Shia, V8, p.295 • Bihar Al Anwar, V85, p.12 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, V6, p. 453

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Prophet {saws} said:
"If the sandals are wet, then pray in your dwellings."

Scholar's Note:
My father (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him) said in his letter to me:
"Know, my son, that the one most deserving to lead the congregation is the one most
proficient in reciting the Qur'an.
If they are equal in recitation, then the one who has the most understanding of
jurisprudence (Fiqh).
If they are equal in Fiqh, then the one who has migrated (performed Hijrah) the earliest.
If they are equal in migration, then the oldest in age.
If they are equal in age, then the one with the most pleasing appearance.
The owner of the mosque has more right to lead in his mosque. Let those who stand
closest to the Imam be people of sound judgment and piety so that if the Imam forgets
or becomes confused, they can correct him. The best rows are the front rows, and the
best part of the front row is that which is closest to the Imam."
text_ar:
لِقَوْلِ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِذَا اِبْتَلَّتِ النَّعَالُ فَالصَّلاَةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ.
وقال أبي رحمه اللهفي رسالته إلي: اعلم يا بني أن أولى الناس بالتقدم في جماعة أقرؤهم للقرآن، وإن كانوا في القراءة
سواء فأفقههم، وإن كانوا في الفقه سواء فأقدمهم هجرة فإن كانوا في الهجرة سواء فأسنهم، فإن كانوا في السن سواء
فأصبحهم وجها وصاحب المسجد أولى بمسجده، وليكن من يلي الامام منكم أولوا الأحلام والتقى فإن نسي الامام أو تعايا
فقوموه، وأفضل الصفوف أولها وأفضل أولها من دنى إلى الامام.
commentary:
My father (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him) said in his letter to me:
"Know, my son, that the one most deserving to lead the congregation is the one most
proficient in reciting the Qur'an.
If they are equal in recitation, then the one who has the most understanding of
jurisprudence (Fiqh).
If they are equal in Fiqh, then the one who has migrated (performed Hijrah) the earliest.
If they are equal in migration, then the oldest in age.
If they are equal in age, then the one with the most pleasing appearance.
The owner of the mosque has more right to lead in his mosque. Let those who stand
closest to the Imam be people of sound judgment and piety so that if the Imam forgets
or becomes confused, they can correct him. The best rows are the front rows, and the
best part of the front row is that which is closest to the Imam."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The Imam of the people is their representative, so choose the best among you to
lead."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِمَامُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَافِدُهُمْ فَقَدَّمُوا أَفْضَلَكُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 377 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1174 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 347 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 86, p. 206
text_chunk:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The Imam of the people is their representative, so choose the best among you to
lead."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said:
"If it pleases you to purify and perfect your prayers, then choose the best among you
(to lead)."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنْ سَرَّكُمْ أَنْ تُزَكُّوا صَلاَتَكُمْ فَقَدَّمُوا خِيَارَكُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 377 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 326 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 315 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 347 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 87
text_chunk:
Imam {a.s} said:
"If it pleases you to purify and perfect your prayers, then choose the best among you
(to lead)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever leads a people in prayer while there is someone among them who is more
knowledgeable than him, their affairs will continue to decline until the Day of
Judgment."

Scholar's Note:
Abu Dharr said:
"Indeed, your Imam is your intercessor with Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, so do
not make your intercessor a foolish person or a transgressor."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ صَلَّى بِقَوْمِ وَ فِيهِمْ مَنْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ أَمْرُهُمْ إِلَى
سَفَالٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
وقال أبو ذر: إن إمامك شفيعك إلى اللّٰه عز وجل فلا تجعل شفيعك سفيها و لا فاسقا .
commentary:
Abu Dharr said:
"Indeed, your Imam is your intercessor with Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, so do
not make your intercessor a foolish person or a transgressor."
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Al-Hussain ibn Kathir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
that a man asked him about reciting (Qur'an) behind the Imam (during prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: "No, the Imam is responsible for the recitation, but the Imam does not
take responsibility for the prayers of those behind him; he is only responsible for the
recitation."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سَأْلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنِ ٱلْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ ٱلْإِمَامِ فَقَالَ «لا
إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ ضَامِنْ لِلْقِرَاءَةِ وَ لَيْسَ يَضْمَنُ الْإِمَامُ صَلاَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ إِنَّمَا يَضْمَنُ الْقِرَاءَةَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 279 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 440 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1251 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 353 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 354 • Al- Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 122 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 252

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
who said:
"Five people should not lead others in prayer nor should they lead them in a
congregational obligatory prayer: the person with leprosy (abrāṣ), the person with a
skin disease (majdhūm), the child of adultery (walad al-zina), the Bedouin (a‘rābī) until
he migrates, and the person who has been subjected to the legal punishment (al-
maḥdūd)."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «خَمْسَةٌ لا يَوْمُونَ النَّاسَ وَ لاَ يُصَلُونَ بِهِمْ
صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةً فِي جَمَاعَةِ الْأَبْرَصُ وَ ٱلْمَجْذُومُ وَ وَلَدُ ٱلزَّنَا وَ الْأَعْرَابِيّ حَتَّى يُهَاجِرَ وَ ٱلْمَحْدُودُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1175 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 324

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"None of you should pray behind a person with a mutilated limb (al-ajdham), a person
with leprosy (al-abrāṣ), a person with a mental disorder (al-majnūn), a person who has
been subjected to a legal punishment (al-maḥdūd), the child of adultery (walad al-
zina), or a Bedouin (al-a‘rābī) leading a migrant (al-muhājir)."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لا يُصَلِّيَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ خَلْفَ الْأَجْدَمِ وَ الْأَبْرَصِ وَ ٱلْمَجْنُونِ وَ الْمَحْدُودِ وَ
وَلَدِ الزِّنَا وَ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ لاَ يَؤْمُ ٱلْمُهَاجِرَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 325
text_chunk:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"None of you should pray behind a person with a mutilated limb (al-ajdham), a person
with leprosy (al-abrāṣ), a person with a mental disorder (al-majnūn), a person who has
been subjected to a legal punishment (al-maḥdūd), the child of adultery (walad al-
zina), or a Bedouin (al-a‘rābī) leading a migrant (al-muhājir)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "An uncircumcised man (al-aghlaf) should not lead the people
in prayer, even if he is the most proficient in reciting the Qur'an among them, because
he has neglected one of the greatest aspects of the Sunnah. His testimony is not
accepted, and prayers are not performed over him unless he left it (circumcision) out
of fear for his life."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: «الْأَغْلَفُ لاَ يَوُمُّ ٱلْقَوْمَ وَ لَوْ كَانَ أَقْرَأَهُمْ لِلْقُرْآنِ لِأَنَّهُ ضَيَّعَ مِنَ السُنَّةِ أَعْظَمَهَا وَ لاَ تُقْبَلُ
لَهُ شَهَادَةٌ وَ لا يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ تَرَكَ ذَلِكَ خَوْفاً عَلَى نَفْسِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 327 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 30 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1184 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 320 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 344 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 84 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 101, p. 112
text_chunk:
Imam {a.s} said: "An uncircumcised man (al-aghlaf) should not lead the people

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"A person in chains (al-qayd) does not lead those who are free, and a person afflicted
with paralysis (al-falij) does not lead those who are healthy."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «لَا يَوْمُ صَاجِبُ الْقَيْدِ ٱلْمُطْلَقِينَ وَ لا يَوْمُ صَاحِبُ ٱلْفَالِجِ ٱلْأَصِحَاءَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"A person in chains (al-qayd) does not lead those who are free, and a person afflicted
with paralysis (al-falij) does not lead those who are healthy."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no issue for a blind person to lead the prayer if the people (praying behind
him) are satisfied with him and he is the best among them in recitation and the most
knowledgeable in religious jurisprudence."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ ٱلْبَاقِرُ وَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَؤُمَّ ٱلْأَعْمَى إِذَا رَضُوا بِهِ وَ كَانَ أَكْثَرَهُمْ قِرَاءَةً وَ أَفْقَهَهُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 338
text_chunk:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no issue for a blind person to lead the prayer if the people (praying behind
him) are satisfied with him and he is the best among them in recitation and the most
knowledgeable in religious jurisprudence."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the truly blind are those who are blind in their hearts, for it is not the eyes that
go blind but the hearts within the chests."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَى أَعْمَى الْقَلْبِ فَإِنّهَا «لا تَعْمَى الْأَبْصَارُ وَ لَكِنْ تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ
الّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ» »
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 338 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 508 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol. 9, p. 117
text_chunk:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the truly blind are those who are blind in their hearts, for it is not the eyes that
go blind but the hearts within the chests."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Three people should not be prayed behind: the one who is unknown (al-majhūl), the
extremist (al-ghālī) even if he claims to hold your beliefs, and the one who openly
commits sinful acts (al-mujāhir bil-fisq) even if he appears moderate."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُصَلَّى خَلْفَهُمُ ٱلْمَجْهُولُ وَ اَلْغَالِي وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ بِقَوْلِكَ وَ الْمُجَاهِرُ
بِالْفِسْقٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُقْتَصِداً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Al-Khisal, Part 1, p. 154 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1181 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 314 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 23 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 463
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Three people should not be prayed behind: the one who is unknown (al-majhūl), the
extremist (al-ghālī) even if he claims to hold your beliefs, and the one who openly
commits sinful acts (al-mujāhir bil-fisq) even if he appears moderate."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s} and Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad
{a.s} said:
"Whoever believes in anthropomorphism (al-jism), do not give them anything from the
zakat, and do not pray behind them."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلِيْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ قَالَ بِالْجِسْمِ فَلاَ تُعْطُوهُ شَيْئاً مِنَ الزَّكَاةِ وَ لا
تُصَلُّوا خَلْفَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 311 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 74
text_chunk:
Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s} and Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad
{a.s} said:
"Whoever believes in anthropomorphism (al-jism), do not give them anything from the
zakat, and do not pray behind them."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Abu Abdullah al-Barqi wrote to Abu Ja'far al-Thani {a.s}, asking:
"May I be your ransom, is it permissible to pray behind someone who stopped at (only
accepted the Imamate of) your father and grandfather {a.s}?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray behind him."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَّبَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْبَرْقِيّ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرِ الثَّانِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: أَ يَجُوزُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ الصَّلاَةُ خَلْفَ مَنْ
وَقَفَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ وَ جَدِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ فَأَجَابَ «لاَ تُصَلَ وَرَاءَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Awalim al-Ulum, Vol. 23, p. 402

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Umar ibn Yazid asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about an Imam
who is generally good in all his affairs and knowledgeable, but he raises his voice and
speaks harshly to his parents, causing them distress.
He asked: "Should I pray behind him?"
He {a.s} replied: "No, do not pray behind him as long as he is not openly defiant and
severing ties”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ إِمَامٍ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِهِ عَارِفٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُسْمِعُ
أَبَوَيْهِ الْكَلَامَ الْغَلِيظَ الَّذِي يَغِيظُهُمَا أَقْرَأُ خَلْفَهُ قَالَ «لا، تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَافَاً قَاطِعاً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 30 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1180 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 313 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 71, p. 44 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 40

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi narrated from him {a.s} that He said:
"Do not pray behind someone who declares you to be an unbeliever (kafir), and do not
pray behind someone whom you have declared to be an unbeliever."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيْ عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا تُصَلَ خَلْفَ مَنْ يَشَهَدُ عَلَيْكَ بِالْكُفْرِ وَ لا خَلْفَ
مَنْ شَهِدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْكُفْرِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 380 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1182 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 311

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Saʿd ibn Ismail narrated from his father, who narrated from al-Ridha {a.s}, that
He said:
"I asked him about a man who commits sins ; should one pray behind him or not?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى سَعْدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ أَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُقَارِفُ الذَّنْبَ يُصَلَّى
خَلْفَهُ أَمْ لا قَالَ »لا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 380 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 40

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It was narrated from Isma'il ibn Muslim that he asked Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about praying behind a man who denies (or rejects) the
decree (Qadar) of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic.
He (Al-Sadiq) replied: "He should repeat every prayer he performed behind him”.
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ الصَادِقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ: عَنِ الصَّلاةِ خَلْفَ رَجُلٍ يُكَذَّبُ بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ
عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَالَ «لِيُعِدْ كُلَّ صَلاَةٍ صَلاَّهَا خَلْفَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 380 • Monotheism, Part 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1182 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 311 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 375 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 73

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Isma'il al-Ju'fi said to Abu Ja'far:
"A man loves The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} but does not
dissociate from his enemies, and he says,
'He (Ali) is dearer to me than those who opposed him.'"
He (Abu Ja'far) replied: "This person is of mixed (belief) and is an enemy; do not pray
behind him, nor is there any respect (to be shown to him) except if you must do so out
of precaution."

Scholar's Note:
My father (may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him) said in his letter to me:
"Do not pray behind anyone except for one of two types of people: either someone
whose religion and piety you trust, or someone you must pray behind out of fear of
their power, sword, or harshness towards the religion. Pray behind them as a form of
precaution and accommodation, and in this case, you may make your own intention
and recite for yourself without following them as an Imam. If you finish reciting a surah
before them, leave one verse and continue praising Allah {SWT} until the Imam bows, at
which point you should finish the verse and bow. If you are performing a
supererogatory (nafl) prayer and the congregational prayer is established, stop and
join the obligatory prayer. If you are in an obligatory prayer, do not stop it; instead,
make it a supererogatory prayer, complete it with two units, and then join the Imam.
However, if the Imam is one you fear, do not interrupt your prayer or make it a
supererogatory prayer; simply continue, move to the row, and pray alongside the
congregation. When the Imam stands for the fourth unit, stand with him, recite the
tashahhud from a standing position, and conclude the prayer."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ إسْمَاعِيلُ الْجُعْفِي لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: رَجُلٌ يُجِبُّ أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ وَ لا يَتَبَرَّأُ مِنْ
عَدُوِّهِ وَ يَقُولُ هُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمّنُ خَالَفَهُ قَالَ «هَذَا مِخْلَطْ وَ هُوَ عَدُوْ فَلا تُصَلَ وَرَاءَهُ وَ لاَ كَرَامَةَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَتَّقِيَهُ
وقال أبي رضي اللّٰه عنه في رسالته إلي: لا تصل خلف أحد إلا خلف رجلين أحدهما من تثق بدينه وورعه، وآخر تتقي
سيفه وسطوته وشناعته على الدين، وصل خلفه على سبيل التقية والمداراة وأذن لنفسك وأقم واقرأً لها غير مؤتم به فإن
فرغت من قراءة السورة قبله فأبق منها آية ومجد اللّٰه عز وجل، فإذا ركع الامام فاقرء الآية واركع بها، فإن لم تلحق القراءة
وخشيت أن يركع فقل ما حذفه الامام من الأذان والإقامة واركع، وإن كنت في صلاة نافلة وأقيمت الصلاة فاقطعها وصل
الفريضة، وإن كنت في الفريضة فلا تقطعها واجعلها نافلة وسلم في الركعتين، ثم صل مع الامام إلا أن يكون الامام ممن
يتقى فلا تقطع صلاتك ولا تجعلها نافلة ولكن أخط إلى الصف وصل معه، فإذا قام الامام إلى رابعته فقم معه وتشهد من
قيام وسلم من قيام.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} once led his companions in prayer while seated. When
he finished, He {saws} said: 'None of you should lead others in prayer while seated after
me.'".
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ جَالِساً فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ
«لاً يَوُمَّنَ أَحَدُكُمْ بَعْدِي جَالِساً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 381 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1263 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 345

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The Prophet {saws} once fell from a horse, injuring the right side of his body, and he led
the people in prayer while seated in the room of Umm Ibrahim”.
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «كَانَ النِّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَقَعَ عَنْ فَرَسِ فَشُجَّ شِقُّهُ ٱلْأَيْمَنُ فَصَلَّى
بِهم جَالِساً فِي غُرْفَةِ أَمَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Jamil ibn Salih asked:
"Which is better, for a man to pray by himself at the beginning of the time (for prayer)
or to delay a little and pray with the people of his mosque if he is their Imam?"
He {a.s} replied: "He should delay and pray with the people of his mosque if he is their
Imam."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ جَمِيلُ بَنُ صَالِحِ: أَيْهُمَا أَفْضَلُ يُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ لِنَفْسِهِ فِي أَوّلِ الْوَقْتِ أَوْ يُوَخِّرُ قَلِيلاً وَ يُصَلِّي بِأَهْلِ
مَسْجِدِهِ إِذَا كَانَ إِمَامَهُمْ قَالَ «يُوَخِّرُ وَ يُصَلِّي بِأَهْلِ مَسْجِدِهِ إِذَا كَانَ هُوَ الْإِمَامَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 381 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 429

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
A man asked him:
"I have a mosque at the entrance of my house. Which is better - should I pray at home
where I can make my prayer longer, or should I lead them (in the mosque) and make it
lighter?"
He {a.s} wrote: "Lead them in prayer and perform it well, but do not make it too heavy
(burdensome)”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ إِنَّ لِي مَسْجِداً عَلَى بَابٍ دَارِي فَأَيْهُمَا أَفْضَلُ أُصَلِّي فِي مَنْزِلِي فَأُطِيلُ الصَّلاَةَ أَوْ
أُصَلِّي بِهِمْ وَ أُخَفّفُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «صَلِّ بِهِمْ وَ أَحْسِنِ الصِّلاةَ وَ لا ثَتَقَّلْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 381 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 1171 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 8, p. 430

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Ali {a.s} said regarding two men who disagreed, with one saying, "I was
your Imam (leader in prayer)," and the other saying, "I was your Imam," that "are their
prayers are valid?."
When asked what if one of them said: "I was following you (as the Imam)," and the
other also said: "I was following you,"
Imam {a.s} said: "Then their prayers are invalid, and they must repeat the prayer”.
text_ar:
وَ إِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلَيْنِ اِخْتَلَفَا فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا كُنْتُ إِمَامَكَ وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ كُنْتْ إِمَامَكَ قَالَ »صَلاَثُهُمَا
ثَامَّةٌ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا كُنْتُ أَنْتَمُ بِكَ وَقَالَ الْآَخَرُ كُنْتُ أَنْتَمُ بِكَ قَالَ «فَصَلاَتُهُمَا فَاسِدَةً فَلْيَسْتَأْنِفَا.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 375 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 382 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 54 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1277 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 352 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 477

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Jamil ibn Darraj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about an Imam
who becomes ritually impure (junub) and does not have enough water to perform the
full ritual bath (ghusl), while the rest of the congregation has water to perform ablution
(wudu). He asked whether some of them should perform wudu and then allow the
Imam to lead.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} replied: "No, but the Imam should perform tayammum (dry ablution)
and lead them, for Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has made the earth a purifier
just as He has made water a purifier”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ جَمِيلُ بْنُ دَرَّاجٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنْ إِمَامِ قَوْمِ أَجْتَبَ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ مَا يَكُفِيهِ
لِلْغُسْلِ وَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءً يَتَوَضَّثُونَ بِهِ فَيَتَوَضَّأْ بَعْضُهُمْ وَ يَوْمُهُمْ قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ يَتَيَمَّمُ ٱلْإِمَامُ وَ يَوْمُهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ طَهُوراً كَمَا جَعَلَ الْمَاءَ طَهُوراً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1
text_chunk:
Jamil ibn Darraj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about an Imam
who becomes ritually impure (junub) and does not have enough water to perform the
full ritual bath (ghusl), while the rest of the congregation has water to perform ablution
(wudu). He asked whether some of them should perform wudu and then allow the
Imam to lead.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} replied: "No, but the Imam should perform tayammum (dry ablution)
and lead them, for Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has made the earth a purifier
just as He has made water a purifier”.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It is narrated from him by Umar ibn Yazid that Imam {a.s} said:
"None of you prays an obligatory prayer at its prescribed time and then prays with them
(in congregation) as an act of precaution (taqiyya) while in a state of wudu, except that
Allah {SWT} will record for him twenty-five degrees (of reward). So strive for this."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَا مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ يُصَلِّي صَلاةً فَرِيضَةً فِي وَقْتِهَا ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ صَلاَةً
تَقِيَّةً وَ هُوَ مُتَوَضِّى إِلَّ كَتَبَ اللّهُ لَهُ بِهَا خَمْساً وَ عِشرِينَ دَرَجَةً فَارْغَبُوا فِي ذَلِكَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 382 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1218 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 302

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It is narrated from him by Hammad ibn Uthman that Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever prays with them in the first row, it is as if he prayed behind the Messenger of
Allah {saws} in the first row”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ حَمَادُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى مَعَهُمْ فِي الصَّفَّ الْأَوَّلِ كَانَ كَمَنْ صَلَّى خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي الصَّفَّ ٱَلْأَوَّلِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 380 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 382 • Al-Arba‘ūn Ḥadīthan (Al-Shahīd al-Awwal) Vol. 1, p. 77 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1218 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1218 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 299 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 300 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 98

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It is narrated from him by Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari that Imam {a.s} said:
"It will be counted for you when you join them (in prayer), even if you do not follow them
(in intention); it will be counted for you just as it would if you were with someone you
follow”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ حَفْصُ بْنُ الْبَخْتَرِي أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يُحْسَبُ لَكَ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مَعَهُمْ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ لاَ تَفْتَدِي بِهِمْ حُسِبَ
لَكَ مِثْلُ مَا يُحْسَبُ لَكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ تَقْتَدِي بِهِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 373 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 265 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1217 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 299

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah narrates that someone said to Jafar ibn Muhammad
{a.s}:
"May I be your ransom! I pass by a group of Nasibis (those hostile to the AhlulBayt {a.s}),
and their prayer has been established while I am not in a state of wudu (ritual purity).
If I do not join them in prayer, they will say whatever they wish about me. Should I then
pray with them and perform wudu afterward and pray again?"
Jafar ibn Muhammad {a.s} responded: "Glory be to Allah {SWT}! Does he not fear that if he
prays without wudu, the earth would swallow him up?"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مَسْعَدَةُ بْنُ صَدَقَةَ: أَنَ قَائِلاً قَالَ لِجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّي أَمُرُ بِقَوْمِ نَاصِبِيَّةٍ
وَ قَذْ أُقِيمَتْ لَهُمُ الصَّلاةُ وَ أَنَا عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ أَدْخُلْ مَعَهُمْ فِي الصَّلاةِ قَالُوا مَا شَاءُوا أَنْ يَقُولُوا أَفَأْصَلِّي
مَعَهُمْ ثُمَّ أَتَوَضًا إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتُ وَ أُصَلِّي قَالَ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ «سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ أَفَمَا يَخَافُ مَنْ يُصَلِّي
عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوء أَنْ تَأْخُذَهُ الأَرْضُ خَسْفاً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 43 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 1, p.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It is narrated from Zayd al-Shahham that He said: Imam Ja'far Al-Sadiq {a.s}
said:
"O’ Zayd, interact with the people through good character. Pray in their mosques, visit
their sick, and attend their funerals. If you can, be the Imams and callers to prayer
(mu'adhdhins), then do so. For if you do this, they will say,
'These are the Ja'fariyyah; may Allah {SWT} have mercy on Ja'far, how well he trained his
companions!'
But if you do otherwise, they will say,
'These are the Ja'fariyyah; may Allah {SWT} do with Ja'far as he deserves for how badly he
trained his companions!'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ زَيْدُ الشَّحَّامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يَا زَيْدُ خَالِقُوا النَّاسَ بِأخْلاَقِهِمْ صَلُّوا فِي مَسَاجِدِهِمْ وَ
عُودُوا مَرْضَاهُمْ وَ اِشهَدُوا جَنَائِزَهُمْ وَ إِنِ اِسْتَطَعْثُمْ أَنْ تَكُونُوا الْأَيِمَّةَ وَ الْمُؤَذّنِينَ فَافْعَلُوا فَإِنَّكُمْ إِذَا فَعَلْثُمْ ذَلِكَ
قَالُوا هَؤُلاءِ الْجَعْفَرِيَّةُ رَجِمَ اللَّهُ جَعْفَراً مَا كَانَ أَحْسَنَ مَا يُؤَدِّبُ أَصْحَابَهُ وَ إِذَا تَرَكْتُمْ ذَلِكَ قَالُوا هَؤُلاءِ الْجَعْفَرِيَّةُ
فَعَلَ اللَّهُ بِجَعْفَرِ مَا كَانَ أَسْوَاَ مَا يُؤَدَّبُ أَصْحَابَهُ.

text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Give the call to prayer (adhan) behind the one you recited the prayer behind”.
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «أَذِّنْ خَلْفَ مَنْ قَرَأْتَ خَلْفَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 56 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1209 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 443 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 365

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
A man said to him {a.s}:
"I pray with my family, then I go to the mosque and they ask me to lead them in prayer."
Imam {a.s} said: "Go ahead and lead them; there is no harm in it. Pray with them."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ رَجُلٌ أُصَلِّي فِي أَهْلِي ثُمَّ أَخْرُجُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَيُقَدَّمُونِي فَقَالَ «تَقَدَّمْ لا عَلَيْكَ وَ
صَلِّّ بِهِمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 1218 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p.

chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Hisham ibn Salim narrated from him {a.s} that He said regarding a man who
prays alone and then finds a congregation:
"He may pray with them and count it as his obligatory (fardh) prayer if he wishes”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمِ عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي الصَّلاَةَ وَحْدَهُ ثُمَّ يَجِدُ جَمَاعَةً قَالَ
«يُصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ وَ يَجْعَلُهَا ٱلْفَرِيضَةَ إِنْ شَاءَ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 379 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 50 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1247 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 401 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 403

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a
man leading a group in prayer while wearing trousers (sarawil) and a cloak (rida).
He {a.s} replied: "There is no harm in it”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الرِّجُلِ هَلْ يُصَلِّي بِالْقَوْمِ وَ عَلَيْهِ سَرَاوِيلُ
وَرِدَاءً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said: "The last prayer that
the Messenger of Allah {saws} led the people in was while wearing a single garment, with
its ends crossed over one another. Shall I show you the garment?" I said: "Yes."
He then brought out a cloak, and I measured it - it was seven cubits by eight hand
spans.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ آخِرَ صَلاَةٍ صَلَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ بِالنَّاسِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاجِدِ قَدْ خَالَفَ بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ أَلاَ أُرِيكَ الثَّوْبَ» قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَ فَأَخْرَجَ مِلْحَفَةً فَذَرَغْتُهَا وَ كَانَتْ
مَبْعَةَ أَذْرُعٍ فِي ثَمَانِيَةِ أَشبَارٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 384 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 391

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Umar ibn Yazid asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
narration that states it is not appropriate to perform supererogatory (nafl) prayers at
the time of every obligatory (fardh) prayer.
He asked: "What is the limit for this time?"
He {a.s} replied: "When the person giving the iqamah (call immediately preceding the
prayer) begins the iqamah."
Umar said: "People differ in the timing of the iqamah."
He {a.s} responded: "The one giving the iqamah is the one with whom the prayer is being
established”.
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرِّوَايَةِ الَّتِي يَرْوُونَ أَنَّهُ لا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُتَطَوَّعَ فِي
وَقْتِ كُلِّ فَرِيضَةٍ مَا حَدُّ هَذَا الْوَقْتِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَخَذَّ ٱلْمُقِيمُ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِي ٱلْإِقَامَةِ
قَالَ «الْمُقِيمُ الَّذِي يُصَلَّى مَعَهُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 384 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 283

Umar ibn Yazid asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
narration that states it is not appropriate to perform supererogatory (nafl) prayers at
the time of every obligatory (fardh) prayer.
He asked: "What is the limit for this time?"
He {a.s} replied: "When the person giving the iqamah (call immediately preceding the

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Hafs ibn Salim asked: "When the muezzin (caller to prayer) says 'The prayer
has been established' (during the iqamah), should the people stand up or remain
seated until their Imam arrives?"
He {a.s} replied: "No, they should stand up. If their Imam arrives, they proceed with him;
otherwise, a man from among the congregation should be taken by the hand and
brought forward to lead."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ حَفْصُ بْنُ سَالِمِ: إِذَا قَالَ الْمُوَذِّنُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاةُ أَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ عَلَى أَرْجُلِهِمْ أَوْ يَجْلِسُونَ حَتَّى
يَجِيءَ إِمَامُهُمْ قَالَ «لَاَ بَلْ يَقُومُونَ عَلَى أَرْجُلِهِمْ فَإِنْ جَاءَ إِمَامُهُمْ وَ إِلاَّ فَلْيُوْخَذْ بِيَدِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَيُقَدَّمَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

has been established' (during the iqamah), should the people stand up or remain
seated until their Imam arrives?"
He {a.s} replied: "No, they should stand up. If their Imam arrives, they proceed with him;
otherwise, a man from among the congregation should be taken by the hand and
brought forward to lead."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said: "When the prayer has
been established (by the iqamah), speaking becomes forbidden for the Imam and the
people of the mosque, except in the matter of appointing an Imam”.
text_ar:
وروى زرارة عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام أنه قال: " إذا أقيمت الصلاة حرم الكلام على الامام وأهل
المسجد إلا في تقديم إمام
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It was narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim that he was asked about a man
leading two others in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stand in front of them and not between them."
And regarding two men praying together in congregation, Imam {a.s} said:
"Yes, he (the one leading) should have the other stand on his right”.
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ: أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَؤُمُ ٱلرَّجْلَيْنِ قَالَ «يَتَقَدَّمُهُمَا وَ لاَ يَقُومُ بَيْنَهُمَا» وَ عَنِ
الرَّجُلَيْنِ يُصَلِّيَانٍ جَمَاعَةً قَالَ «نَعَمْ يَجْعَلُهُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 342

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind me just as I see you from in front of me
and from before me. Do not differ, lest Allah {SWT} cause discord among your hearts."
text_ar:
قَالَ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «أَقِيمُوا صُفُوفَكُمْ فَإِنَّي أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ خَلْفِي كَمَا أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ
قُدَّامِي وَ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيّ وَ لَا تُخَالِفُوا فَيُخَالِفَ آَللّهُ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 423 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 74 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 505

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"Praying in the first row is like striving (jihad) in the way of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Majestic."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرِ عَ: «إِنَّ ٱلصَّلاةَ فِي الصَفَّ الْأَوَّلِ كَالْجِهَادِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1188 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 307

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"I see no harm in rows (of prayer) being between the columns (pillars)."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى الْحَلَبِيْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنْهُ قَالَ: « لا أَرَى بِالصُفُوفِ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَسَاطِينِ بَأْساً.
cross_references: Fiqh al-Reza {a.s}, vol. 1, p. 125 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 386 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 386 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 408 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 499

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Complete your rows when you see a gap, and it does not harm you to move back if
you find tightness in the first row to the row behind you, walking at an angle."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَتِمُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ خَلَلاً وَ لا يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ تَتَأْخَرَ وَرَاءَكَ إِذَا وَجَدْتَ ضِيقاً فِي
اَلصَّفَّ اَلْأَوَّلِ إِلَى الصَّفَّ الَّذِي خَلْفَكَ وَ تَمْشِيَ مُنحَرِفاً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"The rows (in prayer) should be complete and continuous, one row connected to
another, and there should not be a gap between the rows that cannot be crossed, such
that it should only be the space of a human body when in prostration”.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلصُفُوفِ أَنْ تَكُونَ تَامَّةً مُتَوَاصِلَةً بَعْضُهَا إِلَى
بَعْضٍ وَ لاَ يَكُونَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَّيْنِ مَا لاَ يُتَخَطَى يَكُونُ قَدْرُ ذَلِكَ مَسْقَطَ جَسَدِ إِنْسَانٍ إِذَا سَجَدَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 386 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 410

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"If a group prays with a gap between themselves and the Imam that cannot be crossed,
then that Imam is not considered an Imam for them. Any row whose members are
praying following the prayer of an Imam but are separated from the row before them
by a gap that cannot be crossed, that is not a valid prayer for them. If there is a barrier
or a wall, their prayer is also invalid unless one is directly aligned with the door."
Imam {a.s} also said: "These enclosures (maqasir) were introduced by tyrants, and there
is no valid prayer for anyone who prays behind them, following the prayer of those
within."
Furthermore, Imam {a.s} said: "Any woman who prays behind an Imam but with a gap
between her and him that cannot be crossed, her prayer is invalid."
I (the narrator) asked: "If a person comes and wishes to pray, what should they do if
She is beside the man?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should enter between her and the man, and She should move
slightly."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنْ صَلَّى قَوْمٌ بَيْنَهُمْ وَ بَيْنَ ٱلْإِمَامِ مَا لا يُتَخَطْى فَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ ٱلْإِمَامُ لَهُمْ
بِإِمَامٍ وَ أَيّ صَفَّ كَانَ أَهْلُهُ يُصَلُونَ بِصَلَاةِ إِمَامِ وَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّفَ الَذِي يَتَقَدَمُهُمْ مَا لاَ يُتَخَطَّى فَلَيْسَ تِلْكَ لَهُمْ
بِصَلاةٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ سِشْراً أَوْ جِدَاراً فَلَيْسَ تِلْكَ لَهُمْ بِصَلاَةٍ إِلاّ مَنْ كَانَ حِيَالَ البَابِ» قَالَ وَقَالَ «هَذِهِ ٱلْمَقَاصِيرُ إِنَّمَا
أَحْدَثَهَا الْجَبَّارُونَ وَ لَيْسَ لِمَنْ صَلَّى خَلْفَهَا مُقْتَدِياً بِصَلاةٍ مَنْ فِيهَا صَلاةٌ» قَالَ وَقَالَ «أَيُّمَا اِمْرَأَةٍ صَلَّتْ خَلْفَ إِمَامِ
وَ بَيْنَهَا وَ بَيْنَهُ مَا لا يُتَخَطَى فَلَيْسَ لَهَا تِلْكَ بِصَلاةٍ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ جَاءَ إِنْسَانَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ وَ هِيَ
إِلَى جَانِبِ الرَّجُلِ قَالَ «يَدْخُلُ بَيْنَهَا وَ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلِ وَ تَنْحَدِرُ هِيَ شَيْئاً.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
In the narration of Abdullah ibn Sinan from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The minimum distance that should be between you and the Qibla is the space of a
goat's resting place, and the maximum distance is the tethering place of a horse."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «أقَلُ مَا يَكُونُ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ
مَرْبِضُ عَنْزٍ وَ أَكْثَرُ مَا يَكُونُ مَرْبِطُ فَرَسِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 387 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 15 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1191 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 137 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 410 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 302

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Ammar ibn Musa narrated that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was
asked about an Imam praying while behind him are people at a lower level than where
he is praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the Imam is on something like a platform or at a significantly higher
level than their position, their prayer is invalid. However, if he is elevated by a finger's
width or slightly more or less, due to a natural rise, or if the land is even but has a raised
spot where the Imam stands while those behind him are at a lower level and the land
itself is generally flat but sloped in places, then there is no issue."
He was asked about an Imam standing lower than those behind him
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no issue."
Imam {a.s} further said: "If a person is above, on a roof or a platform or any other elevated
place while the Imam prays on the ground below, it is permissible for the person to
pray behind the Imam and follow his prayer even if the person is significantly higher."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ ٱلْإِمَامِ يُصَلِّي وَ خَلْفَهُ قَوْمٌ أَسْفَلُ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْضِعِ
اَلَّذِي يُصَلِّي فِيهِ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ الْإِمَامُ عَلَى شِبْهِ الدُّكَّانِ أَوْ عَلَى أَرْفَعَ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِمْ لَمْ تَجُزْ صَلاَتُهُمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَرْفَعَ
مِنْهُمْ بِإِصْبَعِ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ أَوْ أَقَلَّ إِذَا كَانَ الاِرْتِفَاعُ بِقَطْعِ سَيْلٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَتِ الْأَرْضُ مَبْسُوطَةً وَ كَانَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ مِنْهَا
اِرْتِفَاعٌ فَقَامَ ٱلْإِمَامُ فِي الْمَوْضِعِ الْمُرْتَفِعِ وَ قَامَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ وَ الْأَرْضُ مَبْسُوطَةٌ إِلاَّا أَنَّهَا فِي مَوْضِعِ مُنْحَدِرٍ
فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ» وَ سُئِلَ فَإِنْ قَامَ ٱلْإِمَامُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْ مَوْضِعٍ مَنْ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَهُ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ» وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ «إِنْ
كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فَوْقَ بَيْتٍ أَوْ غَيْرٍ ذَلِكَ دُكَّاناً كَانَ أَوْ غَيْرَهُ وَ كَانَ الْإِمَامُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ الْإِمَامُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ كَانَ
لِلرَّجُلٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ خَلْفَهُ وَ يَقْتَدِيَ بِصَلاَتِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَرْفَعَ مِنْهُ بِشَيْءٍ كَثِيرٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Musa ibn Bakr asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about
a man who stands alone in a row during prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem ; indeed, the row is formed one person at a time."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَقُومُ فِي الصُّفَ وَحْدَهُ
قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إِنَّمَا يَبْدُو الصَّفُّ وَاحِداً بَعْدَ وَاحِدٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It was narrated from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah that He said:
"I heard Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"If you enter the mosque and the Imam is in the bowing position (ruku'), and you think
that if you walk towards him, he will raise his head, then pronounce the takbir (opening
supplication) and bow. When the Imam raises his head, prostrate in your place. If the
Imam then stands, join the row. If he sits, remain seated in your place, and when he
stands again, join the row."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ
الْمَسْجِدَ وَ اَلْإمَامُ رَاكِعْ وَ ظَنَنْتَ أَنَّكَ إِنْ مَشَيْتَ إِلَيْهِ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَكَبَّرْ وَ اِرْكَعْ فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَاسْجُدْ مَكَانَكَ فَإِذَا
قَامَ فَالْحَقْ بِالصَّفَّ وَ إِنْ جَلَسَ فَاجْلِسْ مَكَانَكَ فَإِذَا قَامَ فَالْحَقْ بِالصَّفَ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 385 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 389 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 44 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 436 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1195 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 385
text_chunk:
It was narrated from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah that He said:
"I heard Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"If you enter the mosque and the Imam is in the bowing position (ruku'), and you think
that if you walk towards him, he will raise his head, then pronounce the takbir (opening
supplication) and bow. When the Imam raises his head, prostrate in your place. If the
Imam then stands, join the row. If he sits, remain seated in your place, and when he
stands again, join the row."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
It is narrated: "He should walk during the prayer by dragging his feet and not
stepping over (or taking large steps)."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ يَمْشِي فِي الصَّلاَةِ يَجُرُّ رِجْلَيْهِ وَ لَا يَتَخَطَّى.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 389 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1195

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"If you reach the Imam while he is in the bowing position (ruku') and you say the takbir
(opening supplication) before the Imam raises his head, then you have caught the
rak'ah (unit of prayer).
However, if he raises his head before you bow, then you have missed that rak'ah."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَلَبِي عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَدْرَكْتَ الْإِمَامَ وَ قَدْ رَكَعَ فَكَبَّرْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ
الْإِمَامُ رَأْسَهُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتَ الرَّكْعَةَ وَ إِنْ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ فَقَدْ فَاتَثكَ الرَّكْعَةُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Abu Usamah narrated that he asked about a man who reaches the Imam
while he is in the bowing position (ruku').
Imam {a.s} said: "If he pronounces the takbir and straightens his back (stands up
properly) and then bows, he has caught the rak'ah."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو أُسَامَةَ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنْ رَجْلِ اِنْتَهَى إلَى الْإِمَامِ وَ هُوَ رَاكِعٌ، قَالَ «إِذَا كَبَّرَ وَ أَقَامَ صُلْبَهُ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ
فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
A man said to Imam Abu Ja'far {a.s},
"I am the Imam of the mosque in our neighborhood, and when I bow (in ruku') with
them, I hear the sound of their footsteps while I am in ruku'."
Imam {a.s} replied: "Remain in your bowing position for as long as your bowing takes,
and if they catch up, (continue); otherwise, stand up straight."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّي إِمَامُ مَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَيِّ فَأَرْكَعُ بِهِمْ وَ أَسْمَعُ خَفَقَانَ نِعَالِهِمْ وَ أَنَا رَاكِعْ
فَقَالَ «اِصْبِرُ رُكُوعَكَ وَ مِثْلَ رُكُوعِكَ فَإِنِ اِنْقَطَعُوا وَ إِلاَّ فَانْتَصِبْ قَائِماً.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}: "It is appropriate for the
Imam's prayer to be suited to the ability of the weakest among those behind him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى إسحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَكُونَ صَلاَثُهُ عَلَى
صَلَاَةٍ أَضْعَفٍ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Mu'adh used to lead prayer in a mosque during the time of the Messenger of
Allah {saws} and would make the recitation lengthy.
One day, a man passed by while Mu'adh was reciting a long Surah, so the man recited
(the prayer) for himself, completed it, and then rode off on his mount.
When this incident reached The Prophet {saws}, he sent for Mu'adh and said:
"O’ Mu'adh, be careful not to be a source of hardship (fitnah). Recite from the shorter
Surahs like 'By the sun and its brightness' (Ash-Shams) and similar ones."
text_ar:
وَ كَانَ مُعَاذْ يَؤُمُ فِي مَسْجِدٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ يُطِيلُ ٱلْقِرَاءَةَ وَ أَنَّهُ مَرّ بِهِ رَجُلْ
فَافْتَتَحَ سُورَةً طَوِيلَةً فَقَرَاَ الرَّجُلُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَ صَلَّى ثُمَّ رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَبَعَتَ إِلَى
مُعَاذٍ فَقَالَ «يَا مُعَاذُ إِيَاكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ فَتَّاناً عَلَيْكَ بِالشَّمْسِ وَ ضُحَيهَا وَ ذَوَاتِهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 390 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 1261 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 8, p. 420

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
The Prophet {saws} was leading his companions in prayer one day when he
heard the crying of a child, so he shortened the prayer.

Scholar's Note:
The Imam should recite in a moderate manner because Allah {SWT}, the Almighty, says:
"Do not be loud in your prayer, nor too quiet in it" (Surah Al-Isra 17:110).
When the Imam finishes reciting Surah Al-Fatiha, those behind him should say: "All
praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all worlds."
It is not permissible to say "Ameen" after the recitation of Surah Al-Fatiha because that
was the practice of the Christians.
text_ar:
وَ إِنَّ النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ ذَاتَ يَوْمِ يَوُمُ أَصْحَابَهُ فَيَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصِّبِيّ فَيُخَفَّفُ الصّلاَةَ.
وعلى الامام أن يقرأ قراءة وسطا لان اللّٰه عز وجل يقول: " ولا تجهر بصلاتك ولا تخافت بها .وإذا فرغ الامام من قراءة
الفاتحة فليقل الذي خلفه: " الحمد لله رب العالمين. ولا يجوز أن يقال بعد قراءة فاتحة الكتاب " آمين " لان ذلك كانت
تقوله النصارى.

praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all worlds."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali
Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
Amir al-Mu'minin {a.s} used to say: "Whoever recites (aloud) behind an Imam whom he
follows (in prayer) and then dies will be resurrected on a different (incorrect) natural
disposition (fitra)."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةْ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَرَأْ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ يَأْتَمُ بِهِ فَمَاتَ بُعِثَ عَلَى غَيْرِ فِطْرَةٍ.
cross_references: Al Mahasin, Part 1, p. 79 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 390 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 230 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 269 • Al-Sarāʾir, Part 3, p. 588 • Aʿlām al-Dīn, Part 1, p. 402 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 108 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1201 • Wasail Al- Shia, Vol. 8, p. 356

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"If you are praying behind an Imam whom you are following, do not recite (the Qur'an)
behind him, whether you hear his recitation or not, except in a prayer where the
recitation is done aloud and you do not hear it - then you may recite."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَلَبِيْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ تَأْتَمُ بِهِ فَلا تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ
سَمِعْتَ قِرَاءَتَهُ أَوْ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ إِلَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ صَلَاَةً يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ فَاقْرَأُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 391 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 32 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 428 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 108 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1199 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 355

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
In a narration from Ubayd ibn Zurarah from Imam {a.s}:
"If he (the follower) hears a murmur (of the Imam's recitation), he should not recite."

cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"Do not recite anything (from the Qur'an) in the last two rak'ahs of the four obligatory
rak'ah prayers, whether you are an Imam or not."
I (Zurarah) asked: "So what should I say in them?"
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are an Imam or praying alone, say: 'Subhan Allah {SWT} (Glory be
to Allah {SWT}), Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah {SWT}), and La ilaha illAllah {SWT} (There is
no god but Allah {SWT})' three times, making a total of nine glorifications. Then say the
takbir and bow (for ruku')."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا تَقْرَأَنَّ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْبَعِ الرَّكَعَاتِ
الْمَفْرُوضَاتِ شَيْئاً إِمَاما كُنْتَ أَوْ غَيْرَ إِمَامٍ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا أَقُولُ فِيهَا قَالَ »إِنْ كُنْتَ إِمَاما أَوْ وَحْدَكَ فَقُلْ سُبْحَانَ
اللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلاّ اللّهُ ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتِ تُكَمِّلُهُ تِسْعَ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ ثُمَّ تُكَبِّرُ وَ تَرْكَعُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
text_en:
Wuhayb ibn Hafs narrated from Abu Basir, from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"The minimum that suffices in the last two rak'ahs is to say three tasbihat
(glorifications), by saying: 'Subhan Allah {SWT} (Glory be to Allah {SWT}), Subhan Allah {SWT},
Subhan Allah {SWT}.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى وُهَيْبُ بْنُ حَفْص عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «أَدْنَى مَا يُجْزِي مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ
فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ ثَلاَثُ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ أَنْ تَقُولَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 392 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 775 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 109 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 82, p. 91
