author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated from Dawud ibn al-
Husayn, who narrated from Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who narrated from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}: I asked him about a man who took two slaves as collateral (rahn) from
another man, and one of them perished. Does his right apply to the other slave?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: What if it was a house that burned down? Does his right remain in the land?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: What if it was two animals and one of them perished? Does his right apply to
the other?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: What if it was merchandise that was destroyed because it was left for a long
time, or food that spoiled, or a servant who became blind due to smallpox, or clothes
that were left folded without being aired out until they were ruined?
Imam {a.s} said: "All of this is the same case. His right remains applicable to the
remaining property."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ الْبَزَنْطِيُ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ
الْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَهَنَ عِنْدَهُ آخَرُ عَبْدَيْنِ فَهَلَكَ أَحَدُهُمَا أَ يَكُونُ حَقُهُ فِي
اَلْآخَرِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ أَوْ دَاراً فَاخْتَرَقَتْ أَ يَكُونُ حَقُهُ فِي التُّرْبَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ أَوْ دَابَّتَيْنِ فَهَلَكَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا أَ
يَكُونُ حَقُّهُ فِي الْأُخْرَى قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ أَوْ مَتَاعاً فَهَلَكَ مِنْ طُولِ مَا تَرَكَهُ أَوْ طَعَاماً فَفَسَدَ أَوْ غَلاَماً فَأْصَابَهُ جُدَرِيٌّ
فَعَمِيَ أَوْ ثِيَاباً تَرَكَهَا مَطْوِيَّةً لَمْ يَتَعَاهَذْهَا وَ لَمْ يَنْشُرْهَا حَتَّى هَلَكَتْ قَالَ «هَذَا نَحْوُ وَاحِدٍ يَكُونُ حَقُّهُ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.311 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.389
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated from Dawud ibn al-
Husayn, who narrated from Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who narrated from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}: I asked him about a man who took two slaves as collateral (rahn) from
another man, and one of them perished. Does his right apply to the other slave?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: What if it was a house that burned down? Does his right remain in the land?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: What if it was two animals and one of them perished? Does his right apply to
the other?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: What if it was merchandise that was destroyed because it was left for a long
time, or food that spoiled, or a servant who became blind due to smallpox, or clothes
that were left folded without being aired out until they were ruined?
Imam {a.s} said: "All of this is the same case. His right remains applicable to the
remaining property."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa Al-Kadhim {a.s}) about a man who takes an item as
collateral (rahn) for one hundred dirhams, while its value is three hundred dirhams,
and it gets destroyed. Is the man required to return two hundred dirhams to its owner?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, because he took collateral that had surplus value and then
caused its loss."
I asked: What if half of the collateral is destroyed?
Imam {a.s} said: "It will be accounted for accordingly."
I asked: Should they return the surplus value between them?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفَوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إبْرَاهِيمَ عَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَرْهَنُ الرَّهْنَ بِمِائَةٍ
دِرْهَمٍ وَ هُوَ يُسَاوِي ثَلاَثَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ فَيُهْلِكُهُ أَ عَلَى الرّجُلِ أَنْ يَرُدّ عَلَى صَاجِبِهِ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ لِأَنَّهُ أَخَذَ
رَهْناً فِيهِ فَضْلٌ وَ ضَيَّعَهُ» قُلْتُ فَهَلَكَ نِصْفُ الرَّهْنِ قَالَ «عَلَى حِسَابٍ ذَلِكَ» قُلْتُ فَيَتَرَادَانِ الْفَضْلَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.234 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.311 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.172 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.3 p.120 • Al-Wafi, Vol.18 p.861 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.391

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s}:
"Commander of the Faithful {a.s} ruled regarding collateral (rahn) that if its value is
greater than the debt owed to the creditor and it is destroyed, the excess value must
be returned to the owner of the collateral.
And if the collateral is worth less than the debt and is destroyed, the debtor must pay
the remaining amount owed to the creditor.
But if the value of the collateral equals the debt, then there is no further obligation on
either party."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ : «قَضَى أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي الرَّهْنِ
إِذَا كَانَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مَالِ الْمُرْتَهِنِ فَهَلَكَ أَنْ يُؤَدَّى الْفَضْلُ إِلَى صَاحِبِ الرَّهْنِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ الرَّهْنُ أَقَلَ مِنْ مَالِهِ فَهَلَكَ
الرَّهْنُ أَدَّى إِلَيْهِ صَاحِبُهُ فَضْلَ مَالِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ الرَّهْنُ يَسْوَى مَا رَهَنَهُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.312 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.392

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Fadalah narrated from Aban, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
"If two parties disagree about the value of collateral (rahn), with one claiming it was
pledged for one thousand dirhams and the other claiming it was pledged for one
hundred dirhams, the one claiming the higher value must present evidence. If he
cannot provide evidence, the one claiming the lower value must take an oath."
"Similarly, if the collateral is worth either less or more than the claimed amount, and
they disagree about its status, whether it is collateral (rahn) or a deposit (wadi'ah), the
one claiming it is a deposit must present evidence. If he cannot provide evidence, the
one claiming it is collateral must take an oath."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى فَضَالَةُ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ : «إِذَا اِخْتَلَفَا فِي الرَّهْنِ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا رَهَنْتَهُ
بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمِ وَ قَالَ الْآخَرُ رَهَنْتُهُ بِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ فَإِنَّهُ يُسْأْلُ صَاحِبُ الْأَلْفِ الْبَيِّنَةَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ بَيِّنَةٌ حَلَفَ صَاحِبُ
الْمِائَةِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ الرّهْنُ أَقَلَّ مِمَّا رَهَنَ بِهِ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ وَ اِخْتَلَفًا فِي الرِّهْنِ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا هُوَ رَهْنٌ وَ قَالَ الْآخَرُ هُوَ وَدِيعَةٌ
فَإِنَّهُ يُسْأَلُ صَاحِبُ الْوَدِيعَةِ الْبَيِّنَةَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ بَيِّنَةٌ حَلَفَ صَاحِبُ اَلرَهْنِ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.237 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.312 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.174 • Al-Wafi, Vol.18 p.863

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
"I asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}) about a man who pledges a
slave, garment, jewellery, or household items as collateral, and the owner of the
property tells the creditor, 'You are permitted to use this garment, wear it, benefit from
the property, and use the servant.'
Imam {a.s} said: ‘It is lawful for him if the owner permits it, but I do not like him to do so.'"
I then asked: ‘What if someone pledges a house that produces income, who does the
income belong to?'
Imam {a.s} replied: ‘The income belongs to the owner of the house.' "
I further asked: ‘What if someone pledges a barren land and the owner of the land tells
him to cultivate it for himself?'
Imam {a.s} replied: ‘This is lawful. It is not the same as the previous case. He cultivates
it with his own money, so it is lawful for him as the owner has permitted it, because he
invests his own resources and develops the land.' "
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَرْهَنُ
الْعَبْدَ أَو الثَّوْبَ أَوِ الْحُلِيَّ أَوْ مَتَاعَ الْبَيْتِ فَيَقُولُ صَاحِبُ ٱلْمَتَاعِ لِلْمُرْتَهِنِ أَنْتَ فِي جِلَّ مِنْ لُبْسِ هَذَا الثَّوْبِ اِلْبَسِ
الثَّوْبَ وَ اِنْتَفِع بِالْمَتَاعِ وَ اِسْتَخْدِمِ الْخَادِمَ قَالَ «هُوَ لَهُ حَلاَلَ إِذَا أَحَلَّهُ لَهُ وَ مَا أُحِبُ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ» قُلْتُ فَارْتَهَنَ دَاراً
لَهَا غَلَّةٌ لِمَنِ الْغَلَّةُ قَالَ «لِصَاجِبِ الدّارِ» قُلْتُ فَارْتَهَنَ أَرْضاً بَيْضَاءَ فَقَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُ ٱلْأَرْضِ اِزْرَعْهَا لِنَفْسِكَ فَقَالَ
«هَذَا حَلاَلٌ لَيْسَ هَذَا مِثْلَ هَذَا يَزْرَعُهَا بِمَالِهِ فَهُوَ لَهُ حَلاَلُ كَمَا أَحَلْهُ لِأَنَّهُ يَزْرَعُ بِمَالِهِ وَ يَعْمُرُهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.235 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.312 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.173 • Al-Wafi, Vol.18 p.847 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.392

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Rabah al-Qalla’, who said:
"I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s} about a man whose brother passed away and left behind a
box containing pledged items. Some of these items had the names of their owners and
the amounts for which they were pledged, while others had no information about their
owners or the amounts for which they were pledged. What is the ruling regarding the
items whose owners are unknown?"
Imam {a.s} replied: ‘They are treated as part of his property.' "
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفَوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَبَاحِ ٱلْقَلاءِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ هَلَكَ
أَخُوهُ وَ تَرَكَ صُنْدُوقاً فِيهِ رُهُونٌ بَعْضُهَا عَلَيْهِ اِسْمُ صَاحِبِهِ وَ بِكَمْ هُوَ رُهِنَ وَ بَعْضُهَا لا يُدْرَى لِمَنْ هُوَ وَ لاَ بِكَمْ هُوَ
رُهِنَ مَا تَرَى فِي هَذَا اَلَّذِي لاَ يُعْرَفُ صَاحِبُهُ فَقَالَ «هُوَ كَمَالِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.236 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.313 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.170 • Al-Wafi, Vol.18 p.842 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.399 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.13 p.423

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Abu al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi (may Allah {SWT} be pleased with
him) narrated from Musa ibn Imran al-Nakha'i, from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-
Nawfali, from Ali ibn Salim, from his father, who said:
"I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about the report that has been narrated: 'Whoever relies
more on a pledge (rahn) than on his believing brother, I am free from him.'
Imam {a.s} replied: 'That applies when the truth becomes manifest, and our Qaim (the
Mahdi Imam Muhammad ibn Hassan Al-Mahdi {a.s}) from among the Ahlulbayt {a.s} rises.'
I then asked about the report that says: 'The profit earned by a believer from another
believer is riba (usury).'
Imam {a.s} said: 'That applies when the truth becomes manifest, and our Qaim {a.s} from
among the Ahlulbayt {a.s} rises. As for today, there is no harm if a believer sells to his
believing brother and earns profit from him.' "
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ ٱلْأَسَدِيُ رَضِيَ اللّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ النَّخَعِيّ عَنْ عَمَّهِ
الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْخَبَرِ الَّذِي رُوِيَ
«أَنَّ مَنْ كَانَ بِالرَّهْنِ أَوْثَقَ مِنْهُ بِأَخِيهِ الْمُوْمِنِ فَأَنَا مِنْهُ بَرِيء» فَقَالَ «ذَلِكَ إِذَا ظَهَرَ الْحَقُّ وَ قَامَ قَائِمُنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ
» قُلْتُ فَالْخَبَرُ الَّذِي رُوِيّ «أَنّ رِبْحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ رِبًا مَا هُوَ» قَالَ «ذَاكَ إِذَا ظَهَرَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَ قَامَ قَائِمُنَا أَهْلَ
اَلْبَيْتِ وَ أَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَلا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَبِيعَ مِنَ الْأَخِ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَ يَرْبَحَ عَلَيْهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON PLEDGING (RAHN)
text_en:
Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who reported from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who pledges his bondwoman (as collateral). Is it
permissible for him to have intercourse with her?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Those who have taken her as collateral (the creditors) prevent him
from having access to her."
I then asked: "What if he manages to be with her privately without the knowledge of
those who took her as collateral?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, I do not see any harm in this."

Scholar's Note:
Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, said:

text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْعَلاءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَرْهَنُ جَارِيَتَهُ أ
يَجِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَطَأْهَا قَالَ «إِنَّ آلَّذِينَ اِرْتَهَنُوهَا يَحُولُونَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَهَا» قُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ إنْ قَدَرَ عَلَيْهَا خَالِياً وَ لَمْ يَعْلَمِ
الَّذِينَ اِرْتَهَنُوهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ لاَ أَرَى بِهَذَا بَأْساً».

text_chunk:
Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who reported from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who pledges his bondwoman (as collateral). Is it
permissible for him to have intercourse with her?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Those who have taken her as collateral (the creditors) prevent him
from having access to her."
I then asked: "What if he manages to be with her privately without the knowledge of
those who took her as collateral?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, I do not see any harm in this." Scholar's Note:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurara, from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, that he said:
"Regarding the hunting of a dog, if its owner releases it and pronounces the name of
Allah {SWT}, then he may eat whatever it catches for him, even if it kills. And if it eats from
it, then eat what remains.
If the dog is not trained, but the owner trains it at the moment he releases it, he may
eat from it, for it is considered trained.
However, apart from dogs, such as animals hunted by cheetahs, falcons, and similar
creatures, do not eat from their catch you reach it and perform the proper slaughtering
(dhabh). This is because Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Mukallibeen' (those
who train hunting dogs)
Thus, apart from dogs, their catch is not lawful to eat unless you reach it and slaughter
it properly."
text_ar:
بَابُ الصَّيْدِ وَ الذَّبَائِحِ
قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَك وَ تَعَالَى • يَسْتَلُونَك ماذا أُجِلٌ لَهُمْ قُلْ أُجِلَ لَكُمُ الطَّيّباتُ وَ ما عَلَمْثُمْ مِنَ الْجَوارِحِ مُكَلَّبِينَ تُعَلَّمُونَهُنَ مِمَا
عَلَّمَكُمُ اللَّهُ فَكُلُوا مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ اذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
وَ رَوَى مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : «فِي صَيْدِ الْكَلْبِ إِنْ أَرْسَلَهُ
صَاحِبُهُ وَ سَمَّى فَلْيَأْكُلْ كُلَّ مَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ قَتَلَ وَ إِنْ أَكَلَ فَكُلْ مَا بَقِيَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ غَيْرَ مُعَلَّمٍ فَعَلَمَهُ سَاعَتَهُ
جِينَ يُرْسِلُهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ مُعَلَّمٌ فَأَمَّا مَا خَلاَ الْكِلاَبَ مِمَّا تَصِيدُهُ الْفُهُودُ وَ الصُّقُورُ وَ أَشبَاهُهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ مِنْ
صَيْدِهِ إِلَّ مَا أَدْرَكْتَ ذَكَاتَهُ، لِأَنّ اللّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ قَالَ «مُكَلَّبِينَ» فَمَا خَلا الْكِلابَ فَلَيْسَ صَيْدُهُ بِالَّذِي يُوْكَلُ إِلاَّ أَنْ
تُدْرِكَ ذَكَاتَهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And in another narration, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Eat whatever the dog has eaten from, even if it has eaten two-thirds of it. Eat whatever
the dog has eaten, even if nothing remains of it except a single piece."
text_ar:
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «كُلْ مَا أَكَلَ مِنْهُ الْكَلْبُ وَ إِنْ أَكَلَ مِنْهُ ثُلْثَيْهِ كُلْ مَا أَكَلَ الْكَلْبُ
وَ إنْ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ بَضْعَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Hisham bin Salim narrated from Sulaiman bin Khalid, who said:
"I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a Magian's dog that is taken by a Muslim man, and he
pronounces the name of Allah {SWT} when releasing it. Should he eat what the dog
catches for him?"
Imam {a.s} said: 'Yes, because it is trained and the name of Allah {SWT} has been
mentioned upon it.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ كَلْبِ ٱلْمَجُوسِيِّ
يَأْخَذُهُ الرَّجُلُ الْمُسْلِمُ فَيُسَمِّي جِينَ يُرْسِلُهُ أَيَأْكُلُ مَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ لِأَنَّهُ مُكَلَّبٌ وَ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.208 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.315 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.30 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.70 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.159 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.360 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.62 p.264

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Nadr bin Suwayd narrated from Al-Qasim bin Sulaiman, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a dog that escaped and was not released by its owner,
yet it hunted and its owner found it after it had killed the prey. Should he eat from it?
Imam {a.s} said: 'No. If it hunted while the owner had pronounced the name of Allah {SWT},
then he may eat from it.
But if it hunted without the name of Allah {SWT} being mentioned, then he should not eat
from it. And this is from what Allah {SWT} has said:
"Of what you have trained among hunting animals, teaching them as Allah {SWT} has
taught you" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:4)
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى النَّضْرُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ عَنْ كَلْبِ أَفْلَتَ وَ
لَمْ يُرْسِلْهُ صَاحِبُهُ فَصَادَ فَأَدْرَكَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَ قَدْ قَتَلَهُ أَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ «لا إِذَا صَادَ وَ قَدْ سَمَّى فَلْيَأْكُلْ وَ إِذَا صَادَ وَ
لَمْ يُسَمَّ فَلا يَأْكُلْ وَ هَوَ مِمَّا ٢ عَلَمْتُمْ مِنَ الْجَوْارِحِ مُكَلَّبِينَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.205 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.316 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.25 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.147 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.592 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.4 p.40

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Musa bin Bakr narrated from Zurara, who reported from Abu Abdullah Imam
Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"If a man sends his hunting dog and forgets to mention the name of Allah {SWT}, it is like
one who slaughters an animal and forgets to mention the name of Allah {SWT}.
The same applies if he shoots (an arrow) and forgets to mention the name of Allah {SWT}."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «إِذَا أَرْسَلَ الرَجُلُ كَلْبَهُ وَ نَسِيَ أَنْ
يُسَمِّيَ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ قَدْ ذَبَحَ وَ نَسِيَ أَنْ يُسَمَّيَ وَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا رَمَى وَ نَسِيَ أَنْ يُسَمِّيَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.206 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.316 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.25 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.148 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.357 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.590

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And the ruling regarding that, as mentioned in another narration, is:
"He should mention the name of Allah {SWT} at the time of eating."
text_ar: - وَحُكْمُ ذَلِكَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ «أَنْ يُسَمَّيَ جينَ يَأْكُلُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.316

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Hammad ibn Isa narrated from Hariz who said:
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, was asked about an animal shot with an arrow, and its owner finds
it the next day. Should he eat from it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he knows that his shot is what killed it, then he may eat it, provided
that he had mentioned the name of Allah {SWT} (at the time of shooting)."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ قَالَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّمِيَّةِ يَجِدُهَا صَاحِبُهَا مِنَ
اَلْغَدِ أَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ رَمْيَتَهُ هِيَ قَتَلَتْهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْ وَ ذَلِكَ إِذَا كَانَ قَدْ سَمَّى».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.210 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.316 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.34 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.162 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.365

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Aban narrated from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah who said:
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "Whatever is caught by a snare and has part of it severed, then
it is considered dead. However, if you find the rest of its body alive, then perform the
proper slaughtering (Zabiha) and eat from it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «مَا أَخَذَتِ الْحِبَالَةُ وَ
قَطَعَتْ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ مَيْتَةٌ وَ مَا أَدْرَكْتَ مِنْ سَائِرٍ جَسَدِهِ حَيّاً فَذَكَهِ ثُمَّ كُلْ مِنْهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Isa al-Qummi who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}: "I shoot an arrow, but I do not know whether I mentioned the
name of Allah {SWT} (Bismillah) or not."
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat, and there is no problem."
I said: "I shoot, and it disappears from my sight, then I find my arrow in it."
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat as long as nothing has been eaten from it. But if something has
been eaten from it, then do not eat it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانْ بْنْ عُثِمَانَ عَنْ عِيسَى الْقُمِّيَّ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَرْمِي بِسَهُمِ فَلا أَدْرِي أَ
سَمِّيْتُ أَمْ لَمْ أُسَمٌ فَقَالَ «كُل وَ لا بَأْسَ» فَقُلْتُ أَرمِي فَيَغِيبُ عَنَّي فَأَجِدُ سَهْمِي فِيهِ فَقَالَ «كُلْ مَا لَمْ يُوْكَلْ مِنَهُ
وَ إِنْ أَكِلَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ» مِنْهُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.210 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.317 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.33 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.163

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi asked Imam {a.s} about hunting when a man
strikes the prey with his sword, pierces it with his spear, or shoots it with his arrow,
and he had mentioned the name of Allah {SWT} (Bismillah) at the time of doing so.
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat it, and there is no problem with it."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيُّ : عَنِ الصَّيْدِ يَضْرِبُهُ الرَّجُلُ بِالسِّيْفِ أَوْ يَطْعُنُهُ بِرُمْحِهِ أَوْ يَرْمِيهِ بِسَهْمِهِ
فَيَقْتُلُهُ وَ قَدْ سَمَّى حِينَ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «كُلْهُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.317 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.453
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi asked Imam {a.s} about hunting when a man
strikes the prey with his sword, pierces it with his spear, or shoots it with his arrow,
and he had mentioned the name of Allah {SWT} (Bismillah) at the time of doing so.
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat it, and there is no problem with it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Ibn Muskan narrated from al-Halabi who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a man who shoots an arrow at a game animal, and it
strikes it sideways and kills it. He had mentioned the name of Allah {SWT} (Bismillah)
when he shot the arrow, but the arrowhead did not wound it.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the arrow that struck it is what killed it, then when he finds it, let him
eat it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الصَّيْدِ يَرْمِيهِ الرَّجُلُ بِسَهْمِ
فَيُصِيبُهُ مُعْتَرِضاً فَيَقْثُلُهُ وَ قَدْ سَمَّى عَلَيْهِ جِينَ رَمَى وَ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ الْحَدِيدَةُ فَقَالَ «إنْ كَانَ ٱلسَّهْمُ الَّذِي أَصَابَهُ هُوَ
قَتَلَهُ فَإِذَا رَآهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Zurara heard Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, saying:
"There is no harm in what the 'mi'raad' (a hunting tool) kills, as long as it is specifically
made for that purpose."
text_ar: - وَ سَمِعَ زُرَارَةُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ : «فِيمَا قَتَلَ ٱلْمِعْرَاضُ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ إِذَا كَانَ إِنَّمَا يُصْنَعُ لِذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.167 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.372

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
In a narration from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
Imam {a.s} was asked about what the 'mi'raad' (a hunting tool) strikes down from game.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he has no other arrows except the 'Mi'rad' and mentioned the name
of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, over it, then he may eat from what it killed.
However, if he had other arrows besides it, then he should not."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُيِلَ عَمَّا صَرَعَ ٱلْمِعْرَاضُ مِنَ الصَّيْدِ
فَقَالَ «إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ نَبْلٌ غَيْرُ الْمِعْرَاضِ وَ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَيْهِ فَلْيَأْكُلْ مِمَّا قَتَلَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ نَبْلٌ غَيْرُهُ
فلاً».

chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, used to say:
"If that is his weapon which he uses to hunt with, then there is no harm."

cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.318

And in another report: "If that is his shooting instrument, then there is no

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And it was narrated:
"If it pierced, it may be eaten, but if it did not pierce, it may not be eaten."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ : «أَنَّهُ إِنْ خَرَقَ أَكِلَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَخْرِقُ لَمْ يُؤْكَلْ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said regarding a man who has arrows without iron
tips, and they are entirely wooden. If he shoots with the wooden arrow and strikes the
bird in the middle while it is flying and kills it, and he mentions the name of Allah {SWT}
upon it, even if no blood comes out, and these are known arrows, then he may eat from
it if he has mentioned the name of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «فِي رَجُلٍ لَهُ نِبَالْ لَيْسَ فِيهَا حَدِيدٌ وَ هِيَ عِيدَانْ كُلُهَا فَيَرْمِي بِالْعُودِ فَيُصِيبُ
وَسَطَ الطَّيْرِ مُعْتَرِضاً فَيَقْتُلُهُ وَ يَذْكُرُ اِسْمَ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَخْرُجْ دَمْ وَ هِيَ نِبَالَةٌ مَعْلُومَةٌ فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَ
اسمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.318 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.169 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.373

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Hammad ibn Uthman narrated from Al-Halabi, and Hammad ibn Isa narrated
from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, that he was asked about killing an animal with a
stone or a bullet (projectile).
Imam {a.s} said: "No, it should not be eaten."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمَادُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ وَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ
عَنْ قَثْلِ الْحَجَرِ وَ الْبُنْدُقِ أَيُوْكَلُ فَقَالَ «لا)».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} said regarding a hunted animal that was found
with an arrow in it and was dead, but it was not known who killed it.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not eat it."
And Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever wounds an animal with a weapon and mentions the
name of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, upon it, and then the game remains for a
night or two, and he finds it without a predator having eaten from it, and he knows that
his weapon killed it, then he may eat from it, if Allah {SWT} wills."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي صَيْدٍ وُجِدَ فِيهِ سَهَمْ وَ هُوَ مَيَّتْ لاَ يُدْرَى مَنْ قَتَلَهُ فَقَالَ «لا
تَظعَمُوهُ» وَ قَالَ «مَنْ جَرَحَ بِسِلاَحِ وَ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ ثُمْ بَقِيَ الصَّيْدُ لَيْلَةً أَوْ لَيْلَتَيْنِ ثُمّ وَجَدَهُ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ
مِنْهُ سَبُعٌ وَ عَلِمَ أَنَّ سِلاَحَهُ قَتَلَهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.319

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said regarding a deer that a man hunted, and people started cutting
it up while the one who hunted it was trying to prevent them.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no prohibition in it, and there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ : فِي إِيَلِ اِصْطَادَهُ رَجُلٌ فَيُقَطَّعُهُ النَّاسُ وَ الَّذِي اِصْطَادَهُ يَمْنَعُهُ فَفِيهِ نَهْيّ فَقَالَ «وَ
لَيْسَ فِيهِ نَهِيّ وَ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسِّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V.3 p.319 • Al-Wafi, V.19 p.162 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, V.23 p.365

Imam {a.s} said: "There is no prohibition in it, and there is no harm in it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Aban narrated from Muhammad Al-Halabi who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about
a man who shoots at game and brings it down, then the people rush to it and cut it up.
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ : سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَرْمِي الصِّيْدَ فَيَصْرَعُهُ فَيَبْتَدِرُهُ ٱلْقَوْمُ فَيُقَطَّعُونَهُ
فَقَالَ «كُلْهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.211 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.165 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.364

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih narrated from Aban ibn Taghlib who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} saying: "My father {a.s} used to issue legal rulings during the time
of Banu Umayyah that what was killed by the hawk and the falcon was lawful, and he
would do so out of precaution (Taqiyyah) from them.
But I do not fear them, and what is killed by the hawk and the falcon is unlawful."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ صَالِحِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ يَقُولُ : «كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ يُفْتِي فِي زَمَنِ بَنِي أمَيَّةَ «أَنَّ مَا قَتَلَ الْبَازُ وَ الصَّقْرُ فَهُوَ حَلال» وَ كَانَ يَتَّقِيهِمْ وَ أَنَا لاَ أَتَّقِيهِمْ وَ هُوَ حَرَامْ
مَا قَتَلَ الْبَازُ وَ الصَّقْرُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.208 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.320 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.32 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.72 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.155 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.352

But I do not fear them, and what is killed by the hawk and the falcon is unlawful."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdillah {a.s} that Imam {a.s} said:
"If you release a hawk, a falcon, or an eagle and it kills, do not eat it until you properly
slaughter it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : «إِنْ أَرْسَلْتَ بَازاً أَوْ صَقْراً أَوْ عُقَاباً فَقَتَلَ فَلا
تَأْكُلْ حَتَّى تُذَكِّيَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.207 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.153 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.2 p.11 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.350

Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdillah {a.s} that Imam {a.s} said:
"If you release a hawk, a falcon, or an eagle and it kills, do not eat it until you properly

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: "If you send your hunting dog after a game and you catch up
with it but do not have a blade to slaughter it with, then let the dog kill it, and you may
eat from it."

Scholar's Note:
If you send your dog after game and another dog joins it, do not eat from it unless you
are able to slaughter it properly.
If you shoot at it while it is on a mountain and it falls and dies, then do not eat it.
If you shoot it and your arrow strikes it, and it falls into water and dies, then eat it if its
head remains out of the water; but if its head is in the water, then do not eat it.
As for a bird, if someone captures it by holding its wings, it belongs to the one who
caught it unless the owner is known, in which case it should be returned to him.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِنْ أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ عَلَى صَيْدِ فَأَدْرَكْتَهُ وَ لَمْ تَكُنْ مَعَكَ حَدِيدَةٌ تَذْبَحُهُ بِهَا قَدَعِ ٱلْكَلْبَ
يَقْثُلَهُ ثُمَّ كُلْ مِنْهُ».
فَإِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ عَلَى صَيْدٍ وَ شَارَكَهُ كَلْبٌ آخَرُ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ إِلَّا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ ذَكَاتَهُ وَ إِنْ رَمَيْتَهُ وَ هُوَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ فَسَقَطَ وَ مَاتَ
فَلَا تَأْكُلْهُ وَ إِنْ رَمَيْتَهُ فَأَصَابَهُ سَهْمُكَ وَ وَقَعَ فِي الْمَاءِ فَمَاتَ فَكُلْهُ إِذَا كَانَ رَأْسُهُ خَارِجاً مِنَ الْمَاءِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ رَأْسُهُ فِي الْمَاءِ فَلَا
تَأكُلْهُ وَ الطَّيْرُ إِذَا مَلَكَ جَنَاحَيْهِ فَهُوَ لِمَنْ أَخَذَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يَعْرِفَ صَاحِبَهُ فَيَرُدُّهُ عَلَيْهِ.
commentary:
If you send your dog after game and another dog joins it, do not eat from it unless you
are able to slaughter it properly.
If you shoot at it while it is on a mountain and it falls and dies, then do not eat it.
If you shoot it and your arrow strikes it, and it falls into water and dies, then eat it if its
head remains out of the water; but if its head is in the water, then do not eat it.
As for a bird, if someone captures it by holding its wings, it belongs to the one who
caught it unless the owner is known, in which case it should be returned to him.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V.3 p.320 • Al-Wafi, V.19 p.148 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.348

If you shoot at it while it is on a mountain and it falls and dies, then do not eat it.
If you shoot it and your arrow strikes it, and it falls into water and dies, then eat it if its
head remains out of the water; but if its head is in the water, then do not eat it.
As for a bird, if someone captures it by holding its wings, it belongs to the one who
caught it unless the owner is known, in which case it should be returned to him.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} forbade hunting pigeons in cities.

Scholar's Note:
It is not permissible to take chicks from their nests in a mountain, a well, or a thicket
until they are able to fly.
text_ar:
وَ نَهَى أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْحَمَامِ بِالْأَمْصَارِ.
وَ لَا يَجُوزُ أَخْذُ الْفِرَاخِ مِنْ أَوْكَارِهَا فِي جَبَلٍ أَوْ بِئُرِ أَوْ أَجَمَةٍ حَتَّى يَنْهَضَ.
commentary:
It is not permissible to take chicks from their nests in a mountain, a well, or a thicket
until they are able to fly.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.199 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.389

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ali ibn Ri’ab, from Zurara ibn Ayan, that he said:
By Allah {SWT}, I have never seen anyone like Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s}.
I asked him and said: "May Allah {SWT} rectify your affairs, what birds are permissible to
eat?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat whatever flaps its wings, and do not eat what glides."
I said: "What about eggs found in thickets?"
Imam {a.s} said: "If both ends are equal, then do not eat it, but if the two ends are
different, then eat it."
I asked: "What about water birds?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat whatever has a crop, and do not eat what does not have a crop."
In another narration, Imam {a.s} said: "If the bird glides and flaps, but its flapping is more
than its gliding, then it may be eaten; but if its gliding is more than its flapping, then it
should not be eaten. From water birds, what has a crop or a spur may be eaten, and
what lacks them should not be eaten."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: وَ اللّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ مِثْلَ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَطْ سَأَلْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ مَا يُوكَلُ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ فَقَالَ «كُلْ مَا دَفَّ وَ لا تَأْكُلْ مَا صَفَّ) قَالَ قُلْتُ ٱلْبَيْضُ
فِي اَلْآجَامِ قَالَ «كُلُّ مَا اِسْتَوَى طَرَفَاهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ وَ كُلُّ مَا اِخْتَلَفَ طَرَفَاهُ فَكُلْ» قُلْتُ فَطَيْرُ الْمَاءِ قَالَ «كُلُّ مَا كَانَتْ
لَهُ قَانِصَةٌ فَكُلْ وَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ قَانِصَةٌ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ ». وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ: «إِنْ كَانَ ٱلطَّيْرُ يَصُفُ وَ يَدُفٌّ فَكَانَ دَفِيفُهُ
أَكْتَرَ مِنْ صَفِيفِهِ أُكِلَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ صَفِيفُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ دَفِيفِهِ فَلَمْ يُوْكَلْ وَ يُوكَلُ مِنْ طَيْرِ الْمَاءِ مَا كَانَثْ لَهُ قَانِصَةً أَوْ
صِيصِيَةٌ وَلا يُؤْكَلُ مَا لَيْسَتْ لَهُ قَانِصَةٌ أَوْ صِيصِيَةٌ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)
said: "Every predatory animal with fangs and every bird with talons is unlawful."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «كُلُّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَ مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطِّيْرِ حَرَامٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.244 • Da’a’im Al-Islam, Vol.2 p.123 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.322 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.38 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.55 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.113 • Al-Fusul Al- Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.426 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.62 p.185 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.775 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.16 p.173

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Harith who said: I asked
Abu al-Hasan {a.s} about water birds that eat fish, whether they are permissible to eat.
He {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it, eat them."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ طَيْرِ ٱلْمَاءِ مِمَّا
يَأُكُلُ السَّمَكَ مِنْهُ يَحِلُّ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ كُلْهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.322 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.17 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.59 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.158

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Kirdin al-Mismai asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the bustard bird.
Imam {a.s} said: "I wish I had some of it so that I could eat until I am full."
text_ar: - وَسَأَلَ كِزْدِينُ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ : عَنِ الْحُبَارَى فَقَالَ «لَوَدِدْتُ أَنّ عِنْدِي مِنْهُ فَاكُلُ حَثَّى أَمْتَلِى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.322
text_chunk:
Kirdin al-Mismai asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the bustard bird.
Imam {a.s} said: "I wish I had some of it so that I could eat until I am full."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Zakariyya ibn Adam asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s} about water birds.
Imam {a.s} said: "If they pick up things other than filth, then there is no harm in eating
them."
text_ar: - وَ سَأَلَ زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ آدَمَ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَ : عَنْ دَجَاجِ ٱلْمَاءِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ يَلْتَقِطُ غَيْرَ ٱلْعَذِرَةِ فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.322 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.165
text_chunk:

Imam {a.s} said: "If they pick up things other than filth, then there is no harm in eating
them."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the eggs of water birds.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whatever resembles the eggs of chickens in shape, then eat it."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : عَنْ بَيْضِ طَيْرِ ٱلْمَاءِ فَقَالَ «مَا كَانَ مِنْهُ مِثلَ بَيْضِ
الدَّجَاجٍ يَعْنِي عَلَى خِلْقَتِهِ فَكُلْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.322 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.73
text_chunk:
Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the eggs of water birds.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whatever resembles the eggs of chickens in shape, then eat it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Eat from the fish that has scales, and do not eat from it that which has no scales."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «كُلْ مِنَ السَّمَكِ مَا كَانَ لَهُ فُلُوسٌ وَ لاَ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ مَا لَيْسَ لَهُ فَلْسٌ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.323 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.40 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.129 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.428

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Eat from the fish that has scales, and do not eat from it that which has no scales."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Hammad narrated from Abu Ayyub that he asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a
man who caught a fish, tied it with a string, and released it into the water, and then it
died.
Imam {a.s} said: "It should not be eaten."
text_ar:
ا . ..ا
وَ رَوَى حَمَّادٌ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلِ اِصْطَادَ سَمَكَةً فَرَبَطَهَا بِخَيْطِ
وَ أَرْسَلَهَا فِي الْمَاءِ فَمَاتَتْ أَثُوْكَلُ قَالَ «لا».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Abd al-Rahman ibn Sayabah asked him about fish that are caught, placed in
something, and then returned to the water where they die.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not eat it, because it died in what is its source of life."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَيَابَةَ : عَنِ السَّمَكِ يُصَادُ ثُمَّ يُجْعَلُ فِي شَيْءٍ ثُمَّ يُعَادُ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمُوتُ فِيهِ
فَقَالَ «لا تَأْكُلْ لِأَنَّهُ مَاتَ فِي الَّذِي فِيهِ حَيَاتُهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.323

Imam {a.s} said: "Do not eat it, because it died in what is its source of life."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Aban narrated from Zurara who said: I asked him about a fish that leaps out
of the water, falls onto dry land, and struggles until it dies.
I said: "Can I eat it?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانْ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ سَمَكَةٌ اِرْتَفَعَتْ فَوَقَعَتْ عَلَى الْجَدَدِ فَاضْطَرَبَثْ حَتَّى مَاتَثْ آكُلُهَا
قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.323 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.82

I said: "Can I eat it?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Qasim ibn Burayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, regarding a man who sets up a net in the water,
then returns to his house and leaves it set up.
Later, he comes back and finds that fish have been caught in it and have died.
Imam {a.s} said: "What his hand has done is permissible, so there is no harm in eating
what was caught in it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ بُرَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ نَصَبَ شَبَكَةً فِي الْمَاءِ
ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ وَ تَرَكَهَا مَنْصُوبَةً ثُمَّ أَنَاهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ قَدْ وَقَعَ فِيهَا سَمَكٌ فَمُوِّثْنَ فَقَالَ «مَا عَمِلَتْ يَدُهُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ
بِأكْلٍ مَا وَقَعَ فِيهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.217 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.323 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.11 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.61 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.189 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.83 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.62 p.209

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about fish caught by the
Magians.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it; the catching of fish is merely taking them."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ أَبُو الصَّبَّاحِ الْكِنَانِيُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ : عَنِ الْحِيتَانِ يَصِيدُهَا الْمَجْوسُ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهَا
إِنَّمَا صَيْدُ الْحِيتَانِ أَخْذُهَا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.324
text_chunk:
Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about fish caught by the
Magians.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it; the catching of fish is merely taking them."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
In the narration of Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, Imam {a.s} said:
"There is no harm in pickled foods of the Magians, and there is no harm in their
catching of fish."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «لَا بَأْسَ بِكَوَامِيخِ ٱلْمَجُوسِ وَ لا بَأْسَ
بِصَيْدِهِمُ السِّمَكَ».
cross_references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.454 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.324 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.11 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.64 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.192 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.77 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.209 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.62 p.206 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.77 p.45

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
He said: I asked him about an enclosure made of reeds placed in the water
for fish, and the fish enter it, and some of them die inside it.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
text_ar:
قَالَ : وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْحَظِيرَةِ مِنَ الْقَصَبِ تُجْعَلُ لِلْحِيتَانِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَدْخُلْهَا الْحِيتَانُ فَيَمُوتُ بَعْضُهَا فِيهَا
قَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.324 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.85
text_chunk:
He said: I asked him about an enclosure made of reeds placed in the water
for fish, and the fish enter it, and some of them die inside it.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Halabi asked him about catching fish without mentioning the name of
Allah {SWT} over it.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
text_ar: - وَ سَألَهُ اَلْحَلَبِي : عَنْ صَيْدِ الْجِيتَانِ وَ إنْ لَمْ يُسَمَّ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.216 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.324 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.8 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.185 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.385 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.73
text_chunk:
Al-Halabi asked him about catching fish without mentioning the name of
Allah {SWT} over it.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Do not eat the catfish, nor the eel, nor the zabir, nor the tafiy, which is that which dies
in the water and floats on the surface of the water."

Scholar's Note:
And if you find fish and do not know whether it has been properly slaughtered or not,
and its proper slaughtering is that it is taken out of the water alive, then take it and
throw it into the water. If it floats on the water lying on its back, then it is not properly
slaughtered; but if it is on its front, then it is properly slaughtered. Similarly, if you find
meat and do not know whether it is properly slaughtered or is carrion, then throw a
piece of it onto fire. If it contracts, then it is properly slaughtered; but if it loosens on
the fire, then it is carrion.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «لاَ تَأْكُلِ الْجِرِّيَّ وَ لاَ ٱلْمَارْمَاهِيَ وَ لاَ ٱلزَّمَّيرَ وَ لاَ الطَّافِيَ وَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَمُوتُ
فِي الْمَاءٍ فَيَطْفُو عَلَى رَأْسِ الْمَاءِ».
وَ إِنْ وَجَدْتَ سَمَكاً وَ لَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَذَكِيٌّ هُوَ أَوْ غَيْرُ ذَكِيَ وَ ذَكَاتُهُ أَنْ يُخْرَجَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ حَيّاً فَخُذْ مِنْهُ فَاطْرَحْهُ فِي الْمَاءِ فَإِنْ طَفَا
عَلَى الْمَاءِ مُسْتَلْقِياً عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ فَهُوَ غَيْرُ ذَكِيِّ وَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَهُوَ ذَكِيٍّ وَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا وَجَدْتَ لَحْما وَ لَا تَعْلَمُ أَذَكِيٌّ هُوَ أَمْ
مَيْتَةٌ فَأَلْقٍ مِنْهُ قِطْعَةً عَلَى النَّارِ فَإِنْ تَقَبَّضَ فَهُوَ ذَكِيٌ وَ إِنِ اسْتَرْخَى عَلَى النَّارِ فَهُوَ مَيْتَةً
commentary:
And if you find fish and do not know whether it has been properly slaughtered or not,
and its proper slaughtering is that it is taken out of the water alive, then take it and
throw it into the water. If it floats on the water lying on its back, then it is not properly
slaughtered; but if it is on its front, then it is properly slaughtered. Similarly, if you find
meat and do not know whether it is properly slaughtered or is carrion, then throw a
piece of it onto fire. If it contracts, then it is properly slaughtered; but if it loosens on
the fire, then it is carrion.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.325 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.132

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
It has been narrated: "If someone finds a fish and does not know whether it
is permissible to eat or not, then its tail should be split at the base. If the color turns
green, it is not permissible to eat; but if it turns red, then it is permissible to eat.
And if a snake swallows a fish and then spits it out while it is still alive and wriggling, if
its scales have peeled off, it should not be eaten; but if its scales have not peeled off,
it may be eaten."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ : «فِيمَنْ وَجَدَ سَمَكاً وَ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ مِمَّا يُؤْكَلُ أَوْ لا فَإِنَّهُ يُشَقُّ أَصْلُ ذَنَبِهِ فَإِنْ ضَرَبَ إِلَى الْخُضْرَةِ
فَهُوَ مِمَّا لا يُوْكَلُ وَ إِنْ ضَرَبَ إِلَى الْحُمْرَةِ فَهُوَ مِمَّا يُوكَلُ وَ إِنِ اِبْتَلَعَتْ حَيَّةٌ سَمَكَةً ثُمَّ رَمَثْ بِهَا وَ هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَصْطَرِبُ
فَإِنْ كَانَ فُلُوسُهَا قَدْ تَسَلَّخَثْ لَمْ تُؤْكَلْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فُلُوسُهَا تَسَلَّخَثْ أُكِلَتْ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.325

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who said: I
asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}) about using a flint, a reed, or
a piece of wood to slaughter an animal if one does not have a knife.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it cuts the veins, then there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
[ما تذكّى به الذّبيحة]
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أُبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ ٱلْمَرْوَةِ
وَ اَلْقَصَبَةِ وَ الْعُودِ يَذْبَحُ بِهِنَّ الْإِنْسَانُ إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ سِكِّيناً فَقَالَ «إِذَا فَرَى ٱلْأَوْدَاجَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.228 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.326 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.52 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.80 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.208 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.8 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.62 p.306

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Ibn al-Mughira narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, that
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in eating what is slaughtered with a stone if no iron is
available."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تَأْكُلَ مَا
ذُبِحَ بِحَجَرٍ إِذَا لَمْ تَجِدْ حَدِيدَةً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.209 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.9

Ibn al-Mughira narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, that
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in eating what is slaughtered with a stone if no iron is
available."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Fadl and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah narrated from Abu Abdillah {a.s}
that he said: "A group of people came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon
him and his family) and said to him: 'A cow of ours overpowered us and became
difficult to handle, so we struck it with a sword.'
Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) instructed them to eat it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْفَضْلُ وَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : «إِنَّ قَوْماً أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ
صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالُوا لَهُ إِنَّ بَقَرَةً لَنَا غَلَبَثْنَا وَ اِسْتَصْعَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا فَضَرَبْنَاهَا بِالسَّيْفِ فَأَمَرَهُمْ بِأَكْلِهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.231 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.54 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.218 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.20

Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) instructed them to eat it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Al-Is ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
who said: "A bull in Kufa became wild, and the people attacked it with their swords and
struck it. They then came to Commander of the Faithful {a.s} and asked him about it.
Imam {a.s} said: 'It is a valid slaughtering, and its meat is lawful.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ ٱلْعِيصِ بْنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ : «إِنَّ ثَوْراً ثَارَ بِالْكُوفَةِ
فَثَارَ إِلَيْهِ النَّاسُ بِأَسْيَافِهِمْ فَضَرَبُوهُ وَ أَنَوْا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَسَأَلُوهُ فَقَالَ «ذَكَاةٌ وَحِيَّةٌ وَ لَحْمُهُ حَلاَلٌ»».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Aban narrated from Zurara, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s}, who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a camel that fell into a well and was slaughtered
from the side of its tail.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it if they mentioned the name of Allah {SWT} over it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانْ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ بَعِيرٍ تَرَدَّى فِي بِئُرِ فَذُبِحَ مِنْ قِبَلِ
ذَنَّبِهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إِذَا ذَكَرُوا اِسْمَ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.219 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.21

Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it if they mentioned the name of Allah {SWT} over it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Umar ibn Udhaynah narrated from Al-Fudayl who said: I asked Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who was slaughtering an animal,
and the knife moved too quickly and severed the head completely.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is a valid slaughtering, and there is no harm in eating it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عُمَرُ بْنُ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ ذَبَحَ فَسَبَقَهُ السِّكِّينُ فَقَطَعَ
الرّأْسَ فَقَالَ «ذَكَاةٌ وَحِيَّةٌ فَلا بَأْسَ بِأَكْلِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.230 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.55 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.214 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.17

Imam {a.s} said: "It is a valid slaughtering, and there is no harm in eating it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
In the narration of Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, he said: "If the blood flows, then eat."
text_ar: - وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «إِنْ خَرَجَ الدَّمُ فَكُلْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327
text_chunk:
In the narration of Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, he said: "If the blood flows, then eat."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
In the narration of Samaah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, Imam {a.s} said: "There is no
harm in it if the blood flows."
text_ar: - وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ إِذَا سَالَ الدَّمُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327
text_chunk:
In the narration of Samaah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, Imam {a.s} said: "There is no
harm in it if the blood flows."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Abu Basir asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a sheep that is slaughtered but does
not move, yet a lot of fresh blood flows from it.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not eat it. Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} used to say: 'If the leg
kicks or the eye blinks, then eat it.'"
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : عَنِ الشَّاةِ تُذْبَحُ فَلا تَتَحَرَّكُ وَ يُهَرَاقُ مِنْهَا دَمْ كَثِيرٌ عَبِيطٌ
فَقَالَ «لا تَأْكُلْ إِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «إِذَا رَكَضَتِ ٱلرِّجْلُ أَوْ طَرَفَتِ ٱلْعَيْنُ فَكُلْ» ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.327

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, that he was asked
about a man who slaughtered a bird and severed its head.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it may be eaten, but he should not deliberately cut off its head."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمَادٌ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ ذَبَحَ طَيْراً فَقَطَعَ رَأْسَهُ أ
يُؤْكَلُ مِنْهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ لاَ يَتَعَمَّدْ قَطْعَ رَأْسِهِ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.328 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.320 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.459 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.215 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.18 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.62 p.321
text_chunk:
Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, that he was asked

Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it may be eaten, but he should not deliberately cut off its head."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
"Do not eat from what has been killed by a predator, nor from that which has been
beaten to death, strangled, fallen from a height, or gored, unless you find it alive and
slaughter it properly."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «لا تَأْكُلَنَّ مِنْ فَرِيسَةِ السَّبْعِ
وَ لاَ ٱلْمَوْقُوذَةِ وَ لا الْمُنْخَنِقَةِ وَ لا الْمُتَرَدِّيَةِ وَ لا النَّطِيحَةِ إِلَّ أَنْ تُدْرِكَهُ حَيّاً فَتُذَكِّيَهُ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.328 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.59 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.235 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.37 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.585
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
"Do not eat from what has been killed by a predator, nor from that which has been
beaten to death, strangled, fallen from a height, or gored, unless you find it alive and
slaughter it properly."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Aban narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, that he said regarding an animal that is slaughtered
and has a fetus in its womb: "If it is fully formed, then eat it, for its slaughtering is the
slaughtering of its mother. But if it is not fully formed, then do not eat it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : فِي الذَّبِيحَةِ تُذْبَحُ وَ فِي بَطْنِهَا
وَلَدٌ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ تَامَاً فَكُلْهُ فَإِنَّ ذَكَاتَهُ ذَكَاةُ أُمِّهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ تَامَاً فَلا تَأْكُلْهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.328 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.58 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.461 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.233 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.34

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Umar ibn Udhaynah narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the
Imams (peace be upon them), that he said: I asked him about the saying of Allah {SWT},
the Mighty and Majestic: "Lawful to you are the beasts of cattle." (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:1)
Imam {a.s} said: "The fetus, if it has grown hair or fur, its slaughtering is the slaughtering
of its mother."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عُمَرُ بْنُ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ: ) أُجِلَّتْ لَكُمْ بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَامِ ) فَقَالَ «آَلْجَنِينُ إِذَا أَشعَرَ أَوْ أَوْبَرَ فَذَكَاتُهُ ذَكَاةُ أُمَّهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Kahili narrated from Abu Abdillah {a.s} that a man asked him a question
while I was present about cutting the tails of sheep.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in cutting them if you are doing so to improve your
wealth."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, in the book of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, it is written:
'Whatever is cut from a living animal is considered dead and should not be used.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْكَاهِلِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلَهُ رَجُلْ وَ أَنَا عِئْدَهُ عَنْ قَطْعِ أَلَيَاتِ ٱلْغَنَمِ قَالَ «لا
بَأْسَ بِقَطْعِهَا إِذَا كُنْتَ إِنَّمَا تُصْلِحُ بِهِ مَالَكَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ «أَنَّ مَا قُطِعَ مِنْهَا مَيْتُ لا
بُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ» ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.329

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Every animal that should be slaughtered but is instead killed by stabbing is unlawful,
and every animal that should be killed by stabbing but is instead slaughtered is
unlawful."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «كُلُّ مَنحُورٍ مَذْبُوحِ حَرَامٌ وَ كُلّْ مَذْبُوحِ مَنحُورٍ حَرَامٌ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.2 p.503 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.14 p.1157 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.216 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.14 p.154 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.14 • Al- Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.422

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated that Al-Marzuban asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s} about
the slaughtered animal of a child born out of wedlock, and they were certain of his
status.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it, and it is permissible for a woman and a child if
they are in necessity."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ صَفُوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى قَالَ سَأَلَ ٱلْمَرْزَبَانُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ : عَنْ ذَبِيحَةِ وَلَدِ اَلزَّنَا وَ قَدْ
عَرَفْتَاهُ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ وَ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ وَ الصَّبِيُّ إِذَا أُضْطُرُوا إِلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.329

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Halabi asked him about the slaughtered animal of the Murji’ite and the
Haruri.
Imam {a.s} said: "Eat, and be at ease and settled until whatever is to happen occurs."
text_ar: - وَ سَأَلَهُ الْحَلَبِيُّ : عَنْ ذَبِيحَةِ الْمُرْجِي وَ الْحَرُورِيّ قَالَ فَقَالَ «كُلْ وَ قِرَّ وَ اِسْتَقِرَّ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مَا يَكُونُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.236 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.329 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.72 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.88 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.243 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.68

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Do not eat the slaughtered
animal of a Jew, a Christian, a Magian, or anyone who opposes the religion, except if
you hear him mention the name of Allah {SWT} over it."
And in the book of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, it is written: "A Magian, a Christian, or the
Christians of the Arabs should not slaughter the sacrificial animals."
Imam {a.s} also said: "You may eat their slaughtered animal if they mention the name of
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, over it."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: «لا تَأْكُلْ ذَبِيحَةَ ٱلْيَهُودِيِّ وَ النَّصْرَانِيِّ وَ الْمَجُوسِيّ وَ جَمِيعٍ مَنْ خَالَفَ اَلدِّينَ
إلاَّ مَا إِذَا سَمِعْتَهُ يَذْكُرُ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا وَ فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لا يَذْبَحِ الْمَجُوسِيُّ وَ لاَ النَّصْرَانِيُّ وَ لا
نَصَارَى الْعَرَبِ الْأَضَاجِيَّ» » وَ قَالَ «تَأْكُلُ ذَبِيحَتَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.254

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And in the narration of Abdul Malik bin Amr, from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, he said:
"I asked him, 'What do you say about the slaughtered animals of the Christians?'
Imam {a.s} said: ‘There is no harm in them.'
I said: ‘But they mention the name of the Messiah over them.'
Imam {a.s} replied: ‘They only mean Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, by the Messiah.'"
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَمْرِو عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي ذَبَائِحِ النَّصَارَى
فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهَا» قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَذْكُرُونَ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَسِيحَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَرَادُوا بِالْمَسِيحِ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.68 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.85 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.258 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.62

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Abu Bakr al-Hadrami narrated from Al-Ward bin Zaid, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, 'Relate to me a narration and
dictate it to me so that I may write it down.'
Imam {a.s} said: ‘Where is your memory, O people of Kufa?'
I said: ‘So that no one disputes it with me later.'
I then asked: ‘What do you say about a Magian who says 'In the name of Allah {SWT}' and
slaughters an animal?'
Imam {a.s} said: ‘Eat.'
I said: ‘What if a Muslim slaughters but does not mention the name of Allah {SWT}?'
Imam {a.s} replied: ‘Do not eat. Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, says:
'So eat of that upon which the name of Allah {SWT} has been mentioned'
(Surah Al-An'am 6:118)
and He {SWT} also says:
'And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allah {SWT} has not been mentioned.'
(Surah Al-An'am 6:121)'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيْ عَنِ ٱلْوَرْدِ بْنِ رَيْدِ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ حَدِّثْنِي حَدِيثاً وَ أَمْلِ
عَلَيْ حَتَّى أَكْتُبَهُ فَقَالَ «أَيْنَ جِفْظُكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكُوفَةِ » قُلْتُ حَتَّى لا يَرُدْهُ عَلَيْ أَحَدٌ، مَا تَقُولُ فِي مَجُوسِيّ قَالَ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ ذَبَحَ فَقَالَ «كُل» فَقُلْتُ مُسْلِمٌ ذَبَحَ وَ لَمْ يُسَمَّ فَقَالَ «لا تَأْكُلْ إِنَّ اللهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ: ) فَكُلُوا مِمَّا ذُكِرَ
اِسْمُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ ) وَ يَقُولُ • وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اِسْمُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.69 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.85 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.258 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.63 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.761 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.4 p.434

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Al-Husayn Al-Ahmasi narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"It is the (mentioning of) the name, and none is to be trusted with it except a Muslim."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى الْحُسَيْنُ الْأَحْمَسِيُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «هُوَ ٱلاِسْمُ وَ لاَ يُوْمَنُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَ مُسْلِمٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.240 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.66 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.52 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.53 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.59

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Ubayd Allah {SWT} who
said: I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, "We are in the mountains and we send the shepherds
to the sheep. Sometimes a sheep is injured or something happens to it, and they
slaughter it. Can we eat it?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No, for it is a matter of proper slaughtering, and only a Muslim can be
trusted with it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللّهِ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّا نَكُونُ
بِالْجَبَلِ فَنَبْعَثُ الرُّعَاةَ إِلَى الْغَنَمِ فَرُبَّمَا عَطِبَتِ الشَّاةُ وَ أَصَابَهَا شَيْءَ فَذَبَحُوهَا فَنَأْكُلُهَا قَالَ « لا إِنَّمَا هِيَ الذَّبِيحَةُ
فَلاَ يُوْمَنُ عَلَيْهَا إِلاَّ ٱلْمُسْلِمُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.239 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.66 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.83 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.249 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.49

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And it is narrated from Al-Fudayl, Zurara, and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from
Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
They asked Imam {a.s} about buying meat from the markets without knowing what the
butchers do.
Imam {a.s} said: “Eat if it is in the markets of the Muslims, and do not ask about it."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ وَ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُمْ سَأَلُوهُ عَنْ شِرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ
مِنَ الْأَسْوَاقِ وَ لَا يُدْرَى مَا يَصْنَعُ الْقَصَابُونَ فَقَالَ «كُلْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي أَسْوَاقِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ لا تَسْأَلْ عَنْهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.332
text_chunk:
And it is narrated from Al-Fudayl, Zurara, and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from
Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
They asked Imam {a.s} about buying meat from the markets without knowing what the
butchers do.
Imam {a.s} said: “Eat if it is in the markets of the Muslims, and do not ask about it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about an animal that
was slaughtered not facing the Qibla.
Imam {a.s} said: “Eat, there is no harm in that as long as it was not done intentionally."
He further asked Imam {a.s} about a man who slaughtered an animal without
mentioning the name of Allah {SWT}.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he forgot, let him mention the name of Allah {SWT} when he remembers
and say: 'In the name of Allah {SWT}, at its beginning and at its end.'"
text_ar:
[ما ذبح لغير القبلة أو ترك التسمية ]
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : عَنْ ذَبِيحَةٍ ذُبِحَثْ لِغَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ فَقَالَ «كُلْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ
مَا لَمْ يُتَعَمَّد» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ ذَبَحَ وَ لَمْ يُسَمَّ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ نَاسِياً فَلْيُسَمٌ جِينَ يَذْكُرُ يَقُولُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى
أوَّلِهِ وَ عَلَى آخِرِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.233 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.59 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.228

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s}, about a man who slaughtered an animal while saying Subhan Allah {SWT}
(Glory be to Allah {SWT}), or Allahu Akbar (Allah {SWT} is the Greatest), or La Ilaha Illa Allah
(There is no god but Allah {SWT}), or Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah {SWT}).
Imam {a.s} said: “All of these are among the names of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, and there
is no harm in it."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : عَنْ رَجُلٍ ذَبَحَ فَسَبَّحَ أَوْ كَبَّرَ أَوْ هَلَّلَ أَوْ حَمَّدَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَ قَالَ «هَذَا كُلُهُ مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى لاَ بَأُسَ بِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.234 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.333 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.59 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.229 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.2 p.153 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.31 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.763 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.4 p.437

(Glory be to Allah {SWT}), or Allahu Akbar (Allah {SWT} is the Greatest), or La Ilaha Illa Allah

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And in the narration of Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah Imam
Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, it is reported:
Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who slaughters an animal but forgets to mention the
name of Allah {SWT}, can his slaughtered animal be eaten?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, if he is not suspected (of negligence) and is known to perform
slaughtering properly, and if he does not sever the spinal cord or break the neck until
the animal has completely cooled (ceased movement)."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَذْبَحُ فَيَنْسَى أَنْ
يُسَمِّيَ أَتُوْكَلُ ذَبِيحَتُهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَ لاَ يُنَّهَمُ وَ يُحْسِنُ الذَّبْحَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ وَ لا يَنْخَعُ وَ لا يَكْسِرُ الرَّقَبَةَ حَتَّى تَبْرُدَ
الذَّبِيحَةُ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.333 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.29
text_chunk:
And in the narration of Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah Imam
Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, it is reported:
Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who slaughters an animal but forgets to mention the
name of Allah {SWT}, can his slaughtered animal be eaten?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, if he is not suspected (of negligence) and is known to perform
slaughtering properly, and if he does not sever the spinal cord or break the neck until
the animal has completely cooled (ceased movement)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Muhammad Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"Whoever does not mention the name of Allah {SWT} when slaughtering, do not eat (from
it)."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدٌ الْحَلَبِي عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «مَنْ لَمْ يُسَمَّ إِذَا ذَبَحَ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.229 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.30
text_chunk:
And Muhammad Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"Whoever does not mention the name of Allah {SWT} when slaughtering, do not eat (from

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Hammad narrated from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about the slaughtering done by a woman.
Imam {a.s} said: "If they are women and there is no man among them, then the most
knowledgeable one among them should slaughter and mention the name of Allah {SWT}
upon it."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about the slaughtering done by a boy.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he has reached the age where he can move, is five spans tall, and
can handle the knife, then it is permissible."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ آللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ عَنْ ذَبِيحَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَقَالَ
«إِنْ كُنَّ نِسَاءً لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ فَلْتَذْبَخ أَعْلَمُهُنَّ وَ لَتَذْكُرِ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَبِيحَةِ الصِّبِيِّ فَقَالَ «إِذَا
تَحَرَّكَ وَ كَانَ خَمْسَةَ أَشْبَارٍ وَ أَطَاقَ الشَّفْرَةَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.237 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.333 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.73 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.237

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And in the narration of Umar ibn Udhaynah from a group who narrated from
both of the Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them:
"If a woman performs the slaughter properly and mentions the name of Allah {SWT}, then
there is no issue with eating it. Likewise, the boy and the blind person, if they are
guided, may also perform the slaughter."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنْ رَهْطِ رَوَوْهُ عَنْهُمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَلامُ جَمِيعاً : «أَنَّ ذَبِيحَةَ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا أَجَادَتِ
الذَّبْحَ وَ سَمَّتْ فَلا بَأْسَ بِأَكْلِهِ وَ كَذَلِكَ الصَّبِيُّ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْأَعْمَى إِذَا سُدَّدَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.238 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.334 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.73 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.239 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.45 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.47
text_chunk:
And in the narration of Umar ibn Udhaynah from a group who narrated from
both of the Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them:
"If a woman performs the slaughter properly and mentions the name of Allah {SWT}, then
there is no issue with eating it. Likewise, the boy and the blind person, if they are

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And in the narration of Ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid, he said:
"I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about the slaughter by a boy and a woman, can it be eaten?
Imam {a.s} said: 'If the woman is a Muslim and mentions the name of Allah {SWT} over her
slaughter, then her slaughter is permissible.
And if the boy is strong enough to perform the slaughter and mentions the name of
Allah {SWT}, his slaughter is also permissible.
This applies in cases where there is a fear of losing the animal and no one else is
available to perform the slaughter.'"
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ ذَبِيحَةِ الْغُلاَمِ وَ
الْمَرْأَةِ هَلْ تُوكَلُ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مُسْلِمَةً وَ ذَكَرَتِ إِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى ذَبِيحَتِهَا حَلَّثْ ذَبِيحَتُهَا وَ الْغُلامُ إِذَا قَوِيّ
عَلَى الذِّبِيحَةِ وَ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى حَلَّثْ ذَبِيحَتُهُ وَ ذَلِكَ إِذَا خِيفَ فَوْتُ الذَّبِيحَةِ وَ لَمْ يُوجَدْ مَنْ يَذْبَحُ غَيْرُهُمَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.237 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.334 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.73 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.238 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.45

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Ibn al-Mughira narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s} had a servant girl who used to slaughter for him whenever
he desired."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَلاَمُ كَانَتْ لَهُ جَارِيَةٌ تَذْبَحُ لَهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.238 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.334 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.74 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.240 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.43 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.45

he desired."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
And Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Do not eat the meat of a lamb that has suckled from a sow."
text_ar:
[الحمل و الجدي يرضعان من لبن خنزيرة أو امرأة]
وَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «وَ لاَ تَأْكُلْ مِنْ لَحْمِ حَمَلِ رَضَعَ مِنْ خِنْزِيرَةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.334 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.16 p.186
text_chunk:
And Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Do not eat the meat of a lamb that has suckled from a sow."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON HUNTING AND SLAUGHTERING
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa wrote to Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s},
inquiring about a woman who nursed a young goat with her milk until it was weaned.
Imam {a.s} wrote in reply: "It is a disliked (makruh) act, but there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى إِلَى عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : اِمْرَأَةٌ أَرْضَعَتْ عَنَاقاً مِنَ ٱلْغَنَمِ بِلَبَنِهَا
حَتَّى فَطَمَثْهَا فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ («فِعلٌ مَكْرُوهْ وَ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.334
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa wrote to Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s},
