author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Ammar Al-Sabati asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about how women should greet
when they enter upon a group of people.
Imam {a.s} replied:
“A woman should say, 'Peace be upon you (ʿAlaykum al-Salam),' and a man should
say, 'Peace be upon you all (Al-Salam ʿAlaykum).’"
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَمَّارْ السَابَاطِيْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : عَنِ النِّسَاءِ كَيْفَ يُسَلَّمْنَ إِذَا دَخَلْنَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ قَالَ
«الْمَرْأَةُ تَقُولُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمُ وَ الرَّجُلُ يَقُولُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.470 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236 • Mishkat Al- Anwar, Vol.1 p.199 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.235 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.8 p.366 • Mustadrak Al- Wasa’il, Vol.14 p.290

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s} regarding a man who marries a woman while she has a husband.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the matter is not brought to the attention of the Imam, he must give
five sa‘ (measures) of flour in charity. This is after he separates from her."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ يَتَزَوَّجُ اِمْرَأَةً وَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ فَقَالَ «إِذَا لَمْ يُرْفَعْ
خَبَرُهُ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِخَمْسَةِ أَصْوَاعِ دَقِيقاً هَذَا بَعْدَ أَنْ يُفَارِقَهَا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.470 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.647

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
In the narration of Jameel ibn Darraj regarding a woman who marries during
her waiting period (iddah).
Imam {a.s} said: “They must be separated, and she must observe one waiting period
from either of them. If she gives birth to a child after six months or more, the child
belongs to the latter husband. However, if she gives birth to a child in less than six
months, the child belongs to the former husband."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ : فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَتَزَوَّجُ فِي عِدَّتِهَا قَالَ «يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ تَعْتَدُّ عِدَّةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْهُمَا
فَإِنْ جَاءَثْ بِوَلَدٍ لِسِتَّةِ أَشهْرٍ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ فَهُوَ لِلْأَخِيرِ وَ إِنْ جَاءَثْ بِوَلَدٍ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ أَشهُرٍ فَهُوَ لِلْأَوَّلِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.470 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.168

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Basir who
said: I asked Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who married
a woman, and she told him, "I am pregnant," or "I am your sister through
breastfeeding," or "I am still in my waiting period (iddah)."
Imam {a.s} said: “If he has already been intimate with her and consummated the
marriage, he should not believe her. But if he has not been intimate with her and has
not consummated the marriage, then he should take precaution and inquire if he was
not aware of her situation beforehand."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ
رَجُلِ تَزَوَّجَ اِمْرَأَةً فَقَالَتْ لَهُ أَنَا حُبْلَى أَوْ أَنَا أُخْثُكَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ أَوْ عَلَى غَيْرِ عِدَّةٍ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ دَخَلَ بِهَا وَ وَاقَعَهَا
فَلاَ يُصَدَّقُهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا وَ لَمْ يُوَاقِعْهَا فَلْيَحْتَطْ وَ لَيَسْأَلْ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَرَفَهَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.561 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.470 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.433 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.258 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.296

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man who said to his mother, "Any woman I marry is
as forbidden to me as you are."
Imam {a.s} replied: “This means nothing."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ
لأُمِّهِ كُلُّ اِمْرَأَةِ أَتَزَوْجُهَا فَهِيَ عَلَيَّ مِثْلُكِ حَرَامٌ قَالَ «لَيْسَ هَذَا بِشَيْءٍ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V.3 p.471 • Al-Wafi, V.22 p.955 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.22 p.311

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Jameelah from Aban ibn Taghlib
who said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man who married a woman, and after being
brought to him, she gave birth to a girl in only four months.
He denied that the child was his, while she claimed that she had conceived from him.
Imam {a.s} said: “Her claim is not accepted. If they take the matter to the ruler, they
must both engage in mutual cursing (lian), and they will be separated, and she will
never be permissible for him again."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ
رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ اِمْرَأَةً فَلَمْ تَلْبَثْ بَعْدَ مَا أُهْدِيَثْ إِلَيْهِ إِلَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشهُرٍ حَتَّى وَلَدَثْ جَارِيَةً فَأَنكَرَ وَلَدَهَا وَ زَعَمَتْ هِيَ أَنَّهَا
حَبِلَتْ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ «لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا ذَلِكَ وَ إِنْ تَرَاقَعَا إِلَى السُّلْطَانِ تَلاَعَنَا وَ فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ لَمْ تَجِلَّ لَهُ أَبَداً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.471 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.484 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Vol.8 p.167 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1412 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.382

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Hakim who said: I asked
Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a man who married off his
female slave to another man and then told her, "When your husband dies, you will be
free." The husband then died.
Imam {a.s} said: "When the husband dies, she becomes free and must observe the
waiting period (iddah) of a free woman whose husband has passed away. However,
she does not inherit from him because she only became free after the husband's
death."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنْ رَجُلٍ زَوَّجَ أَمَتَهُ مِنْ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهَا إِذَا مَاتَ الزَّوْجُ فَهِيَ حُرَّةٌ فَمَاتَ ٱلزَّوْجُ فَقَالَ «إِذَا مَاتَ ٱلزَّوْجُ فَهِيَ
حُرَّةٌ تَعْتَدُّ عِدَّةَ اَلْحُرَّةِ الْمُتَوَفِّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَ لاَ مِيرَاثَ لَهَا مِنْهُ لِأَنَّهَا إِنَّهَا صَارَتْ حُرَّةً بَعدَ مَوْتِ الزَّوْجِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.471 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.213 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.131
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
It was narrated from Abu Basir who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}: "A man was found with a woman in a house, and she
admitted that she was his wife, and he admitted that he was her husband."
Imam {a.s} said: “There may be a man whom, if he were brought to me, I would approve
of that for him, and there may be a man whom, if he were brought to me, I would have
him beaten."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ رَجُلْ أَخِذَ مَعَ اِمْرَأَةٍ فِي بَيْتٍ فَأَقَرَّثْ أَنَّهَا
اِمْرَأَتُهُ وَ أَقَرَ أَنَّهُ زَوْجُهَا فَقَالَ «رُبَ رَجُلٍ لَوْ أَتِيتُ بِهِ لَأَجَزْتُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ وَ رُبَّ رَجُلٍ لَوْ أُتِيتُ بِهِ لَضَرَبْتُهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.561 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.471 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.509 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.297
text_chunk:
It was narrated from Abu Basir who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}: "A man was found with a woman in a house, and she
admitted that she was his wife, and he admitted that he was her husband."
Imam {a.s} said: “There may be a man whom, if he were brought to me, I would approve
of that for him, and there may be a man whom, if he were brought to me, I would have
him beaten."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj narrated: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man
who marries his male slave to his female slave. Should she continue to serve him as
she used to, seeing him uncovered or him seeing her in that state?
Imam {a.s} disliked that and said: “My father {a.s} prevented me from marrying one of my
male servants to my female servant for this very reason."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُزَوِّجُ مَمْلُوكَتَهُ عَبْدَهُ أَ
تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا كَانَتْ تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ تَرَاهُ مُنكَشِفاً أَوْ يَرَاهَا عَلَى تِلْكَ الْحَالِ فَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ وَ قَالَ «قَدْ مَنَعَنِي أَبِي عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ أَنْ أُزَوِّجَ بَعْضَ غِلْمَانِي أَمَتِي لِذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.480 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.472 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.199 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.839 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.147

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Al-Alaa ibn Razin asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about the the general masses
(Jumhur al-Nas).
Imam {a.s} said: "They are today considered people of truce. Their lost property is to be
returned to them, their trusts are to be fulfilled, their blood is to be protected, and
marriage with them and inheritance from them is permissible in this state."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ رَزِينٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : عَنْ جُمْهُورِ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ «هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَهْلُ هُدْنَةٍ ثُرَدْ
ضَالَّثُهُمْ وَ تُؤَدَّى أَمَانَثُهُمْ وَ تُحْقَنُ دِمَاوُهُمْ وَ تَجُوزُ مُنَاكَحَتُهُمْ وَ مُوَارَثَتُهُمْ فِي هَذَا الْحَالِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.472 • Al-Wafi, Vol.5 p.524 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.106 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.561

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)
said: "Part of a man's happiness is that his daughter does not experience menstruation
in his house."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مِنْ سَعَادَةِ الرَّجُلِ أَنْ لا تَجِيضَ اِبْنَتُهُ فِي بَيْتِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.472 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.64 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.92

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umair narrated from Yahya ibn Imran from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: "Bravery is found among the people of
Khurasan, physical vigor among the people of Barbar, and generosity and envy among
the Arabs. Therefore, choose carefully where you place your seed."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الشَّجَاعَةُ فِي أَهْلِ
خُرَاسَانَ وَ الْبَاهُ فِي أَهْلِ بَرْبَرَ وَ السَّخَاءُ وَ الْحَسَدُ فِي الْعَرَبِ فَتَخَيَّرُوا لِنُطَفِكُمْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.472 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.299 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.49 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.249

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
In the narration of Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is reported that Imam
Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: “No man has ever had an abundance of hair without his desire
becoming less."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
: «مَا كَثْرَ شَعْرُ رَجُلٍ قَطُ إلاَّ قَلَّثْ شَهْوَتُهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.472 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.309 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.319 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.241 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.87 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.1 p.399

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from Abdul Aziz ibn al-Muhtadi who said:
I asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s}:
"May I be sacrificed for you! My brother passed away, and I married his wife. Then my
uncle came and claimed that he had secretly married her. I asked her about this, and
she strongly denied it, saying, 'There was never anything between me and him at all.'"
Imam {a.s} replied: “Her acknowledgment is binding upon you, and her denial is binding
upon him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ بْنِ الْمُهْتَدِي قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ آَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ
فِدَاكَ إِنَّ أَخِي مَاتَ وَ تَزَوَّجَتْ اِمْرَأْتَهُ فَجَاءَ عَمِّي وَ إِدَّعَى أَنَّهُ كَانَ تَزَوَّجَهَا سِرَاً فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَنْكَرَثْ أَشَدَّ
اَلْإِنْكَارِ وَ قَالَتْ مَا كَانَ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهُ شَيْءٌ قَطُّ فَقَالَ «يَلْزَمُكَ إِقْرَارُهَا وَ يَلْزَمُهُ إِنْكَارُهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.563 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.472 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.686 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.299

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Salih ibn Uqbah narrated from Sulayman ibn Salih from Abu Abdullah Imam
Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who was asked about a man who engages in
intercourse with his wife's bondwoman and then asks his wife to pardon him, but she
refuses. He then says: "If you do not pardon me, I will divorce you," and he avoids her
bed until she pardons him.
Imam {a.s} said: “This man is an oppressor. Where is his kindness?"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَالِحُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صَالِح عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجْلِ يَنْكِحْ
جَارِيَةَ اِمْرَأَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَسْأَلْهَا أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ فِي جِلَّ فَتَأْبَى فَيَقُولُ إِذاً لَأُطَلَّقَئَّكِ وَ يَجْتَنِبُ فِرَاشَهَا فَتَجْعَلُهُ فِي جِلَّ قَالَ
«هَذَا غَاصِبٌ فَأيْنَ هُوَ عَنِ اللظفِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.470 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.473 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.599 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.138

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Abu al-Abbas and Ubayd narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} regarding a woman who had a slave husband, then inherited
him and freed him. They asked if they would remain in their marriage.
Imam {a.s} said: “No, but they must renew their marriage contract."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ وَ عُبَيْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي اِمْرَأَةٍ كَانَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ مَمْلُوكَ فَوَرِثَثْهُ وَ
أَغْتَقَتْهُ هَلْ يَكُونَانِ عَلَى نِكَاجِهِمَا قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ يُجَدِّدَانِ نِكَاحاً آخَرَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.485 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.473 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.619 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.159

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: “It is recommended for a man to approach his
wife on the first night of the month of Ramadan because of the saying of Allah {SWT}, the
Mighty and Majestic: 'It has been made lawful for you to be intimate with your wives
during the nights of fasting' (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:187), and al-rafath means sexual
intercourse."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ أَوّلَ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لِقَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ:
• أُجِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيْامِ الرَّفَتُ إِلى نِسائِكُمْ ) وَ الرَّفَتُ ٱلْمُجَامَعَةُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.4 p.180 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.2 p.173 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.473 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.213 • Al-Wafi, Vol.11 p.497 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.730 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.10 p.349 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.129 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.398 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.2 p.251

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Ishaq who said:
Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Do you know why the dowries
of women became four thousand dirhams?"
I said: “No."
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, Umm Habibah, the daughter of Abu Sufyan, was in Abyssinia
when the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) proposed to her.
The Negus (the king of Abyssinia) gave four thousand dirhams on his behalf as her
dowry. Since then, people have followed this practice. However, the original dowry
was twelve uqiyyah and a nash."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَرِيزٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «أَتَدْرِي مِنْ أَيْنَ صَارَ مُهُورُ النَّسَاءِ
أَرْبَعَةَ آلافِ دِرْهَمِ» قُلْتُ لا قَالَ «إِنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِئْتَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ كَانَتْ فِي الْحَبَشَةِ فَخَطَبَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
وَآلِهِ قَسَاقَ عَنْهُ النَّجَاشِيُّ أَرْبَعَةَ آلآَفِ دِرْهَمٍ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ هَؤُلاَءِ يَأْخُذُونَ بِهِ فَأَمَا ٱلْأَصْلُ فَاثُنَتَا عَشرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً وَ نَشُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.473 • Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.500 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakooni, it is reported that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}
passed by an animal and a stud mating in the middle of the road, and Imam {a.s} turned
his face away.
It was said to him: "Why did you do that, O Commander of the Faithful {a.s}?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is not appropriate for you to do what they do (i.e., allow such
things publicly). It is among the unacceptable acts unless you conceal it where no man
or woman can see it."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ : أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَرَّ عَلَى بَهِيمَةٍ وَ فَحْلٍ يَسْفَدُهَا عَلَى ظَهْرِ الطَّرِيقِ فَأَعْرَضَ
عَنْهُ بِوَجْهِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ ذَلِكَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ لا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَصْنَعُوا مَا يَصْنَعُونَ وَ هَوَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنْكَرِ
إِلَّ أَنْ تُوَارُوهُ حَيْثُ لا يَرَاهُ رَجُلٌ وَ لا اِمْرَأَةٌ».
cross_references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.634 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.473 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.305 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.874 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.11 p.521 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.133 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.61 p.225

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever looks at a woman
and then raises his gaze to the sky or lowers his eyes, his sight will not return to him
until Allah {SWT} marries him to a heavenly maiden (Hoor al-Ayn)."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «مَنْ نَظَرَ إِلَى اِمْرَأَةٍ فَرَفَعَ بَصَرَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ أُوْ غَمَّضَ بَصَرَهُ لَمْ يَرْتَدَ إِلَيْهِ
بَصَرُهُ حَتَّى يُزَوِّجَهُ اللهُ مِنَ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.473 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236 • Fiqh Al-Quran, Vol.2 p.144 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.291 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.860 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.193 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.101 p.37

chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
And in another narration: "His gaze will not return to him until Allah {SWT} grants
him faith, the sweetness of which he will experience."
text_ar: - وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: « لَمْ يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْهِ طَرْفُهُ حَتَّى يُعْقِبَهُ اللّهُ إِيمَاناً يَجِدُ طَعْمَهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: “The first glance is for you, the second is against you and not
for you, and the third in it is destruction."
text_ar: - قَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «أَوَّلُ النَّظْرَةِ لَكَ وَ الثَّانِيَةُ عَلَيْكَ وَ لا لَكَ وَ الثَّالِئَةُ فِيهَا الْهَلاَكُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.474 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.860 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.193 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.37

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON SUPPLICATION FOR SEEKING OFFSPRING
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakooni from Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father {a.s},
he said: “There is no harm for a man to look at the hair of his mother, his sister, or his
daughter."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ الرَجُلُ إِلَى شَعْرِ
أُمِّهِ أَوْ أُخْتِهِ أَو اِبْنَتِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.474 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.236 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.817 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.37

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON SUPPLICATION FOR SEEKING
text_en:
Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) said to one of his companions:
"When seeking a child, say:
'My Lord {AZJ}, do not leave me alone [without offspring], and You {SWT} are the best of
inheritors' and add;
'Grant me from Yourself {SWT} a successor who will inherit from me during my life and
seek forgiveness for me after my death. Make him well-formed in creation and do not
allow Satan to have any share in him. O Allah {SWT}, I seek Your {SWT} forgiveness and
repent to You {SWT}. Indeed, You {SWT} are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.'
Repeat this seventy times. For whoever frequently says this supplication, Allah {SWT} the
Exalted will grant him whatever he wishes of wealth, children, and the goodness of this
world and the Hereafter.
For Allah {SWT} says: 'Seek forgiveness from your Lord {AZJ}; indeed, He {SWT} is ever
Forgiving. He {SWT} will send rain to you in abundance and supply you with wealth and
children and make for you gardens and make for you rivers' (Surah Nuh 71:10–12)."
text_ar:
بَابُ الدُّعَاءِ فِي طَلَبِ الْوَلَدِ
قَالَ عَلِيْ بْنُ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَ لِبَعْضٍ أَصْحَابِهِ: «قُلْ فِي طَلَبِ ٱلْوَلَدِ «رَبّ لا تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَارِثِينَ»
وَ اِجْعَل «لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا يَرِثُنِي» فِي حَيَاتِي وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِي بَعْدَ مَوْتِي وَ اِجْعَلْهُ لِي خَلْقاً سَوِيّاً وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ
للشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ نَصِيباً آللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ أَنُوبُ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ هَذَا
اَلْقَوْلِ رَزَقَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى مَا تَمَنَّى مِنْ مَالٍ وَ وَلَدٍ وَ مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ فَإِنَّهُ يَقُولُ ) اِسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ
غَفَاراً يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَاراً وَ يُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَ بَنِينَ وَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهَاراً »
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.474 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.308 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1308 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.369 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.422

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
It was narrated from Sama'ah ibn Mihran that Abu Abdullah {a.s} said:
“Breastfeeding is for twenty-one months, and anything less than that is an injustice to
the child."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرّضَاعٍ
رُوِيَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الرَّضَاعُ وَاحِدٌ وَ عِشرُونَ شَهْراً فَمَا نَقَصَ
فَهُوَ جَوْرٌ عَلَى الصَّبِيِّ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.40 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.474 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.106 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.455

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Sa'd ibn Sa'd asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} about whether a child can
be breastfed for more than two years.
Imam {a.s} replied: “Two years."
I asked: “If it exceeds two years, is there any obligation upon the parents because of
that?"
Imam {a.s} said: “No."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعْدِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : عَنِ الصَّبِيِّ هَلْ يُرْضَعُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَنَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «عَامَيْنِ» قُلْتُ
فَإنْ زَادَ عَلَى سَنَتَيْنِ هَلْ عَلَى أَبَوَيْهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْءُ قَالَ «لا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.41 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.475 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.107 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1365 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.454

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
“There is no milk with greater blessing for a child to be nursed with than the milk of his
mother."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «مَا مِنْ لَبَنِ يُرضَعُ بِهِ الصَّبِيْ أَعْظَمَ بَرَكَةً عَلَيْهِ مِنْ لَبَنِ أُمِّهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.40 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.475 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.108 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1363

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} looked at Umm Ishaq bint Sulayman
while she was breastfeeding one of her two sons, either Muhammad or Ishaq, and
Imam {a.s} said:
“O Umm Ishaq, do not nurse him from only one breast; rather, nurse him from both.
One will serve as food and the other as drink."
text_ar:
: وَ نَظَرَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ إِلَى أُمِّ إِسْحَاقَ بِئْتِ سُلَيْمَانَ وَ هِيَ تُرْضِعُ أَحَدَ اِبْنَيْهَا مُحَمَّداً أَوْ إِسْحَاقَ
فَقَالَ «يَا أُمَ إسْحَاقَ لا تُرْضِعِيهِ مِنْ تَذي وَاحِدٍ وَ أَرْضِعِيهِ مِنْ كِلَيْهِمَا يَكُونُ أَحَدُهُمَا طَعَاماً وَ اَلْآخَرُ شَرَاباً)».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.475

One will serve as food and the other as drink."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Burayd al-Ijli who
said: I asked Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"What is the meaning of the saying of the Messenger of Allah {SWT} –
'What is unlawful through lineage is also unlawful through breastfeeding'? Explain it to
me."
Imam {a.s} replied: "Every woman who nurses, with the milk of her husband, the child of
another woman, whether the child is male or female, that is the breastfeeding (ridha‘)
referred to by the Messenger of Allah {SWT} (may Allah bless him and his family).
But any woman who nurses, with the milk of two different husbands (one after the
other), the child of another woman, whether male or female, this is breastfeeding that
does not fall under the ruling of the statement of the Messenger of Allah {SWT} 'What is
prohibited through breastfeeding is the same as what is prohibited through lineage.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ الْعِجْلِيَّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَ
رَأْيْتَ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ النَّسَبِ» فَسِّرْهُ لِي فَقَالَ «كُلُّ اِمْرَأَةٍ
أَرْضَعَتْ مِنْ لَبَنِ فَحْلِهَا وَلَدَ اِمْرَأَةِ أُخْرَى مِنْ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ غَلامٍ فَذَلِكَ الرَّضَاعُ ٱَلَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ وَ كُلُّ اِمْرَأَةِ أَرْضَعَتْ مِنْ لَبَنِ فَحْلَيْنِ كَانَا لَهَا وَاجداً بَعْدَ آخَرَ مِنْ جَارِيَةِ أَوْ غَلاَمٍ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ رَضَاعٌ لَيْسَ بِالرَّضَاعِ
اَلَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ ٱلنَّسَبِ»».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.475

Imam {a.s} replied: "Every woman who nurses, with the milk of her husband, the child of

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
“There is no breastfeeding after weaning."

Scholar's Note:
Its meaning is that if a child has been breastfed for two full years and then drinks milk
from another woman after that, such breastfeeding does not establish a prohibition,
because it is breastfeeding after weaning.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «لا رَضَاعَ بَعدَ فِطَامِ».
وَ مَعْنَاهُ أَنَّهُ إِذَا أَرْضِعَ الصَّبِيُ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ثُمَّ شَرِبَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ لَبَنِ امْرَأَةِ أُخْرَى مَا شَرِبَ لَمْ يُحَرِّمْ ذَلِكَ الرَّضَاعُ لِأَنْهُ رَضَاعْ
بَعْدَ فِطَامٍ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.443 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.476 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.72 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.128 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.270 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.254 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.385

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Dawud ibn Al-Husayn narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said:
"Breastfeeding within two years, before the child is weaned, establishes prohibition."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى دَاوُدُ بْنُ الْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الرّضَاعُ بَعْدَ حَوْلَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفْطَمَ يُحَرِّمُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.476 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.3 p.198 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.325 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.256

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
It was narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh who said: Ali ibn Shu'ayb wrote to Abu al-
Hasan {a.s} asking: "A woman breastfed one of my children. Is it permissible for me to
marry one of her children?"
Imam {a.s} wrote in response, "That is not permissible because her children have
become like your own children."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ قَالَ كَتَّبَ عَلِيْ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : اِمْرَأَةٌ أَرْضَعَتْ بَعْضَ
وُلْدِي هَلْ يَجُوزُ لِي أَنْ أَتَزَوَّجَ بَعضَ وُلْدِهَا فَكَتَبَ «لا يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ لِأَنَّ وُلْدَهَا قَدْ صَارَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ وُلَدِكَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.476 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.321 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.3 p.201 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.270 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.222 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.404

Hasan {a.s} asking: "A woman breastfed one of my children. Is it permissible for me to
marry one of her children?"
Imam {a.s} wrote in response, "That is not permissible because her children have
become like your own children."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari wrote to Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-
Askari {a.s} asking about a woman who breastfed a man's child.
He asked: “Is it permissible for that man to marry the daughter of this wet nurse or
not?"
Imam {a.s} responded, "It is not permissible for him."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ الْحِمْيَرِيّ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْعَسْكَرِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي اِمْرَأَةٍ
أَرْضَعَتْ وَلَدَ الرَّجُلِ أَ يَحِلُ لِذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ اِبْنَةَ هَذِهِ ٱلْمُرْضِعَةِ أَمْ لا فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلاَمُ «لا يَحِلُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.476

Imam {a.s} responded, "It is not permissible for him."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said: "If a man marries a young girl (jariyah) who is
still nursing, and his wife then breastfeeds her, the marriage becomes invalid."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْعَلَاَءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَوْ أَنّ رَجُلاً تَزَوَّجَ جَارِيَةً رَضِيعَةً
فَأَرْضَعَتْهَا امْرَأَتُهُ فَسَدَ النِّكَاحُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.476 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.399

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Malik ibn Atiyyah from Abu Abdullah
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} regarding a man who marries a woman, and
she gives birth to his child.
Then she breastfeeds a bondwoman with her milk.
Imam {a.s} was asked: “Is it permissible for his child from another woman to marry that
bondwoman whom she breastfed?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “No, she is like a sister through breastfeeding because the milk
comes from the same father."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ عَطِيّةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَتَزَوَّجُ ٱلْمَرْأَةَ
فَتَلِدُ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ تُرْضِعُ مِنْ لَبَنِهَا جَارِيَةً أَ يَصْلُحُ لِوَلَدِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ تِلْكَ الْجَارِيَةَ الَّتِي أَرْضَعَتْهَا قَالَ «لا هِيَ
بِمَنْزِلَةً الْأُخْتِ مِنَ الرِّضَاعَةِ لِأَنَّ اللَّبَنَ لِفَحْلِ وَاجِدٍ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.477 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.244 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.393

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Hariz narrated from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: “Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition
except when it is continuous and intentional."
I asked: “What is meant by continuous and intentional?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “It is when a mother raises the child, a wet nurse is hired, or a
bondwoman is purchased for breastfeeding."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَرِيزٌ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ إِلا مَا كَانَ
مَجْبُوراً » قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا الْمَجْبُورُ قَالَ «أُمِّ تُرَبِّي أَوْ ظِئرَ تُسْتَأْجَرُ أَوْ أَمَةً تُشتَرَى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.477

Imam {a.s} replied: “It is when a mother raises the child, a wet nurse is hired, or a
bondwoman is purchased for breastfeeding."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Al-Alaa ibn Razin narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} who said:
“Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except when a child nurses from one
breast for a full year."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ رَزِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ إِلاَ مَا اِرْتَضَعَ مِنْ تَدْيٍ
وَاجدٍ سَنَةٌ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.477 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.324 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.379
text_chunk:
Al-Alaa ibn Razin narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} who said:
“Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except when a child nurses from one

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated from Zurarah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: I asked him about breastfeeding, and Imam {a.s}
said:
“Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except when a child nurses from one
breast for two complete years."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عُبَيْدُ بْنُ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللْهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّضَاعِ فَقَالَ «لاَ يَحْرُمُ
مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ إِلاَّ مَا اِرْتَضَعَ مِنْ ثَذي وَاحِدٍ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.477 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.317 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.3 p.197 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.240 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.386

Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated from Zurarah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: I asked him about breastfeeding, and Imam {a.s}

breast for two complete years."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Zurarah narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: “Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition
except when it is for two complete years."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ زُرَارَةَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ ٱلرَّضَاعِ إِلا مَا
كَانَ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.477 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.240 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.379 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.387
text_chunk:
Abdullah ibn Zurarah narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: “Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition
except when it is for two complete years."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ قَالَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «اِنْهَوْا نِسَاءَكُمْ أَنْ يُرْضِعْنَ يَمِيناً وَ شِمَالاً فَإِنَّهُنَّ
يَنْسَيْنَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.446 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.478 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.226 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.382 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.453

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Fudayl narrated from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s} who said: “Choose healthy wet nurses, for milk can transmit illness."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى فُضَيْلٌ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْوُضَّاءِ مِنَ الظُئُورَةِ فَإِنَّ اللَّبَنَ يُعْدِي».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.44 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.478 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.110 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1370 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.468
text_chunk:
Fudayl narrated from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s} who said: “Choose healthy wet nurses, for milk can transmit illness."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a
woman who committed adultery - whether she is suitable to be taken as a wet nurse.
He {a.s} replied: “She is not suitable, nor is the milk of her daughter who was born from
adultery."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ : عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ زَنَثْ هَلْ تَصْلُحُ أَنْ تُسْتَرْضَعَ قَالَ
«لاَ تَصْلُحُ وَ لَاَ لَبَنُ اِبْنَتِهَا الْتِي وُلِدَثْ مِنَ الزِّنَا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.478
text_chunk:

He {a.s} replied: “She is not suitable, nor is the milk of her daughter who was born from
adultery."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s} who said that the Messenger of Allah {SWT} said:
“Do not choose a foolish woman as a wet nurse, for milk can transmit traits. A child is
influenced by the milk, meaning by the wet nurse, in foolishness and ignorance."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «لا
تَسْتَرْضِعُوا الْحَمْقَاءَ فَإِنَّ اللَّبَنَ يُغْدِي وَ إِنَّ ٱلْغُلاَمَ يَنْزِعُ إِلَى اللَّبَنِ يَعْنِي إِلَى الظَّئرِ فِي الرُّعُونَةِ وَ الْحُمْقِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.43 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.478 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.110 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1369 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.467
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s} who said that the Messenger of Allah {SWT} said:
“Do not choose a foolish woman as a wet nurse, for milk can transmit traits. A child is
influenced by the milk, meaning by the wet nurse, in foolishness and ignorance."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Ibn Muskan narrated from Al-Halabi who said: I asked him about a man who
gives his child to a Jewish, Christian, or Magian (Zoroastrian) wet nurse to breastfeed
him either in her house or in his house.
Imam {a.s} said: “A Jewish or Christian woman may breastfeed your child, but you must
prevent her from drinking alcohol and consuming what is unlawful, such as pork. Do
not let them take your child to their homes. A woman who is an adulteress must not
breastfeed your child, for it is not permissible for you. A Magian woman must not
breastfeed your child unless you are compelled to it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيَّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَفَعَ وَلَدَهُ إِلَى ظِئْرٍ يَهُودِيَّةِ أَوْ نَصْرَانِيَّةِ أَوْ مَجُوسِيَّةٍ
تُرْضِعُهُ فِي بَيْتِهَا أَوْ تُرْضِعُهُ فِي بَنْتِهِ قَالَ «تُرْضِعُهُ لَكَ الْيَهُودِيَّةُ وَ النَّصْرَانِيَّةُ وَ تَمْنَعُهَا مِنْ شُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ وَ مَا لا
يَحِلُّ مِثلَ لَحْمِ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَ لا يَذْهَبْنَ بِوَلَدِكَ إِلَى بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَ الزَّانِيَةُ لاَ تُرْضِعُ وَلَدَكَ فَإِنَّهُ لا يَجِلُّ لَكَ وَ الْمَجُوسِيَّةُ لا
تُرْضِعُ لَكَ وَلَدَكَ إِلَّ أَنْ تُضْطَرَّ إِلَيْهَا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.479 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.116 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.465

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
“The milk of a Jewish, Christian, or Magian woman is more beloved to me than the milk
of a child born from adultery. However, he saw no harm in the milk of a child born from
adultery if the master of the bondwoman, with whom the immoral act was committed,
pardons it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَرِيزٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَ قَالَ: «لَبَنُ الْيَهُودِيَّةِ وَ النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ وَ الْمَجُوسِيَةِ أَحَبُ
إِلَي مِنْ لَبَنِ وَلَدِ الزِّنَا وَ كَانَ لا يَرَى بَأْساً بِلَبَنِ وَلَدِ الزِّنَا إِذَا جَعَلَ مَوْلَى الْجَارِيَةِ الَّذِي فَجَرَ بِالْجَارِيَةِ فِي جِلَّ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.43 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.479 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.3 p.322 • Al- Wafi, Vol.23 p.1367
text_chunk:
Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
“The milk of a Jewish, Christian, or Magian woman is more beloved to me than the milk
of a child born from adultery. However, he saw no harm in the milk of a child born from
adultery if the master of the bondwoman, with whom the immoral act was committed,
pardons it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Yunus ibn Yaqub from Abu Abdullah
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a woman
whose milk flowed without childbirth, and she breastfed a girl and a boy with that milk.
Does this milk create the same prohibitions as regular breastfeeding?
Imam {a.s} replied: “No."
text_ar:
اه الوا
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ إِمْرَأَةٍ
دَرَّ لَبَنُهَا مِنْ غَيْرٍ وِلادَةٍ فَأَرْضَعَتْ جَارِيَةً وَ غُلاماً بِذَلِكَ اللَّبَنِ هَلْ يَحْرُمُ بِذَلِكَ اللَّبَنِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ قَالَ «لا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.446 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.479 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.241 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.20 p.398
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Yunus ibn Yaqub from Abu Abdullah
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a woman
whose milk flowed without childbirth, and she breastfed a girl and a boy with that milk.
Does this milk create the same prohibitions as regular breastfeeding?
Imam {a.s} replied: “No."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: “The sucking of milk by a child is equivalent to
breastfeeding."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «وَجُورُ الصَّبِيِّ اللَّبَنَ بِمَنزِلَةِ الرَّضَاعِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.479 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.242
text_chunk:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: “The sucking of milk by a child is equivalent to
breastfeeding."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
Imam Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: “A free woman cannot be forced to breastfeed
a child, but a but a bondwoman (umm al-walad) can be compelled to do so."

Scholar's Note:
If the father finds someone willing to breastfeed the child for four dirhams, and the
mother says, "I will not breastfeed him except for five dirhams," then he has the right
to take the child away from her. However, what is better and kinder for the child is to
leave the child with the mother. Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Majestic, says: 'But if you
disagree, then another woman may breastfeed the child for him' (Surah Al-Talaq 65:6).
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لا تُجْبَرُ ٱلْحُرَّةُ عَلَى إِرْضَاعِ ٱلْوَلَدِ وَ تُجْبَرُ أُمْ ٱلْوَلَدِ».
وَ مَتَى وَجَدَ الْأَبُ مَنْ يُرْضِعُ الْوَلَدَ بِأَرْبَعَةِ دَرَاهِمَ وَ قَالَتِ الْأُمُ لَا أُرْضِعُهُ إِلَّا بِخَمْسَةِ دَرَاهِمَ فَإِنَّ لَهُ أَنْ يَنْزِعَهُ مِنْهَا إِلَا أَنَّ الْأَصْلَحَ
الَهُ وَ الْأَرْفَقَ بِهِ أَنْ يَثَرُكَهُ مَعَ أَمّهِ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزّ وَ جَلَ ٢ وَ إِنْ تَعاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخَرِى
commentary:

mother says, "I will not breastfeed him except for five dirhams," then he has the right
to take the child away from her. However, what is better and kinder for the child is to
leave the child with the mother. Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Majestic, says: 'But if you
disagree, then another woman may breastfeed the child for him' (Surah Al-Talaq 65:6).

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
The Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, ruled regarding a man who passed away
and left behind a child who needed to be breastfed:
"The payment for the child's breastfeeding should be taken from what the child
inherits from his father and mother."
text_ar:
وَ قَضَى أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي رَجُلٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَ تَرَكَ صَبِيَا وَ اسْتُرْضِعَ لَهُ «أَنَّ أَجْرَ رَضَاعِ الصَّبِيَّ
مِمَّا يَرِثُ مِنْ أَبِيهِ وَ أَمَّهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BREASTFEEDING
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakooni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is reported that a man came
to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} and said: “My bondwoman has breastfed my child, and I
want to sell her."
Imam {a.s} replied: “Take her by the hand and say, 'Who will buy from me the mother of
my child?'"
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: أَنّ عَلِيْاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَتَاهُ رَجُلْ فَقَالَ
إنَّ أَمَتِي أَرْضَعَتْ وَلَدِي وَ قَدْ أَرَدْتُ بَيْعَهَا قَالَ «خُذْ بِيَدِهَا وَ قُلْ مَنْ يَشتَرِي مِنِّي أُمّ وَلَدِي».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON CONGRATULATING FOR THE BIRTH OF
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
A man congratulated another man on the birth of a son by saying, "May this young
warrior bring you joy!"
Imam Hasan ibn Ali {a.s}said to him: "How do you know whether he will be a warrior or
one who walks on foot?"
The man replied: “May I be sacrificed for you! What should I say then?"
Imam {a.s} said: “Say: May you thank the Giver, may the gift be blessed for you, may he
reach maturity, and may you be granted his righteousness."
text_ar:
بَابُ التَّهْنِئَةِ بِالْوَلَدِ
قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «رَجُلْ هَنَّأَ رَجُلا أَصَابَ إِبْنا فَقَالَ يَهْنِيكَ الْفَارِسُ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «مَا عِلْمُكَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فَارِساً أَوْ رَاجِلاً» فَقَالَ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فَمَا أَقُولُ قَالَ «تَقُولُ شَكَرْتَ ٱلْوَاهِبَ وَ
بُورِكَ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ، وَ بَلَغَ أشُدَّهُ وَ رُزِقْتَ بِرَهُ» ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.17 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.480 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.437 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1320 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.386 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.44 p.111

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakooni, the Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace and
blessings be upon him and his family) said:
“A righteous child is a flower from the flowers of Paradise."
text_ar:
بَابُ فَضْلِ الْأَوْلَادِ
فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «الْوَلَدُ الصَّالِحُ رَيْحَانَةٌ مِنْ رَيَاحِينِ الْجَنَّةِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.3 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.481 • Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.187 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.218 • Al-Nawadir (Lil-Rawandi), Vol.1 p.5 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1291 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.358 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.362 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.10 p.368 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.90

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“Allah’s {SWT} inheritance from His {SWT} believing servant is a righteous child who seeks
forgiveness for him."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «مِيرَاثُ اللّهِ مِنْ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ ٱلْوَلَدُ الصَّالِحُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.481 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.218 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1296 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.359 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.90

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_ar: - وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى إِذَا أَرَادَ بِعَبْدِ خَيْراً لَمْ يُمِثَهُ حَتَّى يُرِيَهُ ٱلْخَلَفَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.481 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1296 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.357 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.91

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
It is narrated:
"Whoever dies without leaving behind a successor, it is as if he was never among the
people. And whoever dies and leaves behind a successor, it is as if he never died."
text_ar: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنْ مَاتَ بِلاَ خَلَفٍ فَكَأَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي النَّاسِ وَ مَنْ مَاتَ وَ لَهُ خَلَفٌ فَكَأْنْ لَمْ يَمُثَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.481 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1296 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.357 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.91

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Aban ibn Taghlib narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} who said: “Daughters are good deeds, and sons are blessings. Good deeds
are rewarded, and blessings are questioned about."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «آَلْبَئَاتُ حَسَنَاتُ وَ ٱلْبَنُونَ نِعْمَةً فَالْحَسَنَاتُ
يُثَابُ عَلَيْهَا وَ النَّعْمَةُ يُسْألُ عَنْهَا».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) was given the
glad tidings of a daughter. He {saws} looked at the faces of his companions and saw
displeasure in them.
He {saws} said: “What is the matter with you? She is a sweet flower (rayḥanah) that I
smell, and her sustenance is upon Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
And Prophet {a.s} was a father of daughters.
text_ar:
: وَ بُشَّرَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِابْنَةٍ فَنَظَرَ فِي وُجُوهِ أَصْحَابِهِ فَرَأَى الْكَرَاهَةَ فِيهِمْ فَقَالَ «مَا لَكُمْ
رَيُحَانَةٌ أَشَمُّهَا وَ رِزْقُهَا عَلَى اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ» وَ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَبَا بَنَاتٍ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.481 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.202 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1302 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.365 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.90 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.104 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.11 p.58 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.15 p.117

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: “When a child falls ill, it serves as an expiation
for the sins of the parents."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «فِي الْمَرَضِ يُصِيبُ الصَّبِيَّ إِنَّهُ كَفَّارَةٌ لِوَالِدَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.285 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.357

Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: “When a child falls ill, it serves as an expiation
for the sins of the parents."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic, has mercy on a man because of the intensity of his love for his child."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «إِنَّ ٱَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَيَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّجُلَ لِشِدَّةِ حُبِّهِ لِوَلَدِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.201 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.359 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.91
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Umar ibn Yazid said to Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}: "I have daughters."
The Imam {a.s} replied: “Perhaps you wish for their death? Know that if you wish for their
death and they die, you will not be rewarded on the Day of Judgment, and you will meet
your Lord {AZJ} while being disobedient to Him {SWT}."
text_ar:
وَ - قَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ : إِنَّ لِي بَنَاتٍ فَقَالَ « لَعَلَّكَ تَتَمَنَّى مَوْتَهُنَّ أَمَا إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَمَنَّيْتَ مَوْتَهُنَّ وَ مِثْنَ لَمْ
تُوْجَرْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ لَقِيتَ رَبِّكَ جِينَ تَلْقَاهُ وَ أَنْتَ عَاصٍ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.91

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Hamzah ibn Humran narrated through his chain of transmission that a man
came to the Prophet {saws} while another man was sitting with Him {saws}.
The man informed the Prophet {saws} about the birth of his child, and the color of the
man's face changed.
The Prophet {saws} asked him: "What is the matter with you?"
The man replied: “It's nothing."
The Prophet {saws} said: “Speak."
The man said: “I left while my wife was in labor, and I was informed that she gave birth
to a daughter."
The Prophet {saws} said to him: "The earth will carry her, the sky will shade her, and Allah
{SWT} will provide for her. She is a sweet flower that you will smell."
Then the Prophet {saws} turned to his companions and said:
“Whoever has one daughter will be burdened with care.
Whoever has two daughters, then seek help from Allah {SWT} for him.
Whoever has three daughters, the obligation of jihad and every hardship is lifted from
him.
And whoever has four daughters, O servants of Allah {SWT}, help him!
O servants of Allah {SWT}, support him! O servants of Allah {SWT}, have mercy on him!"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمْرَةُ بْنُ حُمْرَانَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ: أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عِنْدَهُ رَجُلٌ فَأَخْبَرَهُ
بِمَوْلُودٍ لَهُ فَتَغَيَّرَ لَوْنُ الرَّجُلِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «مَا لَكَ» قَالَ خَيْرٌ قَالَ «قُلْ» قَالَ خَرَجْتُ وَ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ
تَمْخَضُ فَأُخْبِرْتُ أَنْهَا وَلَدَثْ جَارِيَةً فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِي صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «الْأَرْضُ نُقِلْهَا وَ السَّمَاءُ تُظِلُهَا وَ اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا
وَ هِيَ رَيْحَانَةٌ تَشَمُهَا» ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ «مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ اِبْنَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَهُوَ مَقْرُوحْ وَ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ اِبْنَتَانِ فَيَا
غَوْثَاهْ بِاللَّهِ وَ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلاَثُ بَنَاتٍ وُضِعَ عَنْهُ الْجِهَادُ وَ كُلُّ مَكْرُوهِ وَ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ أَرْبَعُ بَنَاتٍ فَيَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ أُعِينُوهُ
يَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ أَقْرِضُوهُ يَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ اِرْحَمُوهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.202 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.294 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.91 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.101 p.104
text_chunk:
Hamzah ibn Humran narrated through his chain of transmission that a man
came to the Prophet {saws} while another man was sitting with Him {saws}.
The man informed the Prophet {saws} about the birth of his child, and the color of the
man's face changed.
The Prophet {saws} asked him: "What is the matter with you?"
The man replied: “It's nothing."
The Prophet {saws} said: “Speak."
The man said: “I left while my wife was in labor, and I was informed that she gave birth
to a daughter."
The Prophet {saws} said to him: "The earth will carry her, the sky will shade her, and Allah
{SWT} will provide for her. She is a sweet flower that you will smell."
Then the Prophet {saws} turned to his companions and said:
“Whoever has one daughter will be burdened with care.
Whoever has two daughters, then seek help from Allah {SWT} for him.
Whoever has three daughters, the obligation of jihad and every hardship is lifted from
him.
And whoever has four daughters, O servants of Allah {SWT}, help him!
O servants of Allah {SWT}, support him! O servants of Allah {SWT}, have mercy on him!"

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
“Whoever takes care of three daughters or three sisters, Paradise becomes obligatory
for him." It was asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, what about two?"
He {saws} replied: “And two (meaning same reward)."
It was asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, and one?"
He {saws} said: “And one (meaning same reward)."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ عَالَ ثَلاَثَ بَنَاتٍ أَوْ ثَلاَثَ أَحَوَاتٍ وَجَبَثْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ وَ اِثْنَتَيْنِ
قَالَ «وَ اِثْنَتَيْنِ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ «وَ وَاحِدَةً» قَالَ »وَ وَاحِدَةً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.6 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Uddat Al-Da’i, Vol.1 p.90 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1302 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.361 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.368 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.362 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.92

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“Whoever takes care of two daughters, two sisters, two paternal aunts, or two
maternal aunts, they will shield him from the Fire."
text_ar: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلامُ: «مَنْ عَالَ اِبْنَتَيْنِ أَوْ أُخْتَيْنِ أَوْ عَمَّتَيْنِ أَوْ خَالَتَيْنِ حَجَبَتَاهُ مِنَ النّارِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Al-Khisal, Vol.1 p.37 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1302 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.362 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.69

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“When a man is blessed with a daughter, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, sends an
angel to her who passes his wing over her head and chest and says, 'A fragile being
created from weakness; whoever provides for her will be assisted.'"
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «إِذَا أَصَابَ الرَّجُلُ اِبْنَةً بَعَتَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَيْهَا مَلَكاً فَأَمَرَّ جَنَاحَهُ عَلَى
رَأْسِهَا وَصَدْرِهَا وَقَالَ ضَعِيفَةٌ خَلِقَتْ مِنْ ضَعْفِ الْمُثْفِقُ عَلَيْهَا مُعَانٌ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.482 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.202 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1302 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.368 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.104

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)
said: “Know that one of you will find his miscarried child waiting anxiously at the gate
of Paradise. When they (the child) sees him, they will grasp his hand and not let go until
he brings him into Paradise. Indeed, if one of your children dies, you will be rewarded
for it, and if the child remains after you, he will seek forgiveness for you after your
death."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «إِعْلَمُوا أَنّ أَحَدَكُمْ يَلْقَى سِقْطَهُ مُحْبَثْطِناً عَلَى بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتّى
إِذَا رَآهُ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ حَتَّى يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ إِنَّ وَلَدَ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا مَاتَ أُجِرَ فِيهِ وَ إِنْ بَقِيَ بَعْدَهُ اِسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.289 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1296 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.357

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: “Love the
children and have mercy on them. When you promise them something, fulfill it for
them, for they only perceive that you are the ones who provide for them."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَحِبُوا الصِّبْيَانَ وَ اِرْحَمُوهُمْ وَ إِذَا وَعَدْتُمُوهُمْ فَفُوا لَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ لا يَرَوْنَ إِلَّ أَنَّكُمْ
تَرْزُقُونَهُم».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.219 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.92

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Rifa'ah ibn Musa narrated from Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} who said:
I asked him about a man who has sons from different mothers, can he favor one of
them over the others?
Imam {a.s} replied: “Yes, there is no harm in that. My father {a.s} used to favor me over
Abdullah."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ بَنُونَ وَ أَمْهُمْ
لَيْسَتُ بِوَاجِدَةٍ أَيُفَضَّلُ أَحَدَهُمْ عَلَى الآخَرِ قَالَ « نَعَمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ وَ قَدْ كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يُفَضَّلُنِي عَلَى عَبْدِ
اللّه».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1396 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.487

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakooni, it is reported that the Messenger of Allah {SWT}
(peace and blessings be upon him and his family) saw a man who had two sons.
The man kissed one of them and left the other.
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said to him, "Why did
you not treat them equally?"
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ قَالَ: نَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِلَى رَجْلٍ لَهُ اِبْنَانِ فَقَبَّلَ أَحَدَهُمَا وَ تَرَكَ
اَلْآخَرَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «فَهَلاً وَاسَيْتَ بَيْنَهُمَا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Al-Wafi, V.23 p.1397 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, V.21 p.487

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said: “Parents are held accountable for disobedience toward their
children just as children are held accountable for disobedience toward their parents."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «يَلْزَمُ ٱلْوَالِدَيْنِ مِنْ عُقُوقِ ٱلْوَلَدِ مَا يَلْزَمُ ٱلْوَلَدَ لَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْعُقُوقِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.48 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.112 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1385 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.480 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.93 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.15 p.127

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“A man's kindness to his child is a form of his kindness to his own parents."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ ٱلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «بِرْ ٱلرَّجُلِ بِوَلَدِهِ بِرُهُ بِوَالِدَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1388 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.484 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.93

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
In another narration, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his
family) said: “Whoever has a child should act childishly with him."
text_ar: - وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ قَالَ قَالَ النِّبِيُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ صَبِيٌّ فَلْيَتَصَابَ لَهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.483 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1388 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.486
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam {a.s} said:
“Among the blessings of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, upon a man is that his
child resembles him."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مِنْ نِعَمِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُشبِهَهُ وَلَدُهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.4 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.484 • Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.187 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.221 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.222 • Al-Nawadir (Lil-Rawandi), Vol.1 p.5 • Al- Wafi, Vol.23 p.1290 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.356 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.504 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.71 p.84

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE VIRTUE OF CHILDREN
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“When Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, wills to create a being,
He {SWT} gathers every form between him and Adam {a.s}, then creates him in the image
of one of them. Therefore, no one should say about his child, 'This one does not
resemble me or any of my ancestors.'"
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ خَلْقاً جَمَعَ كُلَّ صُورَةٍ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ
آدَمَ ثُمَّ خَلَقَهُ عَلَى صُورَةِ إِحْدَاهُنَّ فَلا يَقُولَنّ أَحَدٌ لِوَلَدِهِ هَذَا لا يُشبِهُنِي وَ لا يُشبِهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ آبَائِي».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH,
text_en:
Umar ibn Yazid narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} who said: "Every person is held in pledge on the Day of Judgment by their
Aqiqah, and the Aqiqah is more obligatory than the sacrificial offering (Udhiyyah)."
text_ar:
بَابُ العَقِيقَةِ وَ التَّحْنِيكِ وَ التَّسْمِيَةِ وَ الْكُنَى وَ حَلْقٍ رَأْسِ الْمَوْلُودِ وَتَقْبِ أُذْنَيْهِ وَ الْخِتَانِ
رَوَى عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «كُلُّ إِمْرِي مُرْتَهَنْ، يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
بِعَقِيقَتِهِ وَ الْعَقِيقَةُ أَوْجَبُ مِنَ ٱلْأُضْحِيَّةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.484 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.226 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.412 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.120

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH,
text_en:
In the narration of Abu Khadijah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, that he said:
“Every person is held in pledge by their natural disposition (fitrah), and every newborn

It was narrated from Umar ibn Yazid who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "By Allah {SWT}, I do not know whether my father performed
the aqiqah (sacrifice for a newborn) for me or not."
Imam {a.s} instructed me, so I performed the aqiqah for myself while I was an old man.
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ اللَّهِ مَا أَدْرِي أَكَانَ أَبِي عَقَ عَنَّي أَمْ لاَ
فَأَمَرَنِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَعَقَقْتُ عَنْ نَفْسِي وَ أَنَا شَيْخٌ.

Righteous Servant (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}), that he said:

text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنِ الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «الْعَقِيقَةُ وَاجِبَةٌ
إِذَا وُلِدَ لِلرَّجُلِ وَلَدْ فَإِنْ أَحَبَ أَنْ يُسَمَّيَهُ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ فَعَلَ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
Ammar Al-Sabati narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said:
“Aqiqah is obligatory for those who are wealthy. As for the poor, when they become
financially capable, they should perform it. If they are unable to do so, then nothing is
required of them.
If Aqiqah was not done for a person until a sacrifice (Udhiyyah) was offered on their
behalf, the sacrifice suffices for them. Every newborn is held in pledge by their
Aqiqah."
Imam {a.s} also said regarding Aqiqah: "A ram should be slaughtered on their behalf. If
a ram is not available, anything permissible for sacrifice in Udhiyyah will suffice. If that
is not possible, then a lamb, the largest among the lambs of the year, should be
offered."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَمَّارُ السَّابَاطِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْعَقِيقَةُ لاَزِمَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيَاً وَ مَنْ كَانَ فَقِيراً
إذَا أَيْسَرَ فَعَلَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَعْقَّ عَنْهُ حَتَى ضَحَّى عَنْهُ فَقَدْ أَجْرَأْتُهُ الْأُضْحِيَّةُ
وَ كُلُّ مَوْلُودٍ مُرْتَهَنَّ بِعَقِيقَتِهِ» وَ قَالَ فِي الْعَقِيقَةِ «يُذْبَحُ عَنْهُ كَبْشُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُوجَدْ كَبْشُ أَجْرَأَهُ مَا يُجْزِي فِي
الْأُضْحِيَّةً وَ إِلاّ فَحَمَلْ أَعْظَمُ مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ حُمْلاَنِ السَّنَةِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
In the narration of Muhammad ibn Marid from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, he said: I asked Imam {a.s} about the Aqiqah.
Imam {a.s} replied: “It can be a sheep, a cow, or a camel.
Then the child should be named, and his head should be shaved on the seventh day.
Charity should be given in gold or silver equal to the weight of the shaved hair.
If the newborn is a boy, a male animal should be sacrificed on his behalf, and if it is a
girl, a female animal should be sacrificed for her."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَارِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْعَقِيقَةِ فَقَالَ «شَاةً أَوْ بَقَرَةْ
أَوْ بَدَنَّةٌ ثُمَّ يُسَمِّي وَ يَحْلِقُ رَأْسَ الْمَوْلُودِ يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ وَ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِوَزْنٍ شَعْرِهِ ذَهَباً أَوْ فِضَّةً فَإِنْ كَانَ ذَكَراً عَقَّ عَنْهُ
ذَكَراً وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَنْتَّى عَقَّ عَنْهَا أَنتَى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.485 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1343

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
Abu Talib {a.s}, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, performed the Aqiqah for the
Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) on the
seventh day after his birth.
He {a.s} invited the family of Abu Talib {a.s}, and when they asked: “What is this?"
Abu Talib {a.s} replied: “This is the Aqiqah of Ahmad {saws}."
They asked: “Why did you name him Ahmad {saws}?"
Abu Talib {a.s} said:
“I named him Ahmad {saws} because of the praise (mahmadah) He {saws} receives from
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth."

Scholar's Note:
It is permissible to perform the Aqiqah for a male child with a female animal and for a
female child with a male animal. It has also been narrated that two female animals
may be sacrificed for a male child and one for a female child. Whatever is practiced in
this regard is acceptable.
The parents should not eat from the Aqiqah meat, although it is not forbidden for them.
If the mother eats from it, it is said that she may not nurse the child. The midwife
(qabilah) should be given a leg portion, specifically the thigh.
AND CIRCUMCISION
However, if the midwife is the man's mother or lives within his household, she is not
entitled to anything unless he chooses to give her.
The meat may be divided as it is, limb by limb, or it may be cooked and distributed with
bread and broth. It should only be given to those who are followers of the Ahlulbayt
(ahl al-wilayah).
text_ar:
وَ عَقَّ أُبُو طَالِبِ رَجِمَهُ اللهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ قَدَعَا آلَ أَبِي طَالِبِ فَقَالُوا
مَا هَذِهِ فَقَالَ «عَقِيقَةُ أَحْمَدَ » قَالُوا لِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ سَمَّيْتَهُ أَحْمَدَ قَالَ «سَمَّيْثُهُ أَحْمَدَ لِمَحْمَدَةِ أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ وَ الْأَرْضِ لَهُ».
وَ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُعَقَّ عَنِ الذَّكَرِ بِأَنْثَى وَ عَنِ الْأُنْثَى بِذَكَرٍ وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ أَنَّهُ يُعَقُّ عَنِ الذَّكَرِ بِأَنْثَيَيْنِ وَ عَنِ الْأَنْثَى بِوَاحِدَةٍ وَ مَا اسْتُعْمِلَ
مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ وَ الْأَبَوَانِ لَا يَأْكُلَانٍ مِنَ الْعَقِيقَةِ وَ لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِمُحَرَّمِ عَلَيْهِمَا وَ إِنْ أَكَلَتْ مِنْهُ الأُمُ لَمْ تُرْضِعْهُ وَ تُطْعَمُ الْقَابِلَةُ
الرَّجْلَ مِنْهَا بِالْوَرِكِ وَ إِنْ كَانَتِ الْقَابِلَةُ أَمَّ الرّجُلِ أَوْ فِي عِيَالِهِ فَلَيْسَ لَهَا شَيْءُ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ قَسَمَهَا أَعْضَاءً كَمَا هِيَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ
طَبَخَهَا وَقَسَمَ مَعَهَا خُبْراً وَ مَرَقاً وَ لَا يُعْطِيهَا إِلَّا لِأَهْلِ الْوَلَايَةِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
In the narration of Ammar Al-Sabati from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, that he said:
"If the midwife (qabilah) is a Jewess who does not eat the meat of an animal
slaughtered by Muslims, she should be given one-fourth of the value of the ram, and it
is purchased from her with that."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنْ كَانَتِ الْقَابِلَةُ يَهُودِيَّةً لاَ تَأْكُلُ مِنْ
ذَبِيحَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ أُعْطِيَتْ رُبُعَ قِيمَةِ الْكَبْشِ يُشْتَرَى ذَلِكَ مِنْهَا ».

chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
In another narration from Ammar, it is reported: "A quarter of the Aqiqah
should be given to the midwife. If there is no midwife, then the child's mother may give
it to whomever she wishes. She should also feed ten Muslims from it, and if she feeds
more, it is even better."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عَمَّارِ أَيْضاً: «أَنَّهُ يُغْطِي الْقَابِلَةَ رُبُعَهَا فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ قَابِلَةٌ فَلِأُمَّهِ تُعْطِيهَا مَنْ شَاءَثْ وَ تُطْعِمُ
مِنْهَا عَشَرَةً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَإِنْ زَادَ فَهُوَ أَفْضَلُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
Ammar Al-Sabati reported that Imam {a.s} was asked about the Aqiqah about
when it is slaughtered, should its bones be broken?
He {a.s} replied: “Yes, its bones should be broken, and its meat should be cut up. After
the slaughter, you may do with it as you wish."
text_ar:
قَالَ عَمَّارُ السَابَاطِيُ : وَ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْعَقِيقَةِ إِذَا ذُبِحَتْ هَلْ يُكْسَرُ عَظْمُهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ يُكْسَرُ عَظْمُهَا وَ يُقَطَّعُ
لَحَمُهَا وَ تَصْنَعُ بِهَا بَعْدَ الذَّبْحِ مَا شِئْتَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V.3 p.486 • Al-Wafi, V.23 p.1347 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, V.21 p.424

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
Idris ibn Abdullah Al-Qummi asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a newborn who is
born and dies on the seventh day. Should the Aqiqah be performed for him?
Imam {a.s} replied: “If he dies before noon, the Aqiqah is not performed for him. But if
he dies after noon, the Aqiqah should be performed for him."
text_ar:
وَ سَأَلَ إِذْرِيسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْقُمِّيْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلَاَمُ : عَنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ فَيَمُوتُ يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ هَلْ
يُعَقُّ عَنْهُ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ مَاتَ قَبْلَ الظَهْرِ لَمْ يُعَقَّ عَنْهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَاتَ بَعْدَ ٱلظُّهْرِ عُقَّ عَنْهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.39 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.487 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.447 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.445
text_chunk:
Idris ibn Abdullah Al-Qummi asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a newborn who is
born and dies on the seventh day. Should the Aqiqah be performed for him?
Imam {a.s} replied: “If he dies before noon, the Aqiqah is not performed for him. But if
he dies after noon, the Aqiqah should be performed for him."

وَ رَوَى عَمَّارْ السَّابَاطِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَذْبَحَ الْعَقِيقَةَ قُلْتَ «يَا قَوْمِ
إِنَّي بَرِيءُ مِمّا تُشْرِكُونَ إِنِّي وَجِّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا» مُسْلِماً «وَ مَا أَنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
» «إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَ نُسُكِي وَ مَحْيَايَ وَ مَمَاتِي لِلهِ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ بِذلِكَ أُمِرْتُ» وَ أَنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَ

In another narration from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s}, he said: "At the time of performing the Aqiqah, say:

'For You {SWT}, I have shed this blood, with no partner for You {SWT}. All praise is due to

Satan.'
As for circumcision, it is a Sunnah (recommended practice) for men and an honorable
practice (makramah) for women."
text_ar:
وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يُقَالُ عِنْدَ الْعَقِيقَةِ اللّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَ لَكَ مَا وَهَبْتَ وَ
أَنْتَ أَعْطَيْتَ اللَّهُمَّ فَتَقَبِّلْهُ مِنَّا عَلَى سُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ وَ تَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَ تُسَمِّي وَ تَذْبَحُ وَ تَقُولُ لَكَ
سَفَكْتُ الدِّمَاءَ لا شَرِيكَ لَكَ «وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ» اللَّهُمَّ اِخْسَا عَنَّا الشَّيْطَانَ الرَّجِيمَ ». وَ أَمَّا الْخِتَانُ فَإِنَّهُ
سُنَّةٌ فِي الرِّجَالِ وَ مَكْرُمَةٌ فِي النَّسَاءِ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim narrated from Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad {a.s} from his
father {a.s} who said that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}said:
"There is no harm if a woman is not circumcised, but as for a man, it is necessary for
him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى غِيَاتُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيًّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ: «لا بَأْسَ
أَنْ لا تَخْتَتِنَ الْمَرْأَةُ فَأَمَّا الرَّجُلُ فَلاَ بُدَّ مِنْهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON AQIQAH, TAHNIK, NAMING, KUNYAH, SHAVING THE NEWBORN’S HEAD, PIERCING THE EARS,
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari wrote to Imam Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn
Ali {a.s}, saying:
"It has been narrated from the Righteous Ones (peace be upon them) that they said:
'Circumcise your children on the seventh day so they may be purified, for the earth
complains to Allah
{SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, about the urine of the
uncircumcised.'
May Allah make me your ransom, but the barbers in our region are not skilled in this,
and they do not circumcise on the seventh day. However, we have a barber who is a
Jew. Is it permissible for the Jews to circumcise Muslim children or not?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “On the seventh day - do not oppose the Sunnah, God willing."
text_ar:
وَ - كَتَبَ عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ رُوِيَ عَنِ الصَّالِحِينَ
عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ «أَنِ اِخْتِنُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ يَطْهَرُوا فَإِنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ تَضِجُ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنْ بَوْلِ الْأَغْلَفِ» وَ
لَيْسَ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ لِحَجَامِي بَلَدِنَا جِذْقٌ بِذَلِكَ وَ لَاَ يَخْتِنُونَهُ يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ وَ عِنْدَنَا حَجَّامٌ مِنَ اَلْيَهُودِ فَهَلْ يَجُوزُ
لِلْيَهُودِ أَنْ يَخْتِنُوا أَوْلادَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ أَمْ لا فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ فَلا تُخَالِفُوا اَلسُنَنَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.488 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.229 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.123
