author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya narrated from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn
in a marfu‘ report, who said: Regarding the prescribed punishment (hadd) in travel, in
which if one commits adultery, he is not stoned if he is married, it was said:
"If he shortens the prayer and breaks his fast, then he is not considered married
(muhsan)."
text_ar:
[حدّ ما يكون المسافر فيه معذورا فى الرّجم دون الجلد]
5037 رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ: فِي الْحَدَّ فِي السَّفَرِ آلَّذِي إِذَا زَنَى
لَمْ يُرْجَمْ إِذَا كَانَ مُحْصَنا قَالَ «إِذَا قَصَّرَ وَ أَفْطَرَ فَلَيْسَ بِمُخْصَنِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.40 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.253

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
In the narration of Talhah ibn Zayd from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s} from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is reported that Imam Ali
ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: "There is no compensation (Uqr) upon a fornicator, and there is
no punishment upon a woman who was coerced (mukraha)."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِياً عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ
عَلَى زَانٍ عُقْرٌ وَ لا عَلَى مُسْتَكْرَهَةِ حَدَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.40 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.18 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.291 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.111

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
In the narration of Aṣim from Muhammad ibn Muslim, he said:
I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who commits
adultery but has not consummated marriage with his wife. Is he considered muhsan
(legally married and liable for stoning)?
Imam {a.s} replied: "No, and not with a bondwoman (amah) either."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَاصِمٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَزْنِي وَ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِأَهْلِهِ
أَيُحصَنُ قَالَ «لا وَ لا بِالْأَمَةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.40 • Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.511 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.16 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.251 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.78 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.76 p.40

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
Rifaah ibn Musa asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man who commits adultery
before consummating his marriage with his wife. Should he be stoned?
Imam {a.s} replied: "No."
I asked: “Should they be separated if he committed adultery before consummating the
marriage?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "No."

Scholar's Note:
And in another narration, it is stated: "The legal punishment (hadd) applies to him."
text_ar:
قَالَ وَ سَأَلَ رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبَا عَبْدِ اللْهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَزْنِي قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِأَهْلِهِ أَ يُرْجَمُ
قَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ هَلْ يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا إِذَا رَنَى قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخَلَ بِهَا قَالَ «لا».
وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آَخَرَ: عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ
commentary: And in another narration, it is stated: "The legal punishment (hadd) applies to him."
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.40

text_en:
Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them),
regarding a man who forcibly violated a Muslim woman.
Imam {a.s} said: "He is to be killed."
text_ar: - وَرَوَى جَمِيلٌ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَلاَمُ : فِي رَجْلٍ غَصَبَ إِمْرَأَةً مُسْلِمَةً نَفْسَهَا قَالَ «يُقْتَلُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.189 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.41 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.17 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.552 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.289 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.109

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
In the narration of Ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub from Burayd from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, regarding a man who forcibly violated a woman.
Imam {a.s} said: "He is to be killed, whether he is married or unmarried."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي رَجُلِ اِغْتَصَّبَ اِمْرَأَةً
فَرْجَهَا قَالَ «يُقْتَلُ مُخصَناً كَانَ أَوْ غَيْرَ مُحْصَنِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.41

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub, who heard Ibn
Bukayr narrating from one of the Imams (peace be upon them), it is reported:
"Whoever commits fornication with a close relative (one prohibited in marriage) until
intercourse occurs, he is to be struck with the sword in a blow that takes from him
whatever it takes.
And if she consented to him, she is to be struck with the sword in a blow that takes
from her whatever it takes."
It was asked: “And who carries out the punishment upon them when they have no
accuser?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “That is up to the Imam when the case is presented to him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ اِبْنَ بُكَيْرٍ يَرْوِي عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«مَنْ زَنَى بِذَاتِ مَحْرَمِ حَتَّى يُوَاقِعَهَا ضُرِبَ ضَرْبَةً بِالسَّيْفِ أَخَذَتْ مِنْهُ مَا أَخَذَتْ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ تَابَعَثْهُ ضُرِبَتْ ضَرْبَةً
بِالسَّيْفِ أَخَذَثْ مِنْهَا مَا أَخَذَتْ» قِيلَ وَ مَنْ يَضْرِبُهُمَا وَ لَيْسَ لَهُمَا خَصْمٌ قَالَ « ذَلِكَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ إِذَا رُفِعَا إِلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.190 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.41 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.23 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.208 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.293 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.113
text_chunk:
In the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub, who heard Ibn
Bukayr narrating from one of the Imams (peace be upon them), it is reported:
"Whoever commits fornication with a close relative (one prohibited in marriage) until
intercourse occurs, he is to be struck with the sword in a blow that takes from him
whatever it takes.
And if she consented to him, she is to be struck with the sword in a blow that takes
from her whatever it takes."
It was asked: “And who carries out the punishment upon them when they have no
accuser?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “That is up to the Imam when the case is presented to him."

text_en:
In the narration of Jamil from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, he said: "His neck is to be
struck,"
Or Imam {a.s} said: “His throat."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakuni, it was reported to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} that
a man had committed fornication with his father's wife, so Imam {a.s} ordered him to be
stoned, even though he was not married (non-muhṣan).
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ أَنَّهُ رُفِعَ إِلَى عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «رَجُلٌ وَقَعَ عَلَى اِمْرَأَةِ أَبِيهِ فَرَجَمَهُ وَ كَانَ غَيْرَ
مُخصَنِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT NECESSITATES DISCRETIONARY PUNISHMENT, LEGAL PUNISHMENT, STONING, EXECUTION, AND EXILE
text_en:
In the narration reported by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Riʾab from Abu
Ubaydah from Abu Jafar {a.s}, regarding a man upon whom a legal punishment (hadd)
was due but he was not punished until he became mentally disturbed.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he had confessed to the hadd upon himself while he was sound in
mind and free from any mental illness, then the hadd must be carried out on him
regardless of his current state."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ
وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ حَدُّ فَلَمْ يُصْرَبُ حَتَّى خُولِطَ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ أَوْجَبَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الْحَدَّ وَ هُوَ صَحِيحْ لا عِلَةَ بِهِ مِنْ ذَهَابِ
عَقْلٍ أَقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ كَائِناً مَا كَانَ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SODOMY
text_en:
In the narration reported by Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, he
said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who approached another man (committing
sodomy).
Imam {a.s} replied: "If the perpetrator was married (muhṣan), then his punishment is
execution, and if he was not married, then the legal punishment (hadd) applies to him."
I then asked: "What about the one who was approached?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "He must be executed in all cases, whether he was married or
unmarried."
text_ar:
بَابُ حَدِّ اللَّوَاطِ وَ السَّحْقِ
رَوَى حَمَّادُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ أَنَى رَجْلاً قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ مُحصَناً
فَعَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَثْلُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنُ مُحْصَنا فَعَلَيْهِ الْحَدّ» قُلْتُ فَمَا عَلَى ٱلْمُوْتَى بِهِ قَالَ «عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَثْلُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ مُخْصَنا
كَانَ أَوْ غَيْرَ مُخصَنٍ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.42 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.559

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SODOMY
text_en:
In the narration of Hisham and Hafṣ ibn Al-Bukhturi, it is reported that a group
of women entered upon Abu Abdullah {a.s}, and one of the women asked him about
lesbianism (Al-sahaq).
Imam {a.s} replied: "Its punishment is the same as that of the adulterer (Al-zani)."
A woman then said: “But Allah {SWT} has not mentioned that in the Qur'an."
Imam {a.s} replied: "Indeed, He {SWT} has."
She asked: “Where is it mentioned?"
Imam {a.s} said: "They are the people of Al-Rass (Ashab Al-Rass)."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ هِشَامٍ وَ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيِّ : أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ نِسْوَةً عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَسَأَلَثْهُ اِمْرَأَةً
مِنْهُنَّ عَنِ السِّحْقِ فَقَالَ «حَدُّهَا حَدُ ٱلزَّانِي» فَقَالَتِ اِمْرَأَةٌ مَا ذَكَرَ آَللَّهُ ذَلِكَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ فَقَالَ «بَلَى» فَقَالَتْ أَيْنَ هُوَ
قَالَ «هُنَّ أَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.42

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SODOMY AND TRIBADISM
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is reported that Imam Ali ibn
Abi Talib {a.s} said: "If it were appropriate for anyone to be stoned twice, it would be the
one who commits sodomy (Al-Luti)."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَوْ كَانَ
بَتْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُرْجَمَ مَرَّتَيْنِ لَرُجِمَ اللُّوطِيُّ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SODOMY AND TRIBADISM
text_en:
Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim Al-Bajali narrated from Abu Khadijah:
"It is not appropriate for two women to sleep under the same blanket unless there is a
barrier between them. If they do so, they should be prohibited from it, and if they are
found again after being warned in the same blanket, each of them should be lashed
the prescribed punishment.
If they are found a third time under the same blanket, they should be punished with
the prescribed punishment,
If they are found a fourth time under the same blanket, they should be executed.
And if a man approaches his wife and she carries his semen and uses it to commit
lesbian acts with her maid, resulting in pregnancy, the wife should be stoned, the maid
should be lashed, and the child should be attributed to the father."

Scholar's Note:
This narration was also reported from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Ishaq ibn Ammar from
Abu Abdullah {a.s}.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الرّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي هَاشِمِ الْبَجَلِي عَنْ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ قَالَ : «لا يَنْبَغِي لامْرَأَتَيْنِ أَنْ تَنَامَا فِي لِحَافٍ
وَاحِدٍ إِلاَّ وَ بَيْنَهُمَا حَاجِزٌ فَإِنْ فَعَلَتَا نُهِيَتَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَإِنْ وَجَدُوهُمَا بَعْدَ النَّهي فِي لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ جُلِدَتَا كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ
مِنْهُمَا حَدَّا حَدّا وَ إِنْ وُجِدَتَا الثَالِثَةَ فِي لِحَافٍ حُدَّتَا فَإِنْ وُجِدَتَا الرَّابِعَةَ فِي لِحَافٍ قُتِلَتَا وَ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ
فَاحْتَمَلَتْ مَاءَهُ فَسَاحَقَتْ بِهِ جَارِيَتَهُ فَحَمَلَتْ رُجِمَتِ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ وَ جُلِدَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ وَ أَلْحِقَ ٱلْوَلَدُ بِأَبِيهِ».
رُوِيَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع.

This narration was also reported from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Ishaq ibn Ammar from
Abu Abdullah {a.s}.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN
text_en:
Ibrahim bin Hashim narrated from Al-Asbagh bin Al-Asbagh. He said:
Muhammad bin Sulayman Al-Misri narrated to me from Marwan bin Muslim from
Ubayd bin Zurarah or from Burayd Al-Ijli (the doubt is from Muhammad), who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a slave who commits adultery.
Imam {a.s} said: “He is to be lashed half the prescribed punishment."
I asked: “What if he does it again?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “He is to be lashed the same amount."
I asked: “What if he repeats it again?"
Imam {a.s} said: “He is not to be given more than half the prescribed punishment."
I asked: “Is he ever liable for stoning due to any of his actions?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “Yes, he is to be killed on the eighth offense if he does it eight times."
I asked: “What is the difference between him and a free man when their actions are
the same?"
Imam {a.s} said: “Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, had mercy on him by not
combining the burden of slavery and the punishment of a free man upon him."
Then Imam {a.s} said: “It is obligatory upon the leader of the Muslims to pay his price to
his master from the zakat share allocated for freeing slaves."
text_ar:
بَابُ حَدِّ الْمَمَالِيكِ فِي الزِّنَا
رَوَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ عَنِ الْأَصْبَعِ بْنِ الْأَصْبَعِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْمِصْرِيُّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ
مُسْلِمِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ أَوْ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ ٱلْعِجْلِيّ الشَّكْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَبْدٌ زَنَى
فَقَالَ «يُجْلَدُ نِصْفَ الحَدِّ» قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ عَادَ قَالَ «فَيُضْرَبُ مِثلَ ذَلِكَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ عَادَ قَالَ «لا يُزَادُ عَلَى نِصْفِ
اَلْحَدِّ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَهَلْ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ الرَّجْمُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ يُقْتَلُ فِي ٱلتَّامِنَةِ إِنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ ثَمَانَ مَرَّاتٍ»
قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا الْفَرْقُ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ الْحُرِّ وَ إِنَّمَا فِعْلُهُمَا وَاحِدٌ قَالَ «إِنَّ اللهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى رَحِمَهُ أَنْ يَجْمَعَ عَلَيْهِ رِبْقَ
الرِّقُّ وَ حَدَّ الْحُرِّ» قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «وَ عَلَى إِمَامِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ ثَمَنَّهُ إِلَى مَوْلاهُ مِنْ سَهْمِ الرِّقَابِ».
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.2 p.93 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.44 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.325 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.802 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.93 p.59

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Harith ibn Al-Ahwal from Burayd Al-
ʿIjli from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} regarding a slave woman who
commits adultery.
Imam {a.s} said: “She is to be lashed half the prescribed punishment, whether she has
a husband or does not have a husband."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ الْعِجْلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي
أَمَةِ تَزْنِي قَالَ «تُجْلَدُ نِصْفَ الْحَدِّ كَانَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا زَوْجٌ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Riʾab from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"The prescribed punishment for Umm Al-Walad (a slave woman who has borne a child
for her master) is the same as that of a slave woman if she has not borne a child."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «أُمْ ٱلْوَلَدِ حَدُّهَا حَدْ
اَلْأَمَةِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا وَلَدٌ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.45 • Al-Wafi, Vol.10 p.662 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.150
text_chunk:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Riʾab from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"The prescribed punishment for Umm Al-Walad (a slave woman who has borne a child
for her master) is the same as that of a slave woman if she has not borne a child."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Nuaym ibn Ibrahim from Mismaʿ Abu Sayyar from
Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said: “The liability of umm Al-walad (a slave woman who has
borne a child to her master) concerning the rights of people is upon her master."
Imam {a.s} also said: “As for the rights of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, regarding prescribed
punishments, that is upon her own body."
Furthermore, Imam {a.s} said: “Retribution (qiṣaṣ) applies between her and other
slaves, but there is no retribution between a free person and a slave."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ أَبِي سَيَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «أُمْ
الْوَلَدِ جِنَايَتُهَا فِي حُقُوقِ النَّاسِ عَلَى سَيِّدِهَا» قَالَ «وَ مَا كَانَ مِنْ حَقُّ اللهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي الْحُدُودِ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي
بَدَنِها» وَ قَالَ «يُقَاصُّ مِنْهَا لِلْمَمَالِيكِ وَ لاَ قِصَاصَ بَيْنَ الْحُرِّ وَ ٱلْعَبْدِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Anbasah ibn MuṣAb who
said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "If my bondwoman commits adultery, should I
administer the prescribed punishment on her?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes, but let it be done in secrecy, for I fear the ruler’s authority upon
you."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ مُصْعَبِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
إنْ زَنَتْ جَارِيَةٌ لِي أَحُدُهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَيَكُنْ ذَلِكَ فِي سِرِّ فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكَ السُّلْطَانَ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from Ṣalih ibn Al-Sindi from Al-Husayn ibn
Khalid who reported from Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s}:
Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who had a slave woman. The slave woman said to
him, "I have paid part of my emancipation contract, so I am free according to that
portion."
He replied: “Yes."
After she had paid part of her contract, her master had intercourse with her.
The Imam {a.s} said: “If he forced her into that act, he will be punished in proportion to
what she had paid of her contract, and the punishment will be waived for him in
proportion to what remained of her contract. However, if she willingly participated
with him, she will share the punishment equally with him and will be lashed the same
amount."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السْلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ
عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَمَةً فَقَالَتِ الْأَمَةُ لَهُ مَا أَدّيْتُ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِي فَأْنَا بِهِ حُرَّةُ عَلَى حِسَابٍ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهَا نَعَمْ فَأْدّثْ
بَعْضَ مُكَاتَبَتِهَا وَ جَامَعَهَا مَوْلاَهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «إِنِ اِسْتَكْرَهَهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ ضُرِبَ مِنَ ٱلْحَدِّ بِقَدْرِ مَا أَدَّتْ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهَا
وَ دُرِئ عَنْهُ مِنَ اَلْحَدِّ بِقَدْرٍ مَا بَقِيَ لَهُ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ تَابَعَتْهُ كَانَتْ شَرِيكَتَهُ فِي الْحَدِّ ضُرِبَتْ مِثْلَ مَا
يُضْرَبُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.186 • Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.237 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.45 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.268 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.29 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.36 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.210 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.320 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.151 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.139

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who took
possession of a slave woman from the spoils of war (Al-fay') and had intercourse with
her before the division of the spoils.
Imam {a.s} said: “The slave woman should be appraised and handed over to him for her
value, and his share from the spoils should be deducted from that amount. He should
be lashed according to the imposed punishment, and punishment will be reduced in
proportion to his share in her."
It was then asked: “Why is the slave woman handed over to him for her value instead
of to someone else?"
Imam {a.s} said: “Because he had intercourse with her, and it is feared that she might
be pregnant."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَ جَارِيَةً مِنَ الْفَيءِ فَوَطِئَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ قَالَ «تُقَوَّمُ
اَلْجَارِيَةُ وَ تُدْفَعُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْقِيمَةِ وَ يُحَطْ لَهُ مِنْهَا مَا يُصِيبُهُ مِنْهَا مِنَ الْفَيْءِ وَ يُجْلَدُ الْحَدَّ وَ يُدْرَأْ عَنْهُ مِنَ الْحَدِّ بِقَدْرٍ
مَا كَانَ لَهُ فِيهَا» فَقِيلَ فَكَيْفَ صَارَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ تُدْفَعُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْقِيمَةِ دُونَ غَيْرِهَا قَالَ «لِأَنَّهُ وَطِئَهَا وَ لا يُوْمَنُ أَنْ يَكُونَ
ثَمَّ حَمْلٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.194 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.46 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.30 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.319 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.120

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT OF SLAVES IN ADULTERY
text_en:
Sulayman bin Khalid narrated from Abu Abdullah, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad
Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a slave jointly owned by two men, where one of them
freed his share. Later, the slave committed an offense that warranted one of Allah’s
{SWT} prescribed punishments.
The Imam {a.s} said: “If, at the time half of him was freed, he was appraised so that the
one who freed him could pay half of his value to the other partner, then half of him is
free, and he should receive half the punishment prescribed for a free person and half
the punishment prescribed for a slave. However, if he was not appraised, then he
remains a slave and should receive the full punishment prescribed for a slave."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ : فِي عَبْدِ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَعْتَقَ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ ثُمَّ
إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ أَنَّى حَدّاً مِنْ حُدُودِ اللهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ الْعَبْدُ حَيْثُ أَعْتِقَ نِصْفُهُ قُوِّمَ لِيُغَرَّمَ اَلَّذِي أَعْتَقَهُ نِصْفَ
قِيمَتِهِ فَنِصْفُهُ حُرُّ يُضْرَبُ نِصْفَ حَدَّ الْحُرِّ وَ يُضْرَبُ نِصْفَ حَدِّ ٱلْعَبْدِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قُوَّمَ فَهُوَ عَبْدٌ يُضْرَبُ حَدَّ ٱلْعَبْدِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.46 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.137

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR INTERCOURSE WITH AN ANIMAL
text_en:
Abbad bin Kathir Al-Basri narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s}, who said: "For mukatab slaves (contracted for emancipation), if they commit
fornication, they are to be lashed in proportion to what they have paid towards their
emancipation with the punishment of a free person, and for the remaining portion,
they are lashed with the punishment of a slave."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبَّادُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ الْبَصْرِيُّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «فِي الْمُكَاتَبَيْنِ إِذَا فَجَرَا يُصْرَبَانِ
مِنَ الْحَدِّ بِقَدْرٍ مَا أَدَّيَا مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِمَا حَدَّ الْحُرِّ وَ يُضْرَبَانِ الْبَاقِيَ حَدَّ الْمَمْلُوكِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.47 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.328 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.138

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR
text_en:
Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Ishaq bin Jarir from Sadeer from Abu
Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} was asked about a man who engages in
intercourse with an animal.
Imam {a.s} said: "He is to be lashed with a punishment less than the prescribed limit and
must compensate the owner for the value of the animal because he has corrupted it
for him.
If it is an animal whose meat is consumed, it must be slaughtered, burned, and buried.
If it is an animal that is ridden, he must pay its value, be lashed with a punishment less
than the prescribed limit, and take it out of the city where he committed the act to
another land where it is not known, and sell it there so that he is not disgraced by it."
text_ar:
بَابُ حَدِّ مَنْ أَنَى بَهِيمَةً
رَوَى اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي
الْبَهِيمَةَ قَالَ «يُجْلَدُ دُونَ الْحَدِّ وَ يُعْرَمُ قِيمَةَ الْبَهِيمَةِ لِصَاحِبِهَا لِأَنْهُ أَفْسَدَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَ تُذْبَحُ وَ ثُحْرَقُ وَ تُدْفَنُ إِنْ كَانَ
مِمَّا يُوكَلُ لَحْمُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِمَّا يُرْكَبُ ظَهْرُهُ أَغْرِمَ قِيمَتَهَا وَ جُلِدَ دُونَ الْحَدِّ وَ أُخْرَجَهَا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ الَّتِي فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ
بِهَا إِلَى بِلادٍ أُخْرَى حَيْثُ لا تُعْرَفُ فَيَبِيعُهَا فِيهَا كَنْ لا يُعَيَّرَ بِهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.204 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.47 • Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.538 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.61 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.223 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.346 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.358 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.76 p.78

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR A
text_en:
Ibrahim bin Hashim narrated from Salih bin Al-Sindi from Muhammad bin
Sulayman Al-Basri from Abdullah bin Sinan.
He said: I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "Inform me about the qawwad (panderer), what is
his prescribed punishment?"
The Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no hadd (fixed legal punishment) on the qawwad. is he
not merely receiving payment for facilitating?"
I said: "May I be your ransom, but he is bringing together a man and a woman
unlawfully."
Imam {a.s} said: "That is the one who arranges unlawful meetings between a man and a
woman."
I said: "Yes, that is the case, may I be your ransom."
Imam {a.s} said: "He is to be lashed three-quarters of the punishment of a fornicator -
seventy-five lashes - and he is to be exiled from the city in which he resides."
text_ar:
بَابُ حَدَّ الْقَوَّادِ
رَوَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ السِّنْدِيّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الْبَصْرِيَّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ:
قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع أُخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الْقَوَّادِ مَا حَدُّهُ قَالَ «لا حَدَّ عَلَى القَوَّادِ أَ لَيْسَ إِنَّمَا يُعْطَى الْأَجْرَ عَلَى أَنْ يَقُودَ»
قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّمَا يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الذَّكَرِ وَ الْأَنْثَى حَرَاماً قَالَ «ذَاكَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَ الذَّكَرِ وَ الْأُنْثَى حَرَاماً» فَقُلْتُ هُوَ
ذَاكَ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَالَ «يُضْرَبُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَرْبَاعِ حَدَّ ٱلزَّانِي خَمْسَةً وَ سَبْعِينَ سَوْطاً وَ يُنْفَى مِنَ ٱلْمِصْرِ الَّذِي هُوَ فِيهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.47 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.171
text_chunk:
Ibrahim bin Hashim narrated from Salih bin Al-Sindi from Muhammad bin
Sulayman Al-Basri from Abdullah bin Sinan.
He said: I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "Inform me about the qawwad (panderer), what is
his prescribed punishment?"
The Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no hadd (fixed legal punishment) on the qawwad. is he
not merely receiving payment for facilitating?"
I said: "May I be your ransom, but he is bringing together a man and a woman
unlawfully."
Imam {a.s} said: "That is the one who arranges unlawful meetings between a man and a
woman."
I said: "Yes, that is the case, may I be your ransom."
Imam {a.s} said: "He is to be lashed three-quarters of the punishment of a fornicator -
seventy-five lashes - and he is to be exiled from the city in which he resides."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR A
text_en:
In a narration: Messenger of Allah {SWT} cursed Al-wasilah and Al-muṭasilah.

Scholar's Note:
This refers to the fornicating woman (zaniyah) and the female procurer (qawwadah) in
this narration.
(Al-Wasilah refers to woman who engages in immoral relationships, interpreted as an
adulteress or prostitute.)
(Al-Muwattasilah refers to woman who facilitates such unlawful relationships, often
interpreted as a female procurer or panderer.)
text_ar:
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَ ٱلْمُوتَصِلَةَ.
يَعَنِي الزَّانِيَةَ وَ الْقَوَّادَةَ فِي هَذَا الْخَبَرِ.
commentary:
This refers to the fornicating woman (zaniyah) and the female procurer (qawwadah) in

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR
text_en:
Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} regarding a man who accuses his wife (of adultery).
Imam {a.s} said: “He is to be flogged."
I asked: “What if she pardons him?"
Imam {a.s} said: “No, and no honor (for him)."
text_ar:
بَابٌ حَدِّ الْقَذْفِ
رَوَى اَلْعَلاءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : فِي الَّذِي يَقْذِفُ اِمْرَأْتَهُ قَالَ «يُجْلَدُ» قُلْتُ
أَرَأْيْتَ إِنْ عَفَتْ عَنْهُ قَالَ «لا وَ لاَ كَرَامَةً».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR
text_en:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Hammad ibn Ziyad from Sulayman ibn Khalid from
Abu Abdullah {a.s} regarding a man who said to his wife after consummating the
marriage, "I did not find you a virgin"
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no legal punishment upon him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ : فِي رَجْلٍ
قَالَ لامْرَأَتِهِ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ لَمْ أَجِدْكِ عَذْرَاءَ قَالَ «لا حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.48 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.78 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.22 p.438

In another narration, Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, the hymen may be lost without
intercourse; it can be lost due to injury, stumbling, or falling."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
In the narration of Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s} from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} would not administer the legal punishment for
insinuation unless it was a clear and explicit accusation, such as saying, 'O’ adulterer,'
or 'O’ son of an adulteress,' or 'You are not your father's son.'"
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ وَهْبِ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «أَنّْ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ لَمْ يَكُنْ
يَحُدُّ فِي التَّعْرِيضِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ بِالْفِرْيَةِ الْمُصَرَّحَةِ مِثْلِ يَا زَانِ وَ يَا اِبْنَ الزَّانِيَةِ أَوْ لَسْتَ لِأَبِيكَ».
cross_references: Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.54 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.155 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.49 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.368 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.205 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.76 p.117

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abbad ibn Suhayb who said:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked about a Christian who accused a Muslim by saying to him,
"O’ adulterer."
Imam {a.s} said: “He is to be flogged eighty lashes for violating the right of the Muslim
and eighty lashes minus one for violating the sanctity of Islam. His head is to be
shaved, and he is to be paraded among the people of his religion so that others may
be deterred."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ صُهَيْبِ قَالَ: سُبِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ نَصْرَانِيّ قَذَفَ
مُسْلِماً فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا زَانٍ قَالَ «يُجْلَدُ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً لِحَقُّ الْمُسْلِمِ وَ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً إِلاَّ سَوْطاً لِحُرْمَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ وَ يُحْلَقُ
رَأْسُهُ وَ يُطَافُ بِهِ فِي أُهْلِ دِينِهِ لِكَيْ يُنَكَّلَ غَيْرُهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.239 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.49 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.75 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.380 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.199

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
It was narrated from Safwan from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from Imam Abu
Abdullah {a.s} who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who slanders a man from the pre-
Islamic Arabs.
Imam {a.s} said: “He is to be given the legal punishment."
I asked: “Is he to be given the legal punishment?"
He said: “Yes, because that offense reaches the Messenger of Allah {SWT}."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَفْتَرِي
عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ جَاهِلِيَّةِ الْعَرَبِ قَالَ «يُضْرَبُ حَدَأ» قُلْتُ يُضْرَبُ حَدَأ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.49 • Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.393 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.16 p.37 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.16 p.254 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.64 p.174

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Ja'far ibn Bashir narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala from Abu Makhlad
Al-Sarraj from Abu Abdullah {a.s}: Imam {a.s} ruled concerning a man who called another
"the son of a madman," and the other replied to him, "Rather, you are the son of a
madman."
Imam {a.s} commanded the first man to flog his companion twenty lashes and said:
“Know that you will also be given twenty lashes in return."
After the first man flogged him, the flogged man was given the whip and he flogged the
first man twenty lashes as a means of punishment to discipline both of them.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ عَنْ أَبِي مَخْلَدِ السِّرَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ : أَنَّهُ قَضَى
فِي رَجُلٍ دَعَا آخَرَ اِبْنَ الْمَجْنُونِ وَ قَالَ الْآخَرُ لَهُ بَلْ أَنْتَ اِبْنُ الْمَجْنُونِ فَأَمَرَ الْأَوَّلَ أَنْ يَجْلِدَ صَاحِبَهُ عِشَرِينَ جَلْدَةً
وَ قَالَ «اِعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ سَتُعَقَّبُ مِثلَهَا عِشرِينَ فَلَمَّا جَلَدَهُ أَعْطَى الْمَجْلُودَ السّوْطَ فَجَلَدَهُ عِشرِينَ نَكَالاً يُنَكَلُهُمَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.242 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.49 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.81 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.510 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.203 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.72 p.298

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal narrated from Uqbah ibn Khalid from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who said to his wife, "O’
adulteress."
Imam {a.s} said: “He is to be given the legal punishment and they are to be separated
after he has been flogged, and she will no longer be his wife."
Imam {a.s} further said: “But if he said something that slipped out unintentionally
without having any knowledge of it, intending only to anger her, then they are not to be
separated."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ هِلالٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ
رَجُلٍ قَالَ لإِمْرَأْتِهِ يَا زَانِيَةُ قَالَ «يُجْلَدُ حَدّا وَ يُفَرّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا بَعْدَ مَا جُلِدَ وَ لاَ تَكُونُ اِمْرَأْتَهُ» قَالَ »وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَالَ
كَلاماً أَفلَتَ مِنْهُ فِي غَيْرِ أَنْ يَعْلَمَ شَيْئاً أَرَادَ أَنْ يَغيظَهَا بِهِ فَلا يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا)».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.50 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.88 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.363 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.218

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} said: "If there is doubt expressed with
'perhaps' or 'it may be' in enforcing a legal punishment, then the punishment is to be
suspended."
text_ar: - وَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ: «إِذَا كَانَ فِي ٱلْحَدَّ لَعَلَ أَوْ عَسَى فَالْحَدّ مُعَطَّلٌ».
cross_references: Da’a’im Al-Islam, Vol.2 p.465 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.50 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.553 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.47 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.27

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The one who accuses a
foundling (laqiṭ) of fornication is subjected to the prescribed punishment (hadd). And
if a woman accuses her husband of fornication while he is deaf, they are separated,
and she is never permissible for him again."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «قَاذِفُ اللَّقِيطِ يُحَدُّ وَ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا قَذَفَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَ هُوَ أَصَمُ يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا ثُمَّ
لا تَجِلُّ لَهُ أَبَداً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.50 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.190

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked about a man who accused his wife of adultery while she
was mute and deaf, unable to hear what he said.
Imam {a.s} said: “If she has witnesses who testify on her behalf before the Imam, he (the
husband) is to be flogged with the legal punishment and they are to be separated, and
she will never be permissible for him again. But if she has no witnesses, then she is
forbidden to him as long as she remains with him, and there is no sin upon her from
him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أُبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ
قَذَفَ اِمْرَأْتَهُ بِالزَّنَا وَ هِيَ خَرْسَاءُ صَمَاءُ لاَ تَسْمَعُ مَا قَالَ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ لَهَا بَيِّنَةٌ يَشهَدُونَ لَهَا عِنْدَ الْإِمَامِ جَلَدَهُ
اَلْحَدَّ وَ فَرّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا ثُمَّ لا تَجِلُّ لَهُ أُبَداً وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا بَيِّنَةٌ فَهِيَ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا أَقَامَ مَعَهَا وَ لا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.166 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.50 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.7 p.310 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.193 • Al-Wafi, Vol.21 p.285 • Al-Wafi, Vol.22 p.962 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.22 p.427
text_chunk:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked about a man who accused his wife of adultery while she
was mute and deaf, unable to hear what he said.
Imam {a.s} said: “If she has witnesses who testify on her behalf before the Imam, he (the
husband) is to be flogged with the legal punishment and they are to be separated, and
she will never be permissible for him again. But if she has no witnesses, then she is
forbidden to him as long as she remains with him, and there is no sin upon her from
him."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakuni, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Whoever acknowledges a child and then denies him is to be given the legal
punishment and held responsible for the child."
text_ar: - وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ أَنَّ عَلِيَاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَقَرَّ بِوَلَدٍ ثُمَّ نَفَاهُ جُلِدَ الْحَدِّ وَ الْزِمَ الْوَلَدَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.261 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.51 • Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.125 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.87 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.364 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1427 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.209 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.17 p.214 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.104

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
In the narration of Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman from some of his narrators from
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, he said: "Every adult, whether male or female, who falsely accuses
a minor or an adult, a male or a female, a Muslim, a free person, or a slave, is subject
to the prescribed punishment (hadd Al-firya).
And for one who is not yet an adult, the punishment is disciplinary (hadd Al-adab)."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ بَعْضِ رِجَالِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «كُلُّ بَالغٍ مِنْ
ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أَنثَى اِفْتَرَى عَلَى صَغِيرٍ أَوْ كَبِيرٍ أَوْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أَنتَى أَوْ مُسْلِمِ أَوْ حُرِّ أَوْ مَمْلُوكٍ فَعَلَيْهِ حَدُ ٱلْفِرْيَةِ وَ عَلَى غَيْرٍ
اَلْبَالِغِ حَدُّ الْأَدَبِ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.51 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.89 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.360 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.186

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"There is no legal punishment upon a mad person until they regain sanity, nor upon a
child until they reach maturity, nor upon a sleeping person until they wake up."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ : «لا حَدَّ عَلَى مَجْنُونٍ حَتَّى يُفِيقَ وَ لاَ عَلَى الصِّبِيِّ حَتَّى يُذْرِكَ وَ لاَ عَلَى ٱلنَّائِمِ
حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.51 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.152 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.282 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.22 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.512 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.76 p.88 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.13

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Ala and Abu Ayyub from Muhammad
ibn Muslim from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} regarding a man who
said to his wife, "O’ adulteress, I have committed adultery with you,"
Imam {a.s} said: “He is liable for one legal punishment for accusing her. As for his
statement, 'I have committed adultery with you,' there is no legal punishment for that
unless he testifies against himself four times for committing adultery before the
Imam."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ وَ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي
رَجُلٍ قَالَ لامْرَأَتِهِ يَا زَانِيَةُ أَنَا زَنَّيْتُ بِكِ قَالَ «عَلَيْهِ حَدُّ وَاجِدٌ لِقَذْفِهِ إِيَّاهَا وَ أَمَّا قَوْلُهُ أَنَا زَنَيْتُ بِكِ فَلاَ حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ
فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشَهَدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ بِالزِّنَا عِنْدَ الْإِمَامِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.211 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.51 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.76 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.4 p.263 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.195

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Nu'aym ibn Ibrahim from Misma Abu
Sayyar from Abu Abdullah {a.s} regarding four people who testified against a woman for
adultery, and one of them was her husband.
Imam {a.s} said: “The three (other witnesses) are to be flogged, and her husband is to
perform lian (mutual cursing) with her. They are to be separated, and she will never be
permissible for him again."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ أَبِي سَيَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ :
فِي أَرْبَعَةٍ شَهِدُوا عَلَى اِمْرَأَةٍ بِالْفُجُورِ أَحَدُهُمْ زَوْجُهَا قَالَ «يُجْلَدُونَ الثَّلَاَثَةُ وَ يُلاعِنُهَا زَوْجُهَا وَ يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ لا
تَجِلُّ لَهُ أَبَداً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.52 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.79 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.260 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.22 p.432

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
It has been narrated: "Indeed, the husband is considered one of the
witnesses."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said:
These two narrations are in agreement and not contradictory. This is because
whenever four people testify against a woman for adultery, and one of them is her
husband who does not deny his child, the husband is counted as one of the witnesses.
However, if he denies his child while testimony is established against her for adultery,
the three others are to be flogged with the legal punishment, and the husband must
perform lian (mutual cursing) with her, leading to their separation, and she will never
be permissible for him again.
This is because lian only occurs when the child is denied.
Additionally, if a slave accuses a free person of adultery, he is to be flogged eighty
lashes because this falls under the rights of the people.
text_ar:
وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ الزَّوْجَ أَحَدُ الشُُّهُودِ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ: هَذَانِ الْحَدِيثَانِ مُتّفِقَانٍ غَيْرُ مُخْتَلِفَيْنِ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ مَتَّى شَهِدَ أَرْبَعَةً عَلَى امْرَأَةِ بِالْفُجُورِ
أَحَدُهُمْ زَوْجُهَا وَ لَمْ يَنْفِ وَلَدَهَا فَالزَّوْجُ أَحَدُ الشُّهُودِ وَ مَتَى نَفَى وَلَدَهَا مَعَ إِقَامَةِ الشَّهَادَةِ عَلَيْهَا بِالزِّنَا جُلِدَ الثَّلَاثَةُ الْحَدَّ وَ
لَاعَنَهَا زَوْجُهَا وَ فُرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ لَمْ تَجِلَ لَهُ أُبَداَ لِأَنَّ اللَّعَانَ لَا يَكُونُ إِلّا بِنَفْيِ الْوَلَدِ وَ إِذَا قَذَفَ عَبْدٌ حُرَا جُلِدَ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً لِأَنَّ
هَذَا مِنْ حُقُوقِ النَّاسِ.
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said:
These two narrations are in agreement and not contradictory. This is because
whenever four people testify against a woman for adultery, and one of them is her
husband who does not deny his child, the husband is counted as one of the witnesses.
However, if he denies his child while testimony is established against her for adultery,
the three others are to be flogged with the legal punishment, and the husband must
perform lian (mutual cursing) with her, leading to their separation, and she will never
be permissible for him again.
This is because lian only occurs when the child is denied.
Additionally, if a slave accuses a free person of adultery, he is to be flogged eighty
lashes because this falls under the rights of the people.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abd Al-Rahman from Ubayd ibn Zurarah
who said: I heard Abu Abdullah {a.s} say, "If a man were brought to me who had accused
a Muslim slave of adultery, and we knew nothing about the slave except goodness, I
would administer the legal punishment upon him - the same punishment as for a free
person, except one lash less."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «لَوْ أَتِيتُ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ قَذَفَ عَبْداً مُسْلِماً بِالزَّنَا لا نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إلا خَيْراً لَضَرَبْثُهُ ٱلْحَدَّ حَدَّ ٱلْحُرّ إلاَّ سَوْطاً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.208 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.52 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.71 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.373 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.178 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.575 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.9 p.248

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hammad ibn Ziyad from Sulayman ibn
Khalid from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
"Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} was asked about a mukatab (a slave who has a contract for
freedom) who falsely accused a Muslim man.
Imam {a.s} said: ‘He is to be flogged with the punishment of a free man - eighty lashes -
whether he has paid any part of his contract or not.'
It was asked: ‘What if he commits adultery while he is a mukatab and has not paid
anything from his contract?'
Imam {a.s} said: ‘This is the right of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic. Fifty lashes are
waived from him, and he is to be flogged fifty lashes.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«سُئِلَ عَلِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ مُكَاتَبِ اِفْتَرَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمِ فَقَالَ «يُضْرَبُ حَدَّ اَلْحُرِّ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةَ أَدْى مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ
شيْئاً أوْ لَمْ يُؤْدِّ» قِيلَ لَهُ فَإِنْ زَنَى وَ هُوَ مُكَاتَبٌ وَ لَمْ يُؤْدِّ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ شَيْئاً قَالَ «هَذَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ يُطْرَحُ
عَنْهُ خَمْسُونَ جَلْدَةً وَ يُضْرَبُ خَمْسِينَ» ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.236 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.52 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.376

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Ibn Mahbub narrated from Malik ibn Atiyyah from Abu Basir from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} regarding a woman who accused a man (of adultery).
Imam {a.s} said: “She is to be flogged eighty lashes."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةً عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ [عَبْدِ اللّهِ خ ل] عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ :
فِي اِمْرَأَةٍ قَذَفَتْ رَجُلاً قَالَ «تُجْلَدُ ثَمَانِينَ جَلَدَةً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.205 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.53 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.358 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.175 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.4 p.48

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from Al-Ala ibn Al-Fudayl from Imam Abu
Abdullah {a.s}:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who denies his child after having acknowledged him.
Imam {a.s} said: “If the child is from a free woman, the father is to be flogged fifty lashes,
which is the punishment for a slave. But if the child is from a slave woman, there is no
punishment upon him."
And if a man says to another man: "You commit the act of the people of Lut (engaging
in relations with men)," he is to be flogged eighty lashes.
Similarly, if he says to him: "O’ effeminate one" or "O’ one who is penetrated," he is to
be flogged with the legal punishment for slander - eighty lashes.
If a man slanders a group of people with a single statement without naming them
individually, he is subjected to one legal punishment. However, if he names them
specifically, then a separate legal punishment applies to each person he named.
This was narrated by Burayd Al-Ijli from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s}.
It has also been narrated: "If they (the slandered individuals) come forward separately,
each one of them receives a separate punishment. But if they come forward
collectively, only one punishment is administered.
If a man slanders another and is flogged, but then repeats the slander, and if he says,
'What I said to you is true,' he is not flogged again.
However, if he accuses him of adultery again after being flogged, the legal punishment
applies. Yet, if he accuses him ten times before being flogged, only one punishment
will be administered."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ بْنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يَنْتَفِي
مِنْ وَلَدِهِ وَ قَدْ أَقَرَّ بِهِ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْوَلَدُ مِنْ حُرَّةٍ جُلِدَ الْأَبُ خَمْسِينَ سَوْطاً حَدَّ ٱلْمَمْلُوكِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَمَةٍ فَلاَ
شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ». وَ إِذَا قَالَ رَجُلْ لِرَجُلٍ إِنَّكَ تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطِ تَنْكِحُ الرِّجَالَ ضُرِبَ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَ كَذَلِكَ إِنْ قَالَ
لَهُ يَا مَعْفُوجُ يَا مَنْكُوحُ جُلِدَ حَدَّ ٱلْقَاذِفِ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَ إِنْ قَذَفَ رَجُلٌ قَوْماً بِكَلِمَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ فَعَلَيْهِ حَدْ وَاحِدٌ إِذَا لَمْ
يُسَمَّهِمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ وَ إِنْ سَمَّاهُمْ فَعَلَيْهِ لِكُلِّ رَجُلٍ سَمَّاهُ حَدُّ رَوَى ذَلِكَ بُرَيْدٌ الْعِجْلِيُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ.
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُمْ إِنْ أَتَوا بِهِ مُتَفَرَّقِينَ ضُرِبَ لِكُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ حَدَا وَاجِداً وَ إنْ أَتَوْا بِهِ مُجْتَمِعِينَ ضُرِبَ حَدَا وَاجِداً
وَ إِنْ قَذَفَ رَجُلٌ رَجُلاً فَجُلِدَ ثُمَّ عَادَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْقَذْفِ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَالَ إِنَّ الَّذِي قُلْتُ لَكَ حَقُّ لَمْ يُجْلَدْ وَ إِنْ قَذَفَهُ بِالزِّنَا
بَعْدَ مَا جُلِدَ فَعَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ وَ إِنْ قَذَفَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُجْلَدَ بِعَشَرِ قَذَفَاتٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ حَدُّ وَاحِدٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.262 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.53 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.83 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.209
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from Al-Ala ibn Al-Fudayl from Imam Abu
Abdullah {a.s}:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who denies his child after having acknowledged him.
Imam {a.s} said: “If the child is from a free woman, the father is to be flogged fifty lashes,
which is the punishment for a slave. But if the child is from a slave woman, there is no
punishment upon him."
And if a man says to another man: "You commit the act of the people of Lut (engaging
in relations with men)," he is to be flogged eighty lashes.
Similarly, if he says to him: "O’ effeminate one" or "O’ one who is penetrated," he is to
be flogged with the legal punishment for slander - eighty lashes.
If a man slanders a group of people with a single statement without naming them
individually, he is subjected to one legal punishment. However, if he names them
specifically, then a separate legal punishment applies to each person he named.
This was narrated by Burayd Al-Ijli from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s}.
It has also been narrated: "If they (the slandered individuals) come forward separately,
each one of them receives a separate punishment. But if they come forward
collectively, only one punishment is administered.
If a man slanders another and is flogged, but then repeats the slander, and if he says,
'What I said to you is true,' he is not flogged again.
However, if he accuses him of adultery again after being flogged, the legal punishment
applies. Yet, if he accuses him ten times before being flogged, only one punishment
will be administered."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no legal punishment for one upon whom legal punishment does not apply."

Scholar's Note:
This means that if a mad person accuses a man of adultery, no legal punishment is
imposed on him. Likewise, if someone accuses a mad person by saying to him, "O’
adulterer," there is no legal punishment for it.
This was narrated by Abu Ayyub from Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Abdullah {a.s}.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «لا حَدَّ لِمَنْ لاَ حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ».
يَعْنِي لَوْ أَنَّ مَجْنُوناً قَذَفَ رَجُلاً لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ حَدّ وَ لَوْ قَذَفَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا زَانِ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ حَدَّ رَوَى ذَلِكَ أَبُو أَيُوبَ عَنْ
فُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ.
commentary:
This means that if a mad person accuses a man of adultery, no legal punishment is
imposed on him. Likewise, if someone accuses a mad person by saying to him, "O’
adulterer," there is no legal punishment for it.
This was narrated by Abu Ayyub from Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Abdullah {a.s}.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Ammar Al-Sabati from Abu Abdullah {a.s}
regarding a man who said to another man, "O’ son of an adulteress," intending
adultery.
Imam {a.s} said: “If his mother is alive and present, and she comes forward to claim her
right, the accuser is to be flogged eighty lashes.
If she is absent, it is to be delayed until she returns and claims her right.
And if she has passed away and nothing is known of her except goodness, the one who
falsely accused her is to be given the legal punishment - eighty lashes."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ يَا اِبْنَ
الْفَاعِلَةِ يَعْنِي الزِّنَا فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَتْ أَمْهُ حَيَّةً شَاهِدَةً ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ تَطْلُبُ حَقَّهَا ضُرِبَ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةَ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ غَائِبَةً
أُنْتُظِرَ بِهَا حَتَّى تَقْدَمَ فَتَطْلُبَ حَقَّهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ قَدْ مَاتَتْ وَ لَمْ يُعْلَمْ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ خَيْرٌ ضُرِبَ الْمُفْتَرِي عَلَيْهَا الْحَدَّ ثَمَانِينَ
جَلْدَةً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.205 • Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.206 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.54 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.360 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.3 p.418 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.187

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
Abu Ayyub narrated from Hariz from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man falsely accusing the son of a woman whose rights were
violated (Al-maghsubah) by saying to him, "O’ son of an adulteress."
Imam {a.s} said: “I believe he deserves the legal punishment of eighty lashes and must
repent to Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, for what he has said."
text_ar:
5086 رَوَى أَبُو أَيُوبَ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ ع قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ ٱلْمَغْصُوبَةِ يَفْتَرِي عَلَيْهِ ٱلرَّجُلُ فَيَقُولُ
لَهُ يَا ابْنَ الْفَاعِلَةِ فَقَالَ « أرَى عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَ يَثُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِمَّا قَالَ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR SLANDEROUS ACCUSATION
text_en:
It was narrated from Abu Walad Al-Hannat that he said:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: “Commander of the Faithful {a.s} was presented with two men,
each of whom had accused the other of something concerning his body.
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} waived the legal punishment for both of them and
administered disciplinary punishment (ta'zir) to them."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاّدِ الْحَنَّاطِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَتِيَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
بِرَجُلَيْنٍ قَدْ قَذَفَ كُلُّ وَاجِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ فِي بَدَنِهِ فَدَرَأْ عَنْهُمَا الْحَدَّ وَ عَزَّرَهُمَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.242 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.55 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.79 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.371 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.202

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR
text_en:
Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
"If a man entered Islam, acknowledged it, and then drank alcohol, committed
adultery, and consumed usury, without having any knowledge of what is lawful and
unlawful, I would not administer the legal punishment upon him if he was ignorant -
unless there was evidence that he had recited the Surah in which adultery, alcohol,
and usury are mentioned.
If he was unaware of that, I would inform and educate him.
But if he committed those acts after that, I would flog him and enforce the legal
punishment upon him."
text_ar:
بَابٌ حَدَّ شُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ وَ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغِنَاءِ وَ الْمَلَاهِي
رَوَى الْحَلَبِيْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً دَخَلَ فِي الإِسْلامِ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ ثُمَّ شَرِبَ
اَلْخَمْرَ وَ زَنَى وَ أَكَلَ الرِّبَا وَ لَمْ يَتَبَيَّنْ لَهُ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْحَلاَلِ وَ الْحَرَامِ لَمْ أَقِمْ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ إِذَا كَانَ جَاهِلاً إِلَّ أَنْ تَقُومَ
عَلَيْهِ اَلْبَيِّنَةُ أَنَّهُ قَرَأْ السُّورَةَ الْتِي فِيهَا الزِّنَا وَ الْخَمْرُ وَ أَكْلُ الرِّبَا وَ إِذَا جَهِلَ ذَلِكَ أَعْلَمْتُهُ وَ أَخْبَرْتُهُ فَإِنْ رَكِبَهُ بَعْدَ
ذَلِكَ جَلَدْتُهُ وَ أَقَمْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.55 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.526 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.32

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
In the narration of Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who attributed it to the Prophet:
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} was presented with Al-Najashi Al-Harithiyy, the poet,
who had consumed alcohol during the month of Ramadan.
Imam {a.s} flogged him eighty lashes, then imprisoned him for a night.
The next day, Imam {a.s} summoned him and flogged him with twenty more lashes.
Al-Najashi said: “O’ Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, you already flogged me eighty
lashes for drinking alcohol. What are these additional twenty for?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “These are for your audacity in drinking alcohol during the month of
Ramadan."

Scholar's Note:
If a man drinks wine or any intoxicating nabidh (fermented drink), he is to be flogged
eighty lashes. Anything that intoxicates in large quantities is prohibited in both small
and large amounts, and fuqqa (a type of frothy drink) holds the same ruling. A person
who drinks any intoxicant, whether wine or nabidh, is to be flogged eighty lashes. If he
repeats the act, he is flogged again, and if he repeats it a third time, he is executed. It
has also been narrated that execution occurs on the fourth offense.
If a slave drinks an intoxicant, he is to be flogged forty lashes and executed on the
eighth offense.
My father, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him, said in his letter to me:
‘Know that the origin of wine is from grapes. If it is exposed to fire or boils without being
touched by fire until its bottom becomes its top, it becomes wine and is prohibited to
drink unless two-thirds evaporate and one-third remains. If it ferments without being
heated, leave it until it naturally turns into vinegar without adding anything to it. Once
it becomes vinegar on its own, it is permissible to consume. If it changes afterward
and becomes wine, there is no harm in adding salt or other substances to it.
However, if wine is poured into vinegar, it is not permissible to consume until it is
separated, placed in a container, and left to turn into vinegar. Once it becomes
vinegar, it is permissible to eat the vinegar into which wine was poured.
Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, has prohibited wine itself, and the Messenger of
Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his family) has forbidden every intoxicating drink.
He {saws} cursed wine, its planter, its guardian, its carrier, the one to whom it is carried,
its seller, its buyer, the one who consumes its price, the one who presses it, the one
who serves it, and the one who drinks it.
Wine has five names:
Al-‘Aseer (the juice), which is made from grapes;
Al-Naqi‘, which is made from raisins;
Al-Bit‘, which is made from honey;
Al-Mizr, which is made from barley; and Al-Nabidh, which is made from dates.
Wine is the key to every evil, and the one who drinks it is like an idol worshipper.
Whoever drinks it will have their prayers suspended for forty days. If they repent within
those forty days, their repentance will not be accepted, and if they die during that
period, they will enter the Fire.
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ يَرْفَعُهُ: أَنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَتِيَ بِالنَّجَاشِيِّ الْحَارِثِيَّ
الشَّاعِرِ قَدْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَضَرَبَهُ ثَمَانِينَ ثُمَّ حَبَسَهُ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ دَعَا بِهِ مِنَ الْغَدِ فَضَرَبَهُ عِشرِينَ سَوْطاً
فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُوْمِنِينَ ضَرَبْتَنِي ثَمَانِينَ سَوْطاً فِي شُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ فَهَذِهِ الْعِشرُونَ مَا هِيَ فَقَالَ «هَذَا لِجُرْأَتِكَ عَلَى
شُزْبٍ الْخَمْرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ».
وَ إِذَا شَرِبَ الرَّجُلُ الْخَمْرَ أَوِ النَّبِيدَ الْمُسْكِرَ جُلِدَ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَ كُلُّ مَا أُسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ وَ كَثِيرُهُ حَرَامٌ وَ الْفُقَاعُ بِتِلْكَ
الْمَنْزِلَةِ وَ شَارِبُ الْمُسْكِرِ خَمْراً كَانَ أَوْ نَبِيداً يُجْلَدُ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً فَإِنْ عَادَ جُلِدَ فَإِنْ عَادَ قُتِلَ وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ أَنّهُ يُقْتَلُ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ وَ
الْعَبْدُ إِذَا شَرِبَ مُسْكِراً جُلِدَ أَرْبَعِينَ جَلْدَةً وَ يُقْتَلُ فِي الثَّامِنَةِ وَ قَالَ أَبِي رَضِيَ اللَهُ عَنْهُ فِي رِسَالَتِهِ إِلَيَّ اعْلَمْ أَنَّ أَصْلَ الْخَمْرِ

In the narration of Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who attributed it to the Prophet:
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} was presented with Al-Najashi Al-Harithiyy, the poet,
who had consumed alcohol during the month of Ramadan.
Imam {a.s} flogged him eighty lashes, then imprisoned him for a night.
The next day, Imam {a.s} summoned him and flogged him with twenty more lashes.
Al-Najashi said: “O’ Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, you already flogged me eighty
lashes for drinking alcohol. What are these additional twenty for?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “These are for your audacity in drinking alcohol during the month of
Ramadan."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Do not sit with those who drink
wine, for when the curse descends, it encompasses everyone present in the
gathering."

Scholar's Note:
It is not permissible to perform prayer in a house where wine is stored in containers.
However, there is no harm in praying in a garment that has been touched by wine
because Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden its consumption but has
not prohibited praying in a garment that has been affected by it.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «لا تُجَالِسُوا شُرَّابَ الْخَمْرِ فَإِنَّ اللَّعْنَةَ إِذَا نَزَلَتْ عَمَّتْ مَنْ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ».
وَلَا تَجُوزُ الصَّلَاةُ فِي بَيْتٍ فِيهِ خَمْرٌ مَحْصُورْ فِي آنِيَةٍ وَ لَا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فِي ثَوْبِ أَصَابَثَهُ خَمْرٌ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حَرَّمَ شُرْبَهَا
وَلَمْ يُحَرَّمِ الصَّلَاةَ فِي ثَوْبِ أَصَابَتْهُ.
commentary:
It is not permissible to perform prayer in a house where wine is stored in containers.
However, there is no harm in praying in a garment that has been touched by wine
because Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden its consumption but has
not prohibited praying in a garment that has been affected by it.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.57 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.25 p.374 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.63 p.499
text_chunk:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Do not sit with those who drink
wine, for when the curse descends, it encompasses everyone present in the
gathering." Scholar's Note:
It is not permissible to perform prayer in a house where wine is stored in containers.
However, there is no harm in praying in a garment that has been touched by wine
because Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden its consumption but has
not prohibited praying in a garment that has been affected by it.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If a wine drinker falls ill, do not visit him; if he dies, do not attend his funeral; if he
testifies, do not accept his testimony; and if he seeks marriage from you, do not marry
him off.
Whoever marries his daughter to a wine drinker, it is as if he has led her to adultery.
And whoever marries his daughter to someone who opposes his faith has severed her
family ties. Whoever entrusts a wine drinker with something has no guarantee from
Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ : «شَارِبُ الْخَمْرِ إِنْ مَرِضَ فَلاَ تَعْوِدُوهُ وَ إِنْ مَاتَ فَلاَ تَشَهَدُوهُ وَ إِنْ شَهِدَ فَلاَ
تُرَكُوهُ وَ إِنْ خَطَبَ إِلَيْكُمْ فَلا تُزَوِّجُوهُ فَإِنَّ مَنْ زَوْجَ اِبْنَتَهُ شَارِبَ الْخَمْرِ فَكَانَّمَا قَادَهَا إِلَى الزِّنَا وَ مَنْ زَوْجَ اِبْنَتَهُ
مُخَالِفاً لَهُ عَلَى دِينِهِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ رَجِمَهَا وَ مَنِ اِنْتَمَنَ شَارِبَ الْخَمْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عَلَى اللهِ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى ضَمَانْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.58 • Al-Wafi, Vol.20 p.613 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.25 p.312

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Five things from five are impossible: Honor from a transgressor is impossible,
compassion from an enemy is impossible, sincere advice from a jealous person is
impossible, loyalty from a woman is impossible, and awe from a poor person is
impossible."

Scholar's Note:
And singing (ghinaʾ) is among the acts for which Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic,
has promised the Hellfire.
This is in reference to His {SWT} saying, the Mighty and Majestic: "And among the people
is he who buys idle talk to mislead others from the way of Allah {SWT} without knowledge
and takes it in mockery. For them is a humiliating punishment." (Surah Luqman 31:6)
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «خَمْسَةٌ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ مُحَالُ الْحُرْمَةُ مِنَ ٱلْفَاسِقِ مُحَالٌ وَ الشَّفْقَةُ مِنَ ٱلْعَدُوِّ
مُحَالٌ وَ النَّصِيحَةُ مِنَ الْحَاسِدِ مُحَالٌ وَ الْوَفَاءُ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ مُحَالٌ وَ الْهَيْبَةُ مِنَ الْفَقِيرِ مُحَالٌ».
وَ الْغِنَاءُ مِمَّا أَوْعَدَ اللَّهُ عَزّ وَ جَلَّ
عَلَيْهِ النَّارَ وَ هُوَ قَوْلَهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشَتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُصِلَ عَنْ سَبِيلٍ
اللّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمِ وَ يَتَّخِذَها هُذُوا أُولئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذابٌ مُهِينَ )
commentary:

has promised the Hellfire.
This is in reference to His {SWT} saying, the Mighty and Majestic: "And among the people
is he who buys idle talk to mislead others from the way of Allah {SWT} without knowledge
and takes it in mockery. For them is a humiliating punishment." (Surah Luqman 31:6)

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the saying of Allah
{SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic:
"So avoid the filth of idols and avoid false speech." (Surah Al-Hajj 22:30)
Imam {a.s} said: "The filth of idols refers to chess, and false speech refers to singing. And
backgammon (nard) is worse than chess.
As for chess, adopting it is disbelief, playing it is polytheism, teaching it is a grave and
destructive sin, greeting someone engaged in it is disobedience, and touching its
pieces is like touching the flesh of swine. Looking at it is like looking at the private parts
of one's mother.
The one who plays backgammon with gambling is like one who eats the flesh of swine,
and the one who plays it without gambling is like one who places his hand in the flesh
or blood of swine.
It is not permissible to play with rings, the fourteen stones, and similar games, as all
of them are forms of gambling, even if children play with nuts, it is considered
gambling.
Beware of striking the stones together (a form of entertainment), for indeed, Satan
runs along with you, and the angels flee from you. And whoever keeps a tambourine in
his house for forty days “has incurred the wrath of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
text_ar:
وَ سُبِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَ : عَنْ قَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ) فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَانِ وَ اِجْتَنِبُوا قَوْلَ الزُّورِ
قَالَ «الرِّجْسُ مِنَ الْأَوْثَانِ الشَّطْرَنْجُ وَ قَوْلُ الزُّورِ الْغِنَاءُ وَ النَّرْدُ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الشَّطْرَنْجِ فَأَمَّا الشَّطْرَنْجُ فَإِنَّ اِتَّخَاذَهَا
كُفْرٌ وَ اللَّعِبَ بِهَا شِرْكْ وَ تَعْلِيمَهَا كَبِيرَةٌ مُوبِقَةٌ وَ السِّلَاَمَ عَلَى اللاَهِي بِهَا مَعْصِيَةٌ وَ مُقَلَّبَهَا كَمُقَلَّبِ لَحْمِ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَ
اَلنَّاظِرَ إِلَيْهَا كَالنَّاظِرِ إِلَى فَرْجِ أَمِّهِ وَ اللأَعِبَ بِالنَّرْدِ قِمَاراً مَثَلُهُ مَثَلُ مَنْ يَأْكُلُ لَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَ مَثَلَ آَلَّذِي يَلْعَبُ بِهَا
مِنْ غَيْرِ قِمَارٍ مَثَلُ مَنْ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ فِي لَحْمِ الْخِنْزِيرِ أَوْ فِي دَمِهِ وَ لا يَجُوزُ اللَّعِبُ بِالْخَوَاتِيمِ وَ الْأَرْبَعَةَ عَشَرَ وَ كُلُّ
ذَلِكَ وَ أشبَاهُهُ قِمَارٌ حَتَّى لَعِبُ الصِّبْيَانِ بِالْجَوْزِ هُوَ الْقِمَارُ وَ إِيَّاكَ وَ الضَّرْبَ بِالصَّوَانِيجِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَرْكُضُ مَعَكَ
وَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تَنْفِرُ عَنْكَ وَ مَنْ بَقِيَ فِي بَيْتِهِ طُنْبُورْ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحاً («فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِغَضَبِ مِنَ اللهِ» عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.58

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the angels withdraw from gatherings where gambling occurs and curse the
one involved in it, except in the case of betting on hoofed animals, animals with
padded feet, feathered birds, and arrows. And the Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace be
upon him and his family) himself raced with Usamah ibn Zayd and conducted horse
races."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لَتَنْفِرُ عِنْدَ الرِّهَانِ وَ تَلْعَنُ صَاحِبَهُ مَا خَلاَ الْحَافِرَ وَ الْخُفَّ وَ
الرِّيشَ وَ النَّصْلَ وَ قَدْ سَابَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَ أَجْرَى الْخَيْلَ ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.59 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.149 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.251

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
It has been narrated that the she-camel of the Prophet (peace be upon him
and his family), was outrun in a race. So Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him and his
family, said:
“It (camel) transgressed and said to itself, ‘Upon me is the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
peace and blessings be upon him and his family.’
And it is a right upon Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, that nothing transgresses
against anything except that He {SWT} humiliates it.
And if a mountain were to transgress against another mountain, Allah would destroy
the transgressing one among them.”
text_ar:
فَرُوِيَ: «أَنَّ نَاقَةَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سُبِقَتْ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِنَّهَا بَغَتْ وَ قَالَتْ فَوْقِي رَسُولُ
اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ حَقُّ عَلَى اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ لا يَبْغِيَ شَيْءُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِلَّ أَذَلَّهُ اللَّهُ وَ لَوْ أَنَّ جَبَلاً بَغَى
عَلَى جَبَلٍ لَهَدَّ اللَّهُ الْبَاغِيَ مِنْهُمَا» ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.59

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his family) forbade
inciting animals against one another, except in the case of dogs.
text_ar: - : وَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَنْ تَحْرِيشِ الْبَهَائِمِ مَا خَلاَ ٱلْكِلاَبَ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.60 • Al-Wafi, Vol.20 p.873 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.11 p.522 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.61 p.227

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL AND REPORTS REGARDING SINGING AND AMUSEMENTS
text_en:
A man asked Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s} about purchasing a bondwoman
with a beautiful voice.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm upon you if you buy her and she reminds you of
Paradise."

Scholar's Note:
This means through the recitation of the Quran, asceticism, and virtuous speech that
is not considered singing. As for singing (ghinaʾ), it is strictly prohibited.
text_ar:
: وَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ عَنْ شِرَاءِ جَارِيَةٍ لَهَا صَوْتٌ فَقَالَ «مَا عَلَيْكَ لَوِ اِشتَرَيْتَهَا
فَذَكْرَثْكَ الْجَنَّةَ ».
يَعْنِي بِقِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ وَ الزُّهْدِ وَ الْفَضَائِلِ الَّتِي لَيْسَتْ بِغِنَاءِ فَأَمَّا الْغِنَاءُ فَمَحْظُورْ.
commentary:
This means through the recitation of the Quran, asceticism, and virtuous speech that
is not considered singing. As for singing (ghinaʾ), it is strictly prohibited.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.60

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
It is narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} that he said:
"A servant continues to steal until, when the value of what he has stolen equals the
blood money for his hand, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, exposes him."
text_ar:
بَابٌ حَدِّ السَّرِقَةٍ
رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ يَسْرِقُ حَتَى إِذَا اِسْتَوْفَى دِيَةَ يَدِهِ
أَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.60 • Uyun Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.289 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.566 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.549
