author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السِّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لاَ يُقْطَعُ السّارِقُ فِي عَامِ سَنَةٍ
مُجْدِبَةٍ».
يَعَنِي فِي الْمَأْكُولِ دُونَ غَيْرِهِ.
commentary: This refers specifically to the theft of food and not to other types of theft.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.60

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
In the narration of Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is
reported: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} was presented in Kufa with a man who had stolen
a pigeon, but he did not cut off his hand and said: ‘I do not cut off (a hand) for stealing
birds.'"
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَتِيَ
بِالْكُوفَةٍ بِرَجْلٍ سَرَقَ حَمَاماً فَلَمْ يَقْطَعْهُ وَ قَالَ «لا أَقْطَعُ فِي الطَّيْرِ»».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.230 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.60 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.111 • Nuzhat Al-Nazir, Vol.1 p.129 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.433 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.285
text_chunk:
In the narration of Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is
reported: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} was presented in Kufa with a man who had stolen
a pigeon, but he did not cut off his hand and said: ‘I do not cut off (a hand) for stealing
birds.'"

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى سَعْدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قَطَعَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي بَيْضَةٍ حَدِيدٍ وَ فِي
جُنَّةٍ وَزْنُهَا ثَمَانِيَةٌ وَ ثَلاَثُونَ رِظلاً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.61 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.247

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah {a.s} regarding a man who
went to another man and said: “So-and-so sent me to you to collect such-and-such,"
and the man gave it to him, believing him.
Later, he met the original person and said: “Your messenger came to me, and I sent
with him such-and-such," but the man replied:
“I did not send him to you, nor did anyone bring me anything."
The supposed messenger then claimed that he had indeed been sent and had
delivered the item to him.
Imam {a.s} said: "If proof is established against him that he was never sent, his hand is
to be cut off. But if there is no proof, the man must swear by Allah {SWT} that he did not
send him, and the other must recover his money from the messenger."
I asked: "What if he claims that necessity compelled him to do so?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "His hand is to be cut off because he has stolen the man’s wealth."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمَادٌ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ أَنَى رَجُلاً فَقَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي فَلاَنْ إِلَيْكَ
لِتُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِ بِكَذَا وَ كَذَا فَأَعْطَاهُ وَ صَدَّقَهُ فَلَقِيَ صَاحِبَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ إِنَّ رَسُولَكَ أَتَانِي فَبَعَثتُ إِلَيْكَ مَعَهُ بِكَذَا وَ كَذَا
فَقَالَ مَا أَرْسَلْتُهُ إِلَيْكَ وَ لاَ أَنَانِي أَحَدٌ بِشَيْءٍ فَزَعَمَ الرَّسُولُ أَنَهُ قَدْ أَرْسَلَهُ وَ قَدْ دَفَعَهُ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ «إنْ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةً
أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُرْسِلْهُ قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةً فَيَمِينُهُ بِاللَّهِ مَا أَرْسَلَهُ وَ يَسْتَوْفِي الْآخَرُ مِنَ الرَّسُولِ الْمَالَ»
قُلْتُ فَإِنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ حَمَلَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْحَاجَةُ قَالَ «يُقْطَعُ لِأنَّهُ سَرَقَ مَالَ الرَّجُلِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.61 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.243

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
It is narrated from one of the two Imams {a.s} that Imam {a.s} said:
"The hand of a thief is not to be cut off until he confesses to the theft twice. If he
retracts his confession, he must compensate for what he stole, but his hand will not
be cut off if there are no witnesses against him."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا يُقْطَعُ السَّارِقُ حَتَّى يُقِرَّ بِالسَّرِقَةِ مَرَّتَيْنِ فَإِنْ رَجَعَ ضَمِنَ
السَّرِقَةَ وَ لَمْ يُقْطَع إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شُهُودٌ».
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.1 p.319 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.61 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, V.10 p.129 • Awali Al-La’ali, V.2 p.354 • Awali Al-La’ali, V.3 p.572 • Al-Wafi, V.15 p.411 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, V.28 p.249 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, V.2 p.296 • Bihar Al-Anwar, V.76 p.190 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.123

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakuni, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Every place that can be entered without permission, and a thief steals from it, there
is no cutting off of the hand."

Scholar's Note:
This refers to places like public bathhouses, inns, mills, and mosques.
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «كُلُّ مَدْخَلٍ يُدْخَلُ إِلَيْهِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ فَسَرَقَ مِنْهُ السَّارِقُ
فَلا قَطْعَ عَلَيْهِ».
بَغنِي الْحَمَّامَاتِ وَ الْخَانَاتِ وَ الْأَرْحِيَةَ وَ الْمَسَاجِدَ.
commentary: This refers to places like public bathhouses, inns, mills, and mosques.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.61

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a child who steals.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he is seven years old or younger, the punishment is lifted from him.
But if he repeats the act after the age of seven, his fingertip is to be cut off or scraped
until it bleeds.
If he repeats it again, a part below his fingertip is to be cut off.
If he steals again after that and has reached nine years of age, his hand is to be cut off.
None of the prescribed punishments of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, are to be
neglected."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْعَلاَءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصِّبِيِّ يَسْرِقُ قَالَ «إنْ
كَانَ لَهُ سَبْعُ سِنِينَ أَوْ أَقَلّ رُفِعَ عَنْهُ فَإِنْ عَادَ بَعْدَ السَّبْعِ قُطِعَتْ بَنَانُهُ أَوْ حُكَتْ حَتَّى تَدْمَى فَإِنْ عَادَ قُطِعَ مِنْهُ أَسْفَلُ
مِنْ بَنَانِهِ فَإِنْ عَادَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ قَدْ بَلَغَ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ وَ لاَ يُضَيَّعُ حَدُّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.62 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.120 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.249 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.452 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.297

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
A man came to Commander of the Faithful {a.s} and confessed to theft.
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} asked him: "Do you recite anything from the Book of
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic?"
The man replied: “Yes, Surah Al-Baqarah."
Imam {a.s} said: “I have pardoned your hand for the sake of Surah Al-Baqarah."
Al-Ashath objected, saying: "Are you suspending one of the punishments prescribed
by Allah {SWT}, the Exalted?"
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} replied: “And what do you know about this matter?
When evidence is established, the Imam has no authority to pardon, but when a man
confesses against himself, then it is up to the Imam - if he wishes, he may pardon, and
if he wishes, he may order the cutting."
text_ar:
: وَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَأَقَرّ بِالسَّرِقَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «أَ تَقْرَأُ
شَيْئاً مِنْ كِتَابِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ» قَالَ نَعَمْ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ فَقَالَ «قَدْ وَهَبْتُ يَدَكَ لِسُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ» فَقَالَ ٱلْأَشعَثُ أَتْعَطَّلُ
حَدّاً مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَقَالَ »وَ مَا يُدْرِيكَ مَا هَذَا إِذَا قَامَتِ الْبَيِّنَةُ فَلَيْسَ لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَعْفُوَ وَ إِذَا أَقَرَّ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى
نَفْسِهِ فَذَاكَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا وَ إِنْ شَاءَ قَطَعَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.62 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.129 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.252 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.572 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.536 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.41

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakuni, the Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him
and his family) said: "There is no cutting (of the hand) for stealing fruit or kathar."
And kathar refers to the inner core of palm trees (Al-jummar).
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «لاَ قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَ لاَ كَتَرٍ وَ الْكَثَرُ هُوَ
الْجُمَّارُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.62 • Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.142 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.139

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s} who said: "Commander of the Faithful {a.s} ruled in the case of a group of
people who slaughtered a camel and ate it. They were investigated to determine who
among them had slaughtered it, and they all testified against themselves that they had
collectively slaughtered it without specifying any individual over another. So, Imam {a.s}
ruled that their right hands be cut off."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قَضَى أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ فِي نَفَرٍ
نَحَرُوا بَعِيراً فَأَكَلُوهُ فَامْتُجِنُوا أَيُهُمْ نَحَرَ فَشَهِدُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ نَحَرُوهُ جَمِيعًا لَمْ يَخُصُوا أَحَداً دُونَ أَحَدِ
فَقَضَى أَنْ تُقْطَعَ أَيْمَانُهُمْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.63 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.129 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.406 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.304

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Yunus narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who stole from the war spoils an amount that would
normally require his hand to be cut off.
Imam {a.s} said: “It should be examined how much his rightful share is. If what he took
was less than his portion, he is to be disciplined (ta'zir) and given the remainder of his
share. If he took exactly what was due to him, then there is nothing upon him.
But if he took more than his share equal to the value of a shield, which is a quarter of
a dinar, then his hand is to be cut off."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى يُونُسُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ سَرَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَغْنَمِ
الشَّيْءَ أَلَّذِي يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ الْقَطْعُ قَالَ «يُنْظَرُ كَمِ آَلَّذِي يُصِيبُهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ آلَّذِي أَخَذَ أَقَلّ مِنْ نَصِيبِهِ عُزِّرَ وَ دُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ
تَمَامُ مَالِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَخَذَ مِثْلَ الَّذِي لَهُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَخَذَ فَضْلاً بِقَدْرٍ ثَمَنِ مِجَنِّ وَ هُوَ رُبُعُ دِينَارٍ قُطِعَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.63 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.106 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.242 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.567 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.425 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.289

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurarah from Imam Abu Jafar {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who rented a donkey and went to cloth merchants,
bought a garment from them, and left the donkey with them.
Imam {a.s} said: “The donkey should be returned to its owner, and the one who took the
garment should be pursued. However, there is no cutting (of the hand) upon him
because this is an act of betrayal, not theft."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجْلٍ اِكْتَرَى جِمَاراً وَ أَقْبَلَ
إِلَى أَصْحَابِ الثَّيَابِ فَابْتَاعَ مِنْهُمْ ثَوْباً وَ تَرَكَ الْحِمَارَ عِنْدَهُمْ قَالَ «يُرَدْ الْحِمَارُ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ وَ يُثْبَعُ الَّذِي ذَهَبَ
بِالثَّوْبٍ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَطَعْ إِنَّمَا هِيَ خِيَانَةٌ».

text_chunk:
Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurarah from Imam Abu Jafar {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who rented a donkey and went to cloth merchants,
bought a garment from them, and left the donkey with them.
Imam {a.s} said: “The donkey should be returned to its owner, and the one who took the
garment should be pursued. However, there is no cutting (of the hand) upon him
because this is an act of betrayal, not theft."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When a man committed theft for the first time, Commander of the Faithful {a.s} would
cut off his right hand. If he repeated the theft, he would cut off his left foot.
If he stole a third time, he would imprison him for life and provide for him from the
public treasury."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ إِذَا سَرَقَ الرَّجُلُ أَوَّلاً قَطَعَ يَمِينَهُ فَإِنْ عَادَ
قَطَعَ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى فَإِنْ عَادَ ثَالِثَةً خَلْدَهُ السِّجْنَ وَ أُنْفَقَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْتِ ٱلْمَالِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked about the minimum amount for which a thief's
hand is to be cut off.
Imam {a.s} said: “A quarter of a dinar."
text_ar: - وَ سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : عَنْ أَدْنَى مَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ السَّارِقُ قَالَ «رُبُعُ دِينَارِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.64 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.247

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
In another narration, it is reported: "One-fifth of a dinar."

Scholar's Note:
If a thief enters a man's house and gathers clothes but is caught inside the house while
still holding the goods, then if he hands them over to the owner of the house, there is
no cutting (of his hand).
However, if he takes the goods out of the door of the house, then his hand is to be cut
off, unless he can prove that he did not take them out.
And if the Imam orders the cutting of the thief’s right hand, but by mistake his left hand
is cut instead, then his right hand is not to be cut after his left has already been
severed.
text_ar:
وَ فِي خَبَرِ آخَرَ: «خُمُسُ دِينَارِ».
فَإِذَا دَخَلَ السَّارِقُ دَارَ رَجُلٍ فَجَمَعَ الثَّيَابَ وَ أُخِذَ فِي الدَّارِ وَ مَعَهُ الْمَتَاعُ فَقَالَ إِذَا دَفَعَهُ إِلَى رَبِّ الدَّارِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَطْعْ فَإِذَا
أخْرَجَ الْمَتَاعَ مِنْ بَابِ الدَّارِ فَعَلَيْهِ الْقَطْعُ أَوْ يَجِيءَ بِالْمَخْرَجِ مِنْهُ وَ إِذَا أُمَرَ الْإِمَامُ بِقَطْعِ يَمِينِ السَارِقِ فَقُطِعَ يَسَارُهُ بِالْغَلَطِ فَلَا
يُقْطَعُ يَمِينُهُ إِذَا قَطِعَتْ يَسَارُهُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri’ab from Zurarah from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} regarding a man who stole, and his right hand
was cut off. Then he stole again, and his left foot was cut off. Then he stole a third time.
Imam {a.s} said: "Commander of the Faithful {a.s} would imprison him for life and would
say, 'I feel ashamed before my Lord {AZJ} to leave him without a hand to clean himself
with and without a foot to walk with to fulfill his needs.'"
Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} added: "When Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} would cut off the hand, he
would cut it below the wrist joint, and when he would cut off the foot, he would cut it
from the ankle."
Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} also stated: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} did not believe that any of the
prescribed punishments should be pardoned."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ سَرَقَ
فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ الْيُمْنَى ثُمَّ سَرَقَ فَقُطِعَتْ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى ثُمَّ سَرَقَ الثَالِثَةَ قَالَ «كَانَ أمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
يُخَلَّدُهُ فِي السِّجْنِ وَ يَقُولُ «إِنَّي لَأَسْتَحْبِي مِنْ رَبِّي أَنْ أَدَعَهُ بِلاَ يَدِ يَسْتَثْظِفُ بِهَا وَ لا رِجْلٍ يَمْشِي بِهَا إِلَى حَاجَتِهِ»
» قَالَ «وَ كَانَ إِذَا قَطَعَ ٱلْيَدَ قَطَعَهَا دُونَ ٱلْمَفْصِلِ وَ إِذَا قَطَعَ ٱلرِّجْلَ قَطَعَهَا مِنَ الْكَعْبِ » قَالَ «وَ كَانَ لا يَرَى أَنْ
بُعْفَى، عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْحُدُودِ».
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.1 p.318 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.64 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.439 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.296 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.76 p.189

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribat from Ibn
Muskan from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
"When the legal punishment is carried out on a thief, he is to be exiled to another town.
If a man steals and is not caught until he steals again and is then apprehended, and
evidence is brought against him, with witnesses testifying to both the first and the
most recent theft, his hand is to be cut off for the first theft, but his foot is not to be cut
off for the second theft.
This is because the witnesses testified to both thefts at the same time before his hand
was cut off for the first theft.
However, if the witnesses had testified regarding the first theft and his hand was cut
off, and then later testified about the second theft, his left foot would be cut off."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَقِيمَ عَلَى السَّارِقِ الْحَدُّ نُفِيَ إِلَى بَلْدَةِ أُخْرَى وَ إِنْ سَرَقَ رَجُلٌ فَلَمْ يُقْدَرْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى سَرَقَ
مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فَأُخِذَ فَجَاءَتِ الْبَيِّنَةُ فَشَهِدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِالسَّرِقَةِ الْأُولَى وَ الْأَخِيرَةِ فَإِنَّهُ تُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ بِالسَّرِقَةِ الْأُولَى وَ لا
نُقْطَعُ رِجْلُهُ بِالسَّرِقَةِ الْأَخِيرَةِ لِأَنّ الشُّهُودَ شَهِدُوا عَلَيْهِ جَمِيعاً فِي مَقَامٍ وَاحِدٍ بِالسَّرِقَةِ الْأُولَى وَ الْأَخِيرَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ
تُقْطَعَ يَدُهُ بِالسَّرِقَةِ الْأُولَى وَ لَوْ أَنَّ الشُهُودَ شَهِدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِالسَّرِقَةِ الأُولَى فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ ثُمَّ شَهِدُوا عَلَيْهِ بَعْدُ بِالسَّرِقَةِ
الْأَخِيرَةٍ قُطِعَتْ رِجْلُهُ الْيُسْرَى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.65 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.129

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"There is no cutting (of the hand) for open and public theft, which is snatching (Al-
khulsah), but I would discipline him (ta'zir).
However, the one who steals and conceals what he takes is to have his hand cut off."
There is no cutting (of the hand) for one who snatches clothing, nor is there cutting for
a pickpocket (ṭarrar) if he steals from the outer garment.
However, if he steals from the inner garment, then cutting is applied.
There is also no cutting for a worker (ajir) or a guest (ḍayf) because they are entrusted.
However, it has been narrated that if a guest hosts another guest who then steals, his
hand is to be cut.
If a paralyzed person (ashall) steals, his right hand is to be cut off regardless of whether
it is paralyzed or healthy. If he steals again, his left foot is to be cut off. If he steals a
third time, he is to be imprisoned for life, provided for from the public treasury of the
Muslims, and restrained from harming people.
This was narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Al-Alaa from Muhammad ibn Muslim
from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, and also by Al-
Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah {a.s}.
Additionally, there is no cutting for a slave if he steals from the property of his master
because it is considered the wealth of the man himself, as if a part of him has stolen
from another part.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «لا قَطْعَ فِي الدَّغَارَةِ ٱلْمُعْلَنَةِ وَ هِيَ الْخَلْسَةُ وَ لَكِنِّي أُعَزِّرُهُ وَ لَكِنْ يُقْطَعُ مَنْ
يَأْخُذُ وَ يُخْفِي». وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلَّذِي يَسْلُبُ الثَّيَابَ قَطْعْ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى الطَرَارِ قَطْعْ إِذَا طَرَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَمِيصِ الْأَعْلَى فَإِنْ
طَرَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَمِيصِ الْأَسْفَلِ فَعَلَيْهِ الْقَطْعُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَجِيرِ وَ لا عَلَى الضَّيْفِ قَطْعْ لِأَنَّهُمَا مُؤْتَمَنَانٍ وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ أَنَّهُ
إنْ أَضَافَ الضَّيْفُ ضَيْفاً فَسَرَقَ قُطِعَ وَ الْأَشَلُ إِذَا سَرَقَ قُطِعَتْ يَمِينُهُ عَلَى كُلّ حَالٍ شَلاَّءَ كَانَثْ أَوْ صَجِيحَةً فَإِنْ
عَادَ فَسَرَقَ قُطِعَتْ رِجْلُهُ ٱلْيُسْرَى فَإِنْ عَادَ خُلِّدَ السِّجْنَ وَ أُجْرِيَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْتِ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ كُفَّ عَنِ النَّاسِ
رَوَى ذَلِكَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ. وَ رَوَاهُ الْحَسَنُ
بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْعَبْدِ إِذَا سَرَقَ مِنْ مَالٍ مَوْلاهُ قَطْعَ
لأَنَّهُ مَالُ الرَّجُلِ سَرَقَ بَعْضُهُ بَعضاً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.65 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.568 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.269

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
"The grave robber (Al-nabbash), if he is known for doing that, is to have his
hand cut off."
text_ar: - : «وَ اَلنَّبَّاشُ إِذَا كَانَ مَعْرُوفاً بِذَلِكَ قُطِعَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.67 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.117 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.246 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.457 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.282
text_chunk:
"The grave robber (Al-nabbash), if he is known for doing that, is to have his
hand cut off."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
It has been narrated that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} ordered the hand of a grave
robber to be cut off.
Imam {a.s} was asked: “Do you cut off (the hand) for stealing from the dead?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “We cut for our dead just as we cut for our living."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ عَلِيَاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَطَعَ نَبَّاشَ الْقَبْرِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَتَقْطَعُ فِي الْمَوْتَى فَقَالَ «إِنَّا لَنَقْطَعُ لِأَمْوَاتِنَا
كَمَا نَقْطَعُ لأَحْيَائِنَا» ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.67 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.116 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.246 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.569 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.456 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.281
text_chunk:
It has been narrated that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} ordered the hand of a grave
robber to be cut off.
Imam {a.s} was asked: “Do you cut off (the hand) for stealing from the dead?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “We cut for our dead just as we cut for our living."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
It has been narrated that Commander of the Faithful {a.s} was presented with
a grave robber.
Imam {a.s} grabbed him by his hair, struck him against the ground, and then said: “Step
on him, O’ servants of Allah {SWT}." So, the people trampled him until he died.

Scholar's Note:
As for a runaway slave (Abd abiq), if he steals, his hand is not to be cut off. Similarly,
an apostate (murtadd) who steals is not to have his hand cut off immediately.
However, the slave is to be called to return to his master, and the apostate is to be
called to return to Islam. If either of them refuses, then his hand is to be cut off for the
theft, and afterward, he is to be executed.
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ: «أَنَّ أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُومِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ أُتِيَ بِنَبَاشِ فَأَخَذَ بِشَعْرِهِ وَ جَلَدَ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «طَنُوا عَلَيْهِ
عبَادَ اللّهِ» فَوُطِئَ حَتَّى مَاتَ».
وَ الْعَبْدُ الْآَبِقُ إِذَا سَرَقَ لَمْ يُقْطَعْ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْمُرْتَدُ إِذَا سَرَقَ وَ لَكِنْ يُدْعَى الْعَبْدُ إِلَى الرُّجُوع إِلَى مَوَالِيهِ وَ الْمُرْتَدُ يُدْعَى إِلَى
الدُّخُولٍ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ فَإِنْ أَبَى وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمَا قُطِعَتْ يَدْهُ فِي السَّرِقَةِ ثُمَّ قُتِلَ.
commentary:
As for a runaway slave (Abd abiq), if he steals, his hand is not to be cut off. Similarly,
an apostate (murtadd) who steals is not to have his hand cut off immediately.
However, the slave is to be called to return to his master, and the apostate is to be
called to return to Islam. If either of them refuses, then his hand is to be cut off for the
theft, and afterward, he is to be executed.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.67 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.570

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the saying of Allah
{SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic:
"The punishment of those who wage war against Allah {SWT} and His Messenger and
strive to spread corruption on earth is that they be killed, or crucified, or have their
hands and feet cut off from opposite sides, or be exiled from the land" (Surah Al-
Ma'idah 5:33).
Imam {a.s} said: “If a person kills but does not engage in combat and does not take
wealth, he is to be executed.
If he engages in combat and kills, he is to be killed and crucified.
If he engages in combat and takes wealth but does not kill, his hand and foot are to be
cut off.
And if he engages in combat but does not kill and does not take wealth, he is to be
exiled.”

Scholar's Note:
It is appropriate that this exile resembles crucifixion and execution, where his legs are
weighed down, and he is thrown into the sea.
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ) إِنَّمَا جَزْاءُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ اللهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ وَ
يَسْعَوْنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسْادا أَنْ يُقَتَّلُوا أَوْ يُصَلّبُوا أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَ أَرْجُلُهُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ أَوْ يُنْفَوْا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ
فَقَالَ «إِذَا قَتَلَ وَ لَمْ يُحَارِبْ وَ لَمْ يَأْخَذِ ٱلْمَالَ قُتِلَ وَ إِذَا حَارَبَ وَ قَتَلَ قُتِلَ وَ صُلِبَ وَ إِذَا حَارَبَ وَ أَخَذَ ٱلْمَالَ وَ لَمْ
يَقْتُلْ قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ وَ رِجْلُهُ وَ إِذَا حَارَبَ وَ لَمْ يَقْتُلْ وَ لَمْ يَأْخُذِ ٱلْمَالَ نُفِيَ».
وَيَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَكُونَ نَفْياً يُشبِهُ الصَّلْبَ وَ الْقَثْلَ يُتَقَلُ رِجْلَاهُ وَ يُرْمَى فِي الْبَحْرِ.
commentary:
It is appropriate that this exile resembles crucifixion and execution, where his legs are
weighed down, and he is thrown into the sea.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.67 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.469

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The crucified person is to be taken down from the wooden structure after three days,
washed, and buried. It is not permissible to keep him crucified for more than three
days."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «الْمَصْلُوبُ يُنْزَلُ عَنِ الْخَشَبَةِ بَعْدَ ثَلاَئَةِ أَيَّامِ يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُدْفَنُ وَ لاَ يَجُوزُ
صَلْبُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ أَيَّامٍ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.68 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.487 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.319 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.2 p.143 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.18 p.160

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ صَلَبَ رَجْلاً،
بِالْجِيرَةِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامِ ثُمَّ أَنزَلَهُ يَوْمَ الرَّابِعِ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَ دَفَتَهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.68

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Ali ibn Ri’ab narrated from Ḍurays from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali
Al-Baqir {a.s} who said: "Whoever carries a weapon at night is considered a highway
robber (muharib), unless he is a man who is not known for suspicion or wrongdoing."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ رِئَابٍ عَنْ ضُرَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ حَمَلَ السِّلاَحَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَهُوَ مُحَارِبٌ
إلاً أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلاً لَيْسَ مِنْ أهْلِ الرِّيبَةِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.246 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.68 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.6 p.157 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.134 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.464 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.2 p.32 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.15 p.120 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.313 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.211 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.4 p.101

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Talhah Al-Nahdi from Sawrah ibn Kulayb who
said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man who leaves his house intending to go to the
mosque or fulfill a need and is met or confronted by another man who strikes him and
takes his garment.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} asked: “What do the people in your region say about this?"
I replied: “They say this is open aggression (dagharah muʿlanah), and that a highway
robber (muharib) only exists in the lands of polytheists."
Imam {a.s} then asked: “Which is more sacred: the land of Islam or the land of
polytheism?"
I replied: “The land of Islam."
Imam {a.s} said: “These people fall under the ruling of this verse:
'The punishment of those who wage war against Allah {SWT} and His Messenger'" (until
the end of the verse). (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:33)
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ النَّهْدِيّ عَنْ سَوْرَةَ بْنِ كُلَيْبِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
رَجُلْ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ يُرِيدُ الْمَسْجِدَ أَوْ يُرِيدُ الْحَاجَةَ فَيَلْقَاهُ رَجُلٌ أَوْ يَسْتَقْبِلُهُ فَيَضْرِبُهُ وَ يَأْخُذْ ثَوْبَهُ قَالَ «أَيِّ
شَيْءٍ يَقُولُ فِيهِ مَنْ قِبَلَكُمْ» قَالَ قُلْتُ يَقُولُونَ هَذِهِ دَغَارَةٌ مُعْلَنَةٌ وَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُحَارِبُ فِي قُرَّى مُشْرِكِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ »أَيْهُمَا
أَعْظَمُ حُرْمَةً دَارُ الْإِسْلامِ أَوْ دَارُ الشِّرْكِ» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ دَارُ ٱلْإِسْلاَمِ قَالَ «هَؤلاءِ مِنْ أَهْلِ هَذِهِ آلْآيَةِ:
• إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ الَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ اللهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ ) إِلَى آخِرِ ٱلْآَيَةِ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.245 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.68 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.134 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.464 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.314 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.285 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.622 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.4 p.101

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
It was narrated from Tarif ibn Sinan Al-Thawri who said:
I asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who stole a free woman
and sold her.
Imam {a.s} said: "There are four legal punishments in this case.
The first is that since he stole, his hand is to be cut off.
The second is that if he had intercourse with her, he is to be flogged with the legal
punishment.
The third is upon the one who bought her: if he had intercourse with her and knew her
status, then if he was married (muhsan), he is to be stoned, and if he was unmarried
(non-muhsan), he is to be flogged with the legal punishment. However, if he did not
know (her status), then there is nothing upon him or upon her.
The fourth is that if she was forced into it, there is no punishment upon her, but if she
consented, she is to be flogged with the legal punishment."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ طَرِيفِ بْنِ سِنَانِ التَّوْرِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَرَقَ حُرَّةً قَبَاعَهَا
فَقَالَ «فِيهَا أَرْبَعَةُ حُدُودٍ أَمَا أَوَّلُهَا فَسَارِقٌ تُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ وَ الثَانِيَةُ إِنْ كَانَ وَطِئَهَا جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ وَ عَلَى اَلَّذِي اِشتَرَى إِنْ
كَانَ وَطِئَهَا وَ قَدْ عَلِمَ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْصَناً رُجِمَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ غَيْرَ مُحْصَنٍ جُلِدَ ٱلْحَدَّ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَ
لاَ عَلَيْهَا هِيَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ اِسْتَكْرَهَهَا فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ طَاوَعَتْهُ جُلِدَتِ الْحَدِّ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.229 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.69 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.113 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.459 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.283

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal narrated from his father from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s}: "Tell me why the right hand and the left foot of a thief are cut off, but
not the right hand and the right foot?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “What a good question you have asked! If his right hand and right
foot were cut off, he would fall onto his left side and would not be able to stand. But
when his right hand and left foot are cut off, he remains balanced and can stand
upright."
I said: “May I be your ransom, how can he stand when his foot has been cut off?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “The cutting is not as you perceive it. The foot is cut off from the
ankle, leaving part of the foot so that he can stand on it, perform prayer, and worship
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
I asked: “From where is the hand cut off?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “The four fingers are cut off, and the thumb is left for him so that he
may lean on it during prayer and wash his face for prayer."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هِلالٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أُخْبِرْنِي عَنِ
السَّارِقِ لِمَ تُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ الْيُمْنَى وَ رِجْلُهُ الْيُسْرَى وَ لاَ تُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ الْيُمْنَى وَ رِجْلُهُ الْيُمْنَى فَقَالَ «مَا أَحْسَنَ مَا سَأَلْتَ إِذَا
قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ ٱلْيُمْنَى وَ رِجْلُهُ الْيُمْنَى سَقَطَ عَلَى جَانِبِهِ الْأَيْسَرِ وَ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى الْقِيَامِ وَ إِذَا قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ ٱلْيُمْنَى وَ
رِجْلُهُ الْيُسْرَى اِعْتَدَلَ وَ اِسْتَوَى قَائِما» قَالَ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ كَيْفَ يَقُومُ وَ قَدْ قُطِعَتْ رِجْلُهُ قَالَ «إِنَّ ٱلْقَطْعَ لَيْسَ
مِنْ حَيْثُ رَأَيْتَ تُقْطَعُ إِنَّمَا تُقْطَعُ الرِّجَلُ مِنَ الْكَعْبِ وَ يُثْرَكُ لَهُ مِنْ قَدَمِهِ مَا يَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ يُصَلِّي وَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ
جَلّ» قُلْتُ فَمِنْ أَيْنَ تُقْطَعُ ٱلْيَدُ قَالَ «تُقْطَعُ ٱلْأَرْبَعُ الْأَصَابِعِ وَ يُثْرَكُ لَهُ الْإِنْهَامُ يَعْتَمِدُ عَلَيْهَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ يَغْسِلُ بِهَا
وَجْهَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.225 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.69 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.103 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.442 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.257 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.628 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.4 p.111
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal narrated from his father from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s}: "Tell me why the right hand and the left foot of a thief are cut off, but
not the right hand and the right foot?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “What a good question you have asked! If his right hand and right
foot were cut off, he would fall onto his left side and would not be able to stand. But
when his right hand and left foot are cut off, he remains balanced and can stand
upright."
I said: “May I be your ransom, how can he stand when his foot has been cut off?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “The cutting is not as you perceive it. The foot is cut off from the
ankle, leaving part of the foot so that he can stand on it, perform prayer, and worship
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
I asked: “From where is the hand cut off?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “The four fingers are cut off, and the thumb is left for him so that he
may lean on it during prayer and wash his face for prayer."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s} regarding a man who stole
a cluster of dates from an orchard worth two dirhams.
Imam {a.s} said: “His hand is to be cut off for that."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى إسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ سَرَقَ مِنْ بُسْتَانِ عِدْقاً قِيمَثُهُ دِرْهَمَانٍ
قالَ «يُقْطَعُ بِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.69 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.128 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.409 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.247 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.287

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THEFT
text_en:
Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Ḍurays Al-Kunasi from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad
ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"If a male slave confesses to theft once before the Imam, his hand is to be cut off.
Likewise, if a female slave confesses to theft before the Imam, her hand is to be cut
off."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented: If the slave is
known to intend harm to his master, his hand is not to be cut off merely based on his
confession of theft. However, if two witnesses testify against him, then his hand is to
be cut off.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَلِيْ بْنُ رِئَابٍ عَنْ ضُرَيْسِ الْكُنَاسِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلْعَبْدُ إِذَا أَقَرَّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
عِثْدَ الْإِمَامِ مَرَّةً أَنَّهُ سَرَقَ قَطَعَهُ وَ الْأَمَةُ إِذَا أَقَرَّتْ عَلَى نَفْسِهَا عِنْدَ الإمَامِ بِالسَّرِقَةِ قَطَعَهَا».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَهُ مَتَى كَانَ الْعَبْدُ مِمَّنْ يُعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْإِضْرَارَ بِسَيِّدِهِ لَمْ يُقْطَعْ إِذَا أَقَرَّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالسَّرِقَةِ
فَإِنْ شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِ شَاهِدَانِ قَطِعَ
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented: If the slave is
known to intend harm to his master, his hand is not to be cut off merely based on his
confession of theft. However, if two witnesses testify against him, then his hand is to
be cut off.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS ON THE MUTE, THE DEAF, AND THE BLIND
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who
said: I heard Abu Abdullah {a.s} say: "If a slave confesses to theft, his hand is not to be
cut off. However, if two witnesses testify against him, his hand is to be cut off."
text_ar:
رَوَى ذَلِكَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «إِذَا أَقَرَّ ٱلْمَمْلُوكُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالسَّرِقَةِ لَمْ يُقْطَعْ وَ إِنْ شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِ شَاهِدَانِ قُطِعَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.70 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.305

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LEGAL
text_en:
Yunus narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar who said that one of the two Imams
(peace be upon them) was asked about the legal punishments (hudud) for a mute, a
deaf person, and a blind person.
Imam {a.s} said: "The legal punishments apply to them if they comprehend what they
are doing."
text_ar:
بَابُ إِقَامَةِ الْحُدُودِ عَلَى الْأَخْرَسِ وَ الْأَصَمَّ وَ الْأَعْمَى
رَوَى يُونُسُ عَنْ إسحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: سُبِلَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ حَدَّ ٱلْأَخْرَسِ وَ الْأَصَمِّ وَ الْأَعْمَى
قَالَ «عَلَيْهِمُ الْحُدُودُ إِذَا كَانُوا يَعْقِلُونَ مَا يَأْتُونَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.244 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.70 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.33 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.550 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.29

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THE ONE
text_en:
Ishaq ibn Ammar and Samaah narrated from Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah {a.s}
who said: I asked Imam - "What is the punishment for one who consumes usury after
clear evidence (has been established)?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “He is to be disciplined. If he returns to it, he is disciplined again. If
he repeats it a third time, he is to be killed."
text_ar:
بَابُ حَدَّ آَكِلٍ الرِّبَا بَعْدَ الْبَيِّنَةِ
رَوَى إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ وَ سَمَاعَةُ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا حَدُّ آكِلِ
الرِّبَا بَعْدَ الْبَيِّنَةِ قَالَ «يُؤَدَّبُ فَإِنْ عَادَ أَدِّبَ فَإِنْ عَادَ قُتِلَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.241 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.70 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.98 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.145 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.401 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.371

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LEGAL PUNISHMENT FOR THE ONE
text_en:
Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
"One who consumes carrion, blood, or pork is to be disciplined. If he returns to it, he
is disciplined again."
I asked: “And if he does it again?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “He is to be disciplined, but there is no execution upon him."
text_ar:
بَابُ حَدَّ آَكِلِ الْمَيْتَةِ وَ الدَّمِ وَ لَحْمِ الْخِنْزِيرِ
رَوَى إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «آكِلُ الْمَيْتَةِ وَ الدَّمِ وَ لَحْمِ الْخِنْزِيرِ عَلَيْهِ
أَدَبّ فَإِنْ عَادَ أُدِّبَ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ عَادَ قَالَ «يُؤَدَّبُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَثل».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.71

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON OBLIGATIONS WHEN MULTIPLE LEGAL
text_en:
Ali ibn Ri’ab narrated from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali
Al-Baqir {a.s} who said: "Any man upon whom multiple legal punishments (hudud) have
been established, and among them is the punishment of death, the lesser
punishments are to be carried out first, and then he is to be executed afterward."
text_ar:
بَابٌ مَا يَجِبُ فِي اجْتِمَاعِ الْحُدُودِ عَلَى رَجْلٍ
رَوَى عَلِي بْنُ رِئَابٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «أَيُمَا رَجُلِ اِجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ حُدُودٌ فِيهَا
الْقَثْلُ يُبْدَأُ بِالْحُدُودِ الَّتِي هِيَ دُونَ الْقَتْلِ ثُمَّ يُقْتَلُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.71 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.70 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.546 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.34 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.36

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Sulayman ibn Dawud Al-Minqari narrated from Hafs ibn Ghiyath who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "Who is responsible for carrying out the legal punishments
(hudud) -the ruler or the judge?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “The implementation of the legal punishments belongs to the one
who holds the authority of judgment."
text_ar:
بَابٌ نَوَادِرِ الْحُدُودِ
رَوَى سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ ٱلْمِنْقَرِي عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاتِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَنْ يُقِيمُ ٱلْحُدُودَ
السُّلْطَانُ أو الْقَاضِي فَقَالَ «إِقَامَةُ الْحُدُودِ إِلَى مَنْ إِلَيْهِ اَلْحُكَمُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.71 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.6 p.314 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.155 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.537 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.27 p.299 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.49

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
It has been narrated that a man brought another man to Commander of the
Faithful {a.s} and said: “O’ Commander of the Faithful, this man claimed that he had a
wet dream involving my mother."
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} replied: “A dream is like a shadow; if you wish, I will flog
his shadow for you."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "However, I will punish him so that he does not repeat such
actions and harm the Muslims."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ رَجُلاً جَاءَ بِرَجُلٍ إِلَى أَمِيرِ الْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ إِنَّ هَذَا زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ
اِختَلَمَ بِأمِّي فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الْحُلُمَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الظَّلِّ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ جَلَدْتُ لَكَ ظِلَّهُ» ثُمّ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ « لَكِنِّي أُوجِعُهُ لِئَلاً
يَعُودَ يُؤْذِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ» ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.72

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
It has been narrated that two boys approached Commander of the Faithful
{a.s} holding their wooden tablets and said: “O’ Commander of the Faithful, judge
between us."
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} replied: “Injustice in this matter is like injustice in legal
rulings. Convey to your teacher on my behalf that if he strikes you more than three
times, it will be taken as retribution against him on the Day of Judgment."
text_ar:
رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ دَنَا مِنْ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ صَبِيَّانِ بِيَدِهِمَا لَوْحَانٍ فَقَالا يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ خَايِزْ بَيْتَنَا
قَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِنَّ الْجَوْرَ فِي هَذَا كَالْجَوْرِ فِي الْأَحْكَامِ أَبْلِغَا مُؤَدِّبَكُمَا عَنَّي أَنَّهُ إِنْ ضَرَبَكُمَا فَوْقَ
ثَلاَثٍ كَانَ ذَلِكَ قِصَاصاً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ » ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.72 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.516

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Yunus from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Maḍi {a.s} who
said:
"All those who commit major sins (kabaʾir), if the legal punishment (Hadd) is carried
out on them twice, they are to be executed on the third offense."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ ٱلْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «أَصْحَابُ ٱلْكَبَائِرِ كُلَّهَا
إِذَا أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَدُّ مَرَّتَيْنِ قُتِلُوا فِي الثَّالِئَةِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.191 • Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.219 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.72 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.37 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.62 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.95 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.212 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.225 • Nuzhat Al-Nazir, Vol.1 p.125 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.352
text_chunk:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Yunus from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Maḍi {a.s} who
said:
"All those who commit major sins (kabaʾir), if the legal punishment (Hadd) is carried
out on them twice, they are to be executed on the third offense."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever we strike with a legal punishment (hadd) from the punishments of Allah {SWT}
and he dies, there is no blood money (diyyah) upon us. But whoever we strike with a
legal punishment from the rights of the people and he dies, then his blood money is
upon us."
text_ar:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ ضَرَبْنَاهُ حَدّاً مِنْ حُدُودِ اللّهِ فَمَاتَ فَلاَ دِيَةَ لَهُ عَلَيْنَا وَ مَنْ ضَرَبْنَاهُ حَدّاً
مِنْ حُدُودِ النَّاسِ فَمَاتَ فَإِنَّ دِيَتَهُ عَلَيْنَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.292 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.72 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.208 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.279 • Nuzhat Al-Nazir, Vol.1 p.155 • Al-Wafi, Vol.16 p.807 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.17 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.29 p.64

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah
{a.s} who said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his
family) and said:
“My mother does not resist the hand of one who touches her."
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: “Then confine her."
The man replied: “I have done that."
The Prophet {saws} said: “Then prevent anyone from entering upon her."
The man said: “I have done that."
The Prophet {saws} then said: “Then restrain her, for you will not honor her with anything
better than preventing her from violating the prohibitions of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Majestic."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «جَاءَ رَجُلْ إِلَى
رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَمّي لاَ تَدْفَعُ يَدَ لامِسِ قَالَ «فَاخْبِسْهَا» قَالَ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ قَالَ «فَامنَغْ مَنْ
يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا» قَالَ قَدْ فَعَلْتْ قَالَ «فَقَيَّدْهَا فَإِنَّكَ لا تَبَرْهَا بِشَيْءٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ تَمْنَعَهَا مِنْ مَحَارِمِ آللَّهِ عَزِّ وَ جَلَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.72 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.551 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.150

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Durays from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"The legal punishments (hudud) that are the rights of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Majestic, cannot be pardoned except by the Imam. However, when it comes to the
rights of people in a legal punishment, there is no harm if it is pardoned without the
Imam’s involvement."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ ضُرَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لاَ يُغْفَى
عَنِ اَلْحُدُودِ الَّتِي لِلّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ دُونَ الْإِمَامِ فَأَمّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ حَقَّ ٱلنَّاسِ فِي حَدَّ فَلاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يُعْفَى عَنْهُ دُونَ
الإمَامٍ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who said to
a woman, "O’ adulteress," and she replied: “You are more adulterous than me."
Imam {a.s} said: “She is subject to the legal punishment (hadd) for the accusation she
made against him. However, regarding her self-admission, she is not to be punished
unless she confesses to that before the Imam four times."
text_ar:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ لامْرَأَةٍ يَا زَانِيَةُ فَقَالَتْ أَنْتَ أَزْنَى مِنِّي قَالَ «عَلَيْهَا الْحَدُّ فِيمَا
قَذَفَثَهُ بِهِ وَ أَمّا فِي إِقْرَارِهَا عَلَى نَفْسِهَا فَلا تُحَدُ حَتَّى تُقِرَّ بِذَلِكَ عِنْدَ ٱلْإمَامِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.73 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.363 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.196

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"It is not permissible for a ruler who believes in Allah {SWT} and the Last Day to administer
more than ten lashes except in the case of a legal punishment (hadd)."

Scholar's Note:
It is permitted to discipline a servant with three to five lashes. However, whoever
strikes his servant beyond what is due without a valid reason has no expiation except
to free him.
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «لاَ يَحِلُّ لِوَالِ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَ ٱلْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَنْ يَجْلِدَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ
أسْوَاطِ إلاّ فِي حَدِّ».
وَ أَذِنَ فِي أَدَبِ الْمَمْلُوكِ مِنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَى خَمْسَةٍ وَ مَنْ ضَرَبَ مَمْلُوكَهُ حَدَاً لَمْ يَجِبْ عَلَيْهِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كَفَارَةْ إِلَا عِثْقُهُ.
commentary:
It is permitted to discipline a servant with three to five lashes. However, whoever
strikes his servant beyond what is due without a valid reason has no expiation except
to free him.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.73

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
In the narration of Ziyad ibn Marwan Al-Qandi from someone who reported
from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, he said: "The hand of a thief is not to be cut off during a year of
famine for stealing anything edible, such as bread, meat, or cucumbers."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ زِيَادِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ الْقَنْدِيِّ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا يُقْطَعُ السَّارِقُ فِي
سَنَةِ الْمَحْقِ فِي شَيْء يُوكَلُ مِثلِ الْخُبْزِ وَ اللَّحْمِ وَ الْقِتَّاءِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.73

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
It was narrated from Adam ibn Ishaq from Abdullah ibn Muhammad Al-Jufi
who said: I was with Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} when a letter from
Hisham ibn Abd Al-Malik arrived regarding a man who had exhumed the grave of a
woman, stolen her clothes, and committed intercourse with her.
The people were divided on how to punish him: some said: “Kill him," while others
said: “Burn him."
Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} wrote back to him:
"The sanctity of the deceased is like the sanctity of the living. His punishment is that
his hand should be cut off for exhuming the grave and stealing the clothing, and the
legal punishment for adultery is to be applied to him.
If he was married (muhsan), he is to be stoned, and if he was not married, he is to be
flogged one hundred lashes."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ آدَمَ بْنِ إسحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ الْجُعْفِيّ قَالَ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ ع وَ جَاءَهُ كِتَابُ
هِشَامِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ فِي رَجُلٍ نَبَشَ اِمْرَأَةً فَسَلَبَهَا ثِيَابَهَا وَ نَكَحَهَا فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدِ اِخْتَلَفُوا عَلَيْنَا هَاهُنَا طَائِفَةٌ قَالُوا
أقْتُلُوهُ وَ طَائِفَةٌ قَالُوا أَحْرِقُوهُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ إِلَيْهِ «أَنَّ حُرْمَةَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ كَحُرْمَةِ اَلْحَيِّ حَدُّهُ أنْ تُقْطَعَ يَدُهُ لِنَبْشِهِ
وَ سَلْبِهِ اَلثَّيَابَ وَ يُقَامَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُ فِي الزِّنَا إِنْ أَحْصِنَ رُجِمَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أُحْصِنَ جُلِدَ مِائَةً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.228 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.74 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.62 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.10 p.116 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.246 • Al-Wafi, Vol.15 p.353 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.278

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his family) said:
“Avert prescribed punishments through doubts. There is no intercession, no
guarantee, and no oath in matters of prescribed punishments.”
text_ar: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَ : «اِدْرَءُوا اَلْحُدُودَ بِالشُّبُهَاتِ وَ لاَ شَفَاعَةَ وَ لاَ كَفَالَةَ وَ لاَ يَمِينَ فِي حَدَّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.74 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.28 p.47 • Al-Fusul Al- Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.513

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, it is reported:
"Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} was presented with a man who had consumed alcohol.
Imam {a.s} asked him to recite the Qur'an, and the man recited it.
Then Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} took his cloak and threw it among the cloaks of the
people and said to him, 'Retrieve your cloak.'
When he could not distinguish it, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} carried out the legal
punishment on him."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ أَتِيَ بِشَارِبٍ
فَاسْتَقْرَأَهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَقَرَأَهُ فَأَخَذَ رِدَاءَهُ فَأَلْقَاهُ مَعَ أَرْدِيَةِ النَّاسِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ «خَلَّض رِدَاك» فَلَمْ يُخَلِّضْهُ فَحَدَّهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.74

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Abu Ayyub narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
"In the book of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, it is mentioned that He {a.s} would administer
punishment using a whip, half a whip, or even a part of it - meaning in the legal
punishments (hudud) when a young boy or girl, who had not yet reached maturity, was
brought to him.
Yet, He {a.s} would not nullify any of Allah’s {SWT} prescribed punishments."
Imam Al Sadiq {a.s} was asked: “How would he strike with part of the whip?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} would hold the whip by its middle and
strike with it, or he would hold it by a third and strike with it, in proportion to their ages.
In this way, he would strike them with the whip without nullifying any of Allah’s {SWT}
prescribed punishments, the Mighty and Majestic."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو أَيُوبَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ
كَانَ يَضْرِبُ بِالسَّوْطِ وَ بِنِصْفِ السَّوْطِ وَ بِبَعْضِهِ يَعْنِي فِي الْحُدُودِ إِذَا أَتِيَ بِغَلَامٍ أَوْ جَارِيَةِ لَمْ يُدْرِكَا وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ
يُنْطِلُ حَدّاً مِنْ حُدُودِ اللّهِ» فَقِيلَ لَهُ كَيْفَ كَانَ يَضْرِبُ بِبَعْضِهِ قَالَ «كَانَ يَأْخُذُ ٱلسَّوْطَ بِيَدِهِ مِنْ وَسَطِهِ فَيَضْرِبُ
بِهِ أَوْ مِنْ ثُلْثِهِ فَيَضْرِبُ بِهِ عَلَى قَدْرِ أَسْنَانِهِمْ كَذَلِكَ يَضْرِبُهُمْ بِالسَّوْطِ وَ لا يُنْطِلُ حَدّاً مِنْ حُدُودِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».

text_chunk:
Abu Ayyub narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
"In the book of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, it is mentioned that He {a.s} would administer
punishment using a whip, half a whip, or even a part of it - meaning in the legal
punishments (hudud) when a young boy or girl, who had not yet reached maturity, was
brought to him.
Yet, He {a.s} would not nullify any of Allah’s {SWT} prescribed punishments."
Imam Al Sadiq {a.s} was asked: “How would he strike with part of the whip?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} would hold the whip by its middle and
strike with it, or he would hold it by a third and strike with it, in proportion to their ages.
In this way, he would strike them with the whip without nullifying any of Allah’s {SWT}
prescribed punishments, the Mighty and Majestic."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF LEGAL PUNISHMENTS
text_en:
Commander of the Faithful {a.s} delivered a sermon to the people and said:
"Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, has set boundaries, so do not transgress
them. He {SWT} has made obligations, so do not neglect them.
And He {SWT} has remained silent on certain matters - not out of forgetfulness - so do
not burden yourselves with them.
This is a mercy from Allah {SWT} for you, so accept it."
Then Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"What is lawful (halal) is clear, and what is unlawful (haram) is clear, and between
them are doubtful matters.
Whoever avoids what is doubtful regarding sin will be even more cautious in avoiding
what is clearly sinful.
The acts of disobedience are the sanctuary of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic.
Whoever grazes near it is likely to fall into it."
text_ar:
وَ خَطَبَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ النَّاسَ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى حَدَّ حُدُوداً فَلا تَعْتَدُوهَا وَ
فَرَضَ فَرَائِضَ فَلاَ تَنْقُصُوهَا وَ سَكَتَ عَنْ أَشيَاءَ لَمْ يَسْكُثْ عَنْهَا نِسْيَاناً لَهَا فَلاَ تُكَلَّفُوهَا رَحْمَةً مِنَ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ
فَاقْبَلُوهَا» ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلِيٌ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ «حَلاَلٌ بَيِّنْ وَ حَرَامٌ بَيِّنٌ وَ شُبُهَاتُ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ فَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَا اِشتَبَهَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ
اَلْإِثْمِ فَهُوَ لِمَا اِسْتَبَانَ لَهُ أَثْرَكُ وَ الْمَعَاصِي جِمَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ فَمَنْ يَرْتَعْ حَوْلَهَا يُوشِكْ أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا».
