author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS MADE THROUGH WRITING AND GESTURES
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-Ashari narrated from Al-Sindi ibn Muhammad from
Yunus ibn Yaʿqub from Abu Maryam, who narrated from his father:
Umamah bint Abi Al-Aṣ - whose mother was Zaynab, the daughter of the Messenger of
Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his family) - was married to Imam Ali ibn Abi Ṭalib
{a.s} after Sayyida Faṭimah {s.a} (passed away).
After the martyrdom of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, Al-Mughirah ibn Al-Nawfal married
her.
It was narrated that she became severely ill until her tongue became paralyzed. Imam
Hasan ibn Ali {a.s} and Imam Hussain ibn Ali {a.s}, the sons of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s},
came to her while she was unable to speak.
They {a.s} began asking her, while Al-Mughirah disapproved.
They {a.s} asked: "Did you emancipate so-and-so and his family?" She nodded her head
in agreement.
They {a.s} continued: "And this and that?"
She again nodded her head in affirmation but could not speak clearly.
Her gestures were accepted as valid in confirming her wishes.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ الْأَشعَرِي عَنِ السِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ
أَبِيهِ : أَنَّ أَمَامَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ وَ أَمُهَا زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَتْ تَحْتَ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ
عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بَعْدَ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ فَخَلَفَ عَلَيْهَا بَعْدَ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النَّوْقَلِ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهَا وَجِعَتْ
وَجَعاً شَدِيداً حَتَّى أُعْتُقِلَ لِسَانُهَا فَجَاءَهَا الْحَسَنُ وَ الْحُسَيْنُ اِبْنَا عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ وَ هِيَ لا تَسْتَطِيعُ الْكَلَاَمَ
فَجَعَلاً يَقُولاَنِ لَهَا وَ الْمُغِيرَةُ كَارِهً لِذَلِكَ «أَعْتَقْتِ فُلاناً وَ أَهْلَهُ» فَجَعَلَتْ تُشِيرُ بِرَأْسِهَا نَعَمْ «وَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا» فَجَعَلَتْ
تُشِيرُ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ نَعَمْ لا تُفْصِحُ بِالْكَلامِ فَأَجَازَ ذَلِكَ لَهَا.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.198 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.29 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.373 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.22 p.157
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-Ashari narrated from Al-Sindi ibn Muhammad from
Yunus ibn Yaʿqub from Abu Maryam, who narrated from his father:
Umamah bint Abi Al-Aṣ - whose mother was Zaynab, the daughter of the Messenger of
Allah {SWT} (peace be upon him and his family) - was married to Imam Ali ibn Abi Ṭalib
{a.s} after Sayyida Faṭimah {s.a} (passed away).
After the martyrdom of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, Al-Mughirah ibn Al-Nawfal married
her.
It was narrated that she became severely ill until her tongue became paralyzed. Imam
Hasan ibn Ali {a.s} and Imam Hussain ibn Ali {a.s}, the sons of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s},
came to her while she was unable to speak.
They {a.s} began asking her, while Al-Mughirah disapproved.
They {a.s} asked: "Did you emancipate so-and-so and his family?" She nodded her head
in agreement.
They {a.s} continued: "And this and that?"
She again nodded her head in affirmation but could not speak clearly.
Her gestures were accepted as valid in confirming her wishes.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS MADE THROUGH WRITING AND GESTURES
text_en:
It was narrated from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad Al-Hamadhani, who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} regarding a man who wrote
something in his own handwriting but did not tell his heirs, "This is my will," nor did he
say, "I have made a will." However, he wrote a document that contained what he
intended to bequeath.
I asked whether it was obligatory for his heirs to fulfill what was written in his
handwriting, even though he did not command them to do so.
Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} replied: "If he had children, they must carry out everything they find
written in their father's document, whether it pertains to acts of righteousness or
anything else."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ الْهَمَذَانِيّ قَالَ : كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ رَجُلْ كَتَبَ كِتَاباً بِخَطَّهِ
وَ لَمْ يَقْلْ لِوَرَثَتِهِ هَذِهِ وَصِيَّتِي وَ لَمْ يَقُلْ إِنِّي قَدْ أَوْصَيْتُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ كَتَبَ كِتَاباً فِيهِ مَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِهِ هَلْ يَجِبُ
عَلَى وَرَثَتِهِ الْقِيَامُ بِمَا فِي الْكِتَابِ بِخَطَّهِ وَ لَمْ يَأْمُرْهُمْ بِذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ وُلَدٌ يُنْفِذُونَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
يَجِدُونَ فِي كِتَابٍ أَبِيهِمْ فِي وَجْهِ الْبِرِّ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.198 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.30 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.372

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON REVOKING A BEQUEST
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faḍḍal narrated from Ali ibn Uqbah from Burayd Al-ʿIjli
from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"The one who makes a will has the right to revoke it or make changes to it as long as he
is alive."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرُّجُوعِ عَنِ الْوَصِيَّةِ
رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ الْعِجْلِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ :
«لِصَاحِبِ اَلْوَصِيَّةِ أنْ يَرْجِعَ فِيهَا وَ يُحْدِثَ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ مَا دَامَ حَيّاً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.12 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.199 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.190 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.73 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.303

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON REVOKING A BEQUEST
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Bukayr ibn Aʿyan from Ubayd ibn
Zurarah, who said: I heard Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"The one making a will has the right to revoke it, whether he is in good health or ill."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أُغْيَنَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ : «لِلْمُوصِي أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ إِنْ كَانَ فِي صِحَةٍ أَوْ مَرَضٍ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.12 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.199 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.189 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.73 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.303

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON REVOKING A BEQUEST
text_en:
Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Abu
Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} ruled that the manumitted slave (Al-mudabbar) is
to be freed from one-third of the estate. A man has the right to revoke his will, to add
to it or reduce from it, as long as he has not passed away."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ : «قَضَى أَمِيرُ
الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنّ الْمُدَبَّرَ مِنَ التُلُثِ وَ أَنَّ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَنْقُضَ وَصِيَّتَهُ فَيَزِيدَ فِيهَا وَ يَنْقُصَ مِنْهَا مَا لَمْ يَمُثْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.12 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.199 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.190 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.74 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.302
text_chunk:
Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Abu
Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} ruled that the manumitted slave (Al-mudabbar) is
to be freed from one-third of the estate. A man has the right to revoke his will, to add

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON REVOKING A BEQUEST
text_en:
In the narration of Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman with his chain of transmission,
Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s} said:
"A man has the right to alter his will. He may free the one he had initially ordered to be
owned, and he may grant ownership to the one he had initially ordered to be freed. He
may give to the one he had previously deprived and deprive the one he had previously
granted, as long as he has not retracted from his decision."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ : «لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُفَيِّرَ
مِنْ وَصِيَّتِهِ فَيُعْتِقَ مَنْ كَانَ أَمَرَ بِتَمْلِيكِهِ وَ يُمَلِّكَ مَنْ كَانَ أَمَرَ بِعِثْقِهِ وَ يُعْطِيَ مَنْ كَانَ حَرَمَهُ وَ يَحْرِمَ مَنْ كَانَ
أَعْطَاهُ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ رَجَعَ عَنْهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.199

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON ONE WHO MAKES A BEQUEST
text_en:
Hammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} regarding a man who made a will in the presence of his heirs, and they
approved it. However, after the man's death, they attempted to revoke the will.
Imam {a.s} said: "They do not have the right to revoke it. The will remains binding upon
them once they had approved it during his lifetime."

Scholar's Note:
Similarly, Ṣafwan ibn Yahya narrated from Manṣur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdullah {a.s}
with the same ruling.
text_ar:
بَابٌ فِيمَن أَوْصَى بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ التُلُثِ وَ وَرَثَتُهُ شُهُودٌ فَأَجَازُوا ذَلِكَ هَلْ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَنْقُضُوا ذَلِكَ
بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ
رَوَى حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى
بِوَصِيَّةٍ وَ وَرَثَتُهُ شُهُودٌ فَأْجَازُوا ذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ نَقَضُوا الْوَصِيَّةَ هَلْ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَرُدُّوا مَا أَقَرُوا بِهِ فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ
لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ وَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةُ جَائِزَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ إِذَا أَقَرُّوا بِهَا فِي حَيَاتِهِ».
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: مِثلَهُ.
commentary:
Similarly, Ṣafwan ibn Yahya narrated from Manṣur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdullah {a.s}
with the same ruling.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE OBLIGATION OF EXECUTING THE
text_en:
Hammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man who made a will to give his wealth in the way of
Allah {SWT}.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Give it to the one he specified in his will, even if that person is a Jew
or a Christian. Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Majestic, says:
'But whoever changes it after hearing it, the sin is only upon those who change it.'"
(Surah Al-Baqarah 2:181)

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him) commented:
"What he has the right to bequeath is one-third (of his wealth)."
text_ar:
بَابُ وُجُوبٍ إِنْفَاذِ الْوَصِيَّةِ وَ النَّهْيِ عَنْ تَبْدِيلِهَا
رَوَى حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
أَوْصَى بِمَالِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «أَعْطِهِ لِمَنْ أَوْصَى لَهُ بِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَهُودِيَا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيَاً إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِّ وَ جَلَ يَقُولُ
فَمَنْ بَدَّلَهُ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى الَذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ مَا لَهُ هُوَ الثّلُثُ.
commentary:
The author of this book (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him) commented:
"What he has the right to bequeath is one-third (of his wealth)."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE OBLIGATION OF EXECUTING THE BEQUEST AND THE PROHIBITION OF ALTERING IT
text_en:
Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Yaʿqub:
A man in Hamadhan mentioned that his father had passed away. His father was
unaware of this matter (the teachings of the Ahl Al-Bayt), and before his death, he
made a will instructing that something be given in the way of Allah {SWT}.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked about how to fulfill this will, and it was explained to Imam
{a.s} that the deceased was unaware of the truth but had made a will at the time of his
death.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: "If a man had made a will to me to distribute his wealth to a Jew
or a Christian, I would fulfill it for them. Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Majestic,
says:
'But whoever changes it after hearing it, the sin is only upon those who change it. Verily,
Allah {SWT} is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.'" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:181)
Then Imam {a.s} added: "Look for someone who is engaged in these paths (meaning the
frontier defense posts), and send it to him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ : أنَّ رَجُلاً كَانَ بِهَمَذَانَ ذَكَرَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ مَاتَ
وَ كَانَ لاَ يَعْرِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ فَأَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُعْطَى شَيْءُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَسُئِلَ عَنْهُ أَبُو
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ كَيْفَ يُفْعَلُ بِهِ وَ أَخْبَرْنَاهُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لاَ يَعْرِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ وَ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ «لَوْ
أنَّ رَجُلاً أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ أَنْ أَضَعَ مَالَهُ فِي يَهُودِيَّ أَوْ نَصْرَانِيّ لَوَضَعْتُهُ فِيهِمْ إِنَّ آللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ يَقُولُ فَمَنْ بَدَّلَهُ
بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثُمُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ ٢ فَانْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ يَخْرُجُ فِي هَذِهِ الْوُجُوهِ يَعِنِي
التُّغُورَ فَابْعَثُوا بِهِ إِلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.200
text_chunk:
Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Yaʿqub:
A man in Hamadhan mentioned that his father had passed away. His father was
unaware of this matter (the teachings of the Ahl Al-Bayt), and before his death, he
made a will instructing that something be given in the way of Allah {SWT}.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} was asked about how to fulfill this will, and it was explained to Imam
{a.s} that the deceased was unaware of the truth but had made a will at the time of his
death.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: "If a man had made a will to me to distribute his wealth to a Jew
or a Christian, I would fulfill it for them. Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Majestic,
says:
'But whoever changes it after hearing it, the sin is only upon those who change it. Verily,
Allah {SWT} is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.'" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:181)
Then Imam {a.s} added: "Look for someone who is engaged in these paths (meaning the
frontier defense posts), and send it to him."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE OBLIGATION OF EXECUTING THE BEQUEST AND THE PROHIBITION OF ALTERING IT
text_en:
It was narrated from Abu Ṭalib Abdullah ibn Al-Ṣalt Al-Qummi that he said:
Al-Khalil ibn Hashim wrote to Dhu Al-Ri'asatayn, who was the governor of Nishapur,
informing him that a man from the Magians had passed away and had bequeathed a
portion of his wealth to the poor.
The executor in Nishapur took that wealth and distributed it among the poor Muslims.
Al-Khalil wrote to Dhu Al-Riʾasatayn about this matter, and Dhu Al-Riʾasatayn
consulted Al-Maʾmun, who said: “I have no ruling on this issue."
Then he asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, and Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} replied:
"The Magian did not bequeath his wealth to the poor Muslims. Therefore, it is
appropriate that an equivalent amount from the charity funds be taken and returned
to the poor among the Magians."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ الْقُمِّيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : كَتَّبَ ٱلْخَلِيلُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ إلَى ذِي الرِّئَاسَتَيْنِ وَ
هُوَ وَالِي نَيْسَابُورَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ ٱلْمَجُوسِ مَاتَ وَ أُوْصَى لِلْفُقَرَاءِ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ فَأَخَذَهُ ٱلْوَصِيُّ بِنَيْسَابُورَ فَجَعَلَهُ
فِي فُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَكَتَبَ الْخَلِيلُ إِلَى ذِي الرِّئَّاسَتَيْنِ بِذَلِكَ فَسَأَلَ ٱلْمَأْمُونَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَيْسَ عِنْدِي فِي ذَلِكَ
شَيْءٌ فَسَأَلَ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ «إِنَّ ٱلْمَجُوسِيّ لَمْ يُوصِ لِفُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ
لَكِنْ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُوُخَذَ مِقْدَارُ ذَلِكَ ٱلْمَالِ مِنْ مَالِ الصَّدَفَةِ فَيُرَدَ عَلَى فُقَرَاءِ ٱلْمَجُوسِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.16 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.201 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.202 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.129 • Fiqh Al-Quran, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.88 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.342

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A PERSON’S RIGHT OVER HIS WEALTH
text_en:
Thaʿlabah ibn Maymun narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Sabaṭi from Ammar
ibn Musa that he heard Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"The owner of the wealth has the most right over his wealth as long as there remains
in him any part of the soul. He may dispose of it wherever he wishes."
text_ar:
بَابٌ فِي أَنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ أَحَقُ بِمَالِهِ مَا دَامَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الرُّوحِ
رَوَى ثَعْلَبَةُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ السَابَاطِيِّ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
يَقُولُ : «صَاحِبُ ٱلْمَالِ أَحَقُ بِمَالِهِ، مَا دَامَ فِيهِ شَيْءْ مِنَ ٱلرُّوحِ يَضَّعُهُ حَيْتُ يَشَاءُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.7 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.201 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.186 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.63 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.297

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A PERSON’S RIGHT OVER HIS WEALTH
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Jabalah narrated from Samaah, from Abu Baṣir, from Abu
Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s}, "A man who has children, is it permissible for him to give his wealth
to his relatives?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is his wealth; he may do with it as he wishes until death comes to
him."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, explained this to mean that
a person may distribute his wealth during his lifetime or gift all of it while alive and hand
it over to the recipient. However, if he bequeaths it (after death), he cannot allocate
more than one-third of it.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَجُلُ
يَكُونُ لَهُ الْوَلَدُ يَسَعُهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ مَالَهُ لِقَرَابَتِهِ قَالَ «هُوَ مَالُهُ يَصْنَعُ بِهِ مَا شَاءَ إِلَى أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ أَنْ يُبِينَ بِهِ مِنْ مَالِهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِ أَوْ يَهَبَهُ كُلَّهُ فِي حَيَاتِهِ وَ يُسَلَّمَهُ مِنَ الْمَوْهَوِبِ
الَهُ فَأَمًا إِذَا أَوْصَى بِهِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنَ التُلُثِ.
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, explained this to mean that
a person may distribute his wealth during his lifetime or gift all of it while alive and hand
it over to the recipient. However, if he bequeaths it (after death), he cannot allocate
more than one-third of it.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A PERSON’S RIGHT OVER HIS WEALTH AS LONG AS THERE REMAINS SOME LIFE IN HIM
text_en:
And the confirmation of this is what Ṣafwan narrated from Murazim regarding
a man who gives something from his wealth during his illness.
Imm {a.s} said: "If he clearly transfers it (during his lifetime), then it is valid. However, if
he bequeaths it (for after his death), then it is only from one-third of his wealth."
text_ar:
وَ تَصْدِيقُ ذَلِكَ- مَا رَوَاهُ صَفَوَانُ عَنْ مُرَازِم فِي الرَّجُلِ يُغْطِي الشَيْءَ مِنْ مَالِهِ فِي مَرَضِهِ قَالَ إِذَا أَبَانَ
بِهِ فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ وَ إِنْ أَوْصَى بِهِ فَمِنَ الثَّلُثِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.202
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A PERSON’S RIGHT OVER HIS WEALTH AS LONG AS THERE REMAINS SOME LIFE IN HIM
text_en:
As for the narration of Ali ibn Asbaṭ from Thaʿlabah from Abu Al-Hasan Amr
ibn Shaddad Al-Azdi from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
"A man has the most right over his wealth as long as his soul remains in him. If he
bequeaths all of it, it is permissible for him."

Scholar's Note:
It means this is permissible if he has no close or distant heir. In such a case, he may
bequeath all of his wealth as he wishes.
However, if he has a close or distant heir, it is not permissible for him to bequeath
more than one-third of his wealth. If he does bequeath more than one-third, it must
then be reduced down to one-third.
text_ar:
وَ أَمّا حَدِيثُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ شَدَّادِ الْأَزْدِيَّ عَنْ عَمّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الرّجُلُ أَحَقُ بِمَالِهِ مَا دَامَ فِيهِ الرُوحُ إِنْ أَوْصَى بِهِ كُلِّهِ فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ لَهُ».
فَإِنَّهُ يَعْنِي بِهِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَارِثُ قَرِيبٌ وَ لَا بَعِيدٌ فَيُوصِي بِمَالِهِ كُلَّهِ حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ وَ مَتَى كَانَ لَهُ وَارِثُ قَرِيبْ أَوْ بَعِيدٌ لَمْ يَجُزْ
لَهُ أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِأكْثَرَ مِنَ التُلُثِ وَ إِذَا أَوْصَى بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ رُدَّ إِلَى التُّلُثِ
commentary:
It means this is permissible if he has no close or distant heir. In such a case, he may
bequeath all of his wealth as he wishes.
However, if he has a close or distant heir, it is not permissible for him to bequeath
more than one-third of his wealth. If he does bequeath more than one-third, it must
then be reduced down to one-third.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE BEQUEST OF ONE WHO INTENTIONALLY TAKES HIS OWN LIFE
text_en:
And a confirmation of this is what was narrated by Ismaʿil ibn Abi Ziyad Al-
Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} from his father, Abu Abdullah
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, that he was asked about a man who dies without
leaving behind an heir or any male relative (Aṣabah).
Imam {a.s} said: "He may bequeath his wealth as he wishes among the Muslims, the
poor, and the wayfarer."

Scholar's Note:
This narration provides a clear explanation, and an explicit (mufassar) narration takes
precedence over a general (mujmal) one in determining rulings.
text_ar:
وَ تَصْدِيقُ ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادِ السُكُونِيُ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَ : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ
الرَّجْلِ يَمُوتُ وَ لا وَارِثَ لَهُ وَ لاَ عَصَّبَةَ قَالَ «يُوصِي بِمَالِهِ حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ الْمَسَاكِينِ وَ اِبْنِ السَّبِيلِ».
وَ هَذَا حَدِيثْ مُفَسَّرٌ وَ الْمُفَسَّرُ يَحْكُمُ عَلَى الْمُجْمَلِ.
commentary:
This narration provides a clear explanation, and an explicit (mufassar) narration takes
precedence over a general (mujmal) one in determining rulings.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.202

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE BEQUEST OF ONE WHO
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad, who said: I heard Abu
Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"Whoever intentionally kills himself will be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever."
Imam {a.s} was asked: "What if he had made a will (waṣiyyah) and then deliberately
killed himself immediately after? Will his will be carried out?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "If he made the will before committing any harmful act against
himself, whether by injury or any other action, then his will is valid regarding one-third
of his wealth. However, if he made the will after having already harmed himself - by
injuring himself or committing an act intending death - then his will is not valid."
text_ar:
بَابُ وَصِيَّةٍ مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ مُتَعَمِّداً
رَوَى اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاّدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ يَقُولُ : «مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ
مُتَعَمَّداً فَهُوَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ «خالِداً فِيها» » قِيلَ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةِ ثُمَّ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ مُتَعَمِّداً مِنْ سَاعَتِهِ
تُنْفَذُ وَصِيَّثُهُ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ أَوْصَى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحَدِثَ حَدَثاً فِي نَفْسِهِ مِنْ جِرَاحَةٍ أَوْ فِعْلِ أُجِيزَتْ وَصِيَّثُهُ فِي ثُلْثِهِ وَ
إِنْ كَانَ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةٍ وَ قَدْ أَحْدَثَ فِي نَفْسِهِ جِرَاحَةً أَوْ فِعْلاً لَعَلَّهُ يَمُوتُ لَمْ تُجَزْ وَصِيَّتُهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.45 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.202 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.207 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.168 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.378
text_chunk:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad, who said: I heard Abu
Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"Whoever intentionally kills himself will be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever."
Imam {a.s} was asked: "What if he had made a will (waṣiyyah) and then deliberately
killed himself immediately after? Will his will be carried out?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "If he made the will before committing any harmful act against
himself, whether by injury or any other action, then his will is valid regarding one-third
of his wealth. However, if he made the will after having already harmed himself - by
injuring himself or committing an act intending death - then his will is not valid."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TWO MEN BEING APPOINTED AS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ṣaffar (may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him) wrote
to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s} asking:
"A man appointed two individuals as executors of his will. Is it permissible for one of
them to independently handle half of the inheritance and the other to manage the
other half?"
Imam {a.s} responded in writing: "It is not appropriate for them to act contrary to the
deceased's instructions. They should act according to what he commanded them,
God willing."

Scholar's Note:
This written response is confirmed to be in his own handwriting.
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجْلَيْنِ يُوصَى إِلَيْهِمَا فَيَنْفَرِدُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِنِصْفِ التَّرِكَةِ
كَتَبَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصِّفَارُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلَاَمُ : رَجُلٌ أَوْصَى
إِلَى رَجُلَيْنِ أَيَجُوزُ لِأَحَدِهِمَا أَنْ يَنْفَرِدَ بِنِصْفِ التَّرِكَةِ وَ الْآخَرِ بِالنَّصْفِ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمَا أَنْ يُخَالِفَا
اَلْمَيَّتَ وَ يَعْمَلآَنٍ عَلَى حَسَبٍ مَا أَمَرَهُمَا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ».
وَ هَذَا التَوْقِيعُ عِنْدِي بِخَطَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON TWO MEN BEING APPOINTED AS EXECUTORS OF A BEQUEST, AND EACH TAKING CHARGE OF HALF OF THE
text_en:
In the book of Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub Al-Kulayni (may Allah {SWT} have mercy
on him), narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Mithami, from
his two brothers Muhammad and Ahmad, from their father, from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid,
from Burayd ibn Muawiyah, it is reported:
A man passed away and appointed two individuals as executors of his will. One of
them said to his companion, "Take half of what he left behind, and give me the other
half."
However, the other refused.
They sought guidance from Abu Abdullah {a.s} regarding this matter, and Imam {a.s} said:
"That rightfully belongs to him."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him) stated: "I do not issue a
legal verdict (fatwa) based on this narration. Rather, I issue a fatwa according to what
I possess in the handwriting of Imam Hasan ibn Ali {a.s}.
And if both reports were authentic, it would be obligatory to follow the statement of
the latter, as ordered by Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}. This is because
narrations have various aspects and meanings, and every Imam {a.s} is more
knowledgeable about his time and its rulings than anyone else. And with Allah {SWT} is
success."
text_ar:
وَ فِي كِتَابٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُلَيْنِيِّ رَجِمَهُ اللهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الْمِيتَمِيِّ عَنْ
أَخَوَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ : إِنَّ رَجُلاً مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى إِلَى
رَجُلَيْنٍ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ خُذْ نِصْفَ مَا تَرَكَ وَ أَعْطِنِي النَّصْفَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ فَأَبَى عَلَيْهِ الْآخَرُ فَسَأَلُوا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «ذَاكَ لَهُ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ لَسْتُ أَفْتِي بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بَلْ أَفْتِي بِمَا عِنْدِي بِخَطَّ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيّ ع وَ لَوْ صَحَ الْخَبَرَانِ
جَمِيعاً لَكَانَ الْوَاجِبُ الْأَخْذَ بِقَوْلِ الْأَخِيرِ كَمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ الصَّادِقُ ع وَ ذَلِكَ أنَّ الْأَخْبَارَ لَهَا وُجُوهٌ وَ مَعَانٍ وَ كُلْ إمَامِ أُعْلَمُ بِزَمَانِهِ وَ
أَحْكَامِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَ بِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيقُ

And if both reports were authentic, it would be obligatory to follow the statement of
the latter, as ordered by Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}. This is because
narrations have various aspects and meanings, and every Imam {a.s} is more
knowledgeable about his time and its rulings than anyone else. And with Allah {SWT} is
success."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS OF A PORTION OF WEALTH,
text_en:
Aban ibn Taghlib narrated from Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s} that Imam {a.s} was
asked about a man who made a bequest (waṣiyyah) of something from his wealth.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The portion specified in the Book of (Imam) Ali {a.s} is one out of six
parts."
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيَّةِ بِالشَّيْءِ مِنَ الْمَالِ وَ السَّهِمِ وَ الْجُزْءِ وَ الْكَثِيرِ
رَوَى أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ : أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ فَقَالَ
«الشَّيْءُ فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ سِنَّةٍ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS OF A PORTION OF WEALTH,
text_en:
Al-Sakuni narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s} that he was asked about a man who
bequeaths a share (sahm) of his wealth.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The share is one out of eight parts, based on the saying of Allah {SWT},
the Mighty and Majestic:
“Indeed, the charities are only for the poor, the needy, those employed to collect them,
those whose hearts are to be reconciled, for freeing slaves, for those in debt, in the way
of Allah {SWT}, and for the stranded traveler." (Surah Al-Tawbah, 9:60)
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى السَّكُونِي عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : أَنْهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُوصِي بِسَهْمِ مِنْ مَالِهِ فَقَالَ «آَلسَّهُمُ
وَاجِدٌ مِنْ ثَمَانِيَةٍ لِقَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ ٠ إِنَّمَا الصَّدَقْاتُ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ وَ ٱلْمَسْاكِينِ وَ ٱلْعَامِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا وَ ٱلْمُؤَلِّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ
وَ فِي الرّقَابٍ وَ الْغَارِمِينَ وَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّهِ وَ اِبْنِ السَّبِيلِ
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.41 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.204 • Ma’ani Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.216 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.210 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.133 • Fiqh Al-Quran, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.142 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.386 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.100 p.209 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.2 p.235

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS OF A PORTION OF WEALTH, A SHARE, A PART, OR A LARGE AMOUNT
text_en:
It has been narrated that "the share is one out of six."

Scholar's Note:
The compiler of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, explained: Whenever a
bequest is made for a share from the categories of zakat, the share is one out of eight,
corresponding to the eight categories mentioned in the Qur'an.
However, if the bequest is for a share from inheritance shares, then the share is one
out of six, aligning with the divisions in inheritance.
These two narrations are consistent and not contradictory. Therefore, the will should
be executed according to what appears to be the intention of the testator.
text_ar:
وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ : «أَنَّ السَّهْمَ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ سِنَّةٍ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ مَتَّى أَوْصَى بِسَهْمِ مِنْ سِهَامِ الزَّكَاةِ كَانَ السّهمُ وَاحِداً مِنْ ثَمَانِيَةٍ وَ مَتَى أَوْصَى بِسَهْمِ مِنْ
سِهَامِ الْمَوَارِيثِ فَالسَّهِمُ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ سِنَّةٍ وَ هَذَانِ الْحَدِيثَانِ مُتَفِقَانٍ غَيْرُ مُخْتَلِفَيْنِ فَتُمْضَى الْوَصِيَّةُ عَلَى مَا يَظْهَرُ مِنْ مُرَادِ
المُوصِي

The compiler of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, explained: Whenever a

corresponding to the eight categories mentioned in the Qur'an.
However, if the bequest is for a share from inheritance shares, then the share is one
out of six, aligning with the divisions in inheritance.
These two narrations are consistent and not contradictory. Therefore, the will should
be executed according to what appears to be the intention of the testator.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS OF A PORTION OF WEALTH, A SHARE, A PART, OR A LARGE AMOUNT
text_en:
It is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Thalabah ibn Maymun,
from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who
bequeathed a portion of his wealth.
Imam {a.s} replied: “A portion is one-tenth." Allah {SWT}, the Almighty, said:
"Then place on every mountain a portion (juz') of them" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:260), and
the mountains were ten.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ تَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِجُزْء مِنْ مَالِهِ فَقَالَ «جُزْءٌ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ) ثُمَّ اِجْعَلَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ
جَبَلٍ مِنْهُنَّ جُزْءاً وَ كَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ عَشَرَةً.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.40 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.205 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.208 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.132 • Fiqh Al-Quran, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.139 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.381 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.281

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS OF A PORTION OF WEALTH, A SHARE, A PART, OR A LARGE AMOUNT
text_en:
It is narrated by Al-Bazanti from Al-Husayn ibn Khalid, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} about a man who bequeathed a portion of his wealth.
Imam {a.s} replied: “It is one-seventh of his one-third share."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, explains that in the past,
wealthy individuals would divide their wealth into portions. Some would divide their
wealth into ten parts, while others would divide it into seven.
Therefore, a person's will should be executed according to how they customarily
divided their wealth. Such specific forms of bequests are usually made by those well-
versed in language and understanding. However, for the majority of people, wills are
generally made in clear and specific terms that require no further interpretation.
If a person makes a will or vows to give away "a large amount" of wealth, then the
interpretation of "a large amount" is considered to be eighty or more, based on the
verse of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Indeed, Allah {SWT} has given you victory in many
(kathirah) battlefields" (Surah At-Tawbah 9:25), where "many" referred to eighty
instances of victory.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْبَرَنْطِيُّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِجُزْءٍ
مِنْ مَالِهِ قَالَ «سُبُعُ ثُلُثِهِ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَمْوَالِ فِيمَا مَضَى يُجَزَّءُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَجْعَلُ أَجْرَاءَ مَالِهِ عَشَرَةً وَ
مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَجْعَلُهَا سَبْعَةً فَعَلَى حَسَبِ رَسْمِ الرَّجُلِ فِي مَالِهِ تُمْضَى وَصِيَّتُهُ وَ مِثْلُ هَذَا لَا يُوصِي بِهِ إِلَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ اللُغَةَ وَ يَفْهَمْ
عَنْهُ فَأَمَا جُمْهُورُ النَّاسِ فَلَا تَقَعُ لَهُمْ الْوَصَايَا إِلَّا بِالْمَعْلُومِ الَّذِي لَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى تَفْسِيرِ مَبْلَغِهِ فَإِذَا أُوْصَى رَجُلٌ بِمَالٍ كَثِيرٍ أَوْ نَذَرَ
أنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِمَالٍ كَثِيرِ فَالْكَثِيرُ ثَمَانُونَ وَ مَا زَادَ لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى
• لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَواطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ
وَ كَانَتْ
ثَمَانِينَ مَوْطِنا.
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, explains that in the past,
wealthy individuals would divide their wealth into portions. Some would divide their
wealth into ten parts, while others would divide it into seven.
Therefore, a person's will should be executed according to how they customarily
divided their wealth. Such specific forms of bequests are usually made by those well-
versed in language and understanding. However, for the majority of people, wills are
generally made in clear and specific terms that require no further interpretation.
If a person makes a will or vows to give away "a large amount" of wealth, then the
interpretation of "a large amount" is considered to be eighty or more, based on the
verse of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Indeed, Allah {SWT} has given you victory in many
(kathirah) battlefields" (Surah At-Tawbah 9:25), where "many" referred to eighty
instances of victory.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO MAKES A BEQUEST OF
text_en:
Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubaid narrated from Al-Hasan bin Rashid, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Askari, (Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s}) about a man
who made a will to dedicate wealth "in the way of Allah {SWT}" (fi sabeelillah).
Imam {a.s} replied: "The way of Allah {SWT} is our Shia (followers)."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجُلٍ يُوصِي بِمَالٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْعَسْكَرِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ
رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِمَالٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «سَبِيلُ اللَّهِ شِيعَتُنَا».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO MAKES A BEQUEST OF
text_en:
Muhammad bin Isa narrated from Muhammad bin Sulayman from Al-Husayn
bin Umar, who said: I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "A man made a will to me regarding
something in the way of Allah {SWT}."
Imam {a.s} said to me: "Use it for Hajj."
I said: “He made a will to me in the way."
Imam {a.s} said: “Use it for Hajj, for I do not know of any path among His {SWT} paths better
than Hajj."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: These two narrations
are in agreement, and that is because what has been bequeathed in the way (of Allah
{SWT}) should be directed to a man from the Shi'a who will perform Hajj on his behalf.
This aligns with the narration that states: "The way of Allah {SWT} is our Shi'a."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ إنَّ رَجُلاً أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ بِشَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ لِي «اِصْرِفْهُ فِي الْحَجِّ» قَالَ قُلْتُ أَوْصَى إِلَيّ فِي السَّبِيلِ
قَالَ «اِصْرِفْهُ فِي الْحَجِّ فَإِنِّي لاَ أُعْلَمُ سَبِيلاً مِنْ سُبُلِهِ أَفْضَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَجِّ».
قَالَ مُصَنّفُ الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ هَذَانِ الْحَدِيثَانِ مُتَّفِقَانٍ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ يُصْرَفُ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ فِي السَّبِيلِ إِلَى رَجْلٍ مِنَ الشَّيعَةِ يَحُجّ
بِهِ عَنْهُ فَهُوَ مُوَافِقٌ لِلْخَبَرِ الَذِي قَالَ: «سَبِيلُ اللّهِ شِيعَتُنَا».

The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: These two narrations
are in agreement, and that is because what has been bequeathed in the way (of Allah

This aligns with the narration that states: "The way of Allah {SWT} is our Shi'a."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LIABILITY OF THE EXECUTOR FOR
text_en:
Muhammad bin Sinan narrated from Ibn Maskan from Abu Sa'id from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} who was asked about a man who made a will for a Hajj and designated it
as a will in favor of a person.
Imam {a.s} said: “His executor must fulfill it and ensure it is carried out as a Hajj, just as
he had bequeathed. For Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, says:
'But whoever changes it after he has heard it, the sin is only upon those who change
it.'"
(Surah Al-Baqarah 2:181)
text_ar:
بَابُ ضَمَانِ الْوَصِيِّ لِمَا يُفَيِّرُهُ عَمَّا أَوْصَى بِهِ الْمَيِّثْ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سُبِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ
أَوْصَى بِحَجَّةٍ فَجَعَلَهَا وَصِيَّةً فِي نَسَمَةٍ فَقَالَ «يَعْرَمُهَا وَصِيْهُ وَ يَجْعَلُهَا فِي حَجَّةٍ كَمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ يَقُولُ ٠ فَمَنْ بَدَّلَهُ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَدَّلُونَهُ ).

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LIABILITY OF THE EXECUTOR FOR
text_en:
Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Muhammad bin Marid who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s} about a man who made a will to another man, instructing him
to free a soul (a slave) for six hundred dirhams from his one-third share of the
inheritance. However, the executor instead gave the six hundred dirhams to a man to
perform Hajj on behalf of the deceased.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} said: “I believe the executor must personally pay six hundred dirhams
from his own wealth and fulfill what the deceased had willed by freeing a soul."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَارِدٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى
إِلَى رَجُلٍ وَ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعْتِقَ عَنْهُ نَسَمَةً بِسِتَّمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ مِنْ ثُلُثِهِ فَانْطَلَقَ الْوَصِي فَأَعْطَى السَّتَمِائَةِ رَجْلاً يَحُجُّ بِهَا
عَنْهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «أَرَى أَنْ يَغْرَمَ ٱلْوَصِيُ سِتَّمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ مِنْ مَالِهِ وَ يَجْعَلَهَا فِيمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ الْمَيَّتُ
فِي نَسَمَةٍ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.22 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.207 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.226 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.97 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.348

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE LIABILITY OF THE EXECUTOR FOR ALTERING WHAT THE DECEASED HAD BEQUEATHED
text_en:
Muhammad bin Abi Umayr narrated from Zayd Al-Narsi, from Ali bin Mazid,
the companion of Al-Sabari, who said:
A man entrusted me with his estate and instructed me to perform Hajj on his behalf.
When I examined the amount, I found it to be very little and insufficient for Hajj. I asked
Abu Hanifa and the jurists of Kufa, and they said: ‘Give it in charity on his behalf’.
Later, when I met Abdullah ibn Al-Hasan during Tawaf, I asked him and said:
‘A man from your followers in Kufa passed away and entrusted his estate to me,
instructing me to perform Hajj on his behalf. However, when I examined the amount,
it was not enough for Hajj. I consulted the jurists in my area, and they advised me to
give it in charity on his behalf, so I did. What do you say?’
He replied: Here is Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} in the Hijr, go to him and
ask him.
So I entered the Hijr, and I saw Abu Abdullah {a.s} under the Mizab, facing the Kaaba,
praying. Then Imam {a.s} turned, saw me, and asked: What is your need?
I said: A man passed away and entrusted his estate to me to perform Hajj on his behalf,
but I found it insufficient for Hajj. I asked the jurists in my area, and they advised me to
give it in charity, so I did.
Imam {a.s} said: What have you done (with the money)?
I replied: I gave it in charity.
Imam {a.s} said: You are liable - unless the amount was not enough for Hajj even from
Mecca. If it was insufficient for Hajj from Mecca, then there is no liability on you. But if
it was enough for Hajj from Mecca, then you are responsible.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ النَّرْسِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَزْيَدِ صَاجِبِ السَّابِرِيِّ قَالَ : أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ رَجُلْ
بِتَرِكَتِهِ وَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَحُجَ بِهَا عَنْهُ فَنَظَرْتُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا شَيْءٌ يَسِيرٌ لا يَكْفِي لِلْحَجِّ فَسَأَلْتُ أَبَا حَنِيفَةَ وَ فُقَهَاءَ أَهْلِ
اَلْكُوفَةِ فَقَالُوا تَصَدَّقْ بِهَا عَنْهُ فَلَمَّا لَقِيتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ ٱلْحَسَنِ فِي الطَّوَافِ سَأَلْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِنْ مَوَالِيكُمْ مِنْ
أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى بِتَرِكَتِهِ إِلَيّ وَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَحُجَ بِهَا عَنْهُ فَنَظَرْتُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَلَمْ يَكْفٍ لِلْحَجَّ فَسَأَلْتُ مَنْ
عِنْدَنَا مِنَ الْفُقَهَاءِ فَقَالُوا تَصَدَّقْ بِهَا عَنْهُ فَتَصَدَّقْتُ بِهَا فَمَا تَقُولُ فَقَالَ لِي هَذَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْحِجْرِ فَأَتِهِ
فَاسْأَلَهُ فَدَخَلْتُ الْحِجْرَ فَإِذَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ تَحْتَ ٱلْمِيزَابِ مُقْبِلٌ بِوَجْهِهِ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ يَدْعُو ثُمَّ اِلْتَفَتَ
فَرَآنِي فَقَالَ «مَا حَاجَتُكَ» قُلْتُ رَجُلْ مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى بِتَرِكَتِهِ أَنْ أَحْجَ بِهَا عَنْهُ فَنَظَرْتُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَلَمْ يَكُفٍ لِلْحَجِّ
فَسَأَلْتُ مَنْ عِنْدَنَا مِنَ ٱلْفُقَهَاءِ فَقَالُوا تَصَدَّقْ بِهَا فَقَالَ «مَا صَنَغْتَ» قُلْتُ تَصَدَّقْتُ بِهَا فَقَالَ «ضَمِئْتَ إِلَّ أنْ لا يَكُونَ
يَبْلُغُ مَا يُحَجّ بِهِ مِنْ مَكَّةَ فَإِنْ كَانَ لاَ يَبْلُغُ مَا يُحَجُ بِهِ مِنْ مَكَّةَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ ضَمَانْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَبْلُغُ مَا يُحَجُّ بِهِ مِنْ
مَكَّةَ فَأَنْتَ ضَامِنُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.21 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.207 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.95

Mecca. If it was insufficient for Hajj from Mecca, then there is no liability on you. But if
it was enough for Hajj from Mecca, then you are responsible.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR RELATIVES AND FREED
text_en:
Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Ali bin Ri’ab, from Zurara, from Abu Jafar
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} regarding a man who bequeathed one-third of
his wealth to his paternal uncles and maternal uncles.
Imam {a.s} said: "Two-thirds are for his paternal uncles, and one-third is for his maternal
uncles."
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيَّةً لِلْأَقْرِبَاءِ وَ الْمَوَالِي
رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى
بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ فِي أَعْمَامِهِ وَ أَخْوَالِهِ فَقَالَ «لأَعْمَامِهِ الثُلُثَانِ وَلِأَخْوَالِهِ الثُلُثُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR RELATIVES AND FREED
text_en:
Sahl bin Ziyad Al-Adami wrote to Abu Muhammad {a.s} about a man who had
sons and daughters and acknowledged that a piece of land belonged to his children
without specifying, whether it should be divided according to Allah’s {SWT} shares and
obligations, where the male receives double the share of the female.
Abu Muhammad {a.s} responded: "They should execute their father's will as he
specified. If he did not specify anything, then it should be divided according to the
Book of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, if Allah {SWT} wills."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادِ الْأَدَمِيّ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : رَجُلٌ لَهُ وُلَدْ ذُكُورٌ وَ إِنَاتٌ فَأَقَرَّ بِضَيْعَةِ أَنَّهَا
لِوُلْدِهِ وَ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَّهَا بَيْنَهُمْ عَلَى سِهَامِ اللهِ وَ فَرَائِضِهِ الذَّكَرُ وَ الْأَنْثَى فِيهِ سَوَاءً فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «يُنْفِذُونَ
وَصِيَّةَ أَبِيهِمْ عَلَى مَا سَمَّى فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَمَّى شَيْئاً رَدُّوهَا عَلَى كِتَابِ اللهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ إنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.208

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR RELATIVES AND FREED SLAVES
text_en:
Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him, wrote
to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s} regarding a man who bequeathed
one-third of his wealth to his male and female servants, either equally or with the
instruction that "the male should receive the share of two females" from the bequest.
Abu Muhammad {a.s} replied: "It is permissible for the deceased to bequeath according
to what he specified, if Allah {SWT} the Exalted wills."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : رَجُلَ
أَوْصَى بِثلُثِ مَالِهِ فِي مَوَالِيهِ وَ مَوْلَيَاتِهِ الذَّكَرُ وَ ٱلْأَنثَى فِيهِ سَوَاءُ أَوْ «لِلذَّكَرِ مِثلُ حَظَّ الأَنْثَيَيْنِ» مِنَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ
فَوَقِّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «جَائِزٌ لِلْمَيِّتِ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ عَلَى مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON APPOINTING A COMPETENT OR AN
text_en:
Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubaid narrated from his brother Ja'far bin Isa bin
Ubaid, from Ali bin Yaqtin, who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} about a man who
appointed a woman as his executor and included a child with her in the will.
Imam {a.s} said: "This is permissible. The woman should carry out the will and does not
need to wait for the child to reach maturity. However, when the child grows up, he has
no right to object unless there has been an alteration or change in the will, in which
case he has the right to restore it to what the deceased had originally intended."
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيَّةِ إِلَى مُدْرِكِ وَ غَيْرِ مُدْرِكِ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدِ عَنْ أَجِيهِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى إِلَى اِمْرَأَةٍ وَ أَشرَكَ فِي الْوَصِيَّةِ مَعَهَا صَبِيّاً فَقَالَ «يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ وَ تُمْضِي الْمَرْأَةُ
اَلْوَصِيَّةَ وَ لا تَنْتَظِرُ بُلُوغَ الصَّبِيِّ فَإِذَا بَلَغَ الصَّبِيُّ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ لا يَرْضَى إلاَّ مَا كَانَ مِنْ تَبْدِيلٍ أَوْ تَغْيِيرٍ فَإِنَّ لَهُ أَنْ
يَرُدَّهُ إِلَى مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ الْمَيِّثُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.46 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.209 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.184 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.140 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.169 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.375

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON APPOINTING A COMPETENT OR AN
text_en:
Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him, wrote
to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s} about a man who made his
children the executors of his will, among them adults who are mature and minors who
are not mature yet.
He asked if it was permissible for the adults to execute the will and settle their father's
debts, proven against the deceased by trustworthy witnesses, before the minors
reached maturity.
Abu Muhammad {a.s} replied: "It is obligatory upon the adult children to settle their
father's debts and not delay this obligation."
text_ar:
وَ كَتَبَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلَاَمُ : رَجُلٌ
أَوْصَى إِلَى وَلَدِهِ وَ فِيهِمْ كِبَارْ قَدْ أَدْرَكُوا وَ فِيهِمْ صِغَارْ أَيَجُوزُ لِلْكِبَارِ أَنْ يُنْفِذُوا ٱلْوَصِيَّةَ وَ يَقْضُوا دَيْنَهُ لِمَنْ صَحَّحَ
عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ بِشُهُودٍ عُدُولٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَ الصِّغَارُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «عَلَى الْأَكَابِرِ مِنَ ٱلْوُلْدِ أَنْ يَقْضُوا دَيْنَ أَبِيهِمْ
وَلاَ يَحْبِسُوهُ بِذَلِكَ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE BENEFICIARY OF A BEQUEST
text_en:
Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini narrated from Muhammad ibn Umar Al-Sabati who
said: I asked Abu Ja'far Al-Thani {a.s}, (the second {a.s}), about a man who had appointed
me as his executor and instructed to give something to his uncle every year. The uncle
then passed away.
Abu Jafar {a.s} wrote in response: “Give it to his heirs.”
text_ar:
بَابُ الْمُوصَى لَهُ يَمُوتُ قَبْلَ الْمُوصِي أَوْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْبِضَ مَا أَوصِيَ لَهُ بِهِ
رَوَى عَمْرُو بْنُ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ السَّابَاطِيّ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ يَعْنِي الثَّانِيَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى إِلَيّ وَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُعْطِيَ عَمّاً لَهُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةِ شَيْئا فَمَاتَ الْعَمُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ «أَعْطِ
وَرَثَتَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.13 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.210 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.231 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.138 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.99 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.334 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.23 p.335 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.23 p.471

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE BENEFICIARY OF A BEQUEST
text_en:
Asim ibn Humaid narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Ja'far Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said: "Commander of the Faithful {a.s} ruled
concerning a man who made a bequest to another, but the person to whom the
bequest was made was absent and died before the one who made the bequest.
Imam {a.s} said: 'The bequest is for the heir of the one to whom it was made.'
Imam {a.s} also said: 'Whoever makes a bequest to someone, whether present or
absent, and the beneficiary dies before the one who made the bequest, then the
bequest goes to the heir of the beneficiary, unless the testator revokes the bequest
before his own death.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «قَضَى أَمِيرُ
الْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى لآخَرَ وَ الْمُوصَى لَهُ غَائِبٌ فَتُوُفِّيَ اَلَّذِي أُوصِيَ لَهُ قَبْلَ الْمُوصِي قَالَ
«الْوَصِيَّةُ لِوَارِثِ الَّذِي أُوصِيَ لَهُ)» وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «مَنْ أَوْصَى لِأَحَدِ شَاهِدٍ أَوْ غَائِبِ فَتُوُفِّيَ ٱلْمُوصَى لَهُ قَبْلَ
الْمُوصِي فَالْوَصِيَّةُ لِوَارِثِ الَّذِي أَوصِيَ لَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتَ»».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.13 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.210 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.230 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.137 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.99 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.333

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE BENEFICIARY OF A BEQUEST DYING BEFORE THE TESTATOR OR BEFORE RECEIVING WHAT WAS
text_en:
Al-Abbas ibn Amir narrated from Muthanna who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man for whom a bequest was made, but he died before
receiving it and left no offspring.
Imam {a.s} said: "Seek an heir or his mawla (guardian) and give it to him."
I asked: “What if no heir is known?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Exert yourself in searching for an heir for him, and if you cannot find
one and Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, knows of your sincere effort, then give it in charity."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ مُتَنَّى قَالَ : سَأَلْثُهُ عَنْ رَجُلِ أُوصِيَ لَهُ بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْبِضَهَا وَ لَمْ
يَثْرُك عَقِباً قَالَ «أُطلُبْ لَهُ وَارِثاً أَوْ مَوْلَى فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْلَمْ لَهُ وَلِيْ قَالَ «اِجْهَذْ أَنْ تَقْدِرَ لَهُ عَلَى
وَلِيّ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْهُ وَ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ مِنْكَ اَلْجَهْدَ فَتَصَدَقْ بِهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.13 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.211 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.231 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.138 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.100 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.334

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION,
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Muawiyah ibn Ammar who said:
A woman from my family entrusted me with her wealth and instructed that
emancipation (of slaves) be made on her behalf, that Hajj be performed, and that
charity be given. However, the amount left was insufficient to cover all that.
I consulted Abu Hanifah, and he said: "It should be divided into three parts - one-third
for Hajj, one-third for emancipation, and one-third for charity."
Then I went to Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} and said to him:
"A woman from my family passed away and entrusted me with one-third of her wealth,
instructing that Hajj be performed on her behalf, emancipation be made, and charity
be given. But the amount was not enough to fulfill all these."
Imam {a.s} said: "Start with Hajj, for it is an obligation from the obligations of Allah {SWT},
the Exalted. Then divide what remains - part of it for emancipation and part for charity."
I informed Abu Hanifah of the statement of Abu Abdullah {a.s}, and he withdrew his
previous opinion and accepted the guidance of Abu Abdullah {a.s}.
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيَّةِ بِالْعِثْقِ وَ الصَّدَقَةِ وَ الْحَجِ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ : أَوْصَتْ إِلَيَّ إِمْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي بِمَالِهَا وَ أَمَرَتْ أَنْ
يُغْتَقَ عَنْهَا وَ يُحَجَّ وَ يُتَصَدَّقَ فَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ ذَلِكَ فَسَأَلْتُ أَبَا حَنِيفَةَ فَقَالَ يُجْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَثلاثاً ثُلْثاً فِي اَلْحَجَّ وَ ثُلْثاً فِي
الْعِثْقِ وَ ثُلُثاً فِي الصَّدَقَةِ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ اِمْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِي مَاتَتْ وَ أَوْصَتْ إِلَيَّ
بِثُلْثِ مَالِهَا وَ أَمَرَثْ أَنْ يُعْتَقَ عَنْهَا وَ يُحَجَّ عَنْهَا وَ يُتَصَدَّقَ عَنْهَا فَنَظَرْتُ فِيهِ فَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «اِبْدَأُ
بِالْحَجِّ فَإِنَّهُ فَرِيضَةٌ مِنْ فَرَائِضِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا بَقِيَ طَائِفَةً فِي الْعِثْقِ وَ طَائِفَةً فِي الصَّدَقَةِ» فَأُخْبَرْتُ
أَبَا حَنِيفَةَ بِقَوْلِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَرَجَعَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ وَ قَالَ بِقَوْلِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.19 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.211 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.221 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.135 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.129 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.396
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Muawiyah ibn Ammar who said:
A woman from my family entrusted me with her wealth and instructed that
emancipation (of slaves) be made on her behalf, that Hajj be performed, and that
charity be given. However, the amount left was insufficient to cover all that.
I consulted Abu Hanifah, and he said: "It should be divided into three parts - one-third
for Hajj, one-third for emancipation, and one-third for charity."
Then I went to Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} and said to him:
"A woman from my family passed away and entrusted me with one-third of her wealth,
instructing that Hajj be performed on her behalf, emancipation be made, and charity
be given. But the amount was not enough to fulfill all these."
Imam {a.s} said: "Start with Hajj, for it is an obligation from the obligations of Allah {SWT},
the Exalted. Then divide what remains - part of it for emancipation and part for charity."
I informed Abu Hanifah of the statement of Abu Abdullah {a.s}, and he withdrew his
previous opinion and accepted the guidance of Abu Abdullah {a.s}.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Dawud ibn Farqad who said:
Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who
was on a journey with a female slave and two male servant slaves. The man said to the
two male slaves, "You both are free for the sake of Allah {SWT}. Bear witness that what is
in the womb of this bondwoman is from me."
Later, the bondwoman gave birth to a boy. When they returned to the man's heirs, the
heirs denied the claim and enslaved the boy and the two male servants. Afterward, the
two male slaves were emancipated, and after their emancipation, they testified that
their former master had made them witness that the child in the womb of the
bondwoman was indeed his child.
Imam Jafar Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Their testimony is valid in favor of the boy, and the boy
cannot enslave them because they have established his lineage."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ فَرْقَدِ قَالَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجْلٍ كَانَ
فِي سَفَرٍ وَ مَعَهُ جَارِيَةً لَهُ وَ غَلامَانِ مَمْلُوكَانٍ فَقَالَ لَهُمَا أَنْثُمَا أَحْرَارْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ فَاشهَدَا أَنّ مَا فِي بَطْنٍ جَارِيَتِي
هَذِهِ مِنَّي فَوَلَدَثْ غَلَاماً فَلَمَّا قَدِمُوا عَلَى الْوَرَثَةِ أُنْكَرُوا ذَلِكَ وَ اِسْتَرَقُوهُمْ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْغُلاَمَيْنِ أَعْتِقَا بَعْدُ فَشَهِدَا بَعْدَ
مَا أَعْتِقًا أَنَّ مَوْلَيهُمَا الْأَوَّلَ أَشهَدَهُمَا أَنَّ مَا فِي بَطْنِ جَارِيَتِهِ مِنْهُ قَالَ «تَجُوزُ شَهَادَتُهُمَا لِلْغُلاَمِ وَ لا يَسْتَرِقَّهُمَا
اَلْغُلامُ اَلَّذِي شَهِدَا لَهُ لِأَنَّهُمَا أَثْبَتَا نَسَبَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.20 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.211 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.222 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.136 • Al-Wafi, Vol.16 p.972 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.403

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Jamilah from Humran from Abu
Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} regarding a man who, on his deathbed,
made a will saying, "Free so-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so," until he
mentioned five individuals. When his estate was assessed, it was found that one-third
of his wealth was not enough to cover the value of the five slaves he had ordered to be
freed.
Imam {a.s} said: "The individuals he named should be evaluated according to their order
of mention, starting with the first. They should be valued, and their emancipation
should proceed from the first he mentioned, then the second, the third, the fourth, and
finally the fifth. If the one-third of the estate runs out before reaching the last, then the
last named does not get freed because the man ordered their emancipation beyond
the limit of what he lawfully owned, and thus it is not permissible."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى
عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ وَ قَالَ أَعْتِقْ فُلاناً وَ فُلاناً وَ فُلاناً حَتَّى ذَكَرَ خَمْسَةً فَنُظِرَ فِي ثُلْثِهِ فَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ ثُلْثُهُ أُثُمَانَ قِيمَةِ ٱلْمَمَالِيكِ
اَلْخَمْسَةِ اَلَّذِينَ أَمَرَ بِعِثْقِهِمْ قَالَ «يُنْظَرُ إِلَى الَّذِينَ سَمَّاهُمْ وَ بَدَأَ بِعِثْقِهِمْ فَيُقَوَّمُونَ وَ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى ثُلْثِهِ فَيُعْتَقُ مِنْهُ
أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ ذَكَرَ ثُمّ الثَّانِي وَ الثَّالِثُ ثُمّ الرَّابِعُ ثُمّ الْخَامِسُ فَإِنْ عَجَزَ الثُلُثُ كَانَ فِي الَّذِي سَمّى آخِراً لِأَنَّهُ أَعْتَقَ بَعْدَ
مَبْلَغِ التُّلَتِ بِمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ فَلاَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.19 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.212 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.197 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.221 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.46 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.398

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Al-Alaa ibn Razin narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdullah
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who, when death approached him, freed his slave and
made a will, but the total of his bequests exceeded one-third of his estate.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The emancipation of the slave is to be carried out, and any reduction
should be applied to what remains (of the bequests beyond the one-third limit)."
text_ar:
اا٢ ٢ل٢٦٢٢
وَ رَوَى الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ حَضَرَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ
فَأَعْتَقَ غُلَاَمَهُ وَ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةِ فَكَانَ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ قَالَ «يُمْضَى عِثْقُ اَلْغُلامِ وَ يَكُونُ النُّقْصَانُ فِيمَا بَقِيَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.17 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.212 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.194 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.120 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.43 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.276 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.399

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Abu Hammam Ismail ibn
Hammam from Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} regarding a man who, at the time of his death, made
a will bequeathing wealth to his relatives and also freed a slave. However, the total of
what he bequeathed exceeded one-third of his estate. He was asked how this should
be handled concerning his will.
Imam {a.s} replied: "The emancipation (of the slave) should be carried out first."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمَّامِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ : فِي
رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ بِمَالٍ لِذَوِي قَرَابَتِهِ وَ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكاً فَكَانَ جَمِيعُ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ يَزِيدُ عَلَى الثُلْثِ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ
فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ فَقَالَ «يُبْدَأُ بِالْعِثْقِ فَيُنْفَذُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.17 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.212 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.135 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.46 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.400

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Al-Nadr ibn Shuayb narrated from Khalid ibn Maad from Al-Jazi from Abu
Abdullah {a.s} regarding a man who passed away and left behind a slave woman of
whom he had freed one-third. The executor of his will married her before any division
of the inheritance had taken place.
Imam {a.s} said: "She should be appraised (for her full value), and both she and her
husband must work to pay off the remaining value of her price after her appraisal.
Whatever state - whether freedom or servitude - applies to the woman will also apply
to her children."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَادَ عَنِ الْجَازِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ تُوُفِّيَ
فَتَرَكَ جَارِيَةً أَعْتَقَ ثَلْثُهَا فَتَزَوَّجَهَا الْوَصِيُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ «أَنَّهَا تَقَوِّمُ وَتُسْتَسْعَى هِيَ وَ زَوْجُهَا
فِي بَقِيَّةِ ثَمَنِهَا بَعْدَ مَا تُقَوَّمُ فَمَا أَصَابَ الْمَرْأَةَ مِنْ عِثْقٍ أَوْ رِقٌ جَرَى عَلَى وَلَدِهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.20 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.213 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.229 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.223 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.7 • Al-Wafi, Vol.10 p.606 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.406 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.101 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.14 p.135

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti narrated from Ahmad ibn
Ziyad who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} about a man who was on his deathbed and
had slaves solely for himself and others jointly owned with another person. In his will,
he stated, "My slaves are free, except for those who are in partnership."
Imam {a.s} wrote in response: "They should be appraised against his estate, and if his
wealth can cover it, then they are free."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ الْبَزَّنْطِيْ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ زِيَادِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنِ
الرَّجْلِ تَحْضُرُهُ الْوَفَاةُ وَ لَهُ مَمَالِيكُ لِخَاصَّةِ نَفْسِهِ وَ مَمَالِيكُ فِي الشَّرْكَةِ مَعَ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ فَيُوصِي فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ
مَمَالِيكِي أَحْرَارٌ مَا خَلا مَمَالِيكِيَ الَّذِينَ فِي الشَّرْكَةِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ «يُقَوْمُونَ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مَالُهُ يَحْتَمِلُ ثُمَّ
هُمْ أَحْرَارٌ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.213

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil ibn Baziʿ narrated from Ali ibn Al-Nuʿman, from
Suwayd Al-Qallaʾ, from Ayyub ibn Al-Hurr, from Abu Bakr Al-Haḍrami, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "Alqamah ibn Muhammad instructed me in his will to free a
slave on his behalf, so I freed a female slave for him. Is that sufficient, or should I free
another from my own wealth?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “It suffices him." Then Imam {a.s} added, "Indeed, Faṭimah, the mother
of my son, had instructed me to free a slave on her behalf, so I freed a female slave for
her."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِبعٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ الْقَلاَءِ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ عَنْ أَبِي
بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ أَوْصَى أَنْ أُعْتِقَ عَنْهُ رَقَبَةً فَأَعْتَقْتُ
عَنْهُ اِمْرَأَةَ أَفَتُجْزِيهِ أَوْ أُعْتِقُ عَنْهُ مِنْ مَالِي قَالَ «يُجْزِيهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ أُمَّ إبْنِي أَوْصَتْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ عَنْهَا رَقَبَةً
فَأَعْتَقْتُ عَنْهَا اِمْرَأَةً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.17 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.214 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.117 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.404
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil ibn Baziʿ narrated from Ali ibn Al-Nuʿman, from
Suwayd Al-Qallaʾ, from Ayyub ibn Al-Hurr, from Abu Bakr Al-Haḍrami, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, "Alqamah ibn Muhammad instructed me in his will to free a
slave on his behalf, so I freed a female slave for him. Is that sufficient, or should I free
another from my own wealth?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “It suffices him." Then Imam {a.s} added, "Indeed, Faṭimah, the mother
of my son, had instructed me to free a slave on her behalf, so I freed a female slave for
her."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Muawiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who died and had instructed that Hajj be performed on
his behalf. Imam {a.s} replied: "If he had never performed Hajj (was a ṣarurah), then Hajj
should be performed on his behalf from the middle of his wealth. But if he was not a
ṣarurah, then it should be performed from one-third of his wealth."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلِ مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُحَجَّ عَنْهُ
قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ صَرُورَةً حُجِّ عَنْهُ مِنْ وَسَطِ الْمَالِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ غَيْرَ صَرُورَةٍ فَمِنَ الثُّلُثِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.18 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.214 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.121 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.11 p.67 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.357

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
And Imam {a.s} said regarding a woman who bequeathed her wealth for
emancipation (freeing slaves), performing Hajj, and giving charity, but her wealth was
insufficient: "Begin with Hajj because it is an obligation. If anything remains, allocate a
portion for charity and a portion for emancipation."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ : فِي اِمْرَأَةٍ أَوْصَتْ بِمَالٍ فِي عِثْقٍ وَ حَجَّ وَ صَدَقَةٍ فَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ قَالَ «اِبْدَأُ بِالْحَجِّ فَإِنَّهُ مَفْرُوضٌ فَإِنْ
بَقِيَ شَيْءٌ فَاجْعَلْ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ طَائِفَةً وَ فِي الْعِثْقِ طَائِفَةً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.18 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.214 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.135 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.129 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.396

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} about a man who bequeathed thirty dinar for the
emancipation of a man from among our companions, but no such person was found.
Imam {a.s} said: "A person should be purchased from among the people and then
emancipated."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى
بِثَلاَثِينَ دِينَاراً يُعْتَقُ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ «يُشتَرَى مِنَ النَّاسِ فَيُعْتَقُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.18 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.214 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.118 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.405

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Imam {a.s} that he said: "Then let them
purchase from among the general people as long as he is not a Naṣibi (one who
harbors enmity towards the Ahl Al-Bayt {a.s})."
text_ar: - وَ رَوَى عَلِيْ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : «فَلْيَشْتَرُوا مِنْ عُرْضِ النَّاسِ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ نَاصِبِيَاً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.215 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.118

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Muhammad ibn Marwan from the Shaykh,
meaning Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}, from his father, Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, peace be upon them both, that Imam {a.s} said:
"Indeed, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, passed away and left sixty
servants. He freed one-third of them, then I drew lots among the remaining ones and
freed another one-third."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنِ الشِّيْخِ يَعْنِي مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : «إِنَّ
أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ سِتِّينَ مَمْلُوكاً فَأَعْتَقَ ثُلُثَهُمْ فَأَقْرَعْتُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَ أَعْتَقْتُ الثُلُثَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.215 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.220 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.408

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Al-Qasim Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu
Basir, who said: I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, about a freed
woman whom my brother had emancipated. She used to serve the maidservants and
was living among his family. He had instructed me to spend on her moderately.
Abu Jafar {a.s}, said: "If she remained with the maidservants and continued serving
them, then spend on her and follow his will."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْقَاسِمُ مُحَمَّدٌ الْجَوْهَرِيّ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
عَنْ مُحَرِّرَةٍ كَانَ أَعْتَقَهَا أَخِي وَ قَدْ كَانَثْ تَخْدُمُ الْجَوَارِيَ وَ كَانَثْ فِي عِيَالِهِ فَأَوْصَانِي أَنْ أَنْفِقَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الْوَسَطِ
فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَتْ مَعَ الْجَوَارِي وَ أَقَامَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَنْفِقُ عَلَيْهَا وَ اِتَّبِعْ وَصِيَّتَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.18 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.215 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.92

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR MANUMISSION, CHARITY, AND HAJJ
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a man who had made a will that a soul be freed on his
behalf from one-third of his wealth with five hundred dirhams. The executor of the will
bought a soul for less than five hundred, and some amount remained. What do you
say about the remaining amount?
Imam {a.s} said: "It should be given to the purchased soul before it is freed, and then it
should be freed on behalf of the deceased."
text_ar:
٧٦٢٢٢٧٬ ٢١٠
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلِ
أَوْصَى أَنْ يُفْتَقَ عَنْهُ نَسَمَةً مِنْ ثُلْتِهِ بِخَمْسِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ فَاشتَرَى الْوَصِي نَسَمَةً بِأَقَلَ مِنْ خَمْسِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ وَ فَضَلَتْ
فَضْلَةٌ فَمَا تَرَى فِي الْفَضْلَةِ قَالَ «تُدْفَعُ إِلَى ٱلنَّسَمَةِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُعْتَقَ ثُمَّ تُفْتَقُ عَنِ ٱلْمَيَّتِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.19 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.215 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.221 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.119 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.410

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR THE MUKATAB AND
text_en:
Asim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, who said:
"The Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, ruled concerning a
contracted slave (mukatab) who was married to a free woman. She made a bequest
for him at the time of her death.
Imam {a.s} said: ‘The people entitled to inheritance cannot have her will executed for
him because he is a mukatab who has not been freed.'
Then Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, ruled that he would inherit in proportion to what
had been freed of him and that the will for him would be valid in proportion to what had
been freed of him."
Imam {a.s} also ruled regarding a mukatab for whom a will had been made, and he had
paid half of what was due upon him, that half of the will was valid for him.
Imam {a.s} also ruled regarding a mukatab who had paid a quarter of what was due upon
him and for whom a will had been made, that a quarter of the will was valid for him.
Imam {a.s} said about a man who made a will for his female mukatabah and she had
paid one-sixth of what was due upon her, that the will was valid for her in proportion
to what had been freed of her.
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيَّةٍ لِلْمُكَاتَبِ وَ أُمّ الْوَلَدِ
رَوَى عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «قَضَى أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ
اَلسَّلَاَمُ فِي مُكَاتَبِ كَانَتْ تَحْتَهُ اِمْرَأَةٌ حُرَّةُ فَأَوْصَتْ لَهُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهَا بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ «أَهْلُ الْمِيرَاثِ لا تَجُوزُ وَصِيَّتْهَا
لَهُ إِنَّهُ مُكَاتَبٌ لَمْ يُعْتَقَ» فَقَضَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «أَنَّهُ يَرِثُ بِحِسَابٍ مَا أُعْتِقَ مِنْهُ وَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ مِنَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ بِحِسَابٍ مَا
أُعْتِقَ مِنْهُ» وَ قَضَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي مُكَاتَبِ أُوصِيَ لَهُ بِوَصِيَّةِ وَ قَدْ قَضَى نِصْفَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فَأَجَازَ لَهُ نِصْفَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ
وَقَضَى فِي مُكَاتَبِ قَضَى رُبُعَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فَأَوصِيَ لَهُ بِوَصِيَةِ فَأَجَازَ لَهُ رُبُعَ الْوَصِيَّةِ وَ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي رَجُلٍ
أَوْصَى لِمُكَاتَبَتِهِ وَ قَدْ قَضَتْ سُدُسَ مَا كَانَ عَلَيْهَا فَأَجَازَ لَهَا بِحِسَابٍ مَا أُعْتِقَ مِنْهَا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.216 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.413

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR THE MUKATAB AND UMM AL-WALAD
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih from Abu Ubaydah, who
said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a man who had a slave woman with whom he had
a son. When death approached him, he bequeathed for her two thousand dirhams or
more and instructed his heirs to enslave her.
Imam {a.s} said: "No, rather she should be freed from one-third of the deceased's estate
and given what he had bequeathed for her."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ صَالِحِ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ
رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَمُّ وَلَدٍ وَ لَهُ مِنْهَا غُلاَمٌ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَثْهُ الْوَفَاةُ أَوْصَى لَهَا بِأَلْفَي دِرْهَمِ أَوْ بِأَكْثَرَ لِلْوَرَثَةِ أَنْ يَسْتَرِقُوهَا
فَقَالَ «لاَ بَلْ تُعْتَقُ مِنْ ثُلُثِ الْمَيِّتِ وَ تُعْطَى مَا أَوْصَى لَهَا بِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.29 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.216 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.600 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.273 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.416

chapter_title: CHAPTER ON BEQUESTS FOR THE MUKATAB AND UMM AL-WALAD
text_en:
It was narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, who
said:
I copied from a book in the handwriting of Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}:
“A certain person, your master, passed away, leaving behind a paternal nephew who
also passed away. The nephew left behind an umm walad (a concubine who bore him
no children) and bequeathed to her a thousand dirhams. Does the bequest hold
validity, and does she receive emancipation? What is her status? May I be your
ransom, I seek your opinion on this matter.”
Imam {a.s} wrote back: "She is to be freed from one-third (of the estate), and she has the
bequest."
text_ar:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ الْبَزَنْطِيّ قَالَ : نَسَخْتُ مِنْ كِتَابِ بِخَطَّ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ
فُلاَنْ مَوْلاكَ تُوُفِّيَ اِبْنُ أَخٍ لَهُ فَتَرَكَ أُمَّ وَلَدٍ لَهُ لَيْسَ لَهَا وَلَدٌ وَ أَوْصَى لَهَا بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمِ هَلْ تَجُوزُ ٱلْوَصِيَّةُ وَ هَلْ يَقَعُ
عَلَيْهَا عِثْقٌ وَ مَا حَالُهَا رَأْيَكَ فَدَثْكَ نَفْسِي فِي ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ («تُعْتَقُ مِنَ الثُلْثِ وَ لَهَا الْوَصِيَّةُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.29 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.217 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.112 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.415

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN MAKING A BEQUEST OF A
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr narrated from Abu Jamilah from Imam
Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s}, who said:
I asked him about a man who bequeathed a sword to another man, and the sword was
in its sheath and adorned with decorations. The heirs said to him, "Only the blade
belongs to you, not the sword (with its accessories)."
Imam {a.s} said: "No, rather the sword with everything it contains belongs to him."
I said to Imam {a.s}: "A man bequeathed a box to another man, and there was money
inside it. The heirs said: ‘Only the box belongs to you, not the money.'"
Imam {a.s} said: "The box with everything it contains belongs to him."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِرَجُلٍ بِسَيْفٍ أَوْ صُنْدُوقٍ أَوْ سَفِينَةٍ
رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجْلٍ أَوْصَى
لِرَجُلٍ بِسَيْفٍ وَ كَانَ فِي جَفْنٍ وَ عَلَيْهِ حِلْيَةُ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْوَرَثَةُ إِنَّمَا لَكَ النَّصْلُ وَ لَيْسَ لَكَ السَّيْفُ فَقَالَ «لاَ بَلِ السَّيْفُ
بِمَا فِيهِ لَهُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ أَوْصَى بِصُنْدُوقٍ لِرَجُلٍ وَ كَانَ فِيهِ مَالْ فَقَالَ الْوَرَثَةُ إِنَّمَا لَكَ الصُّنْدُوقُ وَ لَيْسَ لَكَ
اَلْمَالُ فَقَالَ «الصُّنْدُوقُ بِمَا فِيهِ لَهُ».
