author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN MAKING A BEQUEST OF A
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal
from Uqbah ibn Khalid from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a man
who said:
“This ship belongs to so-and-so," without specifying what was inside it, and there was
food in it. Should the man be given the ship and what is inside it?
Imam {a.s} said: "It belongs to the one to whom it was bequeathed, unless its owner
explicitly excluded what was inside it. The heirs have no claim over it."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ هِلالِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ هَذِهِ السِّفِينَةُ لِفُلانٍ وَ لَمْ يُسَمِّ مَا فِيهَا وَ فِيهَا طَعَامْ أَيُغْطَاهَا اَلرَّجُلُ وَ مَا فِيهَا
قَالَ «هِيَ لِلَّذِي أَوْصَى لَهُ بِهَا إِلا أَنْ يَكُونَ صَاجِبْهَا اِسْتَثْنَى مَا فِيهَا وَ لَيْسَ لِلْوَرَثَةِ شَيْءَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.44 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.217 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.212 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.277 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.145 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.391 • Mustadrak Al- Wasa’il, Vol.14 p.132

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON ONE WHO DOES NOT MAKE A BEQUEST
text_en:
Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah, who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who
died and left behind sons and daughters, both young and old, without leaving a will.
He also had servants, slaves, and jewelry. How should the heirs divide that
inheritance?
Imam {a.s} said: "If a trustworthy man undertakes the division of all that among them,
then there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
بَابٌ فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُوصِ وَ لَهُ وَرَثَةً فَيُقْسَمُ بَيْنَهُمْ أَوْ يُبَاعُ عَلَيْهِمْ
رَوَى زُرْعَةُ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ : سَألْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلِ مَاتَ وَ لَهُ بَنُونَ وَ بَنَاتْ صِغَارٌ وَ كِبَارٌ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَصِيَّةٍ وَ لَهُ
خَدَمٌ وَ مَمَالِيكُ وَ عُقَدٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ الْوَرَثَةُ بِقِسْمَةِ ذَلِكَ الْمِيرَاثِ قَالَ «إِنْ قَامَ رَجُلٌ ثِقَةٌ قَاسَمَهُمْ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ فَلاَ
بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.218 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.240 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Vol.9 p.392 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.422 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.26 p.70

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO MAKES A BEQUEST, BUT THE EXECUTOR FORGETS IT AND ONLY REMEMBERS ONE PART OF IT 338
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}, about a man related to me
who died and left behind young children and male and female slaves. He did not leave
a will.
What is your opinion regarding someone who buys a female slave from them and takes
her as an umm walad (a concubine who bears a child)? And what is your opinion on
selling them?
Imam {a.s} said: "If they have a guardian who manages their affairs, sells on their behalf,
and looks after their interests, then he will be rewarded for it."
I said: “What do you say about someone who buys a female slave from them and takes
her as an umm walad?"
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in that if the guardian responsible for their welfare
sells to him, considering what is in their best interest. They have no right to revoke what
the guardian, acting in their best interest, has done."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اَلْحَسَنْ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ بَيْنِي
وَ بَيْنَهُ قَرَابَةٌ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ أَوْلاداً صِغَاراً وَ تَرَكَ مَمَالِيكَ لَهُ غِلْمَاناْ وَ جَوَارِيَ وَ لَمْ يُوصٍ فَمَا تَرَى فِيمَنْ يَشْتَرِي مِنْهُمُ
الْجَارِيَةَ فَيَتَّخِذُهَا أُمَّ وَلَدٍ وَ مَا تَرَى فِي بَنْعِهِمْ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ لَهُمْ وَلِيْ يَقُومُ بِأَمْرِهِمْ بَاعَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ نَظَرَ لَهُمْ كَانَ
مَأُجُوراً فِيهِمْ» قُلْتُ فَمَا تَرَى فِيمَنْ يَشتَرِي مِنْهُمُ الْجَارِيَةَ فَيَتَّخِذُهَا أمّ وَلَدِ قَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ إِذَا بَاعَ عَلَيْهِمُ
اَلْقَيَّمُ لَهُمْ النَّاظِرُ فِيمَا يُصْلِحُهُمْ وَلَيْس لَهُمْ أَنْ يَرْجِعُوا عَمَّا صَنَعَ الْقَيَّمُ لَهُمُ النَّاظِرُ فِيمَا يُصْلِحُهُمْ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO MAKES A BEQUEST, BUT
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Rayyan, who said:
I wrote to Imam {a.s} - meaning Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s} - asking about a
person who had made a will, but the executor only remembered one part of it. What
should be done with the remaining parts?
Imam {a.s} replied: "Allocate the remaining parts to charitable acts."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجْلِ يُوصِي بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَيَنْسَاهَا الْوَصِيُّ وَ لَا يَحْفَظُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا بَاباً وَاحِداً
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ سَهْلٍ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَيَّانَ قَالَ : كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ
يَعِنِي عَلِي بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَسأَلْهُ عَنْ إِنْسَانِ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةِ فَلَمْ يَحْفَظِ الْوَصِيُّ إِلاَّ بَاباً وَاحِداً مِنْهَا كَيْفَ
بَصْنَعُ فِي اَلْبَاقِي فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «الْأَبْوَابَ الْبَاقِيَةَ اِجْعَلْهَا فِي الْبِرِّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.218 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.277

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE EXECUTOR PURCHASING FROM
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim Al-
Hamdani, who said: I wrote along with Muhammad ibn Yahya asking whether the
executor of a will is permitted to purchase something from the deceased's estate
when it is sold to the highest bidder and take it for himself.
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is permissible if he purchases it properly."
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيّ يَشْتَرِي مِنْ مَالِ الْمَيَّتِ شَيْئًا إِذَا بِيعَ فِيمَنْ زَادَ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلْهَمْدَانِيّ قَالَ : كَتَبْتُ مَعَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى هَلْ
لِلْوَصِيَّ أَنْ يَشتَرِيَ شَيْئا مِنْ مَالِ الْمَيَّتِ إِذَا بِيعَ فِيمَنْ زَادَ يَزِيدُ وَ يَأْخُذُ لِنَفْسِهِ فَقَالَ «يَجُوزُ إِذَا اِشتَرَى صَجِيحاً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.59 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.219 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.233 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.245 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.182 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.423

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN DISINHERITING HIS SON FOR
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa’ narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from the
executor of Ali ibn Al-Sari, who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}: "Ali ibn Al-Sari has passed away and appointed me as his
executor."
Imam {a.s} said: “May Allah {SWT} have mercy on him."
I said: “His son Ja'far committed an act with his father's umm walad (concubine), and
he instructed me to exclude him from the inheritance."
Imam {a.s} said: “Exclude him if you are truthful, and he will suffer affliction."
He (the executor) said: I returned, and Ja'far brought me before Abu Yusuf the judge.
Ja'far said to him, "May Allah {SWT} rectify your affairs. I am Ja'far, the son of Ali ibn Al-
Sari, and this is my father’s executor. Order him to give me my inheritance from my
father."
The judge asked me: "What do you say?"
I replied: “Yes, this is Ja'far, the son of Ali ibn Al-Sari, and I am his executor."
The judge said: “Then hand over his wealth to him."
I said: “I wish to speak with you."
He (the judge) said: “Come closer."
I approached him so that no one could hear me, and I said: “This man committed an
act with his father’s umm walad, and his father commanded me in his will to exclude
him from the inheritance and not give him anything. I went to Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-
Kadhim {a.s}, in Medina, informed him, and sought his guidance. Imam {a.s} ordered me
to exclude him from the inheritance and not give him anything."
The judge said: “By Allah {SWT}, did Abu Al-Hasan command you to do this?"
I said: “Yes."
He (the judge) made me swear three times and then said: “Carry out what you were
ordered. His {a.s} word is decisive."
The executor said: After that, Ja'far was afflicted with madness.
Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa’ said: I saw him after that.

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: If a man makes a will
to exclude his son from the inheritance without the son having committed such an act,
it is not permissible for the executor to carry out this part of the will.
text_ar:
بَابُ إِخْرَاجِ الرَّجْلِ ابْنَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ لإِثْيَانِهِ أَمَّ وَلَدِ لِأَبِيهِ
رَوَى اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَاءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ وَصِيِّ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السّرِيَّ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ السَّرِيِّ تُوُفِّيَ وَ أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ فَقَالَ «رَحِمَهُ ٱللَّهُ» قُلْتُ وَ إِنَّ اِبْنَهُ جَعْفَراً وَقَعَ عَلَى أُمِّ وَلَدٍ لَهُ
فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُخْرِجَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ فَقَالَ لِي «أَخْرِجُهُ إنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقاً فَسَيْصِيبُهُ خَبَلٌ» قَالَ فَرَجَعْتُ فَقَدَّمَنِي إلَى
أَبِي يُوسُفَ ٱلْقَاضِي فَقَالَ لَهُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ أَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ السِّرِيِّ وَ هَذَا وَصِيْ أَبِي فَمُرْهُ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ إِلَيَّ مِيرَاتِي
مِنْ أَبِي فَقَالَ لِي مَا تَقُولُ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ هَذَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّرِيِّ وَ أَنَا وَصِيْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّرِيِّ قَالَ فَادْفَعْ إِلَيْهِ
مَالَهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَرِيدُ أَنْ أُكَلَّمَكَ قَالَ فَادْنُ مِنَّي فَدَنَوْتُ حَيْثُ لا يَسْمَعُ أَحَدٌ كَلاَمِي فَقُلْتُ لَهُ هَذَا وَقَعَ عَلَى أُمَّ وَلَدٍ
لِأَبِيهِ فَأَمَرَنِي أَبُوهُ وَ أَوْصَى إِلَيْ أَنْ أُخْرِجَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاتِ وَ لا أُوَرِّثَهُ شَيْئاً فَأَتَيْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ
بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ وَ سَأَلْثُهُ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُخْرِجَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاتِ وَ لا أُوَرِّثَهُ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ اللَّهَ إِنَّ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ أَمَرَكَ فَقَلْتُ
نَعَمْ فَاسْتَخْلَقَنِي ثَلاَثاً ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي أَنْفِذْ مَا أَمَرَكَ فَالْقَوْلُ قَوْلُهُ قَالَ الْوَصِيُ فَأَصَابَهُ ٱلْخَبَلُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ
اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءُ رَأْيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ.
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ وَ مَتَى أَوْصَى الرّجُلُ بِإِخْرَاجِ ابْنِهِ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ وَ لَمْ يُحْدِثْ هَذَا الْحَدَثَ لَمْ يَجُذْ لِلْوَصِيَّ
إِنْفَاذُ وَصِيَّتِهِ فِي ذَلِكَ
commentary:

to exclude his son from the inheritance without the son having committed such an act,
it is not permissible for the executor to carry out this part of the will.

Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa’ narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from the
executor of Ali ibn Al-Sari, who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}: "Ali ibn Al-Sari has passed away and appointed me as his
executor."
Imam {a.s} said: “May Allah {SWT} have mercy on him."
I said: “His son Ja'far committed an act with his father's umm walad (concubine), and
he instructed me to exclude him from the inheritance."
Imam {a.s} said: “Exclude him if you are truthful, and he will suffer affliction."
He (the executor) said: I returned, and Ja'far brought me before Abu Yusuf the judge.
Ja'far said to him, "May Allah {SWT} rectify your affairs. I am Ja'far, the son of Ali ibn Al-
Sari, and this is my father’s executor. Order him to give me my inheritance from my
father."
The judge asked me: "What do you say?"
I replied: “Yes, this is Ja'far, the son of Ali ibn Al-Sari, and I am his executor."
The judge said: “Then hand over his wealth to him."
I said: “I wish to speak with you."
He (the judge) said: “Come closer."
I approached him so that no one could hear me, and I said: “This man committed an
act with his father’s umm walad, and his father commanded me in his will to exclude
him from the inheritance and not give him anything. I went to Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-
Kadhim {a.s}, in Medina, informed him, and sought his guidance. Imam {a.s} ordered me
to exclude him from the inheritance and not give him anything."
The judge said: “By Allah {SWT}, did Abu Al-Hasan command you to do this?"
I said: “Yes."
He (the judge) made me swear three times and then said: “Carry out what you were
ordered. His {a.s} word is decisive."
The executor said: After that, Ja'far was afflicted with madness.
Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa’ said: I saw him after that.

أَبِي يُوسُفَ ٱلْقَاضِي فَقَالَ لَهُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ أَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ السِّرِيِّ وَ هَذَا وَصِيْ أَبِي فَمُرْهُ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ إِلَيَّ مِيرَاتِي

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN DISINHERITING HIS SON FOR HAVING RELATIONS WITH HIS FATHER’S UMM AL-WALAD
text_en:
And the confirmation of this is what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad
ibn Isa from Abdul Aziz ibn Al-Muhtadi from Sa'id ibn Sa'd, who said:
‘I asked Imam {a.s} - meaning Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} - about a
man who had a son whom he acknowledged and then later disowned, excluding him
from the inheritance. I am his executor, so what should I do?’
Imam {a.s} said: "The son remains legally his due to his prior public acknowledgment.
The executor cannot deny him anything that is already known."
text_ar:
وَ تَصْدِيقُ ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ بْنِ الْمُهْتَدِي عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ :
سَأَلْتُهُ يَعْنِي أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ لَهُ إِبْنٌ يَدَّعِيهِ فَنَفَاهُ وَ أَخْرَجَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ وَ أَنَا وَصِيُّهُ
فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ «لَزِمَهُ ٱلْوَلَدُ لإِقْرَارِهِ بِالْمَشَهَدِ لاَ يَدْفَعْهُ ٱلْوَصِيُّ عَنْ شَيْءِ قَدْ عَلِمَهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S
text_en:
Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Hisham from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
"The end of an orphan's state of orphanhood is marked by reaching puberty, and that
is when he reaches his full strength. However, if he reaches puberty but no sign of
maturity is observed in him, and he is foolish or weak-minded, then his guardian
should withhold his wealth from him."
text_ar:
بَابُ انْقِطَاعٍ يُثْمِ اليَتِيمِ
رَوَى مَنْصُورُ بْنُ حَازِمِ عَنْ هِشَامِ عَنْ أُبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «اِنْقِطَاعُ يُثْمِ ٱلْيَتِيمِ ٱلْإِحْتِلاَمُ وَ هُوَ
أَشُدُهُ وَ إِنِ اِحْتَلَمَ وَ لَمْ يُونَسْ مِنْهُ رُشُدُهُ وَ كَانَ سَفِيها أَوْ ضَعِيفاً فَلْيُمْسِكْ عَنْهُ وَلِيُهُ مَالَهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Mathanna ibn Rashid from Abu Basir from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about an orphan who had memorized the
Qur'an and had no deficiency in his intellect. The one holding his wealth wishes to
invest it until the orphan reaches puberty and then hand over his wealth to him.
Imam {a.s} said: "Even if he reaches puberty but does not have sound intellect, nothing
should ever be handed over to him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُثَنَّى بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ
يَتِيمِ قَدْ قَرَأَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ وَ لَيْسَ بِعَقْلِهِ بَأْس وَ لَهُ مَالٌ عَلَى يَدَيْ رَجُلٍ فَأَرَادَ آلَّذِي عِنْدَهُ ٱلْمَالُ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِهِ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ
وَ يَدْفَعَ إلَيْهِ مَالَهُ قَالَ »وَ إِنِ اِحْتَلَمَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عَقْلٌ لَمْ يُدْفَع إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ أَبَداً».

Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Mathanna ibn Rashid from Abu Basir from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said: I asked Imam {a.s} about an orphan who had memorized the
Qur'an and had no deficiency in his intellect. The one holding his wealth wishes to
invest it until the orphan reaches puberty and then hand over his wealth to him.
Imam {a.s} said: "Even if he reaches puberty but does not have sound intellect, nothing
should ever be handed over to him."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S ORPHANHOOD
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa’ narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said: "When a boy reaches the age of thirteen and enters into his
fourteenth year, what is obligatory upon those who have reached puberty becomes
obligatory upon him, whether he experiences a wet dream or not. His bad deeds are
recorded against him, and his good deeds are recorded for him. Everything becomes
permissible for him except if he is weak-minded or foolish."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «إِذَا بَلَغَ ٱَلْغَلاَمُ
أَشدَّهُ ثَلاثَ عَشرَةَ سَنَةً وَ دَخَلَ فِي الْأَرْبَعَ عَشرَةَ سَنَةً وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ مَا وَجَبَ عَلَى الْمُحْتَلِمِينَ اِحْتَلَمَ أَوْ لَمْ يَحْتَلِمْ
وَ كُتِبَثْ عَلَيْهِ السَّيِّئَاتُ وَ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ الْحَسَنَاتُ وَ جَازَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ ضَعِيفاً أَوْ سَفِيها».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S ORPHANHOOD
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from 'Is ibn Al-Qasim from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who
said: I asked Imam {a.s} about an orphan girl - when should her wealth be handed over
to her?
Imam {a.s} said: "When you know that she will neither corrupt it nor waste it."
I then asked Imam {a.s}: "What if she has gotten married?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Once she marries, the authority of the guardian over her ends."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented: This means
when she reaches the age of nine years.
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْيَتِيمَةِ
مَتَى يُدْفَعُ إِلَيْهَا مَالُهَا قَالَ «إِذَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهَا لا تُفْسِدُ وَ لا تُضَيِّعُ» فَسَأَلْتُهُ إِنْ كَانَتْ قَدْ تَزَوَّجَتْ فَقَالَ «إِذَا تَزَوَّجَتْ
فَقَدِ اِنْقَطَعَ مُلْكُ الْوَصِيَّ عَنْهَا».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ إِذَا بَلَغَتْ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented: This means
when she reaches the age of nine years.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S ORPHANHOOD
text_en:
Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali
Al-Baqir {a.s}, who said: "A girl should not be consummated in marriage until she
reaches nine or ten years of age."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ قَالَ : «لا يُدْخَلُ بِالْجَارِيَةِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ لَهَا
تِسْعُ سِنِينَ أَو عَشرٌ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S ORPHANHOOD
text_en:
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "When a girl reaches nine years of age, her wealth is
handed over to her, her decisions regarding her wealth become valid, and the full legal
punishments are applied for her and upon her."
text_ar:
وَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ دُفِعَ إِلَيْهَا مَالُهَا وَ جَازَ أَمْرُهَا فِي مَالِهَا
وَأُقِيمَتِ الْحُدُودُ التَّامَةُ لَهَا وَ عَلَيْهَا».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S ORPHANHOOD
text_en:
It was narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, that he was
asked about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted and Glorious:
"But if you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them"
(Surah An-Nisa 4:6).
Imam {a.s} said: "Perceiving sound judgment means the ability to safeguard wealth."
text_ar:
وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ ( فَإِنْ آنَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشُداً
فَادْفَعُوا إلَيْهِمْ أَمْوْالَهُمْ 0 قَالَ «إينَاسُ الرُّشدِ حِفْظُ ٱَلْمَالِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CESSATION OF AN ORPHAN’S ORPHANHOOD
text_en:
In the narration of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-
Husayn from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from someone who mentioned from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, that Imam {a.s} said in the interpretation of this verse:
"If you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them"
(Surah An-Nisa 4:6).
Imam {a.s} said: "If you see that they love the family of Muhammad {saws}, peace be upon
them, then elevate them in status."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: This narration does
not contradict what has been previously mentioned. This is because if sound
judgment is perceived in a person - meaning the ability to safeguard wealth - then their
wealth should be handed over to them. Similarly, if sound judgment is perceived in
accepting the truth, they should be tested with it. Moreover, a verse may be revealed
regarding a specific matter but can also apply to other situations.
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي تَفْسِيرِ هَذِهِ الْآَيَةِ ٢ إِذَا رَأْيْتُمُوهُمْ يُحِبُّونَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فَازْقَعُوهُمْ
دَرَجَةً
قَالَ مُصَنّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللّهُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ غَيْرُ مُخَالِفٍ لِمَا تَقَدَّمَ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ إِذَا أُونِسَ مِنْهُ الرُّشدُ وَ هُوَ حِفْظُ الْمَالِ دُفِعَ
إِلَيْهِ مَالُهُ وَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا أَونِسَ مِنْهُ الرُّشُدُ فِي قَبُولِ الْحَقَّ اخْتُبِرَ بِهِ وَ قَدْ تَنْزِلُ الْآَيَةُ فِي شَيْءٍ وَ تَجْرِي فِي غَيْرِهِ.
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: This narration does
not contradict what has been previously mentioned. This is because if sound
judgment is perceived in a person - meaning the ability to safeguard wealth - then their
wealth should be handed over to them. Similarly, if sound judgment is perceived in
accepting the truth, they should be tested with it. Moreover, a verse may be revealed
regarding a specific matter but can also apply to other situations.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT HAS BEEN REPORTED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Sa'd ibn Isma'il from his father,
who said: I asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} about the guardian of orphans whose
wards have reached maturity. He offers them their rightful wealth, but they refuse to
take it. What should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He must return their wealth to them and compel them to take it."
text_ar:
بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ يَمْتَنعُ مِنْ أَخْذِ مَالِهِ بَعْدَ الْبُلُوغِ
رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ
وَصِيَّ أَيْتَامِ يُذْرِكُ أَيْتَامُهُ فَيَعْرِضُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَأْخُذُوا الَّذِي لَهُمْ فَيَأْبَوْنَ عَلَيْهِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَرُدْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ يُكْرِهُهُمْ
عَلَيْهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE EXECUTOR WITHHOLDING THE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from
Muhammad ibn Qays from someone who narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said
regarding a man who died and appointed someone as the guardian of his affairs while
leaving behind a young son.
When the boy grew up, he went to the guardian and said: “Return my wealth to me so
I can get married," but the guardian refused. The boy then went and committed
adultery.
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "Two-thirds of the sin of this man's adultery is upon the
guardian who withheld his wealth and did not give it to him, which would have allowed
him to marry."

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: I have not found this
narration except in the book of Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, and I have not narrated it
except through his transmission. More than one person has related it to me, including
Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Isam Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub.
text_ar:
بَابُ الْوَصِيَّ يَمْنَعُ الْوَارِثَ مَالَهُ بَعْدَ الْبُلُوغِ فَيَزْنِي لِعَجْزِهِ عَنِ التَّزْوِيجِ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُلَيْنِي رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ
بْنِ قَيْسِ عَمْنُ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ وَ لَهُ اِبْنٌ صَغِيرٌ فَأَدْرَكَ
اَلْغُلاَمُ وَ ذَهَبَ إِلَى الْوَصِيِّ فَقَالَ لَهُ رُدَّ عَلَيَّ مَالِي لِأَتَزَوْجَ فَأَبَى عَلَيْهِ فَذَهَبَ حَتَّى رَنَى قَالَ «يُلْزَمُ ثُلْتَيْ إثمِ زِنَى
هَذَا الرَّجُلِ ذَلِكَ الْوَصِي الَّذِي مَنَعَهُ الْمَالَ وَ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ فَكَانَ يَتَزَوَّجُ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ مَا وَجَدْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ إِلَا فِي كِتَابٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ وَ مَا رَوَيْتُهُ إِلَا مِنْ طَرِيقِهِ حَدَّثَنِي
بِهِ غَيْرُ وَاجِدٍ مِنْهُمْ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِصَامِ الْكُلَيْنِيُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ.
commentary:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: I have not found this
narration except in the book of Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, and I have not narrated it
except through his transmission. More than one person has related it to me, including
Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Isam Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT HAS BEEN REPORTED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zakariya ibn
Abi Yahya Al-Sa'di from Al-Hakam ibn Utaibah, who said:
We were sitting at the door of Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, as a
group waiting for him to come out. Suddenly, a woman approached and asked: “Which
of you is Abu Ja'far?"
The people replied: “What do you need from him?" She said: “I want to ask him a
question."
They told her: "This is the jurist of the people of Iraq, so ask him."
She said: “My husband passed away and left behind one thousand dirhams. I had a
debt upon him from my dowry of five hundred dirhams. I took my dowry and also took
my share of the inheritance. Then a man came and claimed that the deceased owed
him one thousand dirhams, and I testified in his favor."
Al-Hakam said: While I was pondering this, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s}, came out and said: “What is this that I see you counting with your fingers, O’
Hakam?"

She had five hundred dirhams as her dowry, which she took, and she also took her
share of the inheritance. Then a man came claiming that the deceased owed him one
thousand dirhams, and she testified in his favor."
Al-Hakam said: By Allah {SWT}, I had not even finished speaking when Abu Jafar Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, said:
“She has admitted to two-thirds of what she possesses, and she has no right to any
inheritance."

text_ar:
بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ أَوْصَى أَوْ أَعْتَقَ وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ رَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي يَحْيَى السَّعْدِيِّ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ
: كُنَّا عَلَى بَابٍ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ ع وَ نَحْنُ جَمَاعَةً نَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ إِذْ جَاءَتِ اِمْرَأَةً فَقَالَتْ أَيْكُمْ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ فَقَالَ لَهَا الْقَوْمُ
مَا تُرِيدِينَ مِنْهُ قَالَتْ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ فَقَلُوا لَهَا هَذَا فَقِيهُ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ فَاسْأَلِيهِ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَوْجِي مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ أَلْفَ
دِرْهَمِ وَ كَانَ لِي عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ مِنْ صَدَاقِي خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ فَأَخَذْتُ صَدَاقِي وَ أَخَذْتُ مِيرَاثِي ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَادَّعَى
عَلَيْهِ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمِ فَشَهِدْتُ لَهُ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَحْسُبُ إِذْ خَرَجَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَقَالَ «مَا هَذَا ٱَلَّذِي أَرَاكَ
تُحَرِّكُ بِهِ أَصَابِعَكَ يَا حَكَمُ » فَقُلْتُ إنَّ هَذِهِ ٱلْمَرْأَةَ ذَكَرَتْ أَنّ زَوْجَهَا مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمِ وَ كَانَ لَهَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ
صَدَاقِهَا خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ فَأَخَذَتْ مِنْهُ صَدَاقَهَا وَ أَخَذَّثْ مِنْهُ مِيرَاثَهَا ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَادَّعَى عَلَيْهِ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمِ فَشَهِدَتْ
لَهُ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ فَوَ اللَّهِ مَا أَثْمَمْتُ الْكَلاَمَ حَتَّى قَالَ «أَقَرَّتْ بِثُلْثَيْ مَا فِي يَدَيْهَا وَ لا مِيرَاتَ لَهَا» قَالَ اَلْحَكَمُ فَمَا
رَأَيْتُ وَ اللَّهِ أَفْهَمَ مِنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَطْ. قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ تَفْسِيرُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ لَا مِيرَاتَ حَتَّى يُقْضَى
الدَّيْنُ وَ إِنَّمَا تَرَكَ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمِ وَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الدَّيْنِ أَلْفٌ وَ خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمِ لَهَا وَ لِلرَّجُلِ فَلَهَا ثُلُثُ الْأَلْفِ لِأَنَّ لَهَا خَمْسَمِائَةِ
دِرْهَمِ وَ لِلرَّجُلِ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمِ فَلَهُ ثُلُثَاهَا.

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON WHAT HAS BEEN REPORTED REGARDING ONE WHO MAKES A BEQUEST OR FREES A SLAVE WHILE IN DEBT
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, regarding
a man who freed his slave at the time of his death while he had a debt upon him.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the value of the slave is equal to the amount of debt he owes or more,
then his emancipation is valid; otherwise, it is not valid."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكَهُ عِنْدَ
مَوْتِهِ وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ قِيمَتُهُ مِثْلَ آلَّذِي عَلَيْهِ وَ مِثلَهُ جَازَ عِثْقُهُ وَ إلاَّا لَمْ يَجُزْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.27 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.118 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.224 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.8 p.232 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.218 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.7 • Al- Wafi, Vol.10 p.621 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.356

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CLEARANCE OF THE DECEASED’S LIABILITY FROM DEBT WHEN SOMEONE GUARANTEES IT FOR THE
text_en:
In the narration of Aban ibn Uthman, it is reported that a man asked Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, about a man who had made a will appointing someone as his executor,
stating that he had a debt upon him.
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "The executor should settle the debt owed by the deceased and
then distribute whatever remains among the heirs."
The man then asked: “Should the executor distribute what was bequeathed for the
debt? Should the debt be collected from the heirs or from the executor?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is not to be taken from the heirs; rather, the executor is
responsible for it."
text_ar:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى إلَى رَجْلِ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِ
دَيْنا فَقَالَ «يَقْضِي الرَّجُلُ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَيْنِهِ وَ يَقْسِمُ مَا بَقِيَ بَيْنَ ٱلْوَرَثَةِ» قُلْتُ فَيُفَرِّقُ ٱلْوَصِيْ مَا كَانَ أوصِيَ بِهِ
فِي الدَّيْنِ مِمَّنْ يُوْخَذُ الدَّيْنُ أَ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ أَمْ مِنَ الْوَصِيِّ فَقَالَ «لا يُوْخَذُ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ وَ لَكِنَّ ٱلْوَصِيَّ ضَامِنْ لَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.24 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.224 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.168 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.117 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.156 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.347

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE CLEARANCE OF THE DECEASED’S
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah
{a.s}, regarding a man who dies while owing a debt, and a guarantor assumes
responsibility for it on behalf of the creditors.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the creditors agree, then the deceased is cleared of responsibility."
text_ar:
بَابُ بَرَاءَةِ ذِمَّةِ الْمَيَّتِ مِنَ الدَّيْنِ بِضَمَانِ مَنْ يَضْمَنُهُ لِلْغُرَمَاءِ بِرِضَاهُمْ
رَوَى اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ عَلَيْهِ
دَيْنٌ فَيَضْمَنُهُ ضَامِنٌ لِلْغُرَمَاءِ قَالَ «إِذَا رَضِيَ اَلْغُرَمَاءُ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ ذِمَةُ ٱَلْمَيَّتِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.5 p.99 • Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.25 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.189 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.225 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.6 p.187 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.167 • Al- Wafi, Vol.18 p.790 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.346 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.422 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.426

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A SOLD ITEM THAT REMAINS INTACT
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj from one of our
companions from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, regarding a man who sold merchandise to another
man.
The buyer took possession of the merchandise but did not pay the price, and then the
buyer died while the merchandise was still in its original form.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the merchandise remains in its original state, it should be returned
to the seller, and the creditors have no right to dispute over it."
text_ar:
بَابُ الْمَبِيع إِذَا كَانَ قَائِما بِعَيْنِهِ وَ مَاتَ الْمُشْتَرِي وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ وَ ثَمَنُ الْمَبِيعِ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي
رَجُلٍ بَاعَ مَتَاعاً مِنْ رَجُلٍ فَقَبَضَ الْمُشتَرِي الْمَتَاعَ وَ لَمْ يَدْفَعِ الثَّمَنَ ثُمَّ مَاتَ الْمُشتَرِي وَ الْمَتَاعُ قَائِمٌ بِعَيْنِهِ فَقَالَ
«إِذَا كَانَ الْمَتَاعُ قَائِماً بِعَيْنِهِ رُدَّ إِلَى صَاحِبِ الْمَتَاعِ وَ لَيْسَ لِلْغُرَمَاءِ أَنْ يُخَاصِمُوهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.24 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.225 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.166 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.116 • Al-Wafi, Vol.18 p.821 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.18 p.414

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON SETTLING DEBT FROM BLOOD MONEY
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya Al-Azraq narrated from Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, regarding a man
who was killed while owing a debt and left behind no wealth.
His family took the blood money (diyyah) from his killer.
Should they use it to settle his debt?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: “Even though he left nothing behind?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "They took his blood money, so they must use it to settle his debt."
text_ar:
بَابُ قَضَاءِ الدَّيْنِ مِنَ الدِّيَةِ
رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْأَزْرَقُ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُقْتَلُ وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ وَ لَمْ يَثرُك
مَالا فَأَخَذَ أَهْلُهُ الدِّيَةَ مِنْ قَاتِلِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَقْضُوا دَيْنَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ وَ هُوَ لَمْ يَثرُك شَيْئاً قَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَخَذُوا دِيَتَهُ
فَعَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَقْضُوا دَيْنَهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE DISAPPROVAL OF APPOINTING A
text_en:
Al-Sakuni narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} from his
father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon
them, who said that the Commander of the Faithful {a.s} said:
"A woman should not be appointed as an executor of a will because Allah {SWT}, the
Almighty and Glorious, says: "And do not give the weak-minded your wealth” (Surah
An-Nisa 4:5)."
text_ar:
بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْوَصِيَّةِ إِلَى الْمَرْأَةِ
رَوَى السِّكُونِيُ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
: «الْمَرْأَةُ لاَ يُوصَى إِلَيْهَا لِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ ٠ وَ لا تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ )

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE DISAPPROVAL OF APPOINTING A
text_en:
In another narration, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, was
asked about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Glorious:
"And do not give the weak-minded your wealth." (Qur'an 4:5).
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not give it to one who drinks alcohol or to women."
Then Imam {a.s} added: "And who is more foolish than a person who drinks alcohol?"

Scholar's Note:
The author of this book, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, commented:

someone appoints her, she must fulfill the responsibility of the will as instructed. It is
also permissible to appoint her for certain matters of the will, if Allah {SWT}, the Exalted,
wills.
text_ar:
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ »وَ لا تُوْتُوا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوْالَكُمُ» قَالَ
«لا ثُوثُوهَا شَارِبَ الْخَمْرِ وَ لاَ النِّسَاءَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ »وَ أَيّ سَفِيهِ أَسْفَهُ مِنْ شَارِبِ الْخَمْرِ».
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ إِنَّمَا يَعْنِي كَرَاهَةَ اخْتِيَارِ الْمَرْأَةِ لِلْوَصِيَّةِ فَمَنْ أَوْصَى إِلَيْهَا لَزِمَهَا الْقِيَامُ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ عَلَى مَا
تُوْمَرُ بِهِ وَ يُوصَى إِلَيْهَا فِيهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى.

text_chunk:
In another narration, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, was
asked about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Glorious:
"And do not give the weak-minded your wealth." (Qur'an 4:5).
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not give it to one who drinks alcohol or to women."
Then Imam {a.s} added: "And who is more foolish than a person who drinks alcohol?" Scholar's Note:

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE OBLIGATION OF THE EXECUTOR
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him, wrote
to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s}, asking:
“A man was the executor of another man's will, and then he died and appointed
another man as his executor. Is the second executor obligated to fulfill the will of the
man for whom the first executor was appointed?"
Imam {a.s} wrote in response: "He is obligated by his right if there is a rightful claim upon
him, if Allah {SWT} wills."
text_ar:
بَابٌ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَى وَصِيّ الْوَصِيَّ مِنَ الْقِيَامِ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ
كَتَبَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : رَجُلْ كَانَ
وَصِيَّ رَجُلٍ فَمَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى إِلَى رَجَلٍ آخَرَ هَلْ يَلْزَمُ ٱلْوَصِيَّ وَصِيَّةُ الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي كَانَ هَذَا وَصِيَّهُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
«يَلْزَمُهُ بِحَقَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ قِبَلَهُ حَقُّ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.226 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.215 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.174 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.402

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO BEQUEATHS A PORTION
text_en:
Asim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who bequeathed a portion of his wealth - a third or a
fourth - to another man. Then, the man (the testator) was mistakenly killed.
Imam {a.s} said: "The will is to be executed from his wealth and from his blood money
(diyyah)."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجْلٍ يُوصِي مِنْ مَالِهِ بِشَيْءِ لِرَجُلٍ ثُمَّ يُقْتَلُ خَطَأً
رَوَى عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسِ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلْ أَوْصَى لِرَجُلٍ بِوَصِيَّةِ مِنْ مَالِهِ ثُلُثٍ أَوْ رُبُعٍ
فَيُقْتَلُ الرَّجُلُ خَطَأْ يَعْنِي الْمُوصِيَ فَقَالَ « تُجَازُ لِهَذَا الْوَصِيَّةُ مِنْ مَالِهِ وَ مِنْ دِيَتِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.63 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.227 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.207 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.57 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.285

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO BEQUEATHS A PORTION
text_en:
In another narration, Abu Abdullah {a.s}, was asked about a man who had
bequeathed one-third of his wealth and was then killed by mistake.
Imam {a.s} said: "One-third of his blood money (diyyah) is included in his bequest."
text_ar:
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلَ خَطَأْ قَالَ «ثُلُثْ
دِيَتِهِ دَاخِلْ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.227 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.58

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO APPOINTS ANOTHER AS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad Al-'Asimi from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Mithami from
Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf from Mathanna ibn Al-Walid from Muhammad ibn Muslim
from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who was asked about a man who appointed another man as
the guardian over his children and their wealth. He also permitted him, in his will, to
invest the wealth with the profit being shared between him and the children.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in that because their father had granted him
permission to do so while he was alive."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي إِلَى رَجُلٍ بِوُلْدِهِ وَ مَالٍ لَهُمْ وَ أَذِنَ لَهُ عِنْدَ الْوَصِيَّةِ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِالْمَالِ وَ
الرِّبْحُ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَهُمْ
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُلَيْنِيُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ الْعَاصِمِيُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ
الْمِيثَمِيَّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يُوسُفَ عَنْ مُثَنَّى بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ :
أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ بِوُلْدِهِ وَ مَالٍ لَهُمْ وَ أَذِنَ لَهُ عِنْدَ الْوَصِيَّةِ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِالْمَالِ وَ يَكُونُ الرِّبْحُ بَيْنَهُ وَ
بَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ قَدْ أَذِنَ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ وَ هُوَ حَيّ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.62 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.227 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.236 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.91 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.427

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO APPOINTS ANOTHER AS THE GUARDIAN OF HIS CHILDREN AND THEIR WEALTH, PERMITTING
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Abdur Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj from Khalid Al-
Taweel, who said: My father called me when death approached him and said:
“O’ my son, take charge of your younger brothers' wealth, invest it, take half of the
profit for yourself, and give them the other half. You are not liable for any loss."
After my father's death, my father's concubine brought me before Ibn Abi Layla and
said:
“This man is consuming the wealth of my children."
I explained to him what my father had instructed me to do.
Ibn Abi Layla said: “If your father commanded you with something invalid, I will not
permit it." Then he had me testify that if I used the wealth, I would be liable for it.
Later, I went to Abu Abdullah {a.s}, and narrated my story to him.
I then asked: “What do you say about this matter?"
Imam {a.s} said: "As for the ruling of Ibn Abi Layla, I cannot overturn it. But as for what is
between you and Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Glorious, you are not liable."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَاجِ عَنْ خَالِدِ الطَّوِيلِ قَالَ : دَعَانِي أَبِي حِينَ حَضَرَثْهُ
اَلْوَفَاةُ فَقَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ اِقْبِض مَالَ إِخْوَتِكَ الصِّغَارِ وَ اِعْمَلْ بِهِ وَ خَذْ نِصْفَ الرِّبْحِ وَ أَعْطِهِمُ النَّصْفَ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ
ضَمَانْ فَقَدَّمَثْنِي أُمْ وَلَدِ أَبِي بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ أَبِي إِلَى اِبْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ هَذَا يَأْكُلُ أَمْوَالَ وُلْدِي قَالَ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ
مَا أَمَرَنِي بِهِ أَبِي فَقَالَ اِبْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى إِنْ كَانَ أَبُوكَ أَمَرَكَ بِالْبَاطِلِ لَمْ أَجِزْهُ ثُمَّ أَشهَدَ عَلَيْ اِبْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى إِنْ أَنَا حَرَّكْتُهُ
فَأَنَا لَهُ ضَامِنَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ بَعْدُ فَاقْتَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ قِصَّتِي ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا تَرَى فَقَالَ «أَمًّا
قَوْلُ اِبْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَلاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ رَدَّهُ وَ أَمَّا فِيمَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ ضَمَانٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.61 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.228 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.91 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.427

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF DEBT BY A
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Isma'il ibn Jabir,
who said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a man who, while ill and in debt,
acknowledged a right for one of his heirs.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is permissible if what he acknowledged is less than one-third (of his
wealth)."
text_ar:
بَابٌ إِقْرَارِ الْمَرِيضِ لِلْوَارِثِ بِدَيْنِ
رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَقَرَّ لِوَارِثِ لَهُ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ بِدَيْنٍ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «يَجُوزُ إِذَا كَانَ الَّذِي أَقَرَّ بِهِ دُونَ الثُلُثِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.42 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.228 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.160 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.112 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.161 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.292

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF DEBT BY A
text_en:
Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
‘I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who acknowledges a debt to one of his heirs.’
Imam {a.s} said: "It is permissible if he is solvent (financially capable)."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى حَمَّادْ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يُقِرُّ لِوَارِثِ بِدَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ
«يَجُوزُ إِذَا كَانَ مَلِيّا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.41 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.229 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.159 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.111 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.159 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.292

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF DEBT BY A
text_en:
Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
‘I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a man who, in his will, acknowledged a debt to one of
his heirs.’
Imam {a.s} said: "If the deceased was in a sound state of health, then give him what was
bequeathed to him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ قَالَ : سَألْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى
لبَغْضٍ وَرَثَتِهِ بِأْنَّ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ دَيْناً فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْمَيِّتُ مَرْضِيّاً فَأْعْطِهِ الَذِي أَوْصَى لَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.41 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.229 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.159 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.111 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.160 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.291 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.183

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF DEBT BY A SICK PERSON IN FAVOR OF AN HEIR
text_en:
Ali ibn Al-Nu'man narrated from Ibn Muskan from Al-'Alaa, the seller of sabiri
(a type of cloth), who said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a woman who entrusted a
man with some wealth. When death approached her, she said to him, "The wealth I
gave you belongs to so-and-so," and then the woman passed away.
Her heirs came to the man and said: “Our relative had wealth, and we believe it is with
you. Swear to us that you have nothing of hers." Should he swear to them?
Imam {a.s} said: "If she was trustworthy in his view, then he should swear. But if she was
suspect, then he should not swear and should leave the matter as it is. Indeed, she
only has a right to one-third of her wealth."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بَيَّاعِ السَّابِرِيِّ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
عَنِ اِمْرَأَةِ اِسْتَوْدَعَتْ رَجُلاً مَالاً فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهَا الْمَوْتُ قَالَتْ لَهُ إِنَّ الْمَالَ الَّذِي دَفَعْتُهُ إِلَيْكَ لِفُلاَنَةَ وَ مَاتَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ
فَأَتَى أَوْلِيَاوُهَا الرَجُلَ وَ قَالُوا إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِصَاحِبَتِنَا مَالٌ لاَ نَرَاهُ إِلاّ عِنْدَكَ فَاحْلِفْ لَنَا مَا قِبَلَكَ شَيْءُ أَفَيَحْلِفُ لَهُمْ فَقَالَ
«إِنْ كَانَتْ مَأُمُونَةً عِنْدَهُ فَلْيَحْلِفُ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُتَّهَمَةً فَلاَ يَحْلِفُ وَ يَضَعُ الْأَمْرَ عَلَى مَا كَانَ فَإِنَّمَا لَهَا مِنْ مَالِهَا ثُلْثُهُ».

text_chunk:
Ali ibn Al-Nu'man narrated from Ibn Muskan from Al-'Alaa, the seller of sabiri
(a type of cloth), who said: I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, about a woman who entrusted a
man with some wealth. When death approached her, she said to him, "The wealth I
gave you belongs to so-and-so," and then the woman passed away.
Her heirs came to the man and said: “Our relative had wealth, and we believe it is with
you. Swear to us that you have nothing of hers." Should he swear to them?
Imam {a.s} said: "If she was trustworthy in his view, then he should swear. But if she was
suspect, then he should not swear and should leave the matter as it is. Indeed, she
only has a right to one-third of her wealth."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF
text_en:
Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, regarding a man who died and left behind a slave. One of his children
testified that their father had freed the slave.
Imam {a.s} said: "His testimony is accepted, and he is not held financially responsible.
However, the slave must work to compensate the share that belonged to the other
heirs."
text_ar:
بَابُ إِقْرَارٍ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ بِعِثْقٍ أَوْ دَيْنِ
رَوَى يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ : فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ عَبْداً فَشَهِدَ
بَعْضُ وُلْدِهِ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَعْتَقَهُ فَقَالَ «تَجُوزُ عَلَيْهِ شَهَادَتُهُ وَ لا يُفْرَمُ وَ يُسْتَسْعَى الْعُلامُ فِيمَا كَانَ لِغَيْرِهِ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.42 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.230 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.163 • Al-Wafi, Vol.25 p.944 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.323

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn ibn
Uthman from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, regarding a man who died, and
some of his heirs acknowledged a debt owed by the deceased to another man.
Imam {a.s} said: "That acknowledgment is binding upon the share of the one who made
the acknowledgment."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ وَ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ فَأَقَرَّ بَعْضُ وَرَثَتِهِ لِرَجُلٍ بِدَيْنٍ فَقَالَ «يَلْزَمُهُ ذَلِكَ فِي جصَّتِهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF
text_en:
In another narration: "If two of the heirs testify and they are both just, their
testimony is accepted and binding upon all the heirs. However, if they are not just, the
obligation is only enforced upon their respective shares."
text_ar:
وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ : «أَنَّهُ إِذَا شَهِدَ اِثْنَانِ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ وَ كَانَا عَدْلَيْنِ أُجِيزَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْوَرَثَةِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُونَا
عَذلَيْنٍ ألْزِمَا ذَلِكَ فِي جصَّتِهِمَا».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON A MAN WHO DIES WHILE IN DEBT AND
text_en:
Ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti narrated through his chain of transmission that he
was asked about a man who dies, leaving behind a family while owing a debt. Should
his family be provided for from his wealth?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is certain that the debt encompasses all of his wealth, then nothing
should be spent on them. However, if it is not certain, then they should be provided for
moderately from his wealth."
text_ar:
بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ وَ لَهُ عِيَالْ
رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي نَصْرِ الْبَرَّنْطِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَمُوتُ وَ يَثْرُكُ عِيَالاً وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَيُنْفَقُ عَلَيْهِمْ
مِنْ مَالِهِ قَالَ «إِنِ اسْتُوقِنَ أَنَّ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ يُحِيطُ بِجَمِيعِ ٱلْمَالِ فَلَاَ يُنْفَقُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُسْتَيْقَنْ فَلْيُنْفَقَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ
وَسَطِ اَلْمَالِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.43 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.230 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.164 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.115 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.157 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.332

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
narrated from Humayd ibn Ziyad from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from
Abdullah ibn Jabalah and others from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Basir from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
"Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, freed the worst of his servants at the
time of his death and kept the best of them.
I (Al-Sadiq {a.s}) said to him (Al-Baqir {a.s}): 'O’ my father, you are freeing these and
keeping those?'
He (Al Baqir {a.s}) replied: ‘‘They have suffered beatings from me, so this is to balance
that (their wrongdoings).'"
text_ar:
بَابُ نَوَادِرِ الْوَصَايَا
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُلَيْنِيُ رَضِيَ اللّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : «أَعْتَقَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مِنْ غِلْمَانِهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ شِرَارَهُمْ وَ أَمْسَكَ خِيَارَهُمْ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا أَبَتِ تُعْتِقُ هَؤُلاءِ وَ ثُمْسِكُ هَؤْلاَءِ فَقَالَ
«إِنَّهُمْ قَدْ أَصَابُوا مِنِّي ضَرْباً فَيَكُونُ هَذَا بِهَذَا» ».

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa’ narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Umar ibn
Yazid from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
"Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s}, fell ill three times, and in each illness, he would make a
will. When he recovered, he would carry out his will."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ : «مَرِضَ عَلِيُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلامُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَضَاتٍ فِي كُلِّ مَرْضَةٍ يُوصِي بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَإِذَا أَفَاقَ أَمْضَى
وَصِيَّتَهُ»،

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr and Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abdur Rahman ibn Al-
Hajjaj, who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s} about what people say regarding making a
will for one-third or one-fourth of one's wealth at the time of death. Is this something
correct and well-known, or how did your father {a.s} handle this matter?
Imam {a.s} replied: "The one-third is what my father {a.s}, peace be upon him, practiced."
text_ar:
5550 رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ صَفَوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ الرّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَاجِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ
اَلسَّلَاَمُ عَمَّا يَقُولُ النَّاسُ فِي الْوَصِيَّةِ بِالثُلُثِ وَ الرُّبُعِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَ شَيْءَ صَجِيحْ مَعْرُوفٌ أَمْ كَيْفَ صَنَعَ أَبُوكَ فَقَالَ
«الثُلُثُ ذَلِكَ الَّذِي صَنَعَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.55 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.41 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.272

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ibrahim ibn Abdul Hamid from
Salma, the servant of the children of Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
“I was with Abu Abdullah {a.s}, when death approached Him {a.s}, and he fell
unconscious.
When He {a.s} regained consciousness, He {a.s} said:
“Give Hasan ibn Ali ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn (who was known as Al-Aftas) 'seventy
dinars.'”
I said: “Will you give to a man who once raised a blade against you?"
Imam {a.s} replied: “Woe to you! Do you not read the Qur'an?"
I said: “Yes."
Imam {a.s} said: “Have you not heard the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious:
'And those who join that which Allah {SWT} has commanded to be joined and fear their
Lord {AZJ} and dread the terrible reckoning'"
(Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:21).
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَلْمَى مَوْلاةٍ وَلَدِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَتْ : كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جِينَ حَضَرَتْهُ ٱلْوَفَاةُ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَا أَفَاقَ قَالَ «أَعْطُوا ٱلْحَسَنَ بْنَ
عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ » وَ هُوَ ٱلْأَقْطَسُ «سَبْعينَ دِينَارا» قُلْتُ أَثْغْطِي رَجُلاً حَمَلَ عَلَيْكَ بِالشَّفْرَةِ فَقَالَ »وَيُحَكِ
أَمَا تَقْرَءِينَ الْقُرْآنَ » قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَ «أَمَا سَمِعْتِ قَوْلَ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ) وَ آلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ
وَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَ يَخْافُونَ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.2 p.209 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.231 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.246 • Mishkat Al-Anwar, Vol.1 p.166 • Fiqh Al-Quran, Vol.2 p.320 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.417 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.248 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.2 p.494 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.14 p.137

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ammar ibn Marwan, who said:
“I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}: 'My father was on his deathbed, and I said to him, "Make a
will."
He (my father) said, "This is my son," referring to Umar, "whatever he does is valid."'
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "Your father has indeed made a will and done so concisely."
I said: 'He also instructed and willed to give you such and such.'
Imam {a.s} said: "Approve it."
I said: 'He made a bequest to free a believing and knowledgeable soul, but when we
emancipated her, it became evident that she was not of proper lineage.'
Imam {a.s} said: "It has fulfilled his obligation. The example of this is like a man who buys
a sacrificial animal thinking it is fat, but then finds it to be thin. It still suffices for him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إنَّ أَبِي حَضَرَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ
فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَوْصِ فَقَالَ هَذَا اِبْنِي يَعْنِي عُمَرَ فَمَا صَنَعَ فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «فَقَدْ أَوْصَى أَبُوكَ وَ
أَوْجَزَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ أَمَرَ وَ أَوْصَى لَكَ بِكَذَا وَ كَذَا فَقَالَ «أَجِزْ » قُلْتُ فَأَوْصَى بِنَسَمَةٍ مُوْمِنَةٍ عَارِفَةٍ فَلَمَّا أَعْتَقْنَاهَا
بَانَ أَنَّهَا لِغَيْرِ رِشدَةٍ فَقَالَ «قَدْ أَجْزَأَثْ عَنْهُ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ ذَلِكَ مَثَلُ رَجُلِ اِشْتَرَى أُضْحِيَّةً عَلَى أَنْهَا سَمِينَةٌ فَوَجَدَهَا
مَهْزُولَةً فَقَدْ أَجْزَأَتْ عَنْهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.62 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.118
text_chunk:
Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ammar ibn Marwan, who said:
“I said to Abu Abdullah {a.s}: 'My father was on his deathbed, and I said to him, "Make a
will."
He (my father) said, "This is my son," referring to Umar, "whatever he does is valid."'
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "Your father has indeed made a will and done so concisely."
I said: 'He also instructed and willed to give you such and such.'
Imam {a.s} said: "Approve it."
I said: 'He made a bequest to free a believing and knowledgeable soul, but when we
emancipated her, it became evident that she was not of proper lineage.'
Imam {a.s} said: "It has fulfilled his obligation. The example of this is like a man who buys
a sacrificial animal thinking it is fat, but then finds it to be thin. It still suffices for him."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Malik, who said:
‘I wrote to Imam {a.s} - meaning Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s} - about a man who
died and had, during his lifetime, given everything he owned to you.
He had no children at the time, but later he had a child. His total wealth amounted to
three thousand dirhams, and I have sent you one thousand dirhams.
If you see fit, may Allah {SWT} make me your sacrifice, kindly inform me of your opinion
so I may act accordingly.’
Imam {a.s} wrote in response: "Release it to them (the surviving children)."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ الْحِمْيَرِيَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَالِكِ قَالَ : كَتَبْتُ إلَيْهِ يَعْنِي عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ رَجُلٌ مَاتَ وَ جَعَلَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فِي حَيَاتِهِ لَكَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَصَابَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَلَداً وَ مَبْلَغُ مَالِهِ ثَلاَثَةُ
آَلْآَفِ دِرْهَمِ وَ قَدْ بَعَثُتُ إِلَيْكَ بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمِ فَإِنْ رَأَيْتَ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ أَنْ تُعْلِمَنِي رَأْيَكَ لِأَعْمَلَ بِهِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلام «أَطلِق لَهُم».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.59 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.232 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.189 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.124 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.180 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.280

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, who said:
“I wrote to Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s} asking about a man who allocated
something from his wealth for you - may Allah {SWT} make me your sacrifice - but later
found himself in need of it. Should he take it back for himself or still send it to you?”
Imam {a.s} replied: "He has the choice in this matter as long as he has not handed it
over. And if it were to reach us, we would consider supporting him with it since he is
now in need."
He (Muhammad ibn Isa) further wrote to Imam {a.s}, asking about a man who made a
will, designating something specific from his wealth for you - may Allah {SWT} make me
your sacrifice - and also bequeathed portions to his relatives from his father's and
mother's side. Then he altered the will, depriving those he had initially granted and
granting to those he had initially deprived. Is this permissible for him?
Imam {a.s} wrote in response: "He has full discretion in all of this until death approaches
him."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُلَيْنِيُ رَضِيَ اللّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدِ
قَالَ : كَتَبْتُ إِلَى عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ رَجْلُ جَعَلَ لَكَ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ شَيْئاً مِنْ مَالِهِ ثُمَّ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَيْهِ أ
يَأْخُذُهُ لِنَفْسِهِ أَوْ يَبْعَثُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ فَقَالَ «هُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ فِي ذَلِكَ مَا لَمْ يُخْرِجْهُ عَنْ يَدِهِ وَ لَوْ وَصَلَ إِلَيْنَا لَرَأْيْنَا أَنْ نُوَاسِيَهُ
بِهِ وَ قَدِ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَيْهِ» قَالَ وَ كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ أَوْصَى لَكَ جَعَلَنِي آللّهُ فِدَاكَ بِشَيْءٍ مَعْلُومٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ وَ أَوْصَى لِأَقْرِبَائِهِ
مِنْ قِبَلِ أَبِيهِ وَ أَمِّهِ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ غَيَّرَ الْوَصِيَّةَ فَحَرَمَ مَنْ أَعْطَى وَ أَعْطَى مَنْ حَرَمَ أَيَجُوزُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
«هُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ إِلَى أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.232

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Isa Al-Ubaydi narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:
“I asked Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s}, about a man who bequeathed one-third of
his wealth after his death, saying, "My one-third after my death is to be divided among
my male and female servants."
This man also had servants inherited from his father. Should the servants of his father
be included in this bequest, being considered part of his servants, or should they not
be included?
Imam {a.s} wrote in response: "They are not to be included."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيُ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الْعَسْكَرِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ رَجُلِ
أَوْصَى بِثُلْثِهِ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ فَقَالَ ثُلْتِي بَعْدَ مَوْتِي بَيْنَ مَوَالِيَّ وَ مَوْلَيَاتِي وَلِأَبِيهِ مَوَالٍ يُدْخَلُونَ مَوَالِي أَبِيهِ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ
بِمَا يُسَمَّوْنَ مَوَالِيَهُ أَمْ لاَ يُدْخَلُونَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لاَ يُدْخَلُونَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.233 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.215 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.153 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.401

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated, saying: Muhammad ibn Isa
reported from Muhammad ibn Muhammad that Ali ibn Bilal wrote to Abu Al-Hasan,
meaning Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s}, regarding a Jew who passed away. The
Jew had made a will assigning something to his creditor.
Ali ibn Bilal asked: 'Am I permitted to take it and give it to your followers, or should I
execute the bequest as the Jew had specified?'
Imam {a.s} wrote in response: 'Send it to me and inform me about it so that I may execute
it in the proper manner, if Allah {SWT} wills.'"
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ كَتَبَ عَلِيْ بْنُ
بِلآلِ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ يَعْنِي عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : يَهُودِيٌّ مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى لِدُيَّانِهِ بِشَيْءٍ أَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَخْذِهِ هَلْ
بَجُوزُ أَنْ آخْذَهُ فَأَدْفَعَهُ إِلَى مَوَالِيكَ أَوْ أَنْفِذُهُ فِيمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ الْيَهُودِيّ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «أوْصِلْهُ إِلَيَ وَ عَرِّفْنِيهِ
الأَنْفِذَهُ فِيمَا يَنْبَغِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.233

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Al-Sakuni narrated through his chain of transmission that the Commander of
the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who, on his deathbed,
confessed;
"So-and-so and so-and-so each have a claim of one thousand dirhams against me,"
and then he died in that state.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever among them provides evidence has the right to the money.
But if neither of them provides evidence, the money is to be divided equally between
them."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى السَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ : فِي رَجْلٍ أَقَرَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ فَقَالَ لِفُلاَنِ وَ
فَلاَنٍ لِأَحَدِهِمَا عِنْدِي ألْفُ دِرْهَمِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَلَى تِلْكَ ٱلْحَالِ فَقَالَ «أَيُهُمَا أَقَامَ الْبَيِّنَةَ فَلَهُ ٱلْمَالُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُقِمْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمَا
الْبَيَّنَةَ فَالْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.58 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.233 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.162 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.162 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.323 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.23 p.183

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated from Ahmad ibn Hamzah, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: 'In our town, sometimes people bequeath wealth to the family of
Muhammad {saws}, and they bring it to me. However, I hesitate to deliver it to you until I
seek your permission.'
Imam {a.s} replied: "Do not bring it to me, and do not involve yourself with it."
text_ar:
5558 رَوَى عَلِيْ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ حَمْرَةَ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ فِي بَلَدِنَا رُبَّمَا أُوصِيَ بِالْمَالِ، لآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
فَيَأْتُونِّي بِهِ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَحْمِلَهُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّى أُسْتَأْمِرَكَ فَقَالَ «لا تَأْتِنِي بِهِ وَ لا تَعَرَّضْ لَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.58 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.234 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.180 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.429

Imam {a.s} replied: "Do not bring it to me, and do not involve yourself with it."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said: ‘A man bequeathed thirty dinars to the descendants of
Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her. The man brought the money to Abu Abdullah
{a.s}, who said:
“Give it to such-and-such an elder from the descendants of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a},
peace be upon her," and that man was poor and struggling to provide for his family.
The man responded: "But the deceased specifically bequeathed it to the descendants
of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}."
Abu Abdullah {a.s} replied: “It will not have the same impact on the descendants of
Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a} in general, but it will have a meaningful impact on this man, for
he has a family to support."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : أَوْصَى رَجُلٌ بِثَلاَثِينَ
دِينَاراً لِوُلْدِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلامُ قَالَ فَأْنَى بِهَا الرَّجُلُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
«إِذْقَعْهَا إِلَى فُلاَنٍ شَيْخٍ مِنْ وُلْدِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ» وَ كَانَ مُعِيلاً مُقِلا فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ إِنَّمَا أَوْصَى بِهَا الرَّجُلُ
لِوُلْدِ فَاطِمَةَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنَّهَا لا تَقَعُ مِنْ وُلْدِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ وَ هِيَ تَقَعُ مِنْ هَذَا ٱلرَّجُلِ وَ
لَهُ عِيَالٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.58 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.234 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.180 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.430
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said: ‘A man bequeathed thirty dinars to the descendants of
Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her. The man brought the money to Abu Abdullah
{a.s}, who said:
“Give it to such-and-such an elder from the descendants of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a},
peace be upon her," and that man was poor and struggling to provide for his family.
The man responded: "But the deceased specifically bequeathed it to the descendants
of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}."
Abu Abdullah {a.s} replied: “It will not have the same impact on the descendants of
Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a} in general, but it will have a meaningful impact on this man, for
he has a family to support."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Ibn Faddal narrated from Ali ibn Uqbah from Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, who said: I said to Imam {a.s}: "A man appointed me as his executor, and I
asked him to appoint a relative of his to share the responsibility with me, and he
agreed. The one who appointed me mentioned that the co-executor owed him one
hundred and fifty dirhams and that he had a silver cup as collateral for this debt. When
the man passed away, the co-executor began to claim that he was owed sacks of
wheat instead."
Abu Abdullah {a.s}, said: "If he brings proof, then his claim is valid; otherwise, he has no
right to anything."
I asked: “Is it permissible for him to take anything from what is in his possession?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is not permissible for him."
I then asked: “What if someone wrongfully took his wealth, and he found the
opportunity to take back from that person's wealth the equivalent of what was taken
from him - would that be permissible?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "This is not the same as that."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ
رَجُلاً أَوْصَى إلَيَّ فَسَأَلْتُهُ أَنْ يُشِرِكَ مَعِي ذَا قَرَابَةٍ لَهُ فَفَعَلَ وَ ذَكَرَ الَّذِي أَوْصَى إلَيَّ أَنَّ لَهُ قِبَلَ الَّذِي أَشرَكَهُ فِي
الْوَصِيَّةِ خَمْسِينَ وَ مِائَةً دِزْهَمِ وَ عِنْدَهُ رَهْنٌ بِهَا جَامُ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَلَمَا هَلَكَ الرَّجُلُ أَنْشَأَ الْوَصِيُّ يَدَّعِي أَنَّ لَهُ قِبَلَهُ
أكْرَارَ جِنْطَةٍ قَالَ «إِنْ أَقَامَ الْبَيِّنَةَ وَ إِلَّ فَلاَ شَيْءَ لَهُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أ يَجِلُ لَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِمَّا فِي يَدِهِ شَيْئاً قَالَ «لا
يَحِلُ لَهُ» قُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجْلاً اِعْتَدَى عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ مَالَهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَى أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا أَخَذَ أَ يَحِلُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ
فَقَالَ «إِنَّ هَذَا لَيْسَ مِثْلَ هَذَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.57 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.234 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.173 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.428

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab narrated from Abdullah ibn
Habib from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who had dinars with me and was ill. He said to me, "If
something happens to me, give so-and-so twenty dinars and give the remainder of the
dinars to my sister."
The man passed away, and I was not present at his death.
Then, a truthful Muslim man came to me and said: “He instructed me to tell you: Look
at the dinars I told you to give to my sister and give ten of them in charity, distributing
them among the Muslims." His sister was unaware that I had anything of his.
Imam {a.s} said: "I see that you should give ten dinars in charity as he instructed."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ : سَألْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ عِنْدِي دَنَانِيرُ وَ كَانَ مَرِيضاً فَقَالَ لِي إِنْ حَدَثَ بِي حَدَثْ فَأُغْطِ فُلاَناً
عِشرِينَ دِينَاراً وَ أَعْطِ أُخْتِي بَقِيَّةَ الدَّنَانِيرِ فَمَاتَ وَ لَمْ أَشْهَدْ مَوْتَهُ فَأَتَى رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ صَادِقٌ فَقَالَ لِي إِنَّهُ أَمَرَنِي
أَنْ أَقُولَ لَكَ أنظُرْ إِلَى الدَّنَانِيرِ الَّتِي أَمَرْتُكَ أَنْ تَدْفَعَهَا إِلَى أَخَتِي فَتَصَدَّقُ مِنْهَا بِعَشَرَةِ دَنَانِيرَ اِقْسِمْهَا فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ
وَ لَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَخْتُهُ أَنَّ عِنْدِي شَيْئاً فَقَالَ «أَرَى أَنْ تَصَدَّقَ مِنْهَا بِعَشَرَةِ دَنَانِيرَ كَمَا قَالَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.64 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.235 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.237 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.77 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.433

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa from
Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar ibn Marwan from Sama'ah ibn Mehran from Abu
Abdullah {a.s}, regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Glorious: "The will is
for the parents and close relatives in a fair manner; it is an obligation upon the
righteous" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:180).
Imam {a.s} said: "This is something that Allah {SWT}, the Almighty and Glorious, has
designated for the one who holds this matter (referring to the rightful authority)."
I asked: “Is there a set limit for this?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
I asked: “What is it?"
Imam {a.s} said: "The minimum is one-third of one-third."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بَنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ
سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلّ • الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلَوالِدَيْنِ وَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ
بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ ) قَالَ «هُوَ شَيْءَ جَعَلَهُ اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ لِصَاجِبِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ» قُلْتُ فَهَلْ لِذَلِكَ حَدْ
قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا هُوَ قَالَ « أَدْنَى مَا يَكُونُ ثُلُثُ الثُلُثِ».
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.1 p.77 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.235 • Al-Wafi, Vol.10 p.363 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.380 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.380 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.100 p.200 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.2 p.231 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.14 p.142

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Dawud ibn Al-Nu'man from Al-
Fudayl, the servant of Abu Abdullah {a.s}, from Abu Abdullah {a.s}, who said:
"The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, had four
of the great angels witness his will to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Jibril, Mika'il, Israfil, and another whose name I do not remember."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ مَوْلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ : «أَشهَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى وَصِيَّتِهِ إِلَى عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْ عُظَمَاءِ
الْمَلائِكَةِ، جَبْرَئِيلَ وَ مِيكَائِيلَ وَ إِسْرَافِيلَ وَ آخَرَ لَمْ أَحْفَظِ اِسْمَهُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.36 • Ithbat Al-Huda, Vol.3 p.26

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
narrated from Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from Sulayman ibn Dawud from Ali
ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: "One of your followers passed away, leaving behind young children
and some wealth, but he also had a debt that his creditors are unaware of. If the debt
is paid, nothing will remain for his children."
Imam {a.s} said: "Spend it on his children."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُلَيْنِيُ رَضِيَ اللّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ
عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ : قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِنْ مَوَالِيكَ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ وُلْداً صِغَاراً
وَ تَرَكَ شَيْئاً وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ وَ لَيْسَ يَعْلَمُ بِهِ الْغُرَمَاءُ فَإِنْ قُضِيَ لِغُرَمَائِهِ بَقِيَ وُلْدُهُ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ شَيْءٌ فَقَالَ «أَنْفِقْهُ عَلَى
وُلَدِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.7 p.43 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.236 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.165 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.4 p.115 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.157 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.332

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who designates his slave for emancipation after his
death (mudabbar). Can he revoke this decision?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it is like a will."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يُدَبِّرُ مَمْلُوكَهُ أَلَهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فِيهِ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.236 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.225 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.75
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who designates his slave for emancipation after his
death (mudabbar). Can he revoke this decision?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it is like a will."

author: Shaykh al-Saduq
chapter_title: CHAPTER ON RARE CASES OF BEQUESTS
text_en:
Ali ibn Al-Hakam narrated from Ziyad ibn Abi Al-Hallal, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah {a.s}, whether the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace and blessings be
upon him and his family, had appointed Al-Hasan {a.s} and Al-Hussain {a.s}, peace be
upon them both, along with the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, in
his will.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
I asked: “Even though they were at that young age?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, and this would not be for anyone else under the age of five."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَلاَّلِ قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ هَلْ أَوْصَى إِلَى الْحَسَنِ وَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَلاَمُ مَعَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ « نَعَمْ»
قُلْتُ وَ هُمَا فِي ذَلِكَ السِّنَّ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لاَ يَكُونُ لِسِوَاهُمَا فِي أَقَلَ مِنْ خَمْسِ سِنِينَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.4 p.237 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.169 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.19 p.376
